tei:titleStmt.tei:title: pod 39 gsung 'bum/_tA ra nA tha/ （dpe bsdur ma/）

tei:div.tei:p: spyi khyab bsdu sgrig 'gan 'khur ba gtso bo/ gzan dkar thub bstan nyi ma/bsdu sgrig 'gan 'khur gzhon pa dang / gtso sgrig pa/ garma bde legs/gtso sgrig gzhon pa/ 'gro 'dul rdo rje/bsdu sgrig pa/ mun sel/ thub bstan nyi ma/ bstan 'dzin blo gros/zla ba bstan 'dzin/ shes rab bzang po/zhu dag dang dkar chag sgrig mkhan/ dpal ldan rgya mtsho/ phur pa phrin las/dkon mchog bsam gtan/ thub bstan nyi ma/ bstan pa dar rgyas/par sgrig lag rtsal pa/ tshe ring chos sgron/ shes rab dpal g.yang /bsod nams 'brug rgyas/
/ lo 7 57shes—

〈mes po'i shul bzhag〉 ces pa'i dpe tshogs 'di ni dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang gis bsgrigs shing 'di ga dpe skrun khang dang mnyam 'brel gyis bskrun pa'i dpe rnying dpe tshogs shig yin la/ de yang mkhas dbang gzan dkar rin po che thub bstan nyi ma mchog gis spyi'i gtso skyong gnang ste/ dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang gis nye ba'i lo bcu tsam gyi ring la 'bad brtson chen pos bod kyi sa gnas gang sar bzhugs pa'i bod yig dpe rnying po ti khrir longs pa rang byung dang mi'i gnod 'tshes 'jig la nye ba'i nyen kha las bskyabs te legs par bsgrigs shing dkar chag tu btab/ dpe thum gsol/ dpe sgrom bzhengs te srung skyob mdzad gnang ba dang gnang mus su yod pa ni/rang re'i mes po'i shul nor srung skyob rgyun 'dzin dang bod rig pa'i gal che'i dpyad gzhi mkho 'don gyi dgos pa che ba ma zad/ rang rgyal mi rigs rig gnas nor mdzod dar rgyas dang srung skyob bgyi ba'i 'phrin las gal chen zhig red/nye char dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang dang 'di ga dpe skrun khang gnyis zhib gros byas mthar/ srol rgyun rig gnas srung skyob dang bod rig pa'i dpyad yig myur skyob dang cha tshang du gtong ba'i dmigs yul ngos 'dzin gcib gyur thog 〈bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus〉 zhes pa'i dpe rnying dpe dkon gyi dpe tshogs chen mo zhig mu mthud nas legs sgrig dang dpe skrun byed bzhin yod pa dang / da char yang dmigs yul dgos pa gcig gyur thog 〈mes po'i shul bzhag〉 ces pa'i dpe rnying dpe dkon gal chen gyi dpe tshogs chen mo 'di nyid par skrun bya rgyu yin la/ de yang sngon byon mes po mkhas dbang dam pa du mas shul du bzhag pa'i gsung 'bum dpe dkon gal chen rnams dang / 'thar 'thor du bzhugs pa'i dpe dkon gal chen dag phyogs gcig tu bsdus te bsgrigs pa 'di'i nang don thad la/ nang don rig pa dang / gso ba rig pa/ tshad ma rig pa/ sgra rig pa/ bzo rig pa/ lo rgyus/ rtsis rig sogs bcu phrag rig pa'i gnas kun 'dus pa'i dpe dkon nor bu dgos 'dod kun 'byung lta bu zhig yin/

'a 'dra' dpe skrun mnyam las kya go skabs legs po nged cag dpe skrun khang la thob pa shan tu skal ba bzang zhing gzi brjid kyi 'os 'gan zhig tu brtsis te lo 'ga'i dpe skrun 'char gzhi gtso bo'i nang du bkod zin cing / las gzhi 'di la krung go'i bod rig pa zhib 'jug lte gnas kyi dbu khrid dang rgyal khab phyi nang gi bod rig pa'i mkhas dbang du mas gdeng 'jog dang mthong chen gyis skul ma yang thob/〈mes po'i shul bzhag〉 gi ma phyi phal cher ni dbu med brisarnying sha stag yin pas/ ma dpe gsal mi gsal dang skung yig mang zhid bris tshugs 'dra min gyi dbang gis klog dka' ba'ang shin tu mang po 'dug 'on kyang dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang gis lo mang ring nyams myong bsdu len dang mkhas dbang du mar bka' 'dri zhus par brten yig gzugs gsar rgyag dang phyogs sgrig thub pa byung / par shing du 'khod yod pa rnams kyang dpe rnying gzhan pa dang bsdur te gtan la phab yod pa bcas te zhib cha deb so so'i bsdu sgrig gsal bshad du gzigs par zhu/dpe rnying srung skyob dang phyogs sgrig dpe skrun gyi las ka 'di la rgyab skyor dang thugs khur gnang mkhan gyi mkhas dbang rnams dang / lhag par du krung ge'i bod rig pa zhib 'jug lte gnas kyi dbu khrid lhan rgyas dang / mkhas dbang thub bstan nyi ma rin po che mchog sogs kyis rgyab skyor dang mdzub ston gyi bka' drin bskyangs pa la snying thag pa nas thugs rje che zhu rgyu dang / dpal brtsegs zhib 'jug khang gi 'gan 'dzin pa lhan rgyas dang / zhu dag pa/ yig rgyag pa sogasamador na las gzhi 'di la lhag bsam dang 'bad brtson chen pos zhabs phyi zhu mkhan rnams la snying thag pa nas bka' drin che zhes zhu rgyu dang /dpe tshogs 'di'i dpe sgrig dang zhu dag thad la ha cang nan tan dang zhib tshags bgyi khul byas mod/'on kyang nga tshor shes tshad dman pa'i dbang gis nor 'chug mi nyung ba yod srid pas dpyod ldan dag gis nor bcos yo bsrang gi dgongs 'char lhug stsol gnang bar zhu zhu/zhes krung go'i bod rig pa dpe skrun khang nas/spyi lo 2007lo'i zla ba dang po'i tshes 10la/—2

de la 'dir rang cag kha ba can gyi khi 'dir chos rgyal lo paṇa rnams dang / sa dge bka' rnying sogs kyi mkhas shing grub pa brnyes pa'i dam pa'i skyes bu rnams kyis/ spyod sgrub kyi shing rta r+ṣa po bco brgyad rjes 'brang dang cas pa'i chos brgyud dang bka' srol mtha' dag dang / de dang rjes su 'brel ba'i thun mong gi rig gnas sum rtags snyan ngag mngon brjod sdeb sbyor/ skar rtsis khrung rtsis sgra tshad bzo gso sogs mdo sngags rig gnas dang bcas pa'i gzhung lugs zab cing rgya che ba tshang la ma nor ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig 'chad nyan 'gyur gsum dang / bshad sgrub las gsum gyi sgo nas thog mar srol gtad/bar du gto la phab/ rim bawo dar rgyas bto ba sogs 'dzin skyong spel bar mdzad pa'i bka' drin bdag rkyen la brten nas/ dbus gtsang khams gsum du bzhugs so cog gi glegs bam thams cad gcig tu spungs na ri rab lhun po'i gtos dang mnyam zhing / chos wo gyi rnam dbye ji snyed yod pa grangs su bgrangs na nam mkha'i gza' skar tshogs kyang skyengs par byed pa zhig mchis pa tsam du ma zad rgya bal hor sogs kyi yul gru kun chung dar khyab che/sgyu mi lag tsho 1)/ lag tsha zu milashe/ ༷re/ /ce) sgyurangatsho mid lta' char bad ga pa'am bad kya sa ga sa su grags pa 'ad nyad 'dzam gling shar nub kyi yul gru dag tsong mkho de/ dper na/ oka si phor dhi dang to wid lta bu yo rob dang / a ri sogs su grags wo gyi slob grwa r+pā mo —1—

rnams su bod yig gi dpe mdzod wo po yod par ma zad/ bod kyi chos dang rig gzhung slob gnyer byed sa'i sde tshan dang slob ma yang mi nyung ba yod/da ni gong du smras pa'i bshad sgrub shing rta chen po bco brgyad ces pa de gang dang gang yin pa'i ngo sprod mdo tsam zhu na/ de yang ji skad du/ 'jam mgon kong sprul rin po che'i zhal nas/ chos blon thon mi be+e ro ska cog zhang / /gnubs chen rin bzang rngog lo sa skya pa/ /bu ston bshad rgyun 'degs pa'i ka chen bcu// zhes dang bod yul sgrub brgyud shing rta chen po brgyad/ /rnying ma bka' gdams lam 'bras bka' brgyud pa/ shangs pa zhi byed sbyor drug bsnyen sgrub bo/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ shes bya'i gzhung lugs sna tshogs kyi 'gyur khyad dang 'chad tshul gyi dbye bas bshad rgyun 'degs pa'i ka chen bcu dang / sgrub pa nyams su len tshul la brgyud pa'i khyad par dang man ngag gi dbye bas sgrub brgyud 'dren pa'i shing rta brgyad de/ bshad sgrub shing rta chen po bco brgyad rjes 'brang dang bcas pa'i gsung rab rgya mtsho lta bu zhig bdag cag gi yab mes gong ma rnams kyis gces pa'i lus srog longs spyod thams cad phangs pa med par btang ste/ phyi rabs rang re'i brgyud 'dzin rnams la 'phran yun phan bde'i dpal la dmigs nas bzhag pa'i nor bu rin po che yid bzhin dbang gi rgyal po mtha' yas pa zhig mchis/de dag las mang che ba rig gsar lo bcu'i god chag chen po sogs dus kyi rgud pa'i dbang gis sems med 'byung bzhi'i 'jig pa dang / sems ldan mi dang mi min gyi gnod pas nyams nyes chen por gyur pa ni rgya bod yongs grags ltar lags/—2

rig gnas gsar brje'i mjug sgril ba dang chabs cig tang gi yang dag pa'i srid jus kyi nyi 'od slar yang 'phros te/ tang dang rgyal khab kyis 'go khrid dang rtsa 'dzugs gnang nas/ dpe rnying 'thor bsdu dang / legs sgrig dpe skrun/ sgyur spel sogs kyi sgo nas rang rigs kyi rig gnas nyams pa sor chud dang / mi nyams gong 'phel gyi bya bar so so'i 'khos bstun gyi sri zhu sgrub pa'i skal ba bzang po'i dpal la longs su spyad du yod pa'i skabs 'dir/ rang re'i yab mes rnams kyis bzhag pa'i pha nor mang po zhig da dung yang nged cag gi bsod nams kyi bgo skal du lhag yod pa rnams la gces spras chen pos srung skyob dang dar spel byed rgyu ni mes rgyal gyis gnang ba'i las 'gan yin par ma zad/ 'u cag bod kyi rig gnas slob gso'i bya bar legs skyes 'bul mkhan gyi rgan dar 'bring gsum gyi shes yon can la mtshon na/ rang re'i phrag par bab pa'i gzhan dring mi 'jog pa'i gzi 'od bla na 'bar ba'i 'os 'gan mchog tu gyur pa zhig kyang yin par sems/der brten/ phyogs dang ris su ma chad pa'i skyes bu dam pa rnams kyis ljags rtsom gnang ba'i gsung rab/ bshad sgrub shing rta bco brgyad las grub pa'i mdo sngags kyi gzhung bshad dang / chos 'byung dang gdan rabs/ rnam thar dang gsan yig brda sprod dang snyan ngag /rtsis dang gso rig sogs dpe dkon 'thor ba rnams bsdus/ chad pa rnams bsab/ nyams pa rnams garbe|sa/ 'khrugs pa rnams bsgrigs te dpe tshogs 'ga' rim pa bstar chags su par du bskrun pa dang bskrun rtsis las/—3

da lan 'dir jo nang rje bas tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum dpe bsdur ma'adi rgya che'i gzigs pa po rnams kyi spyan lam du phul ba yin/'byung char nga tsho'i dpe tshogs dpar skrun zhu rgyu'i skor la lheg bsam ldan zhing mkhyen spyan yangs pa'i mkhas dbang rnams kyis dgongs 'char gyi bka' slob stsol gnang dang / dpe dkon gyi ma phyi g.yar gnang gi skyabs 'jug yong ba macesan macesan/ /zhor 'phros gsal 'debs zhu ba/ lhag par du da lta lus kyi lang tsho rgyas shing sems kyi blo gros bkra ba'i ga'on skyes rnams la mtshon na/ snying pos dben pa'i kha pho 'don pa las/ zol med kyi lhag bsam dkar po snying la 'chang / don ldan gyi rnam dkar bya ba dang du len/ lhad med kyi chos dang rig gzhung slob gnyer byed/ 'khos bstun gyi sri zhu'i las ka cung zad re sgrub nus na/mes rgyal la zhabs tog 'grub/ rang rigs la legs skyes 'bul/ rang nyid kyi la rgya mngon thub pa zhig kyang 'ong ba ni mthong chos mngon gyur lags pas/ de bzhin dgongs dbyings su chub par zhu'o/ /phran 'brog rgan 'khyams po thub bstan nyi mas/spyi lo 2007pa'i zla tshes la gus phul/—4

bsdu sgrig gsal ngakhrind/da lam nga tsho'i jo nang rje btsun tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs te par skrun zhus pa 'di ni/ gzan dkar mchog sprul thub bstan nyi ma'i bka' slob dang bdag rkyen 'og byung ba zhig yin/de yang spyir khong la gsung 'bum pod bzhi bcu tsam zhig yod tshul phyis su bris pa'i rnam thar 'ga' las gsal yang / dngos su pod bzhi bcu'i dkar chag kha gsal zhig da sngon nga tsho'i mjal rgyu ma byung / da lam dngos su mjal rgyu byung ba'i pod bco lnga ni/ deng sang yongs grags su rtag brtan par ma zhes 'bod pa 'di ni/ bod rab byung bcu pa'i me 'brug (spyi lo1616) la/ mnga' ris smad kyi gung thang gi rgyal rabs nyi shu rtsa gsum pa'am/ yang lugs gcig la dmar po sde bsgrangs na nyi shu rtsa bzhi pa bsod nams dbang phyug sdes yon bdag byas/ tā ra nā tha'i dngos slob gnya' yi ban+de dkon mchog legs pas/ thog ma'i mtshams sbyor dang par byang 'bri ba sogs byas te/ dus 'khor sngags phreng dang skad gnyis shan sbyar sogs chos tshan bcu bzhi shing par du bkos pa/ rtag brtan dam chos gling du spyan drangs te bzhugs su gsol/ de'i steng du rtag brtan rang nas brkos pa bcas pod —1—

bco lnga tsam zhig yod pa de'i bu dpe par ma tshar gcig /rgyal dbang lnga pa chen pos 'bras spungs dpe mdzod khang du gdan drangs ba/ phyis dus 'gyur skabs su pe cing mi rigs pho brang du bzhugs kyang / deng seng bod ljongs dpe mdzod khang du spyan drangs te bzhugs pa de yin/yang gangs can mkhas grub rim byon gyi ming mdzod las/ khong la gsung rtsom shin tu mang po yod par grags kyang rgyal dbang lnga pa chen pos/gsung 'bum shing par rnams bka' rgya btab ste par mi chog pa mdzad pas da lta khong gi gsung rtsom rnams kha tshang ba ha cang dka'/ rgyal dbang lnga pa zhing du gshegs rjes/ blo gros brtan pas khong gi gsung 'bum la dkar chag bsdus pa zhig mdzad 'dug /de'i rjes zha lu ri phug sprul skus mdzad pa'i tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum dkar chag dwangs gsal me long zhes pa'i nang du/ pod ka nas tsa bar bcu bdun la chos tshan nyis brgya don gnyis dang / ldeb grangs bdun stong brgyad brgya lnga bcu bzhugs/de lta pe cing mi rigs pho brang du pod bcu bdun la chos tshan nyis brgya don brgyad dang / ldeb grangs bdun stong dgu brgya lnga bcu rtsa brgyad bzhugs zhes gsal yang nga tsho'i gong gi dkar chag gnyis po da sngon mjal rgyu ma rnyed/ de yang zha lu ri phug sprul skus dkar chag dwangs gsal me long zhes pa ljags rtsom gnang ste/ sngar rtag brtan gyi shing par dus zing dbang —2

gis nyams chag rbestor ba rnams/ kha gso mdzad tshul thos kyang zhib phra'i lo rgyus kha gsal mjal rgyu ma byung / da lta dgen 'jam dbyangs rnams rgyal gyi dpe mdzod du bzhugs pa'i par rnying pod bcu bdun 'di/ zha lu ri phug sprul skus nyams gso mdzad pa de yin nam snyams ste/ da lta rtag brtan gyi par rnying bod ljongs dpe mdzod khang du bzhugs pa pod bco lnga dang / pod grangs dang chos tshan mang nyung tshig mtshams sogs cung mi 'dra ba yod pa'i phyir/da lam nga tshos khong gi gsung 'bum glog klad nang du bcug skabs kyi thog ma'i ma dpe ni/ nye char bla ma yon tan bzang pos 'dzam thang du shing par la brkos pa'i glegs bam nyer bzhi can de la byas te zhu dag thengs gsum byas/ de rjes sngar jo nang rtag brtan du bzhugs pa rtsom pa po tā ra nā tha rang nyid kyi phyag dpe skabs 'aṇikar phyag mchan yod pa/ da lta 'bras spungs gnas bcu lha khang nang bzhugs bris ma pod chung bcu la chos tshan43la bsdur gzhi dang / jo nang rtag brtan gyi par rnying pod bco lnga bod ljongs dpe mdzod khang du bzhugs pa dang / a ri ba dgen 'jam dbyangs rnam rgyal gyi dpe mdzod du bzhugs pa par rnying pod bcu bdun yod pa gnyis phyogs bsdoms kyis/ par rnying pod nyi shu tsam la chos tshan 314byung ba la sdur byed byas te dpe bsdur thengs dang po zhus/—3—

de nas rtag brtan gyi par pod nyi shu la bsdur gzhi dang / 'dzam thang gi par mas sdur byed byas te dpe bsdur theng gnyis pa zhus pa yin/ 'on kyang par ma snga phyi gnyis dang bris ma gcig bcas dpe gsum po rtsa ba'i cha nas gcig mtshungs su bzhugs pa las khyad par chen po mi 'dug /cho ga'i skor la mi 'dra ba cung zad yod pa ni mchan dkyus su shor ba yin 'dug pa rnams kyang / gug rtags nang du bcug te gsal po byas yod/ rtag brtan par rnying dang 'bras spungs bris ma gnyis su dpe ma bzhugs pa/ 'dzam thang par ma'i nang bzhugs gsung thor bu'i skor wa rtags can dang / zha rtags can gnyis dang / za rtags can dbu ma theg mchog gi zin bris rab byed drug pa yan chad/ tā ra nā tha'i zhal gsung slob ma ye shes rgya mtshos zin bris su bkod pa dang / rab byed bdun pa brgyad pa gnyis dza 'go'i dge bshes mchog grub rgya mtshos gsar du bsnan pa/ skre rtags can nyang yul gyi lo rgyus tā ra nā thas zhabs btags mdzad par grags pa bcas chos tshan121la 'dzam thang gi par ma'i dpe gcig pu las/ rtag brtan par rnying dang 'bras spungs bris ma gnyis kyi bsdur gzhi ma rnyed/ rtag brtan par rnying gcig pu las gzhan gnyis la med pa chos tshan4/ yang rtag brtan dang 'dzam thang par ma gnyis char med pa/ 'bras spungs gnas bcu lha khang du bzhugs cipa'i gral nas chos tshan bco brgyad la ldeb193gsar rnyed byung —4

ba bcas la/ zhu dag byas te kha skong gi tshul du bzhag yod pa bcas khyon bsdoms deb bzhi bcu zhe lnga la chos/ tshan900yod/ da lta nga tsho'i ma dpe g.yar rgyu ma rnyed pa sngon rtsom pa po'i phyag dpe'i gral nas yin pa/ 'bras spungs gnas bcu lha khang / dpe rtags phyi298nang bzhugs gtam du bya ba nor bu'i 'byung gnas ldeb6/ yang phyi508nang bzhugs 'khor lo gsum gyi rnam bzhag chos dbyings rgya mtsho'i rgyan rnam par bkod pa ldeb92/ ste lag bris kyi chos tshan gnyis po ma 'ongs par dpe g.yar thabs bya dgos/da lta nga tshos dpe bsdur dang zhu dag gi skabs su ma dpe rtsa 'dzin byas te/ dpe gsum mi 'dra ba'i tshe rtag brtan la〈〈rta〉〉rtags 'di dang /'dzam thang la rtags〈〈rja 〉〉'di/ dag cha nor bcos la gug rtag 'di( 1dang / mchan rnams gug rtag〈 co'adi'i nang du blug yod/gsal bshad zhu rgyu zhig la deb bzhi pa'i nang du/ kun mkhyen dol po pa'i gsung chos tshan bzhi/ rig 'dzin tshe dbang kun khyab kyi gsung lho sgo'i cho ga zhes pa'i chos tshan gcig bcas 'dzam thang par mar bzhag yod pa dang / yang sa bzang ma ti paṇa chen gyi gsung dus 'khor phyag rgya'i skor chos tshan gcig rtag brtan par rnying du yod pa rnams rang 'jag bzhag yod pa dang / khong gi rang rnam gtso bor gyur pa'i lo rgyus zhal gdams rnams su/gtsang gi yul skad yin nam snyam pa'i tha snyad go dka' ba mang po zhig —5

bed spyad gnang ba dag kyang rang sor bzhag yod/da lam bka' 'bum 'di rtsis 'khor nang du byugs pa'i 'gro song tsā 'dra tshogs pa nas zhus shing / par skrun tshar lnga brgya'i 'gro song bod rig pa dpe skrun khang nas bgyis/ tshar brgyad brgya'i 'gro song hrin sprin sogs kyi rgya'i sbyin bdag rnams kyis gnang zhing / tshar nyis brgya'i 'gro song tsā 'dra tshogs pa nas bgyis pa bcas kyi mthun rkyen las/ da lam dngos su par du bskrun thub pa byung ste rgya che'i klog pa po rnams kyi spyan lam du phul ba yin/las gzhi 'dir bod ljongs dpe mdzod khang nas ma dpe pod bco lnga g.yar gnang byung ba dang / 'dzam thang bla ma mun sel mchog nas kyang ma dpe btsal rogs dang / go rim sgrig rgyu/ zhu dag bcas la rogs ram gang mang gnang ba dang / khams sprul bsod nams don grub mchog nas nyang yul chos 'byung zhu dag gi rogs ram gnang ba dang / bla ma dpal ldan rgya mtshos zhu dag gi las ka spyi'i thugs 'gan che bzhes gnang ba bcas la thugs rje che zhu rgyu ba'o/ /dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang nas rkarma bde legs kyis/—6

khong ni slob dpon chen hūṃ shārnyi /byeshaṃ dzinas dang / paṇ+ḍi ta gha ya dha ra/gnyos lo tsā ba/ kha rag sgom chung sogs skyes chen mang pos byin gyis brlabs shing / bod skyong brtan ma bcu gnyis kyi nang tshan kha rag khyung btsun gyi gnas jo mo kha rag ces pa'i 'dabs/ chu bo chen po lo hi ta'i nye 'gram du rwa lo tsā ba chen po'i brgyud pa bar ma chad par byon pa la/ shar nub gnyis su gyes pa las shar ba kun dga' seng ge'i gdung brgyud/ sngags 'chang tshul khrims rgya mtsho'i sras rnam rgyal phun tshogs dgung lo bzhi bcu zhe dgu pa rje 'di'i yab dang /yum rdo rje bu dga' dgung lo bcu dgu pa gnyis kyi sras su bod rab byung bcu pa'i shing phag (spyi lo1575) la/ ngo mtshar ba'i ltas dang bcas sku 'khrungs te mes pos pad+ma sri gcod rdo rje zhes mtshan gsol/sku bltams te zla ba brgyad song rjes bzhengs nas gom pa spo thub pa dang / dgung lo gcig tsam nas gsung byon te nga bla ma kun dga' grol mchog yin zhes zhal gyis bzhes pa dang / gzhan yang sku gong ma'i rten gsum dang sbyin bdag / nye gnas sogs kyi 31 rgyus gsal bar gsungs pa sogs kyis/jo nang bla ma kun dga' grol mchog gi yang srid zhabrul med du shes te/ dgung lo bzhi par jo nang mkhan chen lung rigs rgya mtsho dang / zhabs drung bkra shis —1—

stobs rgyas dbang po sogs rta pa brgya dang drug cu rtsa lnga tsam gdan 'dren du byung nas/ gtsang phyogs su gdan drangs te sku gong ma'i slob ma rdo ring kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ lha dbang grags pa/ mkhan chen lung rigs rgya mtsho/ mkhas dbang byams pa lhun grub/ rje drung kun dga' dpal bzang sogs kyis chos lung byang rtser khri ston mdzad/ rdo ring pa chen po 'jam dbyangs kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyi drung du/ thog ma'i rten 'brel du sgrol dkar gyi rjes gnang dang / gshed dmar lha lnga'i dbang / lam 'bras gtso bor gyur pa'i dbang dang gdams pa mang po gsan/ de nas dgung lo drug pa nas yi ge sbyor klog phul du phyin pa mkhyen te/dbang dang rjes gnang sogs yig thog nas gnang ba la dka' tshegs med pa byung /dgung lo brgyad par rje gong ma'i dngos slob mkhas dbang byams pa lhun grub yongs 'dzin du bsten nas/ tshad ma rigs gter sbyangs pas gzhung don la go ba rnyed rung blo 'dzin la zla ba lnga tsam 'gor/ gzhan yang mdo rgyud kyi gzhung lugs mang por gsan bsam mdzad pas mkhyen rtogs rgyas/dgung lo brgyad la phebs skabs stag lung kun dga' bkra shis rgyal mtshan gdan drangs te thog mar bka' gdams glegs bam gyi lung zhus te/ de nas bod rab byung bcu pa'i chu rta khrums stod zla ba'i tshes lnga (spyi lo1582)la/ chos lung byang rtse'i mchod khang gi yang thog tu/ dpal stag lung pa chen po rje btsun kun dga' bkra shis rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i zhal snga nas kyi —2

mkhan po dang /'jam dbyangs kun dga' rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos slob dpon dang /rje drung kun dga' dpal bzang pos dus go ba/chos rje mchod gnas pas grogs dan bgyis te yongs rdzogs dge bsnyen dang bar ma rab byung sngon du 'gro bas dge tshul gyi sdom pa bzhes te/ mtshan kun dga' snying po bkra shis rgyal mtshan zhes gsol/ dag pa'i gzigs snang du rgya gar gyi paṇa chen dz+wa la nā thas tā ra nā tha zhes pa'i mtshan gsol/chos rje brag stod pa lha dbang grags pa'i drung nas chos drug dang phyag chen sogs/ zab chos mang po gsan pas nang zab lam gyi rtogs pa mngon du gyur/ rje drung kun dga' dpal bzang las dus 'khor gtso bor gyur pa'i zab chos mang po gsan/ mkhan po lung rigs rgya mtsho'i mdun dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang dang rgyud bshad/ dpal rgyal ba jo nang pa'i lugs kyi sbyor drug gi zab khrid mtha' dag gsan te nyams len mdzad/ bu lugs kyi sbyor drug gi khrid kyang rdzogs par gsan/ gzhan yang jo zhal bla ma mang po'i gdams khrid dang bka' bstan sogs rgya gzhung gi man ngag mang po dang / kun mkhyen dol bo pa'i gsung 'bum sogs lung mang po gsan/ mkhas grub sangs rgyas ye shes/rdo rje 'dzin pa ye shes dbang po sogs las/ sa skya jo nang shangs pa zhwa lu 'brug pa kai tshang / stag lung sogs kyi chos skor bcas rgyud sde bzhi'i dbang khrid man ngag mtha' dag ma lus par gsan/ gzhan yang rgya gar gyi grub chen gu ru lho phyogs pa sangs rgyas sbas pa'i mgon po/ 'jam dbyangs kun dga'i mtshan can sogs bshes gnyen mang po'i zhabs la gtugs te/ zhang tshal pa'i chos —3—

skor dang / yang dgon pa'i bka' 'bum/ dwags po lha rje'i bka' 'bum/ ri chos ma drug gi khrid/ mi tri bcu gsum ma'i dbang / sangs rgyas thod pa'i dbang /o rgyan bsnyen sgrub skor gyi khrid lung yongs rdzogs/ mar pa nas brgyud rngog pa'i bka' babs dgyes rdor yab yum/ gur rigs bsdus/ gdan bzhi yab yum/ ma hā mā ya ste drug : ti nas brgyud pa 'jam dpal gsang ldan bcas rngog dkyil bdun/ rngog ṭīka rin chen rgyan 'dra'i mdzub khrid/brtag gnyis sa rngog gnyis ga'i bshad srol/ stag lung thang pa'i bka' 'bum/sgrub thabs brgya rtsa'i rjes gnang /nigu chos drug 'jam dkar gyi rjes gnang /'grel chen dri med 'od dang /rdo rje snying 'grel dang / dgyes pa rdo rje'i rgya gzhung / dgyes rdor skor la gtso che'i chos sna sum cu so dgu dang / gdan bzhi'i khrid tshul rgyas pa/ ār+ya de wa'i chos lnga sogs rgya gzhung bcu/ sa ra ha'i chos lnga/ nag po'i gzhung drug lha hi smad lnga/dril bu skor gsum/ gshed dmar bi rū pa'i gzhung brgyad/ ku ku ri pa'i chos bdun/ sgrub thabs mtsho skyes sogs dgyes rdor gyi gzhung shin tu mang po dang / dpe med 'tsho'i sbyor drug rtsa 'grel/dza lan+dha ri'i do ha/ sems kyi phyag rgya sogs mdo sngags spyi dang / khyad par du gsang sngags rgyud sde'i dbang bskyed rdzogs mtha' yas pa gsan/de nas dgung lo bcu bdun pa rab byung bcu pa'i lcags yos hor zla bcu gcig pa'i tshes bcu bdun (spyi lo1591)la/ 'jam dbyangs kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyis mkhan po/ bla ma byams pa lhun grub kyis las kyi slob dpon/dge ba'i bshes gnyen blo bzang pa dang / rje drung kun dga' bsod nams —4

sogs kyis kha skong gnang ste bsnyen par rdzogs pa dge slong gi sdom pa bzhes te/ phyi ltar ngur smrig gi rgyal mtshan 'chang ba'i dge slong 'dul ba 'dzin pa/nang ltar gzhan phan snying rje chen pos thugs rgyud yongs su brlan pa'i rgyal sras sems pa chen po/ gsang ba bskyed rdzogs kyi zab gnad la mnga' brnyes pa'i sngags 'chang rdo rje 'dzin pa zhig tu gyur/de nas bsam sdings su dpal ldan bla ma dam pa byams pa'i mtshan can gyi drung du rdo rje phreng ba'i dbang yongs rdzogs dang / dpal mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i dbang bcas zhus/ bla ma dpal ldan chos kyi bzang po'i zhal snga nas/ rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'bor la brten nas dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang yongs su rdzogs pa bdag po chen po'i mthar thug pa dang / gsang bdag 'khor lo chen po/dril bu lha lnga/ gzungs grwa lnga/ dril bu lus dkyil sogasadabang mang po gsan/gzhan yang dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams las/ gsang 'dus 'phags lugs dang / zhabs lugs/ gshin rje gshed dgra gdong 'jigs gsum/gshed dmar bram ze dpal 'dzin gyi lugs/ gdan bzhi'i gzhung bdun/sangs rgyas thod pa phyogs kyi rgya gzhung mang po dang / rgyud sde 'og ma ci rigs pa dang / grub pa sde bdun/ snying po skor drug yid la mi byed pa'i chos skor rnams dang / phreng ba skor gsum/ rgyud 'grel grags can phal che ba dang /bslab btus dang / byang sa sogs gzhung mang por thos bsam gnang bas blo gros kyi lus stobs ches cher rgyas te gzhung lugs rab 'byams smra ba'i mkhas pa chen por gyur/—3—

de nas bla ma kun dga'i mtshan can dang slob dpon rin po ches bka' bzhin/ rje 'di nyid dgung lo nyer gcig pa rab byung bcu pa'i shing lug hor zla brgyad pa'i tshes lnga(spyi lo1595)la/ ri khrod chen po jo mo nang gi gdan sa par bskos pa bzhin bla brang gi rtsis sprod rtsis len gnang rjes/ skyid phug tu zla gcig lhag tsam bcad mtshams la bzhugs te phag 57'i ljags bsnyen —gnang skabs/ rmi lam du ngo bo slob dpon pad+ma yin pa'i rnal 'byor pa gzi brjid che ba zhig gi drung du/ dwags po rnyi ba rin po che dge bshes bsres song gi rnam par bzhugs 'dug pa las/ rnal 'byor pa'i zhal nas nga dang dol po pa ngo bo gcig yin gsung pa dang / bod kyi dge bshes bsres song des kyang nga yang ngo bo gcig yin gsung pa rmis pas/ dang po pad 'byung gi rten 'brel de sad de sgom gyi sa bon thebs/ bar skabs su dwags po rin po ches chos kyis rtogs pa brnyes/ phyis kun mkhyen chen po'i bzhed dgongs ltar nyams su myong ba'i brda ru go /de nas rgya gar gyi paṇ+ḍi ta pur+ṇa nan+da dang pra yā mā nan+da gnyis dang mjal 'phrad mdzad de gsung gleng gnang barmi/ khong gnyis grub mtha' nang par 'dug kyang pha mes kyi chos rig byed la yang zhen che bas/ phyi rol pa'i lha gcig gnyis bsten gyin 'dug pas dbang chos sogs ni ma zhus/ rig pa'i gnas thams cad la shin tu mkhas par 'dug pas dogs gcod mang du bgyis shing bstan bcos kyang than thun bsgyur/ bha ra ta dang rā ma ya ṇa la sogs pa'i lo rgyus kyang mang du thos/ de skabs rā ma ya ṇa'i srung ma ha nu ma tha'i cho 'phrul lus —6—

byang chen gyi ri dang mnyam pa'i spre'u dang / bha ra ta'i srung ma rgyal po sgyi ma dngos su mthong bas paṇ+ḍi ta na re/ khyod la 'go bar 'dug mthu dang snyan grags longs spyod chen po yong gsungs na yang / chos la mi dad pa'i lha 'dre bsten pas ci bya snyam nas yal bar dor ba yin zhes gsungs/lo dus chag med jo nang du sbyor drug gi khrid gsungs pas ngo ma 'phrod pa gcig kyang ma byung / rgya gar gyi slob dpon su ni r+bha ṇa shrī dang pud+dha badz+ra sogs las zab khrid kyi gdams pa mang po gsan/ jo nang du sgrub mchod la dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor bzhengs te/ 'dus pa bdun brgya tsam la dbang bcu gcig pa rdzogs par gnang / dgung grangs nyer drug skor rwa sgreng du phebs te tshogs su chos 'brel tsam dang / rje tsong kha pa'i bzhugs khri'i steng nas lam rim gsungs/dgung lo nyer dgu par jo nang du bzhugs skabs tho rengs shig la rje btsun byams pas zhal gzigs te/ khong rang la thim pa'i gzigs snang byung bas gzhan stong dbu ma'i grub mtha' la nges shes gting nas rnyed/ kun mkhyen dol po pas zhal yang yang gzigs nas lung bstan gnang ba dang /gzim lam du sham+bha lar phyin nas rigs ldan sprul pa'i sku dang mjal te chos gsan pa'i snang ba sogs gzigs snang mang po byung /dgung lo so dgu par chos 'khor lha sar phebs nas dar chen mang po bslangs te jo bo'i mdun thugs smon zab rgyas gnang / de nas kun mkhyen dol po pa'i sku brnyan gsung byon ma dang / thugs rje chen po/ tshe dpag med bcas —7—

byin rlabs can gyi rten gsum po'i mdun du mchod 'bul dang thugs smon rgya chen gnang ste smon lam rgyal ba rgya mtsho yang brtsams/dgung lo zhe gcig pa rab byung bcu pa'i shing yos hor zla gnyis pa'i tshes bcu gcig (spyi lo1615)la/ gtsang pa sde srid phun tshogs rnam rgyal gyis chos gzhis dang / lha 'bangs sogs rgya cher phul nas mthun rkyen sbyar ba las/dpal rtag brtan dam chos gling nges don dga' ba'i tshal gyi gnas gzhi'i las grwa btsugs te/ phyi gtsug lag khang dang grwa khang brgya phrag tsam lcags ri dang bcas pa/ nang gi rten sangs rgyas rabs bdun dang / tshe dpag med/ sgrol ma/yum chen mo/ dzam bha la sogs gser zangs las grub pa mang po dang / dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i sku zhal phyag yongs rdzogs gser zangs las grub pa dang /bde gshegs mchod rten cha brgyad sogs rten gsum dpag tu med pa bzhengs/jo nang du yang lha khang gsar bzhengs dang nang rten byams chen thog tshad gnyis tsam gser zangs las grub pa sogs mang po bzhengs/ gzhan yang lha bzo sogs lag rtsal pa rnams dang po rgya bal sogs nas gdan drangs/ de nas bris pa dang / spar brko shing bzo sogs lag rtsal pa gso skyong gnang bas/las rigs lag rtsal pa rnams kyang gzhan la re mi dgos pa byung ste/ bka' bstan 'gyur ro cog tshar mang po dang / bka' 'bum skor po ti bzhi bcu shing par du brkos pa sogs rten gsum mang po gsar bzhengs gnang /skabs shig ri bo che nas rgya dpe pod bcu tsam zhig 'byor byung ba'i nang / yar klung lo tsā ba'i phyag dpe ngo ma dus 'khor 'grel chen bod gnyis —8—

'dug dus 'khor rgyud kyi dpe de dbus phyogs nas snga mo zhig tu lag son byung ba dang / 'grel pa 'di skabs su rnyed pa la ya mtshan chen po byung ste thengs mang bklags pas zung sbyor la yang blo skyed chen po byung / gzhanayangadabang mdor bstan gyi 'grel pa don dam bsdus pa'i mdzad byang la nā ro pa'i mtshan yod pa dang / kyai rdo rje'i 'grel pa rdo rje'i tshig bsdus kyi mdzad byang du byang chub bzang po'i skad dod bo dhi bha dra zhes yod pa sogs mang po byung /yang skabs shig gtsang pa sde srid kyis sog po'i steng du dmag dpung chas rtsis la srung 'khor dang sku rim gnang ba'i tshe/ khong ni rje tsong kha pa chen por lhag tu dad pa che ba dang / khyad par du chos sde chen po 'bras spungs la nye sems kyi bag chags shin tu che ba zhig yod pas/ chos sde chen po de nyid dar zhing rgyas pa dang rtsod pa 'jam po'i sgo nas zhi ba'i smon lam btab kyang / nus pa ma thon pa ni phyogs gnyis ka las ngan gyi dbang gis ded pa la g.yol thabs bral zhes gsungs/ de nas dpal 'khor bde chen/ rtse chen chos sde/'jag bsam gnyis/ thar pa gling / rtag brtan chos 'phel sogs dbus gtsang gi chos sde mang por chos dang longs spyod kyi bsnyen bkur rgya chen gnang ste ba3/ngas/de nas dgung grangs re gcig bzhes pa rab byung bcu gcig pa'i shing phag (spyi lo1635)la/ rtag brtan dam chos gling nges don dga' ba'i tshal gyi gdan sa 'jam dbyangs sprul sku sangs rgyas rgya mtsho la gtad de/ chos lung rtse dang jo mo nang du dus khrid phyag len rgyas pa gnang nas/ da res ma gtogs —9

'dir chos mi 'chad gsungs te bu slob rnams la zhal ta mang po gnang ste/ lo de'i nag pa zla ba'i tshes nyer brgyad la zhi bar gshegs so//slob ma/ sprul sku sangs rgyas rgya mtsho/ mkhas dbang ye shes rgya mtsho/mkhan chen rin chen rgya mtsho/ mkhas grub blo gros rnam rgyal rnams dang / sgam po sprul sku/ chos rje ngag dbang pa/ bla ma chu bo chung ba'i sku skye/ mkhan po kun dga' bkra shis rgyal mtshan/ sprul sku ngag gi dbang po/ tre bo sprul sku/chos rje rin stengs pa/ dus 'khor shar chen pa/ chos rje lha bo pa/ dge slong snying po mtha' yas/ byams pa yon tan mgon po/ ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams/ mi pham dkon mchog legs pa/ kun dga' 'phrin las dbang mo/gtsang gi rgyal sras kun dga' bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan sogs mang po byung /gzhan yang bstan pa'i sbyin bdag gtsang pa sde srid phun tshogs rnam rgyal/ byang bdag bkra shis stobs rgyal/ yar 'brog bstan 'dzin mi 'gyur dbang gi rgyal po sogs mang ngo/ /dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang nas dme bde legs kyis/—10

mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan gyi 'grel pa mdo lugs ma'i don khol bur phyung ba bzhugs/ 1blo sbyongs don bdun ma'i bla ma brgyud pa'i garber+shal 'debs bzhugs/ 100snying po don gsum gyi bla ma brgyud pa'i gasku(la 'debs bzhugs/ 101bka' babs drug ldan gyi khrid yig 'phags yul grub pa'i zhal sdo/nga baṭa/gas/ 102phyag rgya chen po ga'u ma'i rang babs rnam gsum zhes bya ba'i khrid yig bzhugs/ 179phyag rgya chen po rang babs rnam gsum gyi dogs pa gcod pa'i lan zhes bya ba bzhugs/ 190ye shes mkha' 'gro ni gu'i dbang bka' che chung rnams kyi sngon du 'gro ba'i chos bcu dang lngar dbye ba'i khyad par bzhugs/ 192ni gus brgyud 'debs a yig chos 'byung ma zhes bya ba bzhugs/ 202

zhes bya ba bsdokyigs/ 209gser chos phyi ma bzhi'i snying po sogs bzhugs/ 226rnal 'byor rnam pa gnyis kyi rtsa ba bzhugs/ 230rnal 'byor pa rnam pa gnyis kyi gsal byed kyi ṭī ka bi dzā ha ri pā ru bzhugs/ 234mkha' 'gro rnam gsum gyi gdams pa bzhugs/ 274mkha' 'gro rnam gsum gyi zhal gdams gung bsgrigs te nyams su len bde ba bzhugs/ 284lam khyer rnam gsum gcig tu dril ba bzhugs/ 291gcod yul zab mo'i khrid yig gnad don snying po zhes bya ba bsdokyigs/ 293gcod yul zab mo'i khrid yig gnad don snying po'i ngag 'don gsol 'debs zhes bya ba bzhugs/ 309gsol 'debs dgongs bskyod ma bzhugs/ 330gcod yul brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs bzhugs/ 332gcod dbang nam mkha' sgo 'byed kyi tsha/ rgyus mu tig phreng ba bzhugs/ 334

dbu phyogs legs par bzhugs pa lags/ 343'pho ba'i man ngag bzhugs/ 352'pho ba hig dgu ma bzhugs/ 355phyir bzlog drug gi khrid yig tshigs bcad ma zhugs/ 357/da yig tshigs bcad ma'i zhal shes bzhugs/ 361

ma'i don khol bur phyung ba bzhugs/swā sti/ rtag bdun chos nyid rta bdun dkyil 'khor gyis/ /glo bur sgrib pa'i sprin mtsho stug po rnams/ /theg chen dam chos dri bzhon gyis gsal ba'i/ /dag pa gnyis ldan chos dbyings 'od gsal rgyal/ /rab byung bstan pa chu yi gter chen las/ /nges gsang shes rab chos nyid yid bzhin nor/ /nges don bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan tshugs slad du/ /nges par len mdzad rton pa bzhi ldan rgyal/ /kun mkhyen bstan pa chu skyes mdzes pa de/ /'a11 rnams dga' ba'i mkhyen brtse'i 'od zer gyis/ /legs par phye mdzad skye dgu'i snying gcig po/ /bka' drin mnyam med sgrol ba'i mgon po mchod/ /zhes mchod par brjod nas/ 'dir mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan gyi 'grel pa mdo lugs ma las gzhung gi sa bcad dang 'bru gnon khol bur phyung ste bshad pa la sems te/rgyal ba sras bcas thams cad la'o/ /gang zag gang gis na lo tsā bas/ tshul ji ltar na sgo gsum gus pas 'dud pa ni phyag 'tshal ba'o/ /de ltar yul dam pa la phyag 'tshal ba'i bsod nams kyis rtsoms bsgyur 'chad nyan mthar phyin par 'grub bo/ /gnyis pa bshad pa nyid nye bar dgod pa la/ rang nyid bstan bcos rtsoms la 'jug pa'i rgyu mchod brjod bshad pa brtsams pa'i bstan bcos la gzhan 'jug pa'i dgos 'grel bshad pa/ 'jug bya bstan bcos kyi rang

bzhin mngon rtogs bshad pa'o/ /dang po la bstod pa dang phyag 'tshal ba'o/ /dang po la bstod bya mkhyen gsum ngos bzung ba dang / des 'phags bzhi'i bzhed don mdzad tshul lo/ /dang po la mkhyen pa gsum gyi ngos 'dzin ni/sems bskyed kyi skabs su gsungs pas ni gang zag so so'i rgyud la yod pa'i mkhyen gsum ngo bo tha dad pa rnams bstan te/ mkhyen gsum ngo bo gcig pa gzhi 'bras dbyer med kyi sher phyin de bzhin nyid ni bstan la/ gzhi de la slob pa gang zag so so'i rgyud la yod pa'i mkhyen gsum ngo bo tha dad pa rnams bstan te/ mkhyen gsum ngo bo gcig pa gzhi 'bras dbyer med kyi sher phyin de bzhin nyid ni bstan la/ gzhi de la slob pa na gang zag so so'i rgyud kyi mkhyen gsum ngo bo tha dad/ de la bstan par gyur tshul yang / sems bskyed kyi skabs su gnod 'joms las bshad do/ /de ltar na gzhir sher phyin 'phags pa'i chos thams cad kyi rgyu chos dbyings de bzhin nyid mkhyen pa gsum ngo bo gcig tu gyur pa gang yin pa de nyid dang / gang zag so so'i rgyud la yod pa ngo bo tha dad pa'i mkhyen gsum gang yin pa de gnyis rten dang brten pa dang / snga ma ni gang la bslab par byed pa'i gzhi'i mkhyen gsum yin la/ phyi ma ni de la slob pa byed pa'i thabs mkhyen pa gsum yin no/ /de lta bas na/ nyan thos zhi ba tshol rnams zhes sogs kyis kyang mkhyen gsum ngo bo tha dad pa so so'i rgyud la yod pa lam bstan gyis bsdus pa'i ye shes dang / tshogs bcas sangs rgyas kyi ni yum de zhes pas mkhyen pa gsum ngo bo gcig pa gzhi 'bras dbyer med pa'i ye shes te gnyis ka bstan to/ /gnyis pa bzhed don mdzad tshul la/ kun shes kyis nyan —2

rang ni lam shes kyi byang sems kyi rnam mkhyen gyi sangs rgyas kyi bzhed don mdzad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ to thos zhes pa nas/ 'khrid mdzad kyi bar ro/ /'di la gsum gang zag gang / thabs gang gis 'bras bu gang du 'khrid par mdzad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ nyan thos zhes pa ni/ byang sems kyi sde snod las/ nyan thos rnams ni rnam grol sgra phyir 'gro/ /zhes pa'i tshul gyis nyan thos te/ srid pa tha ma pa'i tshe yang gzhan gyi sgra phyir 'brang ba'i phyir/ thos sgrogs te/ nyan thos so/ /theg pa dman pa nyid du mtshungs pa'i rang sangs rgyas kyang de'i phyogs su bsdu'o/ /rang sangs rgyas zhes pa ni/ srid pa tha ma pa'i tshe/ slob dpon med par sngon goms pa'i dbang gis/ byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos sum cu rtsa bdun po rnams sgoms pas nyon mongs pa thams cad spangs pa'i dgra bcom pa nyid mngon sum du byed de/ de bas na rang sangs rgyas zhes bya'o/ /nyan rang de rnams zhi ba myang 'das tshol bas na/ zhi tshol ba rnams so/ /myang 'das kyang phung po'i lhag ma dang bcas pa dang / phung po'i lhag ma med pa gnyis las/ nyan rang de /de/ 95 bye/mitshog tshor ra tsha /sde/ tshor ra mo de tsha 95dag lugs na/ phya ma' phung pa ba da pa' rgyu nyan mangs pa' kun 'byung kyang / snga ma'i las nyon gyi 'bras bu/ tshe 'di'i phung po ma spang ba ni lhag ma dang bcas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa ste/ zad du nye bas dngos po la lhag ma zhen pa bzhin no/ /de nyid tshe'i dus byas pa na snga ma'i 'bras bu'i sdug bsngal spang ba'i phyir phung po lnga zad pa ni lhag ma med pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'o/ /rnams zhes pa ni mang po'i tshig ste de las de dag gi dbye bar 'gyur ba'i lta ba ste/ lta ba khas can pa'i dang / sprul pa'i dang / rigs ma nges pa'i dang / nges pa'i nyan riri 3

thos so/ /dang po ni sems bskyed dang ldan la/ nyan thos dang lta ba mthun pa phyin gyi gzung 'dzin bden par 'dod pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni gdul ba'i don sprul pa gnas brtan rab 'byor lta bu rnams so/ /rang sangs rgyas la yang bse ru lta bu dang / tshogs na spyod pa la sogs pa'i dbye ba'o/ /theg pa bla na med pa'i skabs ltar na/ gnas skabs theg pa gsum gyi nges par 'byung zhid thams cad kyang mthar thug yin/ theg pa gcig gi 'bras bu gnas par bzhed pa ni nges pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ kun shes nyid ces pa ni 'dus byas thams cad mi rtag pa'o/ /zag pa dang bcas pa thams cad sdug bsngal ba'o/ /chos thams cad bden pa med pa'o/ /zhes pa gsum dang / bden pa bzhi'i sgo nas/ chos thams cad la rmongs pa med pa'i shes pa ni nyan rang gi ye shes te kun shes de nyid kyis so/ /gsum pa ni/ 'du byed nye bar zhi ba'i mya ngan las 'das par 'khrid par mdzad pa gang yin pa'o/ /de ni bsdud pa'i don to/ /gnyis pa lam shes kyi byang sems kyi bzhed don mdzad pa la/ gang zag gang gis thabs gang gis/'bras bu gang sgrub par mdzad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ 'gro la phan par 'gyur ba'i don dngos po brgyad kyi gnas pa'i sher phyin brjod par bya ba'o/ /'di ston par byed pa'i le'u'i tshogs kyi mdo rnams ni brjod par/ brjod bya dang rjod byed 'di dag /phan tshun brjod bya rjod byed kyi mtshan nyid ni 'brel ba'o/ /de nas chos spyod bcu'i rim pas lam la 'jug cing slob pa ni dgos pa'o/ /sbyor ba bzhi'i ngo bo sher phyin zab mo'i rnal 'byor rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes la —4

brten nas sgrib pa thams cad bral ba'i 'bras bu chos sku thob cing / mdzad pa 'phrin las dang bcas pa ni dgos pa'i dgos pa'o/ /rtsod lan ni/ rnam pa mkhyen pa'i lam mkhyen nyid lam bya ba la sogs pa gsungs te/ med pa ni ma yin te gang gi phyir/ bde blag tu ni rtog pa zhes bya ba rtsom pa'i dgos pa yin/ zhes 'grel lo/ /tshul ji ltar zhe na/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi lam/ skyob pa nyid gzigs lam gsungs pa dang / ston pa sangs rgyas kyi yum rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum 'di las bshad pa gang yin pa'i don byang sems las/ gzhan mtshan ma la spyod pa nyan rang sogs kyi rtogs shing myong ba ma yin pa de gang yin na/ chos spyod bcu'i bdag nyid kyi mdo'i don ni/ tshig le'ur byas pa 'di thos pa las/ dka' tshogs tshegs chung ngus mdo'i don mi brjed pa'i dran pa la bzhag nas/ mdo rgyan las/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' che/ /blo ldan nyid dang gsal ba'i mchog /zhes pa la sogs pa'i mtshan gyi rnam grangs bcu drug dang ldan pa'i blo dang ldan pa/ byang chub sems dpa' mdo rnams mthong ba tsam gyis mdo'i don rtogs par 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/ /gsum pa 'jug bya bstan bcos kyi rang bzhin gyi mngon rtogs bshad pa la gsum/ bsdus don lus rnam gzhag dang / tshig don yan lag rgyas bshad dang / bsdus don gzhan dang gzhan bshad pa'o/ /dang po la gnyis/lus mdor bstan pa dang / lus rgyas par bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ shes rab kyi pha rol phyin pa ni zhes pa nas chos kyi sku dang de rnams brgyad kyi bar ro/ /de ltar dngos po brgyad kyi sher phyin 'chad pa la/ so so'i don dang de dag gi nges —5

pa bsam pa'o/ /dang po la brgyad/ dang po rnam mkhyen la gsum/ mtshan nyid dbye ba sa mtshams so/ /dang po ni chos thams cad kyi rnam pa ste/ rang bzhin nam chos nyid mngon sum gyi rtogs pa gang zhig don gnyis mthar thug pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni stobs bcu'o/ /ye shes bzhi la sogs pa'o/ /gsum pa ni rnam mkhyen dang / chos sku dang / sher phyin la sogs pa/ chos nyid kyi tshul gyis 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad la khyab pa'o/ /gnyis pa lam shes la mtshan nyid dbye ba sa mtshams so/ /dang po ni/ lam gsum rang bzhin med par mngon sum du rtogs pa'i ye shes gang zhig smin rdzogs ma sbyangs par yang dag pa'i mtha' mngon du mi byed par gzhan don byed pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ ji lta ba mkhyen pa mnyam bzhag dang / ji snyed pa mkhyen pa rjes thob kyi ye shes so/ /gsum pa ni/ byang sems kyi sa kho na yod pa la/ rjes mthun pa mkhyen pa gzhan gnyis na'ang yod do/ /gsum pa kun shes la/ mtshan nyid dbye ba sa mtshams so/ /dang po ni/ gang zag gi bdag med mngon sum gyi rtogs pa gang zhig spangs pa nye tshe bar 'gyur ro/ /gnyis pa ni/ nyan rang gi lam gnyis sam/theg dman gyi lam lnga'o/ /gsum pa ni nyan rang gi sa kho na ni yod cing rjes mthun pa mkhyen nas gzhan gnyis na'ang yod do/ /bzhi pa rnam rdzogs la gsum las/ mtshan nyid ni/ spyir 'dir smos sbyor ba tsam ni mkhyen gsum thos bsam gyi shes pa'i don bsdus de sgom pa yin la khyad par rnam kun ni/ mkhyen gsum gyi rnam pa bsdus nas sgom pa gang zhig /dbang du byed pa'i sbyor ba'o/ /dbye ba ni lam lnga'o/ /mtshan nyid pa dang btags pa ba gnyis so/ /sa —6

mtshamasani rtagaparasbyorabani tshogasalamanas rgyun mtha'i bar na yod cing /rnam rdzogs dngos ni/ sangs rgyas kyi sa na yod do/ /lnga pa rtse sbyor la/ mtshan nyid dbye ba/ sa mtshams so/ /dang po ni/mkhyen gsum bsdus sgoms rab tu gyur pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ 'og nas 'chad pa'i don lnga'o/ /gsum pa ni/ sbyor lam nas rgyun mtha'i bar na yod do/ /rtse mor phyin pa dang / lung bstan pa dang / phyir mi ldog pa gsum don gcig pa'i phyir ro/ /drug pa sbyor ba de chos sku rim gyis rdzogs pa de'i go rim mthar gyis pa la mtshan nyid dbye ba sa mtshams so/ dang po ni/ mkhyen gsum bsdus sgom go rim du sgoms pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ bcu gsum yod do/ /gsum pa ni/ sbyor lam nas rgyun mtha'i bar na yod do/ /rgyud mtha' mthar thug par rim sgoms med pa'i phyir ro/ /bdun pa skad cig ma'i sbyor ba la/ mtshan nyid dbye ba/ sa mtshams/ dang po ni/ mkhyen gsum bsdus sgoms mthar thug pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni rtogs tshul gyi dbye bas bzhi yod do/ /gsum pa ni/ sa bcu'i rgyun mtha' na yod do/ /brgyad pa chos kyi sku la mtshan nyid/ mtshon bya dang / mtshan gzhi'o/ /dang po ni sbyor ba'i 'bras bu mthar thug gang zhig /zag med chos kyi yan lag dang ldan pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni/zag pa med pa'i chos ma lus pa bsags pa'i phung po'am/ lus yin pas na/chos sku yin te/ lus dang / 'dus pa dang / tshogs pa dang / bsdus pa rnams rnam grangs so/ /gsum pa la/ ma rdzogs pa dang rdzogs pa gnyis te/ mdo sde rgyan las/ rgyu med pa dang bcas dang sku thob pa dang / zhes so sor mkhyen —7

gsum gyi 'bras bu la rtogs pa bskyed pa'i phyir/ mkhyen gsum dang por bstan/ de nyid lam sgoms pa las byung bas de nasalam shes bstan/ de nyid spangs bya'i snying po yin pas/ spangs bya shes par bya ba'i phyir/ de nas kun nas bstan te bshad pa'i go rim mo/ /gnyis pa 'chad byed don bdun cu la/ tshan pa brgyad las/ dang po rnam mkhyen gyi chos bcu/ gnyis pa lam shes kyi chos bcu gcig /gsum pa kun shes kyi chos dgu/ bzhi pa rnam rdzogs kyi chos bcu gcig /lnga pa rtse sbyor gyi chos brgyad/ drug pa mthar gyis pa'i chosabacu gsum/bdun pa skad cig ma'i chos bzhi/ brgyad pa chos sku'i chos bzhi ste brgyad las/dang po ni/ sems bskyed pa dang gdam ngag dang / /zhes sogs tshigs bcad gnyis/ gnyis pa ni mog mog por byed pa sogs dang / zhes sogs tshigs bcad gsum/ gsum pa ni/ shes pasasrid las mi gnas shing / /zhesasogs tshigs bcad gnyis/ bzhi pa ni/ rnam pa sbyor ba bcas rnams dang zhes sogs tshigs bcad gnyis/ lnga pa ni/ de'i rtags dang rnam 'phel dang zhes pa nas/rtse mo'i mngon rtogs zhes pa'i bar gyis bstan/ drug pa mthar gyis pa rnam gsum rnam bcu zhes pas bstan/ bdun pa ni/ skad cig ma zhes sogs kyis bstan/ brgyad pa ni/ ngo bo nyid longs rdzogs bcas dang / zhes pa tshigs bcad gcig gis bstan/ gnyis pa tshig don yan lag rgyas par bshad pa la gsum/ bslab bya yul mkhyen pa gsum dang / bslab 'bras chos sku'i yan lag rgyas par bshad pa'o/ /dang po la gsum/ 'bras bu rnam mkhyen dang / rgyu lam shes dang / rgyu'i blang dor kun shes kyi yan lag rgyas par bshad —8

pa'o/ /dang po la bzhi/ lam gyi rang bzhin byang chub tu sems bskyed pa/ de rnam par dag byed gdam ngag nod pa/ de sgoms pa'i 'bras bu nges 'byed yan lag gdam pa'i don phyin ci ma log par sgrub pa'o/ /dang po sems bskyed la/sems bskyed kyi mtshan nyid dang / smon 'jug gnyis po de bsdus pa dang rgyas pa'i sgo nas yum gyi mdo bzhin du brjod pa dang de dpe nyi shu rtsa gnyis ldan pa'i sems bskyed kyi dbye ba mdo gzhan dang sbyar te bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ theg chen gyi sems bskyed pa'i mtshan nyid ni/ yon tan gsum dang ldan pa gang zhig gzhan don gyi phyir/ yang dag rdzogs pa'i byang chub 'dod pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni/smon 'jug sems bskyed kyi ngo bo gzhan don dang / byang chub tu 'gro bar 'dod pa de dang / 'jug pa sems bskyed kyi ngo bo byang chub 'dod pa dang der 'gro bzhin pa dang / de ni sher phyin gyi mdo rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum ji lta ba bzhin du bsdus pa dang rgyas pa'i sgo nas brjod do/ /gsum pa ni/ gzhan don phyir byang chub 'dod pa de yang / 'phags pa blo gros mi zad pas bstan pa'i mdo las byung bas/ byang sems rnams kyi sems bskyed pa dang po ni/ sa dang 'dra ste sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad dang de'i tshogs 'phel ba'i rten du gyur pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa man chad la bsam pa sogs dang ldan pa'i sems bskyed ni zhes pa lhag ma nyer gcig pa thams cad la sbyar ro/ /gnyis pa bsam pa ni gser bzang po dang 'dra ste/ phan pa dang bde ba'i bsam pa gzhan du mi 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/ /gsum pa sbyor ba dang yar ngo'i tshes pa'i zla ba dang 'dra ste dge ba'i chos 'phel ba'i phyir ro/ /bzhi pa lhag

pa'i bsam pa ni/ me dang 'dra ste shing mnan pa'i/ me bzhin du rtogs pa gong nas gong du khyad par rtogs shing 'gro bas lhag pa'i bsam pa yin pa'i phyir ro/ /lnga pa sbyin pa'i phar phyin dang gter chen po 'dra ste zang zing gi longs spyod kyi sems can dpag tu med pa tshim par byed pa dang mi zad pa'i phyir ro/ /drug pa tshul khrims kyi phar phyin dang rin chen gyis byang chub dang 'dra ste/ de las yon tan rin po che 'byung ba'i phyir ro/ /bdun pa bzod pa'i phar phyin dang rgya mtsho dang 'dra ste/ nyams bde ba 'byung ba thams cad kyis mi zhabrugs pa'i phyir ro/ /brgyad pa brtson 'grus dang rdo rje dang 'dra ste/ mi shigs pa nyid kyi sra ba'i phyir ro/ /dgu pa bsam gtan dang / ri'i rgyal po dang 'dra ste g.yeng bas mi g.yo ba'i phyir ro/ /bcu pa sher phyin dang / sman gyi rgyal po dang 'dra ste/ sgrib pa gnyis kyi nad rab tu zhi bar byed pa'i phyir ro/ /bcu gcig pa tshad med bzhi dang dge ba'i bshes gnyen dang 'dra ste/ gnas skabs thams cad du sems can thams cang yal bar mi 'dor ba'i phyir ro/ /bcu gnyis mngon shes lnga dang / yid bzhin gyi nor bu dang 'dra ste/ ji ltar mos pa bzhin de'i 'bras bus 'byor ba'i phyir ro/ /bcu gsum pa bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhi dang / nyi ma dang 'dra ste gdul bya'i lo thog yongs su smin par byed pa'i phyir ro/ /bcu bzhi pa so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi dang / dri za'i glu dbyangs snyan pa dang 'dra ste/ gdul bya 'dul bar byed pa'i chos ston pa'i phyir ro/ /bco lnga pa snyoms pa bzhi dang /'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal po dang 'dra ste/ chud mi za ba'i rgyu yin pa'i phyir ro/ /bcu drug pa tshogs gnyis bang mdzod dang 'dra ste/ bsod nams dang ye —10

shes kyi tshogs mang po'i mdzod kyi gnas yin pa'i phyir ro/ /bcu bdun pa byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos dang lam po che dang 'dra ste/ 'phags pa'i gang zag thams cad gshegs shing rjes su gshegs pa'i phyir/ bco brgyad pa zhi gnas dang lhag mthong bzhen pa dang 'dra ste/ bde blag tu 'byer ba'i phyir/ bcu dgu pa chos kyi don 'dzin pa'i gzungs dang / gzhan la ston pa'i spobs pa dang /bkod ma'i chu dang 'dra ste/ chu 'dzin zhing mi zad par 'byin pa dang 'dra bar thos pa dang ma thos pa'i chos kyis don 'dzin zhing mi zad par 'byin pa'i phyir ro/ /nyi shu pa chos kyi sdom bzhi dang / kun dga'i sgra snyan dang 'dra ste/ thar pa 'dod pa'i gdul bya rnams la snyan pa thos par byed pa'i phyir ro/ /nyer gcig pa bsgrod pa gcig pa'i lam dang / chu bo'i rgyun dang 'dra ste/ mi skye ba'i chos la bzod pa thob pa na rang gi ngang gis 'byung ba'i phyir ro/ /bsgrod pa gcig pa nyid ni/ sa der gtogs pa'i byang sem/sa rnams kyis bya ba byed pa tha mi dad pa'i phyir ro/ /nyer gnyis pa thabs mkhas pa dang / sprin dang 'dra ste/ ji ltar 'jig rten gyi 'byor ba thams cad sprin las byung ba ltar/ dga' ldan gyi gnas na bzhugs pa la sogs pa ston pa'i sgo nas de thams cad kyi don bya ba rnams de la rag las pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa/ de rnam par dag byed gdam ngag nod pa la/ gdam ngag bcu spyir bstan pa dang // theg dman gyi dge 'dun bye brag tu bshad pa'o/ /dang po la bzhi/ bsgrub pa rang gi ngo bo/ dmigs yul bden pa bzhi/ rten dkon mchog gsum/ sgrub rnga phun sum tshogs pa'i rgyu la gdams nga/'o/ /dang po la/ sgrub pa'i ngo bo mi rtog ye shes su bstan pa de rnam rtog bcu'i

gnyen po byed tshul mdo dang sbyar ba gnyis las/ dang po sgrub pa'i ngo bo ni/sher phyin zab mo'i rnal 'byor rnam par mi rtog pa yin no/ /gnyis pa ni/ mdo sde rgyan las/ rgyal ba'i srasarnams kyisani med dang yod pa dang / /zhes gsungs so/ /des na rnam rtog bcu po de'i gnyen por mi rtog pa'i rnal 'byor ni sgrub pa yin pa'i phyir/ yang gnyen po dag ston pa'i ngag ni sgrub pa la gdams pa'o/ /gnyis pa la dmigs yul bden pa bzhi las gdam pa la bzhi las/ dang po sdug bsngal bden pa la gdams pa ni/ phung po dang / khams dang / skye mched dang / 'phags pa'i bden pa dang / rten 'brel dang / 'dus byas dang 'dus ma byas te chos bdun po de'i stong nyid la brtson na sher phyin la brtson pa yin zhes pa'i don no/ /kun 'byung la gdams pa ni/gzugs sogs yang dag par skye ba dang / 'gag pa dang / kun nas nyon mongs pa dang rnam par byang ba'i chos can du mthong ngo / /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir zhes pa la sogs pa'i ngag go /'gog bden la gdam pa ni/rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi 'gog bden zab mo de la ni skye 'gag dang gzugs sogs nas byang chub kyi bar gyis brtags pa'i chos thams cad med do zhes ston pa'i ngag go /skabs 'dir byang chub dang sangs rgyas sogs med ces pa'i tshig gis brtags pa'i chos rnams 'gog par shes dgos kyi gshis lugs kyi sangs rgyas dang byang chub dang chos dbyings bkag par mi bsam mo lam gyi bden pa la gdams pa ni/ gzugs sogs la yang dag par brtson zhes bya ba'o/ /mi brtson zhes bya ba mi mthong ba des ni byang sems sher phyin la de ltar

brtson pa ni brtson zhes bya bar rig par bya'o/ /gsum pa rten dkon mchog gsum la gdams pa ni/ sangs rgyas dkon mchog la gnod pa ni/ yang dag par dus gsum ma mthong bas/ rnam mkhyen dang dus gsum mi sbyor ba dang /gzugs sogs yang dag par ma mthong bas gzugs sogs dang rnam mkhyen nyid du mi sbyor ro/ /de ltar brtson pa ni sher phyin la brtson par zhes bya'o/ /la sogs pa'i sgras chos dkon mchog la sbyor ba ni/ gzugs sogs chos rnams 'byung ba dang 'dzin pa dang rtag mi rtag dang / bde sdug dang bdag yod med dang zhi ma zhi stong mi stong / mtshan ma dang smon pa yod med dang / skye 'gag dang dus gsum zhes bya ba la sogs par mi sbyor ba de ltar brtson pa ni sher phyin la brtson zhes bya'o/ /bzhi pa bsgrub pa phun sum snartogs pa'i rgyu la gdams pa la bzhi ste/sgrub pa'i mi mthun phyogs spong pa'i rgyu brtson 'grus/ sgrub pa la gzhan gyi grangs mi 'jog pa'i rgyu spyan lnga sgrub pa'i yon tan thams cad rdzogs pa'i rgyu mngon shes drug /sgrub pa mthar thug pa'i rgyu lam la gdams pa'o/ /dang po la brtson 'grus rnam pa gsum ste/ ma zhen pa la gdams pa ni/ 'dir lus dang ngag dang yid du zhen cing dmigs pa ni/ byang sems kyi gnas ngan len no/ /lus sogs mi dmigs pa sa dang / nyan rang gi sems spangs nas dus thams cad du/ sems can la snying rje nye bar gnas pas/ gnas ngan len sbyong zhes pa nyid lus sogs la ma zhen par gdams pa'o/ /yongs su mi ngal ba la gdams pa ni/ chos thams cad la dmigs pa'i 'du shes kyi rloms sems su byed pa ni —13

ngal zhing dub par gyur pa las de mi byed pa ni sus kyang mi thub cing mi ngal zhes gdams so/ /lam yongs su 'dzin pa la gdams pa ni/ sa brgyad pa'i ye shes kyi theg pa 'og ma 'di'i spangs rtog kyang bsdus pas ye shes de dag ldan pa ni theg pa thams cad kyi lam yongs su 'dzin pa ste/ ye shes de dang ldan pa dus ngan song la sogs pa'i skyon thams cad mi 'dzin no zhes gdams pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ bdag rkyen rdzu 'phrul rkang pa bzhi la brten yul mthong ba ni mtshan nyid yin no/ /yul la lta bar byed pa dang gsal bar byed pas na mig ces bya'o/ /gnod 'joms las/ gzugs thams cad la 'jug pa'i shes pa ni sha'i mig go /ting nge 'dzin dang snyoms par 'jug pa thams cad shes pa ni lha'i mig go /thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes ni shes rab kyi mig go /gnas dang gnas ma yin pa mkhyen pa rtogs pa'i shes pa dgu po de dag ni chos kyi mig go /rdo rje lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin gyi ye shes ni sangs rgyas kyi mig go zhes gsungs so/ /'dod khams tshul ni/ de ltar byang chub sems dpa' mig lnga yongs su dag pa dang / thob par 'dod pa'i phar phyin drug la brtson par bya'o/ /zhes gdams so/ /gsum pa la/ rgyu ngo bo/ 'brasabu gsum las/ dang po ni mdo sde rgyan las/ bsam gtan bzhi pa shin tu dag thob nas/ /zhes sogasaso/ /gnyis pa ni/ bdag bskyed bsam gtan la brten nas yul mngon sum du gyur pa'i rig pa ni spyir mngon shes tsam gyi mtshan nyid do/ khyad par rdzu 'phrul gyi rnam 'phrul sna tshogs ston pa dang / sgra sna tshogs thos pa dang / sems can gyi sems kyis —14

spyod pa la 'jug pa dang / sngon gyi mtha' spyod pa rjes su dran pa dang / gzhan gyi skye ba dang 'chi 'pho sogs shes pa dang / skye ba las nges par 'byung ba'i thabs shes pa rnams yul gyi thad du bcug pa ni/ mngon shes kyi yon tan drug gi mtshan nyid/ yul sngon du gyur pa'i tshul gyis shes pas mngon shes dang / yul dus thams cad du bya ba thog med du byed pas mthu'o/ /de rnams kun rdzob kyi shes pas yongs su rdzogs pa dang don dam par mi dmigs pas rnam par dag pa ste gnyis bstan to/ /bzhi pa sgrub pa mthar phyin pa'i rgyu lam la gdams pa la gnyis las/ dang po mthong lam la gdams pa ni/ chos thams cad grag pa tsam du zad pas/ gzugs sogs ming dang brdar btags pa la bslab pa dang /sems can gtan med cing mi dmigs pas gzugs sogs byang sems kyi 'gyur ba med pa de ltar sher phyin la bslab pa dang / gzugs sogs rten med cing mi dmigs pas byang chub sems dpa' gzugs sogs kyi tshig bla dwags su 'gyur ba med par de ltar sher phyin la bslab par bya'o/ /zhes gdams pa'o/ /gnyis pa sgom lam la gdams pa ni/ chos thams cad mi dmigs shing ma mthong ba'i phyir chos thams cad la sems mi bkran pa de ltar sher phyin la bslab par bya'o zhes chos thams cad mi dmigs pas gdams pa mdzad do/ /gnyis pa theg dman gyi dge 'dun bye brag tu bshad pa ni/ theg pa 'og ma gnyis la slob pa'i gang zag kun shes nyid kyis nyer zhir khrid par bya rgyu mdo'i gong 'og bar gsum du byung ba rnams bde blag tu rtogs pa'i phyir/bstan bcos kyis phyogs gcig tu bsdus nas theg dman gi dge 'dun nyi shu —15

po de yang gang zhe na/ dbang po brtul po dang / dbang po rnon po ste gnyis dang /de'i steng du bar ma ste mya ngan las 'da' ba/ de'i steng du dad pas mos pa dang /mthong bas thob pa gnyis te bzhi'o/ /de'i steng du lha'i rigs nas rigs su skye ba dang / mi'i rigs nas rigs su skye ba dang drug go /de'i steng du tshe gcig bar chad gcig pa ste bdun no/ /de'i steng du bar ma dor mya ngan las 'da' ba dang / skyes nas 'da' ba dang / mngon par 'du byed pa dang bcas pas 'da' ba dang / mngon par 'du byed pa ma yin par 'da' ba dang bzhi ste bcu gcig go /de'i steng du 'og min du 'gro ba dang bcu gnyis so/ /de'i steng du 'phar ba gsum ste bco lnga'o/ /de'i steng du srid rtse'i mthar thug 'gro dang bcu drug go /de'i steng du gzugs kyi chagaso bcom dang bcu bdun no/ /de'i steng du mthong ba'i chos la zhi ba thob pa dang bco brgyad do/ /de'i steng du lus kyi mngon sum du byed pa dang bcu dgu'o/ /de'i steng du bse ru lta bu ste rang sangs rgyas dang nyi shu'o/ /gsum pa de sgom pa'i 'bras bu nges 'byed yan lag la/ chos drug mdor bstan pa'i sgo nas khyad par gyi chos bzhis nyan rang las 'phags par bstan/ ngo bo ngos bzung ba'i sgo nas drug po so sor phye ste rgyas par bshad pa'o/ / dang po ni/ dmigs pa dang zhes pa nas khyad par 'phags pa zhes pa 'dis/ byang semasakyi sbyor lam nyan rang gi sbyor lam las/ chos bzhi'i khyad par du 'phags pa bstan te/ 'di ltar byang chub sems dpa' 'gro ba thams cad skyob pa'i bsam pa can de'i sbyor lam drod dang sogs pa'i sgras bsdus pa —16

rtse mo dang bzod pa dang chos mchog gi bdag nyid bzhi po go rim ji lta ba bzhin du zlog pa'i gzungs/ srog dang 'jug pa'i gzungs rtog dang / rdzas 'dzin rtog pa dang rtag par 'dzin pa'i rnam rtog bzhi po spang byar ldan zhing de'i gnyen po byang sems kyi rgyud la brtan pa drod sogs re re yang chung dang 'bring dang chen por phye ba bcu gnyis po rnams gzhan nas so/ /khyad par gyi chos dmigs pa dang rnam pa dang / rgyu dang yongs su 'dzin pa bzhi po de yis so/ /gnyis pa ngo bo ngos bzung ba'i sgo nas drug po so sor phye ste/ rgyas par bshad pa la drug ste/ dmigs pa dang rnam pa dang rgyu dang che 'bring chung gsum du dbye ba dang / rnam rtog bzhi po dang / yongs 'dzin rgyas par bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ dmigs pa'i ngo bo gang zhe na/ drod sogs bzhi po'i dmigs pa gzugs rber+shags mi rtag pa dang la rber+shags pa'i sgras bsdus pa sdug bsngal ba dang / bdag med pa dang / mi sdug pa dang / zhi ba dang / stong pa dang / mtshan ma med pa dang /smon pa med pa ste/ 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi'i btags can gyi chos rnams so//gnyis pa ni/ rnam pa'i ngo bo gang zhe na bden pa'i chos ma rig pa la sogs pa des ni rnam pa ma rig pa sogs la mngon par zhen pa dang la sogs pa'i sgras bsdus pa gnas pa dang kun du shes pa ste/ rim pa ltar lta ba phyin ci mthog pa dang / 'du shes phyin ci log gsum po yin pas/ de gsum 'gog cing med pa'i rnam pa gang yin pa de yin no/ /gsum pa ni/ theg pa gsum char thob pa'i rgyu zhes pa 'dis/ nges 'byed yang dag rnam pa bzhi po thams cad theg pa gsum char thob pa'i rgyu yin par bstan to/ / —17

bzhi pa chung 'bring che gsum gyi dbye ba bshad pa la/ drod chung 'bring che gsum du bshad pa/ rtse mo chung 'bring che gsum du bshad pa/ bzod pa chung 'bring che gsum du bshad pa/ chos mchog chung 'bring che gsum du bshad pa'o/ /dang po drod chung ngu ni/ gzugs sogs yang dag par yod pa la ming tsam gyi bskur ba 'debs pa ni/ 'dun pa ste 'grib pa dang yang dag pa med pa la ming tsam gyi sgro 'dogs pa ni 'god pa ste 'phel ba'o/ /yang dag par drod chung ngu'i ye shes de brtags pa'i chos thams cad ma mthong zhing ming de yang med pa'i phyir/ gzugs sogs gnod bral ba dang / mi gnas pa dang bral ba'i ye shes drod chung ngu yin no/ /des na drod chung ngu ni gzugs sogs la sgro bskur med cing ming thams cad gnas pa med pa'i ye shes zhes pa'i don no/dhe/gnyis pa drod 'bring po ni/ phyir mi ldog pa'i sa la mi gnas pa'i tshul gyis gnas pa dang / phung po khams nas/ ma 'dres pa'i bar chos su btags pa tsam dang / de ltar 'dogs pa'i ming ni dge mi dge la sogs chos gang gis kyang brjod du med pa'i ye shes so/ /spyo pa'i don te/ gsum pa drod r+pā po'i gnas skabs kyi byang sems ni/ kun btags dang gzhan dbang gis/ gzugs sogs la gzugs pa'i rnam rtog gis mi gnas de/ kun brtags dang gzhan dbang gis gzugs sogs de dag ni/ chos nyid kyi gzugs sogs de'i ngo bor gyur pa yongs su grub pa'i rang bzhi dang gcig nyid med pa'i phyir ro/ /de ltar na chos dang chos nyid ngo bo tha dad du tsor ro zhe na/ chos can gzugs ra tsha 1do /bye /re/ de tsho 95 shāwakhrinar tsho yig :detha//bye 95sags dag ga ga sa 'tshos nyad dang rang ba stang pa nyad ga pa nyad —18— —pa

do/ /gnyis pa rtse mo chung ngu'i gnas skabs kyis byang sems stong nyid kyis rnal 'byor la spyod pa de gzugs sogs de ma rig pa dang sogs pa'i sgras sdug bsngal ba dang / bdag med pa dang / zhi ba dang / stong pa dang / mtshan ma med pa dang / smon pa med pa dang / dben pa dang / gzung ba'i rnam rtog gis mi gnas te/ stong pa nyid kyis gzugs mi rtag la sogs pa/ de rnams brtags pa'i gzugs mi rtag pa la sogs pa/ de rnams brtags pa'i gzugs mi rtog pa sogs de'i ngo bos stong pa'i phyir dang / gzugs ma rig pa sogs de dag gcig gis chos nyid dang / rang bzhin stong pa nyid gcig pa nyid kyi phyir ro/ /gnyis pa/ rtse mo 'bring ni/ gzung ba'i rnam rtog gis chos rnams mi 'dzin pa gang yin pa de yin te/ chos de dag mtshan mar mi mthong ba'i ye shes yin pa'i phyir dang / yongs grub kyi gzugs sogs ni/ gzung ba med cing /mtshan ma yang ma yin pa'i phyir ro/ /gsum pa rtse mo chen po ni/ brtags pa bzhis sher phyin nyid la yongs su rtog pa ni/ chos thams cad dmigs su med par mthong ba'i ye shes so/ /brtags pa bzhi ni/ sher phyin 'di gang / 'di ni gang gi 'di ni ci'i phyir 'di ni ci zhig na/ shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin zhes pa lta bu'o/ /gsum pa bzod pa che 'bring chung gsum las/ dang po chos nyid kyi gzugs sogs dngos po ngo bo nyid med pa gang yin pa de ni/ brtags pa'i mtshan nyid med pa nyid kyis ngo bo nyid du gyur pa'i ye shes so/ /gnyis pa ni/shes pa med pa'i phyir brtags pa'i chos de dag skye ba med cing / de la nges par 'gyur ba med pa dang / rang bzhin gyi rnam par dag pa'i phyir/ chos nyid kyi —19

gzugs sogs de dag dri bcas kyi gnas skabasan skye ba med cing / dri med kyi gnas skabs na glo bur gyi ngesapar 'byung ba med pas mi dmigs par spyod pa'i byang sems te/ lus ngag sems mtshan ma yongaba'isu dag pa dang / lasakyi dbang gis ngan song du mi skye'o/ /gsum pa ni chos nyid kyi gzugs sogs de dag gzugs sogs la ting nge 'dzin rtog pa'i spyod pa'i mtshan ma med cing sems phyin ci log gis so/ /kun du shes par bya ba ni 'du shesaphyin ci log gis so/ /mos zhes bya ba ni lta ba phyin ci log gis so/ /bzhi pa chos mchog che 'bring chung gsum las/ dang po ni rnam par mi rtog pa'i ting nge 'dzin dang / ting nge 'dzin de'i byed pa nyid yin no/ /ting nge 'dzin de la dbye na/ chos thams cad skye ba med pa dang / dpa' bar 'gro ba la sogs pa brgya dang nyer gcig go /ting nge 'dzin gyi byed pa ni/ de dang des gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' myur du 'tshang rgya ba yin no/ /gnyis pa ni byang sems ting nge 'dzin de dag gis smra ba de de bzhin gshegs pas gang bla na med pa'i byang chub tu lung ston pa dang / bdag ni dus gsum du snyoms par zhugs so/ /'jug go/'jug par 'gyur ro/ /snyams su ting nge 'dzin des rlom sems su 'gyur ba zad pa yin no/ /gsum pa ni/ gnas skabs 'dir gnyis 'dzin nub pas yul dang yul can mnyam pa nyid kyi phyir sher phyin dang ting nge 'dzin dang / byang sems gsum po phan tshun gzhi mthun pa yin pa'i tshul gyis ngo bo gcig go /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ ting nge 'dzin rnam par mi rtog pa yin pa'i phyir ro/ /chung 'bring che gsum gyi don bsdu ba ni/ gong du bshad pa de ltar thams —20—

cad kyi mthug bsdu ba nges 'byed cha mthun drod rtse bzod chos mchog bzhi po ni re re yang chung dang 'bring dang chen po gsum gsum phye nas rnam pa bcu gnyis yin no/ /lnga pa rnam rtog la dbye na gzung rtog dang 'dzin rtog gnyis so/ /rim pa ltar gang zhig gzung bar 'dzin pa dang / gang zhig 'dzin par 'jigs pa ni mtshan nyid do/ /dang po gzung rtog ni gzhi kun nas nyon mongs skyon can du 'dzin pa dang / nyon slongs de'i gnyen po rnam par byang ba yon tan can du 'dzin pa'i khyad par rim pa ltar ldog pa'i gzung bar rtog pa dang / 'jug pa'i gzung bar rtog pa rnam pa gnyis bstan to/ /de dag re re'ang rmongs pa ma rig pa dang / srid pa la sogs pa dang / phung khams skye mched la sogs pa'i bye brag gis gzung rtog gnyis po re re ni so sor phye ba rnam pa dgu dgu yin no/ /gang zhig 'jug bya'i yul skyon can du mthong zhing der zhen pa blo ldog pa gzung rtog dang / gang zhig gzung bya'i yul yon tan du mthong zhing der zhen pa'i blo 'jug pa gzung rtog gnyis pa 'dzin rtog la gang zhig sems rdzas su yod par chen pa'i blo rdzas 'dzin rtog pa dang / gang zhig sems rtag pa bar yod par zhen pa'i blo rtag 'dzin rtog par lta ste/ sems can rdzas su yod pa'i rten can te yul can dang / sems can rtag par yod pa'i rten can te/ yul can gyis 'dzin pa'ang rnam pa gnyis su 'dod de gang gi sgras ni snga ma gnyis su phye ba ltar ro/ /'dzin rtog de dag rang dbang can du bdag dang sogs pa'i sgras/ sems can dang skyes bu sogs ngo bo rten gyi dbye ba dgu dang / phung po dang sogs pa'i sgras khams dang skye mched sogs rten gyi dbye ba dgu las/ rten can 'dzin rtog —21—

gnyis po yang dgu dgur dbye ba ni/ ji ltar gzung rtog ni dbye ba bzhin no/ /drug pa yongs 'dzin bshad pa ni/ gang gi phyir de ltar yin pa de'i phyir thabs la mkhas pa'i ngo bo yongs 'dzin ni/ sems mi 'gongs pa ste/ skrag pa nyid dang sogs pa'i sgras sngangs pa dang / sngangs par gyur pa ni rim pa ltar skrag pa chung dang 'bring dang chen po ngo bor gnod 'joms las gsungs/ rgyu gzhan yang med pa ni ma yin te/ mnges rgyan du/ 'a17 ba de gnas min la bskrag pa gdung byed 'gyur/ zhes sogs gsungs/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyis sher phyin ston pa 'di thos na/ sems mi 'gongs pa nyid la sogs pa'i rgyu thabs la mkhas pa ni/ chos thams cad la ngo bo nyid med par so sor rtog pa'i dang sogs pa'i sgras phar phyin drug rdzogs par bya ba dang / theg chen phyin ci ma log par ston byed kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen la brten pa'i dang bshes gnyen de'i mi mthun phyogs sdig pa'i grogs po bor ba'i thabs la mkhas pa ste/ dus dang rnam pa kun du yongs 'dzin gyi ngo bor gyur pa ni/ bzhi pa gdam pa'i don phyin ci ma log pa'i sgrub pa la bzhi ste sgrub pa la 'jug pa'i rten rigs kyi rang cibazhin/ sgrub pa pos shes par byed pa'i yul dmigs pa/ sgrub pa po byang sems la sems dpa' chen po zhes pa'i rgyu mtshan ched du bya ba/ sgrub pa dang ni ngo bo'o/ /dang po ni/ gal te chos kyi dbyings la dbyer med phyir/ don dam pa'i dbang gis rigs ni tha dad du dbye bar rung ba ma yin no snyam na/ don dam pa nyid la de lta yin yang / kun rdzob kyi dbang gis chos sgrub pa tha dad pa nyid kyi bye brag rtogs pa'i chos dag 'jug pa'i rten gnyen po 'jug pa'i brtan/ spong —22

ba 'jug pa'i brtan zhes pa'i tshul dag gis/ bstan chos nyid de'i dbye ba yongs su brjod pa ni 'gal ba med do/ /dper na nam mkha' la dbye ba med kyang / shar phyogs kyi nam mkha' dang zhes pa la sogs pa ltar ro/ /gnyis pa sgrub pa pos shes par bya ba'i yul dmigs pa la/ spyir bstan pa dang / so sor bshad pa gnyis las/ dang po ni/ dmigs pa chos thams cad ste/ de yang dge la sogs pa yis/ gnyis pa so sor bshad pa ni/ 'jig rten pa'i rtogs pa ste/chos ni phung po khams skye mched dge ba bcu/ bsam gtan tshad med/ gzugs med dang / mngon shes lnga'o/ /gang dag 'jig rten las 'das par 'dod pa'i chos ni/ dran pa nyer bzhag nas/ ma 'dres bco brgyad kyi bar rnams so/ /zag bcasakyi chos ni/ phung po khams skye mched dang bsam gtan tshad med gzugs med rnams so/ /zag pa med pa'i chos ni dran pa nyer bzhag nas/ ma 'dres pa'i bar dag go /gang dag 'dus byas ni/ khams gsum dang 'dus byas su gtogs pa'i ma 'dres pa'i bar dag go /'dus ma byas ni dus gsum zad pa dang de bzhin nyid la sogs pa'i yongs grub rnams so/ /slob pa nyan rang dang /thun mong pa'i chos ni/ bsam gtan bzhi/ tshad med bzhi/ gzugs med bzhi/mngon shes lnga rnams so/ /gang dag thub pa'i thun mong ma yin pa byang phyogs so bdun dang / stobs sogs nas ma 'dres bco brgyad kyi bar du 'byung ngo / /gsum pa sgrub pa po byang sems la sems dpa' chen po zhes pa'i rgyu mtshan ched du bya ba ni sems can kun mchog ces sogs te/ de la phyed ni gangabya ba ni gang zhe na chen po gsum ni phyed do/ /sems dpa' chen po ni bya ba'o/ /—23—

byang sems la don gang gi ched du/ sems dpa' chen po zhes zer ba'i rgyu ni/sems can kun gyi mchog nyid du gyur pa'i sems chen po dang / spong ba chen po dang / rtogs pa chen po ste/ gsum po de dang ldan pa'i byang chub sems dpa' chen po gsum gyi rang byung ste/ rang bzhin gyi ched du bya ba sems dpa' chen po zhes smos pa 'di shes par bya'o/ /bzhi pa sgrub pa'i ngo bo la/ go cha dang / 'jug pa dang / tshogs dang nges par 'byung ba'i sgrub pa'o/ /dang po ni/ bsam gtan rgya chen pos kun nas blangs pa'i sgrub pa rgya chen po yang phar phyin gcig gi nang du phar phyin thams cad rdzogs par sgrub pa ni/ sbyin pa la sogs pa phar phyin rnam pa drug la/ sbyin pa'i sbyin pa la sogs la re re la'ang drug drug tu yod pa rnams de dag rang rang so sor bsdus pa yis/ go cha'i sgrub pa gang yin pa de pha rol du phyin pa drug tshan drug ni mdo las gsungs pa ji lta ba bzhin du bshad par bya ba yin no/ / ciganyis pa 'jug sgrub la/ ngo bo dang / de yul gang la 'jug pa dang gsum/ dang po ni byang chub sems dpa' sbyin sogasaphyin drug la spyod pa'i bsam gtan bzhi/ tshad med bzhi/ gzugs med bzhi la snyoms par 'jug cing ldang ba na dge ba de dag sems can thams cad dang thun mong du byas nas/bla med byang chub tu bsngo ba ni/ bsam gtan gzugs med kyi 'jug pa'i sgrub pa dang / de dag snyoms par 'jug pa'i ngang nas phar phyin drug rdzogs par byed pa ni/ sbyin sogs kyis 'jug pa'i sgrub pa dang / dran pa nyer bzhag nas ma 'dres bco brgyad kyi bar dag sgom pa ni lam 'jug pa'i sgrub pa dang / sems —24

can thams cad skyabs par gzhol ba byams pa'i ting nge 'dzin dang / sems can thams cad la snying brtse bar gzhol ba snying rje'i ting nge 'dzin dang / sems can thams cad bsgral bar bya'o zhes gzhol ba dga' ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang /sems can thams cad kyi zag pa zad par bya ba la gzhol ba btang snyoms kyi ting nge 'dzin ni byams pa la sogs pa'i 'jug pa'i sgrub pa dang / nang stong pa nyid la sogs pa'i chos thams cad la dmigs pa'i shes pa 'jug pa med pa dang ldan pa'i tshul gyis chos thams cad shes pa dang / 'khor gsum rnam par dag pa'i phar phyin drug dang / 'dod pa brgyad pa'i phyin drug rgyu gnod 'joms su gsungs so/ /skabs 'di'i ched du bya ba bzhi snyoms pa rnam par sgom pa'i ched du bya ba ni mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis nang stong pa nyid nas ma 'dres pa'i bar dag sgoms pa yin no/ /sgom pa rnam par sgoms pa ni dmigs pa'i sgoms pa thams cad bzhin pa'i don yin pa'i phyir ro/ /mngon shes rnams rdzogs pa'i phyir sems dang po bskyed pa nas bzung ste/ byang chub snying po'i bar du sems can smin par byed pa dang / sangs rgyas la mchod pa byas pa ni mngon shes drug gis 'jug pa'i sgrub pa ste rnam pa brgyad do/ /gnyis pa ni/ gang la 'i〈cog pas sgrub pa zhes bya zhe na/ rnam kun mkhyen pa'i tshul te/ chos thams cad dngos po'i ngo bo nyid yod pa la slob cing 'ju pa'i sgrub pa yin pa'i phyir ro/ /gsum pa ni las ci zhig byed par shes par bya zhe na/ theg chen la 'jug pa yin par shes par bya'o/ /gsum pa tshogs sgrub la/ tshogs sgrub kyi ngo bo/ tshogs sgrub la bzhugs pa/ tshogs sgrub kyi byed las —25

so/ /dang po ni/ go cha dgod pa rnams kyi nang nas/ rnam par smin pa lasabyung ba'i/ rdzu 'phrul gyi phyogs bcu'i ngan 'gro zhi bar byed pa sgyu ma lta bu ni brtse ba dang / sgyu ma'i chos nyid nye bar gzungs nas/ phar phyin drug la rang nyid gnasaste gzhan yang de dag la dgod pa sgyu ma lta bu ni sbyin sogs drug dang / rnam mkhyen dang ldan pa'i sems rtse gcig pas gnas shing / sgyu ma'i chos nyid gzung nas phyogs bcu'i sems can sbyin sogs la dgod pa sgyu ma lta bu ni zhi gnas dang / sgyu ma'i chos nyid sgrub pa yongs su grub kyi gzugs sogs te/ kun btags pa'i ngo bo dngos po'i gzugs sogs kyi stong pa'i ye shes ni lhag mthong ste/ de dang bcas pa dang / yongs grub kyi gzugs sogs ma bcings ma grol bar mthong ba'i ye shes ni zhi lhag gi thabs shes zung du 'brel ba'i lam gang yin pa de nyid yimyo no/ /de la dmigs pa'i tshul gyis phar phyin drug la rang nyid gnas shing gzhan yang 'god pa ni thabs la mkhas pa gang yin pa dang /ye shes dang ni zhes pa ni nang stong pa nyid la sogs pa stong nyid rnams yin te stong nyid zab mo rnams rang stong ma yin par gzhan stong yin pa la sogs par bstan pa'o/ /bsod nams dang zhes pa ni dpa' 'bar 'gro ba la sogs pa'i ting nge 'dzin rnams so/ /lam dang zhes pa la bco lnga ste/ byang phyogs so bdun dang rnam thar sgo gsum la sogs pa'o/ /gzung dang zhes pa ni/ 'dzin par byed pas na gzungs so/ /de la bzod pa thob pa'i rgyur 'gyur ba'i gzungs dang /gsang sngags kyi gzungs dang / chos kyi gzungs dang don gyi gzungs/ gnyis pa tshogs sgrub la zhugs pa'i rang bzhin bstan pa ni/ yongs su sbyong ba'i chos ri 26

tshornam pa bcu tham pa yis/ sa ni dang po thob par 'gyur te/ rnam mkhyen dang ldan pa'i yid la bya bas dge ba thams cad sgrub pa ni lhag pa'i bsod nams mi dmigs pa'i phyir phan pa'i dngos po yongs su sbyong ba nyid dang / rnam mkhyen dang ldan pa'i yid la bya bas tshad med bzhi sgrub pa ni sems can mi dmigs pa'i phyir/ sems can rnams la sems mnyam pa yongs su sbyong ba nyid dang /sems can rnams la rnam rtog med par sbyin pa yongs su bskong ba dang / rnam cimakhyen nyid la bskul zhing 'jog par byed pa'i bshes gnyen bsten pa dang /rnam mkhyen dang ldan pa'i sems kyis chos 'tshol la/ nyan rang gi sar mi lhung ba ni/ chose thams cad mi dmigs pa'i phyir/ dam chose dmigs pa 'tshol ba yongs su sbyong ba dang / sangs rgyas kyi sku mthong na rnam mkhyen ma thob bar sangs rgyas yid la byed pa dang / mi 'bral ba ni mtshan dpe mi dmigs pa'i phyir/ sangs rgyas kyi skur 'dod dga' ba yongs su sbyong ba dang / gsung rab yan lag bcu gnyis sems can rnams la phyin ci ma 31ga par ston pa ni/ chos kyi dbye ba mi dmigs pa'i phyir/ chos ston pa yongs su sbyong ba dang / ji skad smra ba de bzhin du byed pa ni/ tshig mi dmigs pa'i phyir/ bden pa'i tshig yongs su sbyong ba ni bcu pa yin par 'dod de/ de dag rnams kyang rang bzhin mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis spyod pa yongs su sbyong bar shes par bya ste tshul ni kun la 'dres so/ /sa gnyis pa'i yongs sbyong ni/ nyan rang gi sems dang / tshul khrims dang / byang chub la bar chad byed pa'i chos yid la mi byed pa ni tshul khrims —27

yongasasu dag pa dang / byang chub semasadapa' spyad pa spyod pa na/ byasapa chung yang chud mi gson na/ chen po lta ci smosapa ni byas pa bzo ba dang / sems can thams cad la gnod 'tshe'i sems med pa ni bzod pa dang / theg pa gsum la sems can smin par byed pa ni dga' zhing rab tu dga' ba dang / sems can thams cad yongs su skyobs pa ni semasacan mi gtong ba dang / sems can re re'i phyir yang bskal pa du mar gyur pa'i sdug bsngal myong bar bya'o snyam pas sems can thams cad kyi phyir spro zhing mi skyo ba ni snying brtse che ba dang / bla ma rnams la ston pa'i 'du shes bskyed pa ni bkur bsti bla ma la gus mnyam pa dang / sems can thams cad smin par bya ba'i phyir las gzhan mi byed par/phar phyin rnams yongs su sbyong ba ni brgyad pa sbyin pa la sogs pa la brtson pa yin no/ /sa gsum pa ni/ rnam pa lngas sbyong ste/ phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba rnams kyis gang ci gsungs pa thams cad gzung bar bya'o snyam du chog mi shes pa ni thos pas mi ngoms pa nyid dang / chos ston kyang chos kyis sbyin pa'i dge ba de/ tha na byang chub la yang re ba med pa ni zang zing med par chos kyi sbyin pa dang / rang gzhan gyi sems kyi zhing dag par byed pa'i dge ba bsgrub pa ni/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing kun yongs su sbyong ba dang / spyad pa spyod pa ni/ rnam mkhyen ma rdzogasakyi bar du nam yang skyo bar mi 'gyur ba ni dpag tu med pa'i 'khor bas yongs su mi skyo ba dang / nyan rang gi sems la gnod pa ni ngo tsha shes shing khrel yod pa la gnas zhes bya ba de dag kyang rloms sems med pa'i bdag nyid de rnam pa lngas —28—

so/ /bzhi pa ni rnam pa bcu gnyis kyi dag pa yin te/ nyan rang gi sa las shin tu 'da' ba ni/ nags su gnas pa dang / bla na med pa'i byang chub kyang mi 'dod pa ni 'dod pa chung ba dang / rnam mkhyen thob kyang rloms sems mi byed pa ni chog shes pa dang / chos zab mo la nges par sems pa'i bzod pa ni/ sbyang ba yang dag sdom bstan dang / gang la bslab pa thams cad rgyu med pa ni bslab pa yongs su mi gtong ba dang / 'dod sems mi skye ba ni/ 'dod pa'i yon tan rnams la smod pa dang / chos thams cad la mngon par 'du byed pa med pa ni/ mya ngan las 'das pa'i sems dang / nang dang phyi rol gyi chos rnams 'dzin pa med pa ni bdog pa kun gtong ba dang / rnam shes la gnas pa rnams la sems mi sbyor ba ni/ sems mi zhum pa dang / dngos po thams cad yid la mi byed pa ni/dngos po thams cad la lta ba med pa yin te/ de ltar bcu po dag pas so/ /sa lnga pa ni bcu spangs pas thog ste/ 'di ltar rdzus te skye ba dang / skra bregs shing gos ngur smrig gyon pa ni/ khyim pa dang 'grogs pa spangs pa dang /sems can 'di dag bdag gi bsod nams kyi bde bar 'gyur ba la/ ser sna'i sems bskyed par mi bya'o snyam pa ni/ rang gi khyim la 'khres pa ste ser sna byed pa spong ba dang / nyan rang gi sems ni 'du 'dzin te/ der skye ba'i gnas spong ba dang / nang dang phyi'i chos rnams yang dag par mi mthong ba ni/ rim pa ltar bdag la bstod pa dang / phyi'i chos rnams yang dag par rjes su mi mthong ba ni gzhan la brnyas pa ste/ smod pa spong ba dang / srog gcod pa la sogs pa ni/ bde 'gro la yang bar du gcod par byed na 'phags pa'i lam dang byang chub —29

la lta ci smos te/ mi dge ba'i las kyi lam bcu spongs ba dang / rlom sems dang khengs pa skye ba'i chos ci yang ma mthong ba ni rlom sems spongs pa dang / khengs pa spongs pa dang / dngos po rnams mi dmigs pa ni phyin ci log spong ba dang /blo ngan ste the tshom spong ba dang / dug gsum gyi dngos po ma mthong ba ni nyon mongs bzod pa ste/ rang dgar 'jog pa spong ba dang / de ltar bshad pa'i spang bya'i chos bcu po 'di ni rnam par spangs nas sa lnga pa yang dag par 'thob pa yin no/ /sa drug pa ni/ gnyen po du zhig rdzogs shing / spang bya'i chos yongs su spangs pas/ sa drug pa thob ce na/ gnyen po drug rdzogs shing / spang bya drug spangs pas 'thob ste/ rdzogs par bya ba gnyen po'i chos ni phar phyin drug go /byang chub kyi lam ma yin pa'i phyir/ slob ma nyan thos la dga' ba'i sems spangs pa dang / byang chub kyi lam la yin pa'i phyir/ bse ru rang sangs rgyas la dga' ba'i sems dpa' dang / byang chub kyi lam ma yin pa'i phyir/ gzhan don la skrag pa'i sems spangs pa dang / byang chub kyi sems ma yin pa'i phyir/ slong ba pos bslangs na sems mi zhus pa dang / byang chub kyi lam ma yin pa'i phyir bdog pa kun gtang yang / sems mi dga' ba med pa dang / rang nyid dbul yang slong mo ba mi spongs ba sems dang po bskyed phyin chad drag tu sbyin pa gtong ba dang / sems can du mi byed pas sa drug mngon du gyur pa yang dag pa thob pa snyun no/ /sa bdun pa la gnyis te/ nyes pa spong tshul dang / yon tan rdzogs tshul —30

lo/ /dang po ni/ nyi shu ste/ bdag dang sems can du 'dzin pa dang / srog tu 'dzin pa dang / gang zag tu 'dzin par mi bya ste/ bdag la sogs pa de dag ni dngos po rten med pa'i phyir ro/ /chad par 'dzin pa dang rtag par 'dzin par mi bya ste/ chos gang yang mi skye ba de rtag chad du mi 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/ /mtshan ma'i 'du shes mi bya ste/ kun nas nyon mongs rten med pa'i phyir ro/ /rgyur lta bar mi bya ste lta ba de yang dag par rjes su mi mthong ba'i phyir ro/ /phung po dang khams dang skye mched rnams la zhen par mi bya ste/ chos de dag rang bzhin gyis med pa'i phyir ro/ khams gsum la chen pas gnas pa dang chags par mi bya ste/ de dag dngos por med pa'i phyir ro/ /sems ni kun du zhum shing sgyid lugs par mi bya ste/ kun btags dngos po'i chos thams cad gzugs su rung ba la sogs pa'i rang gi mtshan nyid kyi stong pa ni yongs su grub pa'i ngo bo stong pa nyid kyi mi stong pa'i phyir ro/ /dkon mchog gsum gyis dngos por dmigs pa'i lta bas dkon mchog gsum mi mthong bas/ dkon mchog gi dngos po der lta ba'i mngon par zhen par mi bya ste/ mi dmigs pa'i ye shes kyi mthong ba'i phyir ro//tshul khrims der lta ba'i mngon par zhen par mi bya'o/ /chos thams cad stong pa nyid zhes pa 'di dang / stong nyid kyi mtshan nyid 'di 'gal lo zhes stong pa nyid la rtsod pa dang / chos thams cad stong pa nyid de dang / stong nyid kyi mtshan nyid 'di 'gal ba'i nyes pa chad cing med pa yin no/ /de ltar nyi shu po sa bdun pa'i byang chub sems dpa' gang la rnam par chad pa'i rgyu de'i sa bdun pa ring du song ba 'thob bo/ gnyis pa yon tan rdzogs tshul ni nyi shu ste/ stong pa nyid kyi dngos —31—
