gsum pa thugs kyi 'pho ba ni/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/snod bcud thams cad 'od du zhu nas rang la thim/ rang lus kyang stong par thim par bsam/ lte ba'i thad kyi bar snang stong pa der rang sems rig cing gsal ba tsam de nyid rim pas lte ba'i thad nas snying ga'i thad dang / snying ga nas mgrin pa'i thad dang / mgrin pa nas spyi bo'i thad tsam nas dbyings su thim pa'am/ bla ma yi dam gang mos kyi thugs gar 'pho'o/ /'di la ci ste dmigs pa mi gsal na/ rang sems 'od kyi rnam par bya zhing / lte ba'i thad kyi cha nges pa yang lag pa mdun rgyab gnyis ka nas lte ba'i thad du reg pas reg bya yod par sems bstad do/ /bzhi pa ye shes kyi 'pho ba ni/ lte ba'i thad du zhu bde'i nyams myong yod na drangs la dmigs pa bstad/ de ltar med na bde bar mos pa tsam byas la/'pho tshul thugs dang 'dra'o/ /de rnams kyis sngon 'gro sgyu lus 'phros don dang bcas pa song nas/ gnyis pa dngos gzhi 'od gsal la/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor ni/ rang gi spyi bor bla ma sgom/ de'i thugs gar thig le dkar la dmar pa'i mdangs can 'od zer 'phro ba zhig dmigs la thugs ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin yin snyam du mos/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ snod thams cad gzhal yas khang dang / bcud thams cad lhar gyur par bsam/ de rnams 'od du zhu nas bla ma'i sku la thim par mos la/ gnyid kyi 'od gsal zin pa dang / sad dus kyi 'od gsal khyad par can zin par gsol ba btab/ bla ma 'od du zhu nas rang la bstim/ de nas rang yi dam du gsal ba'i lus kyi dbus su rtsa dbu ma gsal 137

thebs na/ snying ga'i thad kyi dbu ma'i nang du pad+ma'i lte ba dang / dbu ma'i phyi rol gyi phyogs bzhi la pad 'dab bzhi yod par sgom/ dbu ma mi gsal na snying gar pad+ma 'dab ma bzhi pa zhig sgom/ dbu ma mi gsal na snying gar pad+ma 'dab ma bzhi pa zhig sgom pa'i lte ba sbugs stong du yod pa'i am shad dam/ hūṃ sngon po zhig sgom/ 'dab ma bzhi la shar nas g.yas skor gyis ma ning gi yi ge ṛ dṛ '-i lī bzhi gsal btab la/ rlung bum pa can bzung zhing / de rnams la sems bstad/ de nas mdun gyi ṛ yig thung ngu la dmigs pa bstad cing / bum pa can gsum la sogs pa 'dzin / de bzhin du gzhan gsum la yang re re bzhin dmigs pa bstad cing / bum pa can gsum la sogs pa 'dzin/ dbus kyi yi ge la cung yun ring ba tsam sems bstad cing bum can bzung / de nas shar gyi ṛ yig thung ngu de g.yas kyi dṛ yig ring po la thim pas/ de brjid dang ldan par gyur zhing / shar gyi pad 'dab stong sang ste gyur bar bsams la/ g.yas kyi yi ge la sems bstad cing / rlung bum pa can 'dzin/ de bzhin du dṛ yig ring po rgyab kyi '-i yig thung ngu la thim pa dang / mṛ yig thung ngu g.yon gyi lī yig ring po la thim pa dang / de yang dbus kyi yi ge la thim pas de brjid dang ldan zhing 'od 'bar bar bsams la/ de la dmigs pa bstad cing / rlung bum pa can 'dzin no/ /de ni 'od gsal 'dzin pa'i dmigs pa 'bring po yin la/ bsdus pa ni/rang gi snying gar pad+ma 'dab ma bzhi pa'i lte bar sa bon la mos na hūṃ sngon po gsal btab la de la dmigs pa gtod pa dang / thig le la mos na hūṃ zhu ba las thig le sngon po 'od 'phro ba zhig sgom pa dang / lha sku la mos na/ pad+ma'i lte —138

bar yi dam zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa zhig sgom la/ de la sems bstad pas 'od gsal zin par 'gyur ro/ /'od gsal 'dzin pa'i dmigs pa rgyas pa ni/ rang yi dam du gsal ba'i snying ga chos kyi 'khor lo rtsa 'dab brgyad pa kha thur bstan dang / lte ba sprul 'khor rtsa 'dab drug cu rtsa bzhi pa kha gyen bstan/ de gnyis ka 'phrad pa lte ba'i 'khor lo'i lte bar gtum mo'i rang bzhin a shad cig sgom/ snying ga'i 'khor lo'i lte bar hūṃ yig ring po dang / phyogs kyi 'dab ma bzhi la g.yon skor gyis/sum̐ sum̐ hūṃ hūṃ rnams dang / mtshams rnams la byang shar nas g.yas skor gyis sne sgro sgro rnams sgom la/ lte ba'i a shad kyi me 'od kyis/ snying ༄ yu chu u ga'i 'khor lo yi ge dang bcas pa rnams tsha 'ur re khyab par bsam la/ bum can 'dzin zhing sgom mo/ /yang rdo rje nor bur pad+ma/ 'dab bzhi'i lte ba la e sngon po'am/ hūṃ sngon po gang rung zhig sgom la/ de la dmigs pa gtod pa dang / yang las kyi phyag rgya dang mnyam par sbyor ba'i rjes chags kyi bde ba la goms pa zhig yin na/ las rgya la brten pa dang / de lta min na ye shes kyi phyag rgya'i rjes chags sgom pa na/ rang gi lus kyi stod smad thams cad nas byang chub gyi sems zhu ba rnams rim pas 'dus te snying ga'am/ gsang gnas kyi nor bu gang rung zhig tu thig le dkar la dmar pa'i mdangs chags pa zhig tu gyur par mos la/ de nyid nyams bde khril le 'dug pa la sems rtse gcig tu bstad cing / rlung bum pa can 'dzin no/ /de ltar 'od gsal 'dzin pa'i dmigs pa de rnams nyin par drag tu —139

sgom zhing / mtshan mo dmigs pa la sems gtod bzhin pa'i ngang nas gnyid du 'gro bar byas pas 'od gsal zin par 'gyur ro/ /de yang dmigs pa'i rnam grangs de rnams gang zag gcig gis thams cad sgom dgos pa ma yin gyi/dmigs pa gang rung zhig la brten nas 'od gsal zin par byas pas chog pa yin no/ /des kyang ma zin na/ mun khang ngam sprin med nam mkha' la lus gnad rnam snang gi chos bdun dang ldan par byas / mig 'bras gyen du bsgril la bar snang stong pa der bstad cing / sems kyang gang yang yid la mi byed par bsgom mo/ /yang na g.yas pa'i mig bsgril zhing / g.yon phyogs kyis phreng sogs kyi nam mkha' la blta ba dang / g.yon pa'i mig bsgril la g.yas phyogs kyi phreng sogs kyi bar snang la bltas la/ mig lpags phyed bkab tsam byas shing sgom mo/ /de ltar zhag bdun tsam re sgom zhing / yang zhag bdun tsam re gong gi dmigs pa nyid sgom pas 'od gsal zin par 'gyur ro/ /de ni nyin mo'i 'od gsal zin pa'i man ngag go /'od gsal gyi bogs 'don ni/ rang gi snying gar pad+ma dkar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'am/ bcu drug pa 'dab ma phyed tsam gyen du langs pa/ 'dab ma brgyad sgom na/ a i u ṛ '-i e o e rnams 'dab ma rnams la sgom/ 'dab ma bcu drug sgom nas dbyangs bcu drug gsal btab/de'i nang du pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa kha dog dmar po 'dab ma'i phyid tsam gyen langs kyi rnam pa can/ 'dab ma rnams la a ka tsa ṭa ta pa ya sha brgyad bsgom/de'i nang du pad+ma 'dab bzhi sngon po/ 'dab ma phyed tsam gyen langs kyi rnam pa can/ 'dab ma rnams la thig le sngon po bzhi dang / lte bar a shad cig gsal 140

btab/ de nas rlung bum pa can bzung la/ pad+ma gsum yi ge dang bcas pa las 'od zer dkar po spros/ snod bcud thams cad 'od zer dkar po'i rnam par gyur/ de rnams tshur 'dus/ rang gi ba spu'i bu ga nas zhugs/ phyi'i pad+ma dkar po yi ge dang bcas pa la thim pas/ de rnams 'od du ltem ltem 'dug pa la sems bstad do/ /de ltar yun ring du sgom pa las/ nyin par dang / gnyid du 'gro kha dang / gnyid kyi 'od gsal zin pa'i skabs rnams su dkar lam pa'i snang ba 'byung zhing / de yang brtan por gyur pa na/ rlung bum pa can bzung zhing /pad+ma dkar po yi ge dang bcas pa pad 'dab dmar ser yi ge dang bcas pa la thim par bsam mo/ /yangs pad 'dab sngo dmar yi ge dang bcas pa las 'od zer dmar po spros/ snod bcud thams cad 'od zer dmar po'i rnam par gyur/de rnams tshur 'dus rang gi ba spu'i bu ga nas zhugs/ pad 'dab dmar po yi ge dang bcas pa la thim pas/ de rnams 'od du ltem ltem 'dug pa la sems bstad cing / rlung bum pa can bzung / de ltar yun ring du sgom pa las/ nyin par dang / gnyid du 'gro kha dang / gnyid kyi 'od gsal zin pa'i skabs rnams su dmar lam pa'i snang ba 'byung zhing / de yang brtan por gyur pa na/ pad 'dab dmar po yi ge dang bcas pa pad 'dab nang ma la thim par bsam zhing /rlung bum pa can bzung ngo / yang pad 'dab sngon po lte ba'i a shad dang bcas pa las 'od zer kha dog sngon po'i tshogs dpag tu med pa spros/ snod bcud thams cad 'od zer sngon po'i rnam par gyur/ de rnams tshur 'dus nang skor gyi pad 'dab sngon po thig le dang bcas pa la thim pas/ de nyid 'od du ldem ldem —141—

'dug pa la sems bstad cing / rlung bum pa can 'dzin no/ /de ltar goms pa las nyin par dang / gnyid du 'gro kha dang / gnyid kyi 'od gsal gyi skabs rnams su nag lam pa'i nyams 'char bar 'gyur zhing / shar ba de yang brtan por gyur pa na/ pad 'dab sngon po thig le dang bcas pa lte ba'i a shad la thim par bsam zhing / rlung bum pa can bzung ngo / /de nas dbus kyi a shad las 'od zer kha dog 'di lta bu ma yin pa shin tu dwangs pa dpag tu med pa spros/snod bcud thams cad smig rgyu ltar mer mer shig shig tu 'dug par bsam de rnams tshur 'dus rang gi ba spu'i bu ga nas zhugs/ a shad la thim par bsam zhing rlung bum pa can bzung ngo / /de ltar sgom pa las nyin par dang / gnyid du 'gro kha dang / gnyid kyi 'od gsal zin pa'i skabs rnams su shes pa shin tu dwangs shing gsal ba'i nyams skye bar 'gyur ro/ /de rnams ni rim pa bzhin snang mched thob pa 'od gsal kyi ye shes rnams sgrub par byed pa'o/ /yang na rang gi lus kyi dbus su rtsa dbu ma dang / lte ba dang spyi bo'i rtsa 'khor rgyas bsdus ji ltar rigs pa zhig gsal btab la/ lte ba'i dbus su a shad/ spyi bor oṃ dkar po mgo bo thur bstan zhig sgom la/ lte ba'i a shad las gtum mo'i me 'bar dbu ma'i nang nas yar song / sbyi bo'i oṃ la reg pas oṃ las byang chub kyi sems kha dog dkar bo bab ste lte ba'i a shad la thim/ byang chub kyi sems kyi rgyun gyi 'od zer kha dog dkar pos lus kyi nang thams cad skya lam ste gang bar bsam ste rlung bum pa can bzung ngo / /yang na oṃ yig las 'od zer dkar po dbu ma'i nang nas mar song / a shad la thim zhing 'od dkar pos —142

lus thams cad la khyab par bsam/ de ltar sgom pas nyin par la sogs pa'i gnas skabs gsum po der dkar lam pa'i snang ba shar zhing / de yang brtan po gyur pa na/ mgrin pa'i rtsa 'khor rgyas bsdus ji ltar rigs pa'i dbus su/a yig dmar po mgo gyen bstan zhig gsal btab la / lte ba'i a shad las gtum mo ye shes kyi me 'bar ba mgrin pa'i a la reg pas/ de las 'od zer dmar po'am thig le dmar po'i rgyun byung / de'i 'od zer dmar pos lus thams cad dmar lam ste khyab par bsam/ mthar lte ba'i a shad la thim par bsam zhing / rlung bum pa can bzung ngo / /de ltar sgom pas gnas skabs gsum po der dmar lam pa'i snang ba 'char bar 'gyur zhing / de yang brtan por gyur pa na/ snying ga'i 'bor lo rgyas bsdus ji ltar rigs pa sgom pa'i lte bar hūṃ sngon po mgo thur bstan zhig sgom la/ lte bskre a shad las gtum mo'i me 'bar/ snying ga'i hūṃ la reg /de las bdud rtsi'i 'od zer sngon po babs/de'i 'od zer sngon pos lus kyi nang thams cad khyab par bsam la/ rlung bum pa can bzung ngo / /de ltar sgoms pas gnas skabs gsum po der nag lam pa'i snang ba shar zhing / de yang brtan por gyur pa na spyi bo'i oṃ dang / mgrin pa'i ā+o snying ga'i hūṃ la thim/ lte rnga/'i a shad kyang snying ga'i hūṃ la thim/ hūṃ yig kyang mi dmigs par yal bar bsam la rlung bum pa can bzung / de ltar goms pas gnas skabs gsum po der shes pa dwangs shing gsal ba'i nyams skye par 'gyur ro/ /bogs 'don gnyis po 'di ji ltar mos pa zhig sgoms pas chog pa yin no/ /de ltar yun ring du goms pa las snang mched thob pa 'od —143

gsal gyi ye shes rjes mthun pa rgyud la skye bar 'gyur zhing / de la brten nas yul snang re re'i steng du yang snang mched thob pa gsum ngos zin pa dang / mtshan mo gnyid la 'gro khar yang snang mched thob pa gsum ngos zin zhing / gnyid kyi 'od gsal skyod thub par 'byung la/ 'chi ba'i tshe snang mched thob gsum ngos zin nas 'chi ba 'od gsal ngo 'phrod pa 'byung ba yin no/ /'od gsal gyi bogs 'don spogs chog ni/ ril 'dzin dang rjes gzhig gnyis sgom pa ste/dang po ril 'dzin gyi dmigs pa'i gzhi ni lus gnad legs par bcas te/shes pa cung zad rang babs su bzhag /de nas rang g.yin snang ba thams cad la cig car du shes pa cher re bstad cing gzhigs nas/ brtags shing dpyad pa na blo ngor snang ba thams cad dbyings su nub pa'i ngang la cung zad tsam mnyam par bzhag go /yang rang gzhan snang ba thams cad cig car lha skur sgom/ de rnams kyi ngo bo la bltas shing btsal ba na/ gang yang mi rnyed pa'i dbyings stong pa'i ngang der cung zad cig bzhag go /rjes gzhig gi dmigs pa'i gzhi ni/ rang gi mdun du ji tsam snang ba'i dngos po rnams la shes pa bstad cing / ngo bo la bltas pa na blo ngor snang ba de gang du yang ma rnyed pa'i dbyings stong pa'i ngang la cung zad bzhag go /yang de rnams lha skur sgom zhing / de'i ngo bo la bltas pas gang yang ma rnyed pa'i dbyings la 'jog pa dang / rang lus la bltas shing gzhigs pa na/ rang gi blo ngor lus snang yongs su nub pa'i stong pa'i ngang la mnyam par 'jog pa dang / yang rang nyid lha skur sgom zhing / de'i ngo bo la bltas pas ngos bzung dang bral ba'i ngang la bzhag go /ril 'dzin rjes gzhig —144

gi dmigs pa dngos la ril 'dzin rkyang pa sgom pa dang / rjes gzhig rkyang pa sgom pa dang / de gnyis sbrags te sgom pa dang / gnyis ga'i gzhi mthun pa sgom pa dang bzhi las/ dang po ni/ rang yi dam gang byed du gsal ba la/ sems dpa' gsum brtsegs dngos su sgom pa'am/ de'i mtshon don thugs gar thig le zlum po/ de'i dbus su yi dam gyi sa bon sgom la/ de las 'od zer 'phros/lus kyi nang thams cad gang / rang lus 'od kyi gong bur gyur pa mi dmigs par yal bar sgom mo/ /'di la rang lus stong par thim pa'i zhor la snang ba thams cad kyang nub par bsam pas chog go /gnyis pa ni/ snying ga'i sa bon thig le dang bcas pa las 'od zer 'phros snod thams cad gzhal med khang dang / bcud thams cad yi dam gyi skur gyur/ de rnams 'od du zhu/ de rnams rim pas rgya je chung du 'dus te/ rang lus la thim/ rang lus 'od kyi gong bur gyur pa yang mtha' nas rim pas 'dus te/snying ga'i thig le la thim/ de yang sa bon la thim/ de yang rim pas nā da'i bar du bsdus la/ nā da la cung zad sems bzung / mthar de yang mi dmigs par bsam la stong pa'i ngang la cung zad mnyam par bzhag go /gsum pa ni/ gong ril 'dzin gyi skabs su bstan pa ltar/ rang lus stong par bsdus/ stong pa'i ngang las slar yang yi dam gyi sku thig le sa bon dang bcas pa grub par bsam/ sa bon dang thig le las 'od zer 'phros snod bcud thams cad lha skur gyur/ de rnams 'od du zhu/ rim pas tshur 'dus rang la thim/de yang 'od du zhu ste/ snying ga'i thig le la thim pa nas/ nā da yang mi dmigs —145

pa'i bar sgom pa'o/ /bzhi pa ni/ rang gzhan thams cad lha skur bsgom zhing stong par bsdu ba yin yang / las dang po pas mtha' dag dmigs pa'i yul du 'char dka' bas/ rang gis ji ltar gsal ba'i 'gro ba bcu la sogs pa dngos su sgom/ de rnams la 'gro ba gzhan thams cad thim pa'i mos pa bya/ rang dang de rnams yi dam gyi skur gsal ba'i so so'i snying gar thig le dang sa bon yang sgom/ so so'i sa bon thig ler bcas pa las 'od zer 'phros/ snod thams cad gzhal yas khang dang / bcud thams cad lha skur sgom/ de rnams 'od du zhu/rim pas tshur 'dus te/ rang rang so so yi dam du gsal ba'i sku lus la thim/de yang 'od du zhu nas so so'i snying ga'i thig le la thim/ de so so'i sa bon la thim pa nas nā da yang mi dmigs par stong par gyur pa'i bar du sgom mo/ // lnga pa las kyi phyag rgya'i man ngag la/ sngon 'gro bla ma'i rnal 'byor ni/ rang gi spyi bo'am mdun du seng khri/ pad+ma/ nyi ma/ zla ba'i steng du/ rtsa ba'i bla ma'i sku la rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma'i ngo bo mi mo'i rnam pas 'byud pa/ bla ma'i dpral bar rnam snang yab yum mgrin par 'od dpag med yab yum/ snying gar mi bskyod pa yab yum/ lte bar rin 'byung yab yum/ gsang gnas su don grub yab yum rnams sgom la gsol ba btab pas/ rnam snang yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i sbyor mtshams nas byang chub sems kyi rgyun dpag tu med pa byung / spyi bo nas zhugs lus thams cad gang / bum dbang thob par bsam/mgrin pa'i 'od dpag med yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i sbyor mtshams nas byang chub kyi sems kyi rgyun byung / spyi bo nas zhugs lus thams cad gang /—146

gsang dbang thob par bsam/ snying ga'i mi bskyod pa yab yum snyom par zhugs pa'i sbyor mtshams nas byang chub kyi sems kyi rgyun byung / spyi bo nas zhugs lus thams cad gang / shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob par bsam/ de bzhin du lte ba'i rin 'byung yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i sbyor mtshams nas byang chub sems kyi chu rgyun babs pas/ lus thams cad gang bar bsam/ gsang gnas kyi don grub yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i sbyor mtshams nas byang chub sems kyi chu rgyun babs/ spyi bo nas zhugs lus thams cad gang bas/ dbang bzhi pa thob par bsam mo/ /sngon 'gro gnyis pa rtsa khrus ni/ rang tha mal pa'i lus la rtsa gsum 'khor lo bzhi rags pa tsam gsal btab pa'i spyi bo bde ba chen po'i 'bor lo'i dbus su rnam snang he ru ka dkar po/ 'bor lo dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ rus pa'i rgyan gyis spras pa/ zhabs g.yon bskum g.yas brkyang pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ sangs rgyas spyan ma dang mnyam par sbyor ba zhig gsal btab la/ mchod pa dpag tu med pa blos sprul nas phul zhing / bdag la byin gyis rlab tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ rnam snang yab yum gyi sbyor mtshams nas/ byang chub kyi sems kyi chu rgyun dpag tu med pa byung / spyi bo'i 'khor lo bkrus shing dag par bsam/ de nas rim pas brgyud de/ rtsa 'khor lo bzhi'i gnas thams cad khyab pas/ sdig sgrib thams cad bkrus shing dag par bsam la/ 'jam rlung bum pa can 'dzin pa'i he ru ga'i yi ge brgya pa gang rung bzla'o/ /mgrin pa longs spyod kyi 'bor lo'i dbus su 'od dpag med he ru ka yab yum sgom la mchod pa phul zhing gsol ba btab pas/ 'od —147

dpag med yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i sbyor mtshams nas byang chub kyi sems kyi chu rgyun dpag tu med pa byung / mgrin pa'i 'khor lo bkrus/ de nas yas mar thams cad du song ste/ 'khor lo bzhi po thams cad bkrus shing dag par bsam la/ bum pa can nam yig brgya gang rung bzla'o/ /yang snying ga chos 'khor gyi dbus su mi bskyod pa he ru ka yab yum sgom pa'i sbyor mtshams nas byang chub kyi sems kyi rgyun byung / snying ga'i 'khor lo bkrus shing sbyangs/ de nas yas mar thams cad du song ste 'khor lo bzhi'i gnas thams cad bkrus shing dag par bsam la/ bum pa can nam yig brgya gang rung bzla'o/ /yang lte ba sprul 'khor gyi dbus su rin chen 'byung ldan he ru ka yab yum sgom la/ sbyor mtshams nas byang chub kyi sems kyi rgyun dpag tu med pa byung / lte ba'i 'khor lo bkrus/ de nas yas mar thams cad du song ste/ 'khor lo bzhi sogs lus kyi rtsa gnas thams cad bkrus pas dag par bsam la bum pa can nam/ yig brgya gang rung bzla'o/ /yang gsang gnas bde skyong gi 'khor lo'i dbus su don yod grub pa he ru ka yam yum sgom la/ sbyor mtshams nas byang chub kyi sems kyi chu rgyun dpag tu med pa byung / gsang gnas kyi 'khor lo bkrus/ de nas yas mar thams cad du song ste/ 'khor lo bzhi sogs lus kyi gnas thams cad bkrus pas dag par bsam la/ 'jam rlung bum pa can 'dzin pa'am/ he ru ga'i yi ge brgya pa gang rung bzla'o/ /de rnams re re bzhin dmigs thun re re yin no/ /sngon 'gro'i gsum pa maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba ni/ rang gi mdun du bla ma sgom la/ maṇ+ḍal 'bul tshul ni spyi dang 'dra ba las/ lha mo/ klu mo/ mi mo/ gnon —148—

spyin mo sogs rig ma grangs med pas phyur bur bkang ste phul bar bsam mo // gnyis pa dngos gzhi la/ gong gtum mo'i skabs su bstan pa ltar gyi bum pa can la sogs pa'i rlung sbyor rnams goms par byas nas/ thog mar mchog gi 'dren pa ni/ lus gnad legs par bcas rlung ro bsal la/de'i rjes su rlung dal bus phyir bus/ 'bud pa rdzogs mtshams su 'phro bcad cing / phyir cung zad bzung / yang gcig bus la 'phro bcad cing / phyir cung zad bzung / yang bus la/ de nas dal bus nang du rngub cing / rngub pa rdzogs mtshams su yang 'phro bcad cing rngub/ de rdzogs pa dang / yang 'phro bcad cing rngub la/ de nas steng rlung rgyu zhabs phyogs su drag tu mnan/ 'og rlung rgyab kyi phyogs su yar 'then la rked pa nyag ste bya zhing thub tshad du bzung / mi thub pa dang phyir 'bud tshul ni/ 'bud thengs gcig la dum bu gsum du byas te/'bung tshul gong bzhin dang / nang du rngub pa yang rngub thengs gcig la tshan pa gsum du byas te rngub la/ nang du 'dzin pa sogs yang yang sgom pa'o/ /sems kyi dmigs pa ni/ phyir 'bud pa'i tshe lus kyi nang nas rlung rnams du ba lta bu'i rnam pas bun bun don par bsam/ rlung nang du rngub pa'i tshe/ rlung rnams 'od zer sna lnga'i rnam pas zhugs shing / nyams bde ba dang ldan par bsam/ nang du bzung ba'i tshe sems mi rtogs par bzhag go /gnyis pa rtsa ba'i 'dren pa ni/lus gnad legs par bcas/ rlung ro mang du bsal/ de rjes rlung nang du shar te rngub la/ steng rlung lte bar mnan/ thur sel drag tu 'then la rlung gnyis kha spyor du bzung / steng rlung mnan pa'i shugs ma shor bar ltag par bgyed byas —149

la stod du drag tu 'then/ yang 'og rlung bshang sgor drag tu sdom pa'i shugs ma shor bar rlung kha sbyor de nyid rgyu zhabs phyogs smad kyi gnas su drag tu mnan/de 'dra lan gsum tsam byas pa'i mthar rlung phyir btang ngo / /thog mar zhag bdun tsam gyi ring rlung thengs re re la rlung kha sbyor stod smad du 'then gnon byed pa lan gsum tsam bya/ de nas rim pas je mang la btang ngo / gsum pa yan lag 'dren pa ni/ lus gnad legs par bcas la/ rlung ro mang du bsal/ de rjes rlung yongs su rdzogs par bus la/ phyir thub tshad du bzung / lto ba tshigs pa la gcer bar bya zhing thur sel drag tu gyen du 'then pa dang / khong nang gi shugs stod du lan gsum tsam 'then/ rlung phyir bzung bzung bar bshang sgo lhod klod cing / khong nang gi rlung gi shugs thur du mnan/ mi bde ba skyes pa dang / rlung nang du rngub tshul de lta bu yang yang sgom pa'o/ /'di la yang khong nang gi rlung gi shugs gyen du 'then pa dang / thur du gnon pa yang thog mar gsum tsam dang / de nas rim pas je mang du btang ngo / /bzhi pa rab skor gyi rlung sbyor ni/ lus gnad lce sbyang gi 'dug stangs bya ba/ rkang pa sems skyil byas pa'i long bu'i stod tsam nas lag pa gnyis kyis bzung la/ lus sgur te 'dug pa'am/ yang na glang po'i 'dug stangs bya ba pus 51 gnyis btsugs/ lag pa khu tshur bcangs pa mdun du sa la btsugs la stod sgur ro/ /de ltar lus gnad gnyis po gang rung dang ldan pas rlung phyir bus la/ phyi rol du ci thub bzung de dzi'i ngang nas khog nang stong pa'i shugs de nyid g.yas su skor ba dang / g.yon du skor ba bya/ de nas nang du rngub la/ rlung kha sbyor du bzung ba de nyid g.yas dang /—150

g.yon du skor ro/ /'di la phyi rol du bzung la skor ba yun ring ba dang / nang du 'dzin zhing skor ba yun thung ba tsam bya'o/ /lnga pa 'gyur ba drug ldan ni/ lus tsog pu la rkang pa re mig ltar ba〈snal/ lag pa khu tshur bcangs pa 〈snal la mchan khung gnyis kyi 'og tu bcug /nywa bzhi bsgrims/ mig gyen du blta/ lce rkan la sbyar/ mgrin pa dgug cing / thur sel 'then pa dang mnyam du/ hūṃ yig gi sgras rlung phyir bsal/ lto ba tshigs pa la gcer/ phyi rol du mi bde ba ma skyes kyi bar du bzung la/ de nas nang du rngub/ yang ltag pa bgyed cing / rlung sbyor sngar bzhin no/ /dmigs pa ni/ lte bar hūṃ yig gam/ e yig lta bu sa bon nam thig le/ phyag mtshan gang rung zhig sgom la/ thur sel 'then zhing / hūṃ yig gi sgras rlung bus tshe/ de nyid yar song ste/ spyi bo nas 'thon par bsam/drug pa hūṃ rang gi sbyor ba ni/ rkang lag gnyis brkyangs shing / hūṃ yig gi gdangs nyi shu rtsa gcig gis phyir rlung bus la/ stong 'dren bya zhing / phyir cung zad bzung la/ lto ba tshigs pa la gcer te/ thur sel gyen du 'then 'then bya'o/ /de nas rlung nang du rngub pa dang lag pa gnyis kyis rkang mgo nas bzung la sgang 'then bya'o/ /bdun pa rang 'gags ni/ rlung ro bsal ba sogs mi byed par/ rlung rgyu ba'i 'phro bod kyis bcad la/ khog nang gi shugs thur du mnan zhing / thur sel klod ci thub byed pa'o/ /brgyad pa ni/ rlung ro bsal la/ steng rlung rngub cing mnan/ thur sel klod par byed pa'o/ /dgu pa ni/ rlung ro bsal la nang du rngub/ thur sel steng du 'then la/ steng rlung gi shugs gsang gnas su gtun brdung ba lta bu'i tshul gyis lan gsum bzhi tsam/ lnga drug tsam thur du sna 151—

sdigs par byed cing / lus 'dar thon par byed pa'o/ /rlung sbyor phyi ma chung ba gsum po 'di la lus gnad rting pa gcig gis gsang gnas kyi rtsa ba nas ldem pa dang / rting pa gcig gis gsang gnas kyi steng nas gnon par byed pa'o/ /bcu pa ni/ rlung ro bsal la/ de nas sna bug gi rlung ma bzung par/khog nang gi shugs gsang gnas su drag tu mnan/ de nas rang babs su bzhag la/ thur sel gyen du drag tu 'then/ de rjes lto ba ldir byas la/ bshang sgo 'byed 'dzum lan gsum bya'o/ /rlung sbyor de rnams yun ring du goms par byas la/ de nas zhag shas zhig chu dron gyis lus thams cad bkrus la/ nyi ma la gdugs shing phur mnye bya/ de nas dri chus bkrus shing phur mnye bya/ de nas dha dhu ra te thang khrom gyi khu bas bkrus shing phur mnye bya/ de nas ba'i lce ba me la bsregs pa'i thal ba chu la btab pa'i snyigs ma sa rdo dang 'dres pa de min pa'i dwangs ma 'jam po des/ dbang po'i sgo rnams ma yin pa'i lus thams cad la byugs shing / nyi ma la phur mnye byas la mthar chus bkrus/ de nas 'bras bu gsum dang / tsha ba gsum gyi khu bas lus la byugs shing phur mnye byed pa'am/yang na gong gi de rnams la 'bras bu gsum dang / tsha ba gsum cung zad re bsre'o/ /de rnams kyis lus kyi ba spu dang / rtsa rnams 'jam zhing mnyen par 'gyur bas gegs chung bar byed pa'o/ /de nas yang zhag 'ga' lus stong sang nge ba 'dug par bsam pa dang / rtsa 'khor lo bzhi sogs rtsa nang rnams stong sang nge 'dug pa la sems bstad pa'i stong ra sgom mo/ /de nas dngos gzhi srog thur bsre ba la/ 'jam rlung la brten pa dang / rtsub rlung la brten pa dang / rdo rje —152

gtsug tor gyi phyag rgya la brten nas bsre ba dang gsum las/ dang po ni/ lus gnad legs par bcas pa'i/ lag pa mnyam bzhag lte bar bkan la bzhag /rlung ro bsal/ de nas rlung nang du rngub la/ slar yang dal bus lhag ma ma lus par phyir bus la/ lto ba tshigs pa la gcer bya/ phyi rol du bzung la/thur sel gyen du 'then la khog nang stong pa'i shugs steng du drangs shing / rlung ro cung zad 'bud rgyu byung ba rnams kyang sna sgo nas phyir byung bar byed pa'o/ /de'i skabs sems kyi dmigs pa rni/ thur sel gyen du 'then pas/ rkang mthil nas bzung/ rlung thams cad kha dog sngon po'i rnam pas yar byung / gsang gnas su gcig tu 'dres/ lus kyi dbus na yar spom phra mda' tsam pa'i rnam pa byung / spyi gtsug nas rgyang te 'thon/ rtsa ba gdugs kyi rkang pa lta bu mda' gang ngam/'dom gang tsam gyi steng du rlung rnams 'khyil ba gdugs lta bu sgor sgor 'khor ba la sems bstad do/ /de ni thur sel srog la bsre ba'i man ngag yin la/ de nyid kho na 'bad pas sgom na/ thur sel srog la 'dre ba'i rtags 'phral du 'byung sla ba yin yang / 'phral gegs sdang zhing / phugs bogs chung bas/ dresag thur sel la bsre ba dang gnyis spel mar sgom na legs pas de ga'i 'phro nas rlung dal bus nang du rngub la/ steng rlung gsang gnas dang / bshang sgo gnyis gar du mnan zhing sgo de gnyis kyang cha mnyam du lhod klod/ dmigs pa ni/ mgo bo dang lag pa sogs lus kyi stod gyi rlung rnams mar byung / mgrin par gcig tu 'dus/ lus kyi nang nas mar song / bshang sgo nas 'thon/ sa 'og thag ring por song bar bsam la/ der yang rlung rnams 'khyil te 'khor lo ltar 'bor ba —153—

la sems bstad do/ gnyis pa ni/ rlung gnad dang dmigs pa sngar dang 'dra ba las/ rlung drag la myur ba'i tshul gyis phyir bus/ thur sel gyen du 'then zhing /khog nang gi shugs stod du 'dren pa'i skabs thog mar rgyu zhabs g.yas su skor zhing stod du 'dren/ yang g.yon du skor la stod du 'dren/ de nas sked pa g.yas g.yon du skor zhing sngar bzhin 'dren pa dang / snying ga'i stod kyi thad g.yas g.yon du skor la sngar bzhin stod du 'then pa'o/ /yang srog thur sel la bsre ba'i steng rlung gsang gnas dang / bshang sgo gnyis su gnon pa'i skabs/ snying ga'i thad g.yas su bskor la thur du gnon pa dang / g.yon du yang skor la thur du gnon pa dang / de bzhin du sked pa g.yas g.yon du skor la thur du gnon pa dang / rgyu zhabs g.yas g.yon du skor la thur du gnon par byed/ rlung nang du rngub pa'i che drag la myur bar rngub bo/ /gsum pa ni/ 'phongs stegs skum khru gang tsam gyi steng du 'changs bzhag la stegs kyis 'dug /de nas rlung bzung la/lag pa gnyis khu tshur bcang pa pus mo'i steng nas yang drangs la/ rgyab tu shad kyis brkyang/ rlung gsang gnas su drag tu mnan yang steng du 'dren/ de 'dra lan gsum rdzogs mtshams lag pa gnyis mdun du rdo rje gtsug tor gyi phyag rgya bcas la/ de mgo mjug ldog pa spyi bo'i steng du bzhag la/ langs shing bgang 'dren gyi rlung stod du 'dren/ de nas phyag rgya de bkrol la/ 'phongs sa la rdeb pa dang mnyam du rlung rgyu zhabrus su mnan no/ /de dag gi skabs su gegs sel ba la hā ring dang / ha thung 'don pa gnyis las/ dang po ni/ rkang pa sems skyil la lag pa gnyis pus mo'i steng du bzhag la/ ro stod sgur zhing hā zhes 'don/ de —154

nas ro stod bgyed la/ dpyad phrag brdeg pa dang mnyam du ha drag tu 'don par byed pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ spyi dang 'dra'o/ /gzhan yang gegs sel zhing bogs 'don pa la/ rab skor ni/ 'jam rlung bzung la/ lto ba g.yas su lan gsum bzhi skor g.yon du'ang lan gsum bzhi tsam skor/ de nas rlung phyir bus la phyi rol du bzung zhing / khog nang gi shugs de nyid g.yas g.yon du lan gsum tsam skor ba ni/ nang skor ba dang / phyi skor ba ni/ mgo g.yas g.yon du bskor ba dang / lag pa g.yas khu tshur bcangs pa brkyang te phyi nang du lan gsum gsum skor ba dang / lag pa g.yon la yang de dang 'dra'o/ /de nas langs te thog mar rkang pa g.yas phyi nang du lan gsum gsum skor ba dang / de nas g.yon pa'ang phyi nang du lan gsum gsum skor ba dang / de nas 'bebs rgyag par byed pa'o/ /rdeg pa ni/ rlung bzung la steng gi shugs dbus dang / mdun dang / g.yas dang / g.yon dang / rgyab tu brdeg par byed pa'o/ /de nas rlung bus la phyir bzung zhid / khog nang gi shugs dbus dang / mdun rgyab g.yas g.yon rnams su brdeg par byed pa ni nang gi brdeg pa dang / phyi la brdeg pa ni/mgo bo/ mdun rgyab/ g.yas g.yon rnams su lan gsum gsum brdeg pa dang /lag pa g.yas pa khu tshur bcangs pa/ dpung pa g.yas pa'i steng du lan gsum gsum brdeg pa dang / g.yon pa'ang de dang 'dra/ de nas langs la/ rkang pa g.yas 'phongs la lan gsum brdeg /g.yon pa'ang de dang 'dra/ de'i rjes su 'bebs rgyag par byed pa'o/ /sprug pa la nang dang / phyi sprug pa gnyis las/dang po ni/ rkang pa sems skyil byas la/ lag pa gnyis pus mo la bkab/ rlung 155

nang du drag tu bzung zhing / shugs dang ldan pas lan gsum tsam sprugs/ de nas rlung phyir bus la ha zhes brjod cing drag tu sprugs so/ /de nas mgo mdun rgyab tu bsgyur zhing sprug /sa/ /g.yas g.yon du gcu zhing sprugs/ /ltag par bgyid cing sprug/ /sa/ /lag pa g.yas mgo la bskor zhing zhags pa 'phen pa'i tshul gyis lan gsum sprug /sa/ /g.yon pa'ang de dang 'dra/ lag pa gnyis ka dus gcig tu lan gsum sprugs/ /de nas langs la rkang pa g.yas lan gsum sprugs/ /g.yon pa'ang de dang 'dra/ de nas rlung bsgyur byas la/ lag pa gnyis rgyab tu lag phur btsugs la rkang ba g.yas lan gsum brkyang bskum bya/g.yon pa'ang de dang 'dra/ de nas gan rkyal du rkang lag rnams dus gcig tu sprugs cing brkyang bskum bya'o/ /de rnams sngon 'gro'i tshul du btang nas/dngos gzhi la thor mar ye shes kyi phyag rgya la bslab pa la/ rang nyid yi dam du gsal bas/ ye shes kyi phyag rgya la snyoms par zhugs pa'i rjes chags kyi bde ba sgom pas/ byang chub kyi sems rnams spyi bo nas mar rim pas babs te/ rdo rje nor bur sleb par bsam la der bzung ba ni/ 'gyur pa drug ces bya ba/ lto ba tshigs pa la gcer ba dang / yan lag bzhi nywa bzhi bsgrims te drag tu bskums pa dang / lce rkan la sbyar/ mig gyen du bsgril/ mgrin pa dgug pa sogs 'gyur ba drug dang ldan pas steng rlung phyir bsal zhing / thur sel drag tu klod la/ spyi bo'i thad kyi nam mkhar sems gtad do/ /'dren la hi 'dren dang /hūṃ 'dren dang /hri 'dren dang gsum las/ dang po ni/ rlung hi zhes kha nas sgra dang bcas pas phyir bus la stong 'dren bya/ yang nang du rngub la sgang 'dren bya'o/ /—156 /

gnyis pa ni/ sna sgo nas hūṃ gi sgras phyir bus la/ stong 'dren dang / sgang 'dren sngar bzhin bya/ gsum pa ni/hri gi sgras rlung kha nas phyir bus la/ stong 'dren dang sgang 'dren sngar bzhin bya'o/ /de nas seṅge rnam rol gyi phyag rgyas 'grems spyi dang mthun par bya/ gzhan yang gong gegs sel gyi skabs su bstan pa'i zhabrul 'khor drug po rnams kyis kyang 'grems shing khyab par byed pa'o/ /rtsa ba bcings pa ni/ rkang pa g.yas g.yon gang rung zhig gi rting pas gsang gnas kyi rtsa ba mnan/ rkang pa cig shos kyi rting pas bol gong mnan la/ lusacung zad skur la lag pa gnyis khu tshur bcangs pa mdun du sa la btsugs la/rlung bzung zhing steng rlung gi shugs gsang gnas su mnan/ 'phongs cung zad btegs la slar 'bebs kyi tshul gyis gsang gnas kyi rtsa ba rting pa la thug par bya ba/ de 'dra lan nyi shu rtsa bdun bya ba las/ dgu dgu'i mtshams su g.yas g.yon du gcus cing gnon pa yang bya'o/ /gsang rtsa mnan pa'i rkang pa'i bol gong gi thad du/ cig shos kyi rkang pa'i rting pa'i lan nyi shu rtsa gcig tsam brdeg /gsang ba'i rtsa la gnon pa rkang pa g.yas g.yon gyi rting pa re mos kyis bya'o/ khyab par byed pa ni rlung bzung la langs shing shugs dang ldan pas lus sgur te/ lag pa g.yas pa'i mthe bong g.yon pas bzung la mdun du sa la btsugs/ rkang pa'i brang yang sa la btsugs/ rlung gi shugs stod kyi phyogs su yong bar byas la/ rkang pa'i brla byin pa la sbyar zhing mnan pa dang / steng du bteg cing 'then pa lan 'ga' bya'o/ /thun rting ma la lag pa g.yon pa'i mthe bong g.yas pas bzung ba sogs re mos kyis bya'o/ /'ching bar byed pa ni/—157

'phongs stegs cung zad cig bcug la tsog pu'i rnam pas/ rkang pa gnyis kyi mgo mdun du yong bar byas/ lag pa thal mo sbyar ba'i rtse thur du bstad pa lte ba'i smad tsam du thog mar yong bar byas la/ rlung kha sbyor du bzung ba dang / lto ba tshigs pa la gcer bya zhing / thal mo rtse thur bstan de nyid yar drangs te/mgrin pa'i thad tsam du slebs pa na/ thal sbyar rtse gyen du bstan la/ thad gar yang 'dren ci thub byed/ de mtshams nas langs te/ lag pa gnyis rkang pa la nang nas 'khyud cing / rkang mgo gnyis nas lag pa gnyis kyis bzung la/ lus sgur zhing g.yas g.yon dbus gsum nas gcus pa'o/ /dbyings su skyel ba ni/lag pa gnyis mnyam bzhag gi phyag rgyas lto ba skor byas te/ rlung kha sbyor bzung zhing gsum pa mdun du ha cang ma 'phel bar byas la/ mig thad gar lta zhing /lus g.yas gcu g.yon gcu bya/ sems mi rtog par bzhag go /me thab ni rkang pa re mig ltar bsnol/ lag pa gnyis bsnol bas rkang pa g.yas g.yon gyi mthe bong nas bzung la rlung bum pa can 'dzin zhing thog mar lto ba'i smad g.yas su skor ba dang / g.yon du skor ba lan gsum gsum bya/ de nas rked pa g.yas su gcu ba dang / g.yon du gcu ba dang / lus bgyed cing sked pa mdun du 'phul ba dang / lus sgur zhing rgyab tu 'phul ba dang / de ga'i ngang nas 'phar zhing sdigs pa rnams lan gsum gsum bya'o/ /lug gi 'dug stangs ni/ langs la rlung 'khrab cig byas/ de nas lus skur zhing pus mo gnyis bar thag mtho phyed do tsam yod par byas te sa la btsugs// lag pa gnyis kyang mdun du mtho gang tsam gyi bar yod par byas la sa la btsugs/ lag pa g.yon ma gug par byas —158—

shing / g.yas pa'i lag ngar dang gru mo sa la bzhag cing / mgo g.yas phyogs sa la thug tsam bya/ de nas lag pa gnyis bsrangs la/ lus 'dar thon pa sprugs/ /g.yon phyogs su'ang de bzhin bya/ de nas lag pa gnyis char gyi gru mo dang / lag ngar sa la bzhag cing / dpral ba sa la thug tsam bya/ de nas lag pa gnyis bsrangs la sus sprugs so/ /byi la'i 'dug stangs ni/ bum pa can bzung zhing / rlung 'khrab cig byas la/ de nas lus sgur zhing lag pa gnyis mdun du sa la btsugs/ rkang mgo gnyis kyang sa la btsugs/ sum̐ gi sgras stong 'dren bya zhing / mgo dang ro stod sgur rgyab shed gyen du 'then ci thub bya/ de nas mgo dang ro stod bgyed cing / lus kyi smad 'bur gyis yod par bya'o/ /lce spyang gi 'dug stangs ni/ 'phongs sa la ma reg par rkang pa'i brang sa la btsugs/lag pa gnyis khur tshur bcangs pa mdun du sa la bzhag /hūṃ gi sgras stong 'dren bya'o/ /de nas seṅge rnam rol bya'o/ /'bror lo bskor ba ni/ bum pa can gyi ngang nas/ rna ba dpung mgo la thug pa'i mgo g.yas su lan gsum bskor ba dang /g.yon du lan gsum bskor bar bya'o/ /de nas lag pa g.yas khu tshur bcangs pa phyi nang du lan gsum gsum bskor/ de bzhin du g.yon pa'ang bstor/ lte ba man cher ma g.yo bar byas la/ mgo dang ro stod g.yas g.yon du lan gsum gsum bskor/ pho ba sogs ro smad g.yas g.yon du lan gsum gsum bskor/de nas langs la rkang pa g.yas phyi nang du lan gsum gsum bskor la rkang mgo 'phongs la brdeg /rkang pa g.yon pa'ang de bzhin bya'o/ /zhags pa 'phen pa ni/bum pa can gyi ngang nas mgo mdun rgyab tu 'phyang 'phyang 'phen pa dang / g.yas —159

g.yon du'ang 'phen pa ste lan gsum gsum mo/ /lag pa g.yas kyi sor mo rnams brkyangs te 'phen pa dang / khu tshur bcangs te dpung mgo la brdeg pa lan gsum gsum bya zhing / g.yon pa'ang de bzhin bya/ de nas skyil krung sa nas bteg par byas la/ gan rkyal du 'gyel ba dang / yar langs la mdun du kha bub byas te dpral ba sa la reg pa tsam yong bar bya ba ste/ mdun rgyab tu lan gsum g.yas g.yon gyi pus mo sa las ma bteg par byas te/ mgo g.yas g.yon gyi sa la reg pa tsam yong ba'ang lan gsum gsum bya'o/ /de nas langs la rkang pa g.yas mdun du lan gsum brkyang bskum byed pa dang / de bzhin du g.yas dang rgyu ba rnams su yang bya zhing / g.yon pa'ang de bzhin byas la/ mthar 'bebs bya'o/ /ske rags 'ching ba ni/ lag pa gnyis khu tshur gshibs pa sked pa la shugs dang ldan pas ske rags 'ching ba'i tshul bya zhing /rlung bum pa can drag tu bzung la ro stod cung zad gyen du bgyed cing lan gsum bya'o/ /bco brgyad phrugs pa ni/ rlung bzung la bca' gzhi dang bcas langs la/de nas lag pa gnyis steng du 'phangs bodang mnyam du lan gsum 'phar ba dang / de nas yang lan gsum 'og tu sdigs pa dang / de nas lag pa gnyis kyis rkang pa'i sor mo nas bzung la/ lus skur zhing / bgang 'dren dang stong 'dren bya ba ni steng du 'then pa dang / de nas lag pa gnyis kyis rkang pa'i gzhog pa nas bzung la/ bgang 'dren dang stong 'dren bya ba ni/ thad gar 'then pa dang / de nas gan rkyal du byas la/ lag pa gnyis kyis rkang pa'i sor mo nas bzung zhing bsrub pa dang bcas bgang 'dren stong 'dren bya ba ni 'og tu 'then —160

pa dang / de nas gan rkyal du bsdad pa'i ngang nas rkang lag bzhi dus gcig tu sprugs shing / brkyang bskum lan gsum byas pa'i mthar rgyab 'phar gcig bya'o/ /de ltar lus sbyong dang / rlung sbyor de rnams yun ring du sgoms par byas pa las thog mar ye shes kyi phyag rgya dang lag pa'i phyag rgya la bslab/ de nas mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i phyag rgya rab lam sgom pa las ye shes cung zad skyes pa/de lta min yang dam tshig dang ldan pa/ gsang sngags la mos pa thob pa zhig nges par dgos pa yin no/ /de nyid kyi thog mar gzugs la blta ba'i rjes chags kyi bde ba sgom la/ bzung ba dang / bzlog pa dang / bgram pa dang / khyab par bya/ de bzhin du sgra dang / dri dang / ro dang / phyi'i reg bya tsam la brten nas rjes chags kyi bde ba sgom pa'ang sngar bzhin bslabs/ de nas rang nyid lhag pa'i lha dang / phyag rgya 'bor lo'i dbang phyug mar sgom la/ mkha' gsang byin rlabs dang / skye mched dang sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlabs pa'ang dran par byas la/thabs shes mnyam par sbyar ba'i thog mar dga' ba tsam la bzung bzlog khyab bgram rnams bya/ de nas mchog dga' dang / khyad dga' dang / mthar lhan skyes kyi bar du bya'o/ /de yang rtsa mdud cung zad grol ba rnams la dga' ba bzhi 'char ba gsal por shes kyang / las dang po pa rnams la gsal por shes pa dka' yang / spyir cha shas tsam 'char ba ni nges par yin no/ /thabs shes mnyam par sbyor ba dang ma bral ba'i dus der bzung pa'i thabs ni/ 'og sgo drag tu lhod/ steng rlung phyir bus la/ phyi rol du bzung bzhin pa'i ngang nas/ sto ba tshigs pa la gcer bya/ yang rlung phyi rol du bzung bzhin pa'i ngang nas/ lto ba —161

phyir bskyed pa rnams bya zhing / steng rlung nang du rngub pa dang / gsang gnas dang bshang sgo'i bar du sdigs shing / gas brdung ba ltar bya ba ni bzung pa dang /bzlog pa ni/ hūṃ gis sgras stong 'dren bya ba dang / rlung kha sbyor du bzung ba bgang 'dren bya ba dang / ma ning grug zhung rnams byed do/ /bgram pa ni/ nywa bzhi rnams lhod klod pa'o/ /de nas gong du bstan pa ltar gyi lus sbyong 'khrul 'khor thams cad bya zhing / de nas 'jam rlung bum pa can bzung la sems kyi rang zhal blta zhing / mi rtog par 'jog pa ni/ rlung dang bsri zhing ye shes wo por skyel pa'o/ // drug pa man ngag thor bu la/ thog mar yi dam sgom pa'i man ngag sgyu mi lag tsha she mizu ri 1)sdo rme mi la ga dzeg tsha/rje/zu mizu mi 4 min/ rang gang sgam pa' ya dam gas gang yan brtags ta/ rda 'a rags yan na snying ga dang / rin po che'i rigs yin na lte ba dang / las kyi rigs yin na gsang gnas dang / pad+ma'i rigs yin na mgrin pa dang / rnam snang gi rigs yin na spyi bo'i 'khor lo bsgom mo/ /de yang rang lus kyi rtsa 'khor pad+ma'i gzhal yas khang gi dbus su yi dam gyi lha bsgoms/ dmigs pa gsal na de'i thugs gar sa bon sngags 'phreng dang bcas pa'ang sgoms la/ de rnams la dmigs pa bstad cing / snang stong sgyu ma lta bu shes pas sngags bzla zhing / thun 'jog khar mchod pa dpag tu med pa blos sprul te phul la gsol ba btab/ thun mtshams su yang kha zas za ba'i tshe/ yi dam la mchod pa phul bar mos so/ /lha sgom pa'i tshul 'di ni/ rang lus kyi rtsa 'khor rnams su sgom pas/ rdzogs rim dang shin tu mthun pa'i rnal 'byor ro/ /bla ma sgom pa'i man ngag la/ phyi sgrub dang / nang —162— —

sgrub gnyis las/ dang po la yang phyi nang gsang gsum las/ dang po ni/ rang gi mdun du bla ma sgom/ de'i thugs gar thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa la/ 'khor sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dpag tu med pas bskor bar bsams la/ phyag 'tshal ba dang mchod pa 'bul ba dang /gsol ba 'debs pa rnams byas rjes/ bla ma'i mtshan la de nyid gsum spel byas pa'i bzlas pa bya ste/ dper na/ oṃ āḥrin chen rdo rje hūṃ hūṃ/ zhes pa lta bu'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ bla ma mdun du sgom pa'i de'i thugs gar thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes rdo rje 'chang dar dang rin po ches brgyan pa/ 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rnam pa can la/ 'khor sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' 'khor los bsgyur pa'i rnam pa can dpag tu med pas bskor bar bsams la/ phyag 'tshal ba nas bzlas pa'i bar gong bzhin no/ /gsum pa ni/ bla ma'i thugs gar thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes dpal he ru ga'i rnam pas bzhugs pa la/'khor dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dpag tu med pas bskor bar bsams la phyag 'tshal ba sogs gong bzhin no/ /gnyis pa nang sgrub ni/ mdun du bla ma sgom la/ mos gus gdung ba byas gsol ba btab pas/ bla ma 'od du zhu nas rang la thim pas/ rang gi spyi bo'i 'khor lo pad+ma'i gzhal yas khang gi dbus su bla ma rnam par snang mdzad sku mdog dkar po g.yas 'bor lo dang / g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum spyan ma dkar mo dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ mgrin par bla ma 'od dpag med sku mdog dmar po/ g.yas pad+ma dang / g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i —163—

dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum gos dkar mo dang mnyam par sbyor pa/ snying gar bla ma mi bskyod pa rme rimadog sngon po g.yas rdo rje dang / g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang phyug mas 'byud pa/ lte bar bla ma rin chen khrung ldan sku mdog ser po g.yas rin po che dang / g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum rin chen sgrol ma dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ gsang gnas su bla ma don yod grub pa sku mdog ljang khu/ g.yas ral gri dang / g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum dam tshig sgrol ma dang mnyam par sbyor ba ste/ gnas lngar bla ma rigs lnga yab yum sgom la/ bla ma'i mas dang rigs lnga so so'i sa bon lnga de nyid gsum spel pa'i bzlas pa bya ba ste/ oṃ āḥrin r+ṣa rdo rje bh+rūṃ hūṃ/ spyo pa dang / de bzhi du dzi hūṃ dang / hūṃ hūṃ dang / e hūṃ dang khaṃ dang khaṃ hūṃ zhes pa rnams btags pa bzlas par bya'o/ /bar chad bsal ba'i man ngag la/ go rak+ṣa'i lugs dang / bi ru pa'i lugs gnyis las/ dang po ni/ thog mar rang gi lus ngag yig gsum la shes pa bstad de/ 'di ltar du snang ba ni med bzhin du 'khrul ba sgyu ma lta bu'o snyam du bsam la/ de nas rang //de/ sgyu mi sgyu milag tshadzog tsha /ni// sgyu mi rme mi sgyu mi dzog tsha lus ngag yad gsum gya nga ba la ra rgyas bltas shang btsal ba na rag ngar gang yang ma rnyed pa'i ngos bzung thams cad dang bral ba de'i ngang la ci gnas su mnyam par bzhag pa ni/ dmigs skor dang po'o/ /de la cung zad goms pa na/ de nas rang dbang ba'i gnas khang dang /longs spyod dang / 'khor g.yog la sogs pa rnams la 'di thams cad med bzhin du snang ba sgyu ma lta bu'o snyam du sgom pa dang / de dag gi ngo bo la cher gyis —164

bltas te/ ngos bzung bral pa'i ngang la mnyam par 'jog pa ni/ dmigs skor gnyis pa dang / de nas dgra sdang ba la sngar bzhin sgom pa dmigs skor gsum pa dang / gnyen byams pa la sgom pa dmigs skor bzhi pa dang / de nas rang gi mthong thos su gyur pa yul nye bar gnas pa rnams la sgom pa dmigs skor lnga pa dang / mthar snang ba thams cad la sgom pa dmigs skor drug pa'o/ /de rnams la rim gyis bslabs te goms par gyur pa na/ thog mar tsha grang la sogs rkyen phran bu la/ hūṃ gi sgras rnam par mi rtog pa'i dbyings su skyel ba dang /de nas chags sdang bde sdug 'jigs skrags sogs 'char sgo thams cad/ hūṃ gi sgras dbyings su gcod pas/ rang gi khyim du sgom zhing / de nas dur khrod dang /tshogs 'dus dang / 'dre gdon gyi gnas rnams su smyon par brdzus te phyin pa na/ der 'dre gdon gyi cho 'phrul dang / skye bo rnams kyis bstod smad sogs rkyen bzang ngan thams cad hūṃ gi sgras rnam par mi rtog pa'i dbyings su bskyal lo/ /gnyis pa bi ru pa'i lugs la yang / las dang po pa'i nyams len dang / rang gi khyim du rkyen dang bsre ba dang / mthar dur khrod la sogs par rgyu ba ste/ sngar bzhin gsum las/ dang po la/ snying rje sgom pa dang / stong nyid sgom pa gnyis las/ dang po ni/ sems can thams cad drin can gyi pha ma yin/ 'di dag gis bskyed pa'i gnod pa bdag la byung ba'ang / skye shi 'phos nas ngo ma shes pas lan pa yin snyam du bsam la snying rje drag tu sgom pa ni/ dmigs skor dang po'o/ /de nas bdag bde ba 'dod pa bzhin du sems thams cad kyang bde bar 'dod/ bdag sdug bsngal mi 'dod pa bzhin du sems can rnams sdug bsngal —165

mi 'dod pas/ de ltar na nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig /sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral par gyur cig snyam du sgom pa ni/ dmigs skor gnyis pa dang / de nas sems can rnams nyon mongs pas sems dkrugs te las bsags/ des 'khor bar 'khyams te sdug bsngal myong ba snying re rje snyam du sgom pa ni/dmigs skor gsum pa dang / de nas don dam par sems can yang bden par ma grub/ de dag gis myong ba'i sdug bsngal yang bden par ma grub/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid yin yang de ltar ma rtogs par sdug bsngal myong ba'i sems can 'di rnams snying re rje snyam du bsgom pa ni/ dmigs skor bzhi pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ snang ba thams cad rang gi sems yin/ sems las logs su grub pa cung zad kyang med snyam du bsgom pa ni/ dmigs skor dang po dang / de nas sems kyi ngo bor yang ma grub ste/ ngos bzung thams cad dang bral ba stong pa nyid kyi ngang la bzhag go /de nas stong pa'i ngang las/ snang ba thams cad lha skur lam ste sgom pa ni/ stong pa'i ngang las dag pa'i snang ba sgom pa dang /yang rne stong pa'i ngang las/ ma dag pa'i snang ba shar ba'i tshe/ rang gi lus dum bu brgya stong du mar gtubs te/ sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' thams cad mchod pas mnyes/ rigs drug rnams rang rang so so'i bsam pa dang mthun pa'i longs sbyod byung ste tshims par bsam/ khyad par du yang log 'dren bgegs kyi tshogs rnams sha khrag gi gtor mas tshims pas mos mthar de rnams kyi sems dang rang gi sems stong pa nyid du bsres la mnyam par bzhag —166

go /de rnams cung zad goms par gyur pa na rang khyim du tsha grang la sogs pa'i rkyen ched gtad yod par byas te/ stong nyid snying rjes lam du 'khyer/ de nas rang khyim du rkyen sna tshogs dang bsre ba la goms pa na/ dur khrod dang tshogs 'dus dag 'dre gdon thams cad kyi gnas su phyin la/ rkyen bzang ngan thams cad dang bsre bar bya'o/ /sems 'dzin gyi man ngag la/ spyir bka' babs drug ldan gyi man ngag 'di la/ sems 'dzin gyi rnam grangs lnga brgya tsam yod kyang /'dir dkyus su gsungs pa la bcu drug tsam las/ thog mar zhag 'ga' lus gnad ji ltar bde ba zhig bcas la/ bya byed thams cad spangs te gang yang mi sgoms par bsdad/ de nas tho rangs lta bu rig pa dwangs pa zhig la/ rang nyid kyi lus re zhig tu gyur par bsams la/ de'i ri sul dang / de la gnas pa'i shing dang / chu 'bab tshul sogs la rim gyis sems bstad/ yang 'phro bcad cing sgom pa ni dmigs pa dang po dang / yang rang gi lte ba'i thad tsam du ne'u gsing yid du 'ong ba zhig bsadru/sa/ de'i phyogs zhig tu shing sdong lo 'dab dang ldan pa zhig ldem lcug gi 'dug pa la sems bstad cing / yang 'phro bcad kyin sgom pa ni dmigs pa gnyis pa dang / yang rang gi snying ga'i thad du sa gzhi'i dbus su mtsho shin tu dwangs pa me re ba la chu gnyer shig shig 'dug pa la sems 'dzin zhing / slar 'phro bcad kyin sgom pa ni dmigs pa gsum pa dang /yang rang nyid kyi spyi bo'i steng nas nam mkha' de'i yang steng na rgyal chen rigs bzhi/ de'i steng na sum cu rtsa gsum/ de'i steng na gzugs khams/ de'i steng na gzugs med khams de'i steng na 'jig rten gyi khams gzhan zhig gi rlung gi —167—

dkyil 'khor nas/ gzugs med khams kyi bar dang / de'i steng na yang 'jig rten gyi khams gzhan zhig gi rlung gi dkyil 'khor nas de'i gzugs med khams kyi bar la sems gtod pa sogs mang po zhig song ba na/ de bzhin gshegs pa tshe dpag med bzhugs par bsam la/ de la shes pa bstad cing /slar 'phro bcad kyin yang yang sgom pa ni dmigs pa bzhi pa dang / yang rang gi 'og phyogs na sa'i dkyil 'khor dang / dmyal ba'i gnas rnams rim pa bzhin dang / chu'i dkyil 'bor dang / de'i 'og na rlung gi dkyil 'bor dang / de'i 'og na 'jig rten gyi khams gzhan zhig gi gzugs med khams nas rlung gi dkyil 'khor gyi bar dang / de'i yang 'og na 'jig rten gyi khams gzhan zhig gi gzugs med khams nas/ rlung gi dkyil 'khor gyi bar la shes pa gtod pa sogs mang po zhig song ba na/ de bzhin gshegs pa thal ba'i dbang po bzhugs par bsams la de la sems cung zad cig bstad la/ slar 'phro bcad kyin sgom pa ni dmigs pa lnga pa dang / yang yid kyi pho nya gtong ba bya ba/ rang nyid 'di nyid na yod par bsam pa'i rang gnyis pa zhig phar 'gro bar bsam/rgyang tsam du slebs pa na/ des tshur blta zhing / 'di nas kyang phar bltas par bsams la/ de nyid rim pas ri brgal te/ thag ring por phyin pa na/ yang 'di nas phar blta ba dang / phar nas tshur blta bar bsam pa ni dmigs pa drug pa dang / yang rang nyid kyi 'og phyogs lta bu zhig tu mtsho chung ngu zhig sgom/ de rim pas je che dang / dpangs je mtho la song nas/ mthar rang gi steng dang phyogs thams cad chus bskor pa'i dbus na rang nyid 'dug par bsams pa ni —168

dmigs pa bdun pa dang / yang rang gi mdun lta bu phyogs gang yang rung ba zhig tu dmigs rten gyi mar me zhig bzhag /de la skabs skabs su cung zad blta zhing / gzhan yid kyis mar me g.yo ba med pa zhig sgom ste/ /de la sems 'dzin pa ni dmigs pa brgyad pa dang / yang rang gi gsang gnas su mar me dgu rab tu g.yo ba la sems 'dzin pa ni dgu pa dang / yang rang nyid yul gang la sems 'phro bar gyur pa'i dngos po zhig la yid bstad 'jog /gzhan la sems 'phro na de la 'phro ba bcad de/ slar dmigs rten snga ma de ka la sems 'jog pa ni bcu pa dang / yang rang gi gang yid du 'ong ba'i dngos po zhig la sems 'dzin/ rnam rtog gas 'phro na/ slar rang gi gang yid du 'ong ba'i dngos po de ka la sems 'jog pa ni dmigs pa bcu gcig pa dang / yang lus gnad rkang pa mdun du gshibs/ rgyu mo khung gnyis nas lag pa g.yas g.yon gnyis kyis bzungs/ de'i thad kyi rkang mthil du 'od zer 'phro ba la sems 'dzin pa'am/yang na shing ril mo sbom phra 'tshams pa zhig rkang pa'i rgyu mo khung du bcug /rkang sor g.yas g.yon lag pas bzungs la/ shing gis reg pa'i reg bya yod pa der sems gtod pa ni/ gdan khri la sems 'dzin pa ste dmigs pa bcu gnyis pa dang / yang shog bu'am/ ras lta bu zhig la gzhi sngon po de'i dbus su ljon shing ngam ri lta bu zhig bris/ de'i rtsa bar mi'i gzugs brnyan zhig bris la/de mdun du dmigs rten du bzhag la gzhi sngon po/ ne'u gsing dang de'i dbus su ri'am ljon shing gang rung zhig la rang nyid skor ba byed pa ni dmigs pa bcu gsum pa dang / yang rang gi spyi bor shing lta bu zhig btsugs la/ de'i reg bya —169

yod par nor bu 'od 'phro ba zhig la sems 'dzin pa ni/ gtsug gi nor bu la sems 'dzin pa ste dmigs pa bcu bzhi pa dang / spyi bor shing bu 'jog pa mi bde na/ lag pa gnyis thal mo sbyar ba spyi bor bzhag pa ni dmigs pa bco lnga pa dang / yang lag pa gnyis khu tshur brla steng du bzhag ro stod dang ltag pa bgyed byas la/ gdong gyen du phyogs pas mig bar snang la blta/ lus kyi dbus su 'od kyi go bu kha dog ji ltar bde ba zhig sgom la/ de lus kyi dbus nas yar song / spyi bo nas 'thon/ nam mkha' mthon por yal bar sgoms pa ni dmigs pa bcu drug pa'o/ gegs sel gyi man ngag la / rtsa dang rlung dang thig le la brten pa'i gegs gang yin ngos zin par byas la/ grang ba'i nad rnams lte ba'i 'khor lo'i byed pa la brten nas 'byung ba'i dbang du mdzod/thog mar bar rlung bzung bzhin pa'i ngang nas rlung ro bsal/ steng rlung rngub cing 'og rlung 'then la rlung gnyis kha sbyor du bzung / lto ba g.yas g.yon du lan gsum gsum bskor ba dang / steng du 'then pa dang / 'og tu gnon pa dang / lto ba tshigs pa la gcer te rgyab ngos su 'then pa dang / lto ba phyir bskyed pa rnams byas la/ rlung phyir 'bud pa'i tshe grang ba'i nad sogs mi bde ba gang yin pa de/'od zer 'ja' tshon gyi rnam pas sna sgo dang / 'og sgo gnyis nas kyang bun bun 'thon par bsam mo/ /rlung phyi rol du 'dzin pa'i ngang nas/ khog nang stong pa'i shugs g.yas g.yon du bskor ba dang / steng 'og tu 'then gnon byed pa dang /rgyab mdun du bcol ba rnams byed do/ khrag sogs tsha pa'i nad rnams lus kyi stong du 'byung ba'i/ de sel ba la sngar bar rlung bzung ba de rjes rngub ste kha sbyor —170

du bzung / de nyid pho stod du drangs la pho stod dang ro stod g.yas g.yon du bskor pa dang / steng 'og tu 'then gnon dang / rgyab mdun du bcol ba rnams byas la/ /rlung phyir gtong ba'i tshe sna bug dang 'og sgo gnyis nas nad 'ja' tshon gyi rnam pas 'thon par bsams/ rlung phyir bzung la skor ba sogs byed do/rlung gi nad ni mgo dang tshigs rnams la brten nas 'byung bas/ de sel ba yang / bar rlung bzung la/ de rjes rlung rngub ste steng 'og gi rlung kha sbyor du bzung la/ de nyid stod kyi char 'then byas te/ mgo g.yas g.yon du bskor ba dang /steng 'og tu 'then gnon dang mdun rgyab tu bcol ba rnams byed pa dang / lag pa skor la brkyang bskum byed cing sprugs pa dang / rlung gtong ba'i tshe/ nad rnams dbang po'i sgo rnams dang / mgrin pa yan gyi ba spu'i bu ga rnams dang /rkang lag gi sen mo'i hrag rnams nas bun bun 'thon par bsams/ rlung phyi rol du bzung bzhin pas mgo bo bskor ba sogs bya'o/ /7/ rlung rengs bcu'i gegs sel ni/ bum pa can la sogs pa'i rlung gi sbyor ba sgom pas gegs byung ba'am/ de lta min yang rdo rje'i lus la gnad du bsnun pa'i rdzogs rim gang rung sgom pas rlung 'du bar 'gyur zhing / de la brten nas gegs byung na gegs sel gyi man ngag 'di rnams sgom dgos pa yin no/ /de yang srog rlung la skyon zhugs te ro stod gzer ba dang / snying mi dga' ba dang / shes pa 'phyo ba la sogs pa byung na/ rdo rje nor bu'i rtse mor sems drag tu bstad la/ sngar bum pa can la rber+shags pa bo/mas pa zhig yin na/thur sel 'then 'then byed pa yin zhing / de ltar min na steng rlung gsang gnas —171—

su mnan la/ rlung rnams rdo rje nor bur yal bar bsam pa yang yang sgom pas sel lo/ /ro stod la chu tshan sogs chu dron mos bran pas kyang phan par 'gyur ro/ /me mnyam la skyon zhugs na pho ba sbo 'brog dang sgrags skyugs sogs 'byung bas/ de la sems mgrin par bstad la/ bar rlung bzung zhing / lto ba'i smad bar rlung yod par bskor ba dang / pho stog bskor bar byas pas sel lo 'di la lto ba la thog mar chang gis byug pa byas la/ de nas bye ma bsregs pa lta bu gang yang rung bas grang dug byas pas kyang phan par 'gyur ro/ /thur sel la skyon zhugs te chu lam dang / bshang lam du na tsha skye ba dang / bshang gci sdom pa dang / bshang gci mi thub pa sogs byung na/ sems spyi bor bstad la/ bshang lam dang / chu lam gyi bar dang / tshang ra la sogs par khu tshur brdeg cing phur mnye byas pas sel lo/ /gyen rgyu'i rlung rengs na/ mgrin pa 'gags pa dang /nang du sha skye ba dang / gre ba tsha ba la sogs pa dang / sna bug tsha ba sogs 'byung zhing / de sel ba la rlung drag tu rngub la/ rlung bzung zhing mgo bskor bar bya/drag tu rlung bus la yang mgo bskor ro/ /'di la mgrin pa'i bum can lta bu dang bsgrags te mgo bskor bar byas na/ gegs sel mchog tu 'gro'o/ khyab byed kyi rlung rengs na lus thams cad na ba'am/ sbrid pa'am/ lus khol bu khol bur tsha tshag pa la sogs pa 'byung bas/ de sel ba la/ yan lag thams cad sprugs shing / lus 'dar phrug phrug bya'o/ /'di la rjes kyi khyad par snum dang g.yer ma bsres pas lus la byug pa dang / 'khrul 'khor gyi khyad par ka pā la a sa na bya ba/ spyi bo sa la btsugs / rkang pa gnyis gnam du bstan pa'i lus sbyong byas —172

pas kyang sel bar 'gyur ro/ /yan lag gi rlung lnga rengs pa sel ba la mig tu rgyu ba'i rlung rengs te mig tsha ba dang mi gsal bar 'gro ba la sogs pa byung na/ lto ba phyir skyed pa'i bum pa can bzungs la shugs dang ldan pa'i mig drag tu g.yas g.yon tu skor ba dang / yas mar du lta ba rnams byas la/ mthar rlung 'bud cing lus drag tu sprugs so/ /'di la rdzas kyi khyad par tsha ba la brten te mig nan gur gum sogs 'debs pa dang / grang ba la brten na skyer pa'i khan da sogs byug cing / snga dro so brdar ba byugs pas kyang phan par 'gyur ro/ /rna bar rgyu ba'i rlung rengs na/ rna ba 'ur ba dang na zug skye ba la sogs pa 'byung bas/ de sel ba la/ rlung drag tu rngubs la lto ba bskyed pas bum pa can bzung la/ rna ba mi bde ba'i phyogs de bkag cing / mthar drag tu 'bud pa'i tshe/ rlung rnams rna ba min pa'i phyogs nas 'thon par bsams la/ lus thams cad drag tu sprugs/ /'di la rdzas kyi khyad par dri chu dron mos rna ba bkang ste/ mthar phyir 'pho'o/ /yang dag par rgyu ba'i rlung rengs na/ sna bug gi lam tsha ba sogs mi bde ba 'byung bas/ de sel ba la rlung drag tu rngubs la lto ba phyir bskyed pas bum can bzung la lag pa g.yas g.yon re mos kyis sna'i rtse nas bzung ste mnye ba dang / bya po9rdog g.yas g.yon nas dus gcig tu lag pa g.yas g.yon gyis bzung la mnye zhing / mthar drag tu 'bud cing lus thams cad sprugs/ /rab tu rgyu ba'i rlung rengs na/ lce mi bde ba dang / sprid pa dang / thor ba skye ba sogs 'byung bas/ de sel ba la/ rlung drag tu rngubs la/ lto ba phyir bskyed pa'i bum pa can bzung la/ lce brkyangs shing bsgril la rkan la sbyor ba ci thub bya ba lan mang —173

du byas pa'i mthar rlung drag tu 'bud cing lus thams cad sprugs/ /nges par rgyu ba'i rlung rengs na/ lus thams cad na ba dang / sbrid pa'am/ lus khol bur na ba sogs 'byung bas/ de sel ba la/ rlung drag tu rngub la/ lto ba phyir bskyed pas bum pa can bzung la/ lag pa gnyis kyi sor mo gcan gzan gyi sder mo ltar bskum la/ nywa bzhi bsgrims pas sprugs pa dang / rkang pa'i sor mo yang bskum la/ nywa bzhi bsgrims pas sprugs pa dang / kha bsgrad pas nywa bzhi bsgrims la mgo sprugs pa dang / ro stod gcu ba dang / rgya mtsho bskyod pa sogs byas la mthar rlung drag tu 'bud cing lus thams cad sprugs/ /tsha ba'i nad sel ba la/ rang gi spyi bor haṃ yig dkar po mgo bo thur du bstan pa/ 'od zer dkar po shin tu bsil ba 'phro ba las/ bdud rtsi reg bya shin tu bsil ba babs te/ 'od zer dang bdud rtsis lus kyi nang grang bsil bsil gyur pa la sems bstad pas sel lo/ /grang ba'i nad sel ba la/ rang gi lte ba'am gsang gnas su a yig dmar po shin tu tsha ba'i rang bzhin can las 'od zer dmar po reg bya shin tu tsha ba 'phros te/ des lus kyi nang thams cad gang bas tsha 'ur te gyur par bsams pas sel lo/ /'dus pa'i nad rnams kyis lus lci bar gyur na/ gsang gnas su yaṃ yig shin du g.yo ba'i rang bzhin can sgoms la/de las 'od zer 'phros pas/ lus kyi pags pa sha khrag rus pa rnams brjid med pa du ba 'dra ba zhig tu gyur pa/ yaṃ las 'phros pa'i rlung gis yal yal gyen du 'degs par bsams pas sel lo/ /gzhan yang rlung rengs pa ste/ rtsa gnas su 'gag pa'i gegs sel spyi khyab ni/ rang gi lus kyi gnas thams cad —174

nas rlung rnams 'od zer gyi rnam pa rta rnga lta bu rkang dang bcas pa byung ste/ bshang sgo nas 'thon pa 'og thag ring por song ste/ mthar yal bar bsam/ 'di la 'khrul 'khor yang langs te rkang pa gnyis drag tu bsgrad pa dang / bshang sgo phyir phul zhing lhod pas kyang sel lo/ /yang rlung rtsa gnas rnams su 'khyil ba'i gegs ni/ 7rlung rengs pa las gegs dang mi bde ba'i rnam pa cha phra bar 'byung ba ste/ de sel ba la/ rlung rnams 'od zer gyi rnam pas lus kyi nang nas yar byung ste/ sbyi bo nas 'thon/ bar snang thag ring por yal bar bsam zhing / hā ring dang ha thung yang 'don no/ /gzhan yang zug gzer lus kyi dbus sam steng 'og tu 'byung ba'am/ stod kyi char rgyab mdun du gzer ba lta bu byung na/ rdo rje rgya gram gyis steng 'og tu gzir ba la steng nas mnan par bsam zhing / mdun rgyab tu gzer na/ rdo rje rgya gram gyis nang nas mdun phyogs su mnan par bsam mo/ /'bor lo bskor ba ni/ ro stod dang lto ba dang rgyu zhabs rnams na zhing mi bde bar gyur na thad de dang de 'khor lo rtse mo shin tu rno ba/ kha dog ji ltar rigs pa zhig sgom la/ de drag tu 'khor bas je cher gyur te/ rtsibs rnams kyis yongs su bcad pas lus kyi phyi na mar thon pas/ lus nyid smad har gyis bcad par bsams/ 'di la rlung sbyor bum can nyid gang na sar sdigs par byed pa'o/ /srad bu la brten pa ni/ rang gang na sar srad bu gru gu lta bu zhig yod pa de nar gyis phar song / lus kyi na sar bu ga byung ste de nas song ba sne gcig lus nang na thog mar yod pa de/ slar gru gu 'gril ba ltar phar hril te 'gril bar bsam/ de lta bu yang yang sgom zhing / rlung sbyor ni bu ga nas —175

srad bu phar 'gro ba'i tshe/ rlung kha sna gnyis gar nas drag tu 'bud do/ /bu ga mang po'i sbyor ba ni/ lus thams cad tshags se ltar khrol tshags su 'dug pa la/'bebs chung dang bcas ha bton pas rlung rnams du ba'i rnam pas bu ga nas bun bun thon par bsam mo/ /'khor lo med pa ni/ rang gi gsang gnas yan chad dang / mgrin pa man chad kyi lus sbug dong lta bu stod smad zangs thal du yod pa/ dpangs mtho ba zhig sgom/ shes pa byings ba dang / thur sel la skyon zhugs pa'i nad dang / chu ser dang / grang ba sogs kyis sked pa man chad na na/'og nas rlung gi tshogs dpag tu med pa rang lus sbug dong lta bu'i nang nas yar shong tshad du song / steng gi bu ga nas thon/ bar snang thag ring por yal bar bsam zhing / rlung kha sna gnyis ka nas drag tu bus la lag pa drag tu sprugs/ /yang rgod pa shas che ba dang / lte ba yan chad na na/ steng phyogs kyi nam mkha' nas rlung gi tshogs dpag tu med pa byung / rang lus sbug dong lta bu'i nang na mar zhugs te song / sa 'og thag ring por yal bar bsams/ rlung kha sna gnyis ka nas rngubs la/ bsdad yod na 'bebs chung bya ba'am/ langs na rkang pa gnyis re mos kyis drag tu sprugs/ /lus rab tu zhu ba'i sbyor ba ni/ rang gi mdun du thog mar mtsho chung mar khu'am chu dron lta bus gang ba zhig bsams la/de je cher gyur pa'i nang du rang gi lus kyang rim par nub ste/ spyi bo man chad de'i nang du nub cing bying ba na/ rang gi lus yongs su zhu ste de dang 'dres par bsams/ 'dis ni sems mi gnas par rnam rtog drag tu 'phro ba'i gegs sel lo/ /bogs 'don gyi dmigs pa ni/ mnyam bzhag tu rtog med rnam par mi —176

rtog pa sgom par byed pa zhig yin na/ 'gro 'chag nyal 'dug sogs thun mtshams rnams su yang dran pa'i rten dngos po ji ltar rigs pa zhig bzhag la/de yang yang mthong ba'i rkyen gyis bskul te/ mi rtog pa yang yang dran par byas te sgoms pas kyang mnyam bzhag la bogs thon par 'gyur ro/ /yang mnyam bzhag tu gtum mo lta bu rtog bcas kyi rnal 'byor sgom par byed pa zhig yin na/thun mtshams rnams su dper na zas za ba'i tshe/ zas kyi dbus su gtum mo e yig bsgom par byed pa dang / gzhan yang gtam smra ba'i tshe/ de'i kha nang du gtum mo e yig sgom par byed pa sogs la bslabs pas kyang bogs thon par 'gyur ro/ /gzhan bla ma yi dam rang gang mos zhig bar snang thag ring por bzhugs par bsams la/ rang nyid ljon shing lta bu zhig la 'dzegs te yar phyin zhing / bla ma yi dam bzhugs pa dang thad mnyam par slebs pa na/ 'di dag thams cad rang sems kyi snang ba tsam yin/ bden par grub pa cung zad kyang med snyam pa'i 'dun pa cung zad btang la/ rang dang bla ma yi dam dang snang ba thams cad stong pa nyid kyi ngang du thag bcad de/ yid la mi byed pa'i tshul gyis cung zad mnyam par bzhag /yang de las langs te bla ma yi dam de las kyang mtho ba'i nam mkha'i dbyings na bzhugs par bsams la/ rang nyid nyi zla'i 'od zer ram/ ljon shing lta bu gang rung zhig la 'dzegs te phyin pa na/ bla ma yi dam bzhugs pa'i thad dang mnyam par slebs pa na/ sngar bzhin stong nyid kyi ngang du mnyam par 'jog pa sogs mtha' med kyi bar du byas pas kyang ting nge 'dzin thams cad la bogs thon zhing / yon tan yar 'phel du 'gyur ro// //—177

'dir smras pa/ tshangs sogs dregs ldan lha yis btud pa'i 'od kyis phyogs kun mtha' bskor zhing / /thugs rje'i cha shas yongs su gang bar grub pa'i rtags ris ma nyams pa/ /bgrangs yas lus can rgya mtsho'i gnyen gyur phan bde'i bdud rtsi spro ba mkhan/ /dpal ldan bde chen rdo rje'i zla ba 'phags yul shar ri'i phrag par shar/ /gang des dngos grub mchog brnyes bye ba brgyas/ /rmad byung phan bde'i lam bzang ji snyed pa/ /gcig tu dril ba rdo rje'i theg pa yi/ /rim gnyis rnal 'byor mchog gi dga' ston bskrun/ /gang 'di rigs kyi khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang / /bshes gnyen dam par snang ba kun dga'i mtshan/ /'dren pa mchog des gangs ri'i khrod 'di mā /sngon med legs bshad gsar pa'i bdud rtsi bkye/ /brgyad khri bzhi stong chos rnams kyi/ /snying po las kyang ches snying po/ /'di bris dge ba gang thob pas/ /zung 'jug rdo rje'i sku thob shog /ces pa 'di yang rgyal ba kun 'dus kyi ngo bo rje btsun rdo rje 'chang kun dga' snying po'i gsung las ji ltar byung ba bzhin/ shākya'i dge slong ye shes rgya mtshos zin bris su bgyis pa'o/ /maṅga lo/'di'i brgyud pa ni/zur ming ba tshe dbang kun khyab/ mngon byang rdo rje thar/ bla ma dri med/ lha rtse rgyal mtshan/ ngag dbang bsam gtan/zur ming yan chad de'i gsan yig tu rtogasadagos so/ /bka' bab drug ldan khrid yig yang mthong ma myong nas mi shes na yang / tshigs chen bcu la khro bcu gsang 'dus lus dkyil skabs lta bu dang / rigs drug dus 'khor gyi sngon 'gro'i skabs mtshungs re yin nam zhu / zhes ngag dbang tshogs gnyis rgya mtsho'i gsung ngo // //zhus dag maṅga lo/ /—178

zhes bya ba'i khrid yig bzhugs/na mo gu ru we/ phyag rgya chen po ga'u ma'i rang babs rnam gsum zhes bya ba/ ye shes mkha' 'gro ni gu ma'i gdams ngag 'di la/ khrid kyi sngon 'gro dal 'byor rnyed dka'/ mi rtag pa sdug bsngal sogs spyi dang mthun/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed dang / a yi stong ra rnams ni gu chos drug dang 'dra/ thun gyi sngon 'gro bla ma'i rnal 'byor ni/ gzhan sgyu lus dang 'dra ba las maṇ+ḍal mang du 'bul/ bdag 'dzin blo yi thongs par mdzod du gsol/ dgos med rgyud la skye bar mdzad du gsol/ 'od gsal phyag rgya chen po rtogs par mdzad du gsol/zhes pa khyad par ro/ /khrid dngos la/ sngon 'gro rang babs rnam gsum/ dngos gzhi skyon bzhi rang grol/ rjes sku gsum rang shar gyi khrid do/ /dang po la zhi gnas kyi khrid dang / lhag mthong gi khrid gnyis/ dang po la dmigs pa'i gzhi dang / bogs 'don no/ /dang po ni/ sngar sgo gsum gyi bya ba thams cad don med la dor song 'dug pas/ da phyin chad sgom la brtan pa cung zad cig ma skyes par mi dge ba dang / lung ma bstan lta ci smos/ spros bcas dge ba yang rtsol ba glod/ lus rnam snang gi chos bdun/ ngag rlung ro lan gsum bsal nas smra brjod lta ci smos rlung 'dzin 'dren tsam yang spong pa'i rang babs/ sems ma bcos pa lhod —179

de glod/ dmigs skor gcig /rnam rtog sna tshogs 'phro na lam gyis skyes pa la ngo shes/ 'phro rbad kyi bcad la bzhag /dmigs skor gnyis/ 'go 'gyu rgya 'byams su 'gro na/ nam dran dus phyin chad 'di 'dra gtan nas ma byung ba byed snyam zhe dam bya/ rnam rtog byung tsa na dran zhing ngo shes pa byed snyam pa byas pas sel te/ dmigs skor gsum/ de dus shes pa mi gsal bar song / brjed nges kyang cher 'gro na bying ba'i skyon yin/ rig pa bsgrim/ mig dpangs gtod/mthongs dkar ba dang yang thog la sogs par bsgom/ bying ba 'phro bcad de langs pa sogs byed/ yang tshig pa za zhing sbun langs na rgod pa yin pas lhod kyis glod/ lta stangs smad/ 'dod yon la dga' bas sems g.yengs na/ mi rtag sdug bsngal la yid 'byung bar bya ste dmigs skor bzhi pa'o/ / gnyis pa la lta stangs nges med la bslab pa/ chos spyod sna tshogs la bslab pa/ spyod lam sna tshogs dang bsre ba'o/ /dang po ni/ mig gi lta stangs mtho ba thag nye ba thog mthil lta bu dang /ring ba ri rtse'am nam mkha'i dbyings lta bu la mnyam par bzhag ste dmigs skor lnga/ dma' ba nye ba rtsig 'khris sam ring ba ri rtsib lta bu la mnyam par bzhag ste drug pa'o/ /thad ka nye ba gyang ldan nam ring ba ri ldan lta bu la mnyam par bzhag ste bdun pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ mdo 'don/ sngags zlos/ gtam sna tshogs dang bsre zhes pa'i don mdo la sogs pa kha ton byang ba rnams dang thog mar bsre/ rim gyis kha tan thams cad dang bsre gang thub bya ste brgyad pa'o/ /sngags thung ba rnams dang thog mar bsre/ de nas bzlas pa thams cad dang bsre —180

ste dgu pa'o/ /dang por chu sgra sogs 'byung ba'i sgra dang bsre/ de nas mi mang po'i ca co dang sgo 'then sogs dang bsre/ de nas mi gzhan gyis gtam smra ba la bsres te de dag gi sgra lhang lhang ba der had de bzhag ste dmigs skor bcu pa'o /gsum pa spyod lam sna tshogs la bslab ste/ zas za na yang rang babs kyi ngang nas za/ lam du 'gro na yang de bzhin du sbyang / gtam smra na yang rang babs kyis ngang nas ma bral bar bya ste/ dang por sgrim mi dgos par do gal chung ba rnams la sbyangs pas mthar thams cad la 'byongs pa yin no/ /de bzhin du bde sdug /dga' mi dga'/ ya nga bag tsha ngo tsha skyug bro sogs mtho dman gyi rnam rtog skye ba'i yul thams cad la rang babs su bsres kyin sbyang / thams cad kyang sngar ltar dge sbyor gyi ngang du tshud 'ong ste dmigs skor bcu gcig pa'o/ /de ltar na zhi gnas la dmigs skor bcu gcig go /gnyis pa lhag mthong gi khrid sems tshol ni/ bla ma'i zhal rgyun las rgyas par 'byung ba'i dbang du byas na/ dang po sngar bzhin rang babs gsum gnad du babs nas lhod kyi klod pa'i ngang nas 'tshol ba ni thams cad kyi sngon 'gro yin no/ /dngos gzhi dmigs thun bdun te/ sems kyi ngo bo la 'tshol ba skye 'gag la 'tshol ba/ yul snang ba la 'tshol ba/ rnam rtog la 'tshol pa/ yul snang yod med kyi khyad par la 'tshol ba/ rnam rtog yod med kyi khyad par la 'tshol ba/ rang bzhin dbyings su thag bcad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ sems kyi ngo bo la che re lta zhing zhib tu gzhig pa 'jug pa ste/ der rtsol ba rang zhig la song —181—

nas 'di yin brjod du med pa'i nyams skyes pa na rang babs su 'jog ste dmigs skor gcig go / gnyis pa ni/ sems rtog med kho na la bltas nas skye 'gag gtan mi byed pa'i rtag pa brtan pa zhig 'dug gam/ skye 'gag byed pa'i ci med cing med cig 'dug /skye 'gag byed na ji ltar skye yin 'dug /gnas na ji ltar gnas/ kha dog dbyibs sogs ji lta bu/ phyi nang gang na 'dug /'gag na ji ltar 'gag ces sogs zhib tu brtags pa na/ ngos bzung med pa la zhi ste/ dmigs skor gnyis pa'o/ /gsum pa ni/ mig gis gzugs mthong na/ gzugs su lam mer mthong ba de ngo bo ji ltar 'dug pa lta/ de dang sems rig rig tur tur 'di gcig gam/ tha dad khyad ci 'dug zhib tu dpyad/de bzhin rna bas sgra thos pa sogs la'ang sbyar te/ dmigs skor gsum pa'o/ /bzhi pa ni/ yang rnam rtog lam gyi 'char ba 'di dang sems kyi rang bzhin la khyad par ci 'dug /de gnyis gcig mi gcig brtag /rnam rtog skyes pa'i tshe ji ltar skyed/ skyes nas ma 'gags pa'i skabs yod lugs ga 'dra zhig 'dug /'gag tsa na 'gag lugs ci 'dra zhig 'dug zhib tu brtags te/ dmigs skor bzhi pa'o/ /lnga pa ni/ mig gis gzugs mthong ba'i dus kyi sems dang ma mthong ba'i dus kyi sems la khyad ci 'dra zhig 'dug /yod na yod lugs dang med na med lugs ji ltar yin brtags te dmigs skor lnga pa'o/ /drug pa ni/rnam rtog skyes pa'i dus kyi sems dang ma skyes pa'i dus kyi sems la bzang ngan gsal mi gsal stong mi stong khyad yod med legs par brtags/ 'tshol thabs de bzhi la'ang mthar dmigs gtad zhig pa zhig 'byung ba'i de kho na'i ngang —182— —

bskyong / dmigs skor drug pa'o/ /bdun pa ni/ snang ba 'di thams cad rang gi sems su thag bcad/ sems la legs par brtags pa na ngos bzung ci yang med pa dang de kha'i ngang la bzhag da rung mang du btsal bas/ ngos bzung med bzhin du ci med cing med kyang ma yin par stong bzhin du sna tshogs su 'char ba'i rig stong rjen ne ba/ wa le khyug ge ba/ lhag ger myong ba/ brjod mi shes pa de la cham gyis bzhag ste dmigs skor bdun pa'o/ /de ltar lhag mthong la bdun no/ /sngon 'gro rang babs rnam gsum la dmigs skor bco brgyad do/khyung po'i bla ma ni gu mas sngon 'gro la gtso bor mdzad/ mai tri pas dngos gzhi la gtso bor mdzad/ su kha sidhi'i rjes la gtso bor mdzad gsungs te sngon 'gro'i skabs 'dir rtogs pa skye dgos so/ /dngos gzhi la thog mar byin rlabs kyi sgo nas brku thabs su ngo sprod pa ni/ maṇ+ḍal chos 'byung mthing kha zhig bzhengs/ der malji'i steng du gtor ma che ba la mda' dar btsugs shing rgyan bzang pos brgyan pa zhig bzhag /mdun du 'bul gtor dang mchod pa dang tshogs rdzas rnams bshams/ mchod pa byin rlabs spyi dang 'dra/ slob dpon rang gis bde mchog lhan skyes kyi mngon rtogs bsgoms la/ mdun bskyed maṇ+ḍal dang gtor ma sum+bhas bsangs/ swā bha was sbyangs/ gtor chog ltar mgon por bskyed pa nas bzlas pa'i bar bya/ de nas slob ma rnams la khrus dang me tog bkye bsdu sogs bya/ maṇ+ḍal lan gsum phul la/ slob ma rnams la bde mchog lhan skyes kyi mngon rtogs phog la cung zad sems 'dzin du 'jug /mdun bskyed mgon por skad cig gis bsgom du —183

bcug cing / steng gi cha la brgyud pa'i bla ma thams cad kyis bskor ba'i dbus su/ ye shes mkha' 'gro ni gu ma sku mdog smug nag ḍā ma ru dang thod pa kha ṭ+wāṃ ga bsnams pa gar stabs dang rus pa'i rgyan can/ lang tsho dar la babs pa/sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs mkha' 'gro sde lnga mkha' 'gro ma bye ba 'bum sde'i tshogs dang bcas pa bzhugs par bsam/ de rnams la dngos su bshams pa'i maṇ+ḍal 'di nyid stong gsum gyi 'jig rten gyi khams su mos te gser gyis bkang zhing 'bul bar bsam/dpon slob rnams kyis lhan cig tu tshogs dang gtor ma byin gyis brlabs/byin rlabs kyi cho ga ni yi dam gang byed kyi nang mchod ltar byin gyis brlab/ oṃ hrīḥha ha hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa gyi mthar/ oṃ a kā ro btags pas dang por bla ma dang yi dam la phul/ de nas gtor chog ltar mgon po 'khor bcas la phul/ oṃ sarba ḍā ki ni sa pa ri wā ra a kā ro sogs kyis mkha' 'gro ma la 'bul/ snyims pa me tog dang bcas pas gsol 'debs 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod byas la/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas la skyabs su mchi'o/ /phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i chos la skyabs su mchi'o/ /phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i dge 'dun la skyabs su mchi'o/ /bla ma dang yi dam gyi lha tshogs ye shes kyi mgon po phyag drug pa'i lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o/ /rtsa ba dang brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams dang yi dam gyi lha tshogs rnams kyis bdag la phyag rgya chen po'i rtogs pa ngo 'phrod par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/mkha' 'gro chos skyong ba'i srung ma rnams kyis bdag phyag rgya chen po zhu ba dang —184

nyams su len pa la phyi nang gi bar du gcod pa gang yang mi 'byung bar mdzad du gsol/ zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab/ rtsa ba'i bla ma la mos gus dung ba byed du bcug /lus gnad bcas rlung rang babs su rgyu ru gzhug /bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang bcas pa thams cad 'od du zhu nas slob ma rang nyid la thim par mos la dar cig stod kyis glod nas/ sems kyi rang ngo la lhan zher ltos shig byas la yud cig mnyem par 'jog tu bcug /da lta sems ngos bzung thams cad dang bral ba/ rjen ne+e ye re ba 'di ka rang sems skye med chos sku'am/ tha mal shes pa'am rang babs zhes bya ba yin pas/ da phyin chad 'di ka mnyam rjes thams cad du bzo bcos med par skyongs shig byas/ maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba dang smon lam btab pa sogs spyi dang mthun/ gnyis pa ni/ thun gyi sngon 'gro sngar ltar las/ gnas 'gyu thams cad du dran pas zin pa zhig bya'o/ /zhes yang yang 'dun pa byas nas/ dmigs pa'i dngos gzhi la sems gnas pa'i tshe/kha nang log tu rang ngo shes pa tsam byas nas/ bzo bcos med pa'i tshul du bzhag /yul snang gi 'char sgo'am/ rnam rtog gi 'char sgo ci byung yang ched gtad dgag sgrub blang dor mi bya bar gang shar de rang ngo shes tsam gyi ngang la mnyam par bzhag pas rnam rtog kho rang ma 'gags bzhin du gsal seng nge ba de'i ngang bskyang / ngo mi shes su gcig kyang ma shor bar bya/ ngo shes dang ma bral phyin chad 'gyu na'ang 'gyu ru bcug rang log tu 'gro na'ang 'gro ru bcug dran pa la ched gtad du 'bad/ 'di la bsgom du rdul tsam med/ yengs su skad cig kyang med ces bya/ de nyid la skyon bzhi rang grol bar ngo sprad de/ nye drags pas —185

ngo ma shes/ zab drags pas ngos ma zin sla drags pas yid ma ches/ bzang drags pas blor ma shong zhes pa'i skyon bzhi las grol ba ste/ dang po ni rang ngo ma shes pa/ gnyis pa ni/ sngar 'chi ba dang shugs chad kyi nyams la sogs pa'i dus su tha mal shes pa rang ngo gsal bar ston pa mang du byung mod kyang / bla ma'i gdams ngag gis ngo ma sprad pa de srid thabs gang gis kyang ma shes pa'o/ /gsum pa ni/ mkhas rmongs thams cad byar med la blos ma khel ba'o/ /bzhi pa ni/ sems kyi rang bzhin sangs rgyas yin pa blor ma shong pa'o/ /de la gnas 'gyu thams cad rang ngo shes tsam na rang bzhin stong gsal du 'dug /des na gang shar la bzo bcos byed don med/ rang bzhin gsal stong 'di las logs su 'khor 'das gang yang med par shes tshe skyon de bzhi rang grol ba yin/gsum pa rjes sku gsum rang shar la sku gsum rang shar ngo sprad pa dngos dang /de'i bogs 'don pa'o/ /dang po ni/ sngar gyi tha mal shes pa ma bcos so ma de nyid sngon gdod ma gsal stong zung 'jug tu rang shar bar rang ngo shes pa nas stong pa chos kyi sku/ gsal ba sprul sku/ zung 'jug longs skur thag bcad nges shes bskyed nas rang babs de ga'i ngang du bskyang bar bya'o/ /de ltar nyams su myong ba'i tshe/ sems skad cig ma gcig kyang sku gsum du ngo 'phrod/ rnam rtog skad cig ma gcig kyang sku gsum gyi rang bzhin no/ /de ltar nyams myong du shar bar byas nas rtag tu skyongs dgos pa yin no/ /gnyis pa la/ bogs 'don dang gegs sel gnyis las/ dang po la/ mos gus tshad med la brten nas bogs 'don pa/ snying rje tshad med la brten nas bogs 'don pa/ thabs khyad par —186

can la brten nas bogs 'don pa'o/ /dang po ni/ spyi rtogs pa skyes na mos gus shugs 'byung la 'byung / ma rtogs pa'i sems can la snying rje rang shugs kyis skye yang / de la slar yang mos gus dang snying rje bsgom pas me 'bar ba la shing gcer ba bzhin du cher 'phel te lam gyi bogs 'don bla na med par 'gyur pa yin no/ /de ltar yang yang lam phyag rgya chen po bsgom bzhin du mos gus dang snying rje drag tu bsgoms pas mthar thug rtogs pa'i thabs su 'gyur ro/ /de yang mos gus ni spyir rtsa ba'i bla ma de nyid sangs rgyas dngos yin pa dang / thugs chos kyi sku mdzad spyod 'phrin las thams cad gzhan don gzugs sku rnam gnyis sangs rgyas byang sems yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bo yin par thag gcod/ bdag gnas lugs la dkri bar mdzad pas bka' drin che/ bka' drin la nam yang 'khor ba med snyam pa mos gus kyi gdung shugs drag pos gsol ba rtse gcig tu 'debs/ bla ma'i mos gus kyis yid bsgyur bas rang bzhin spros bral gyi ye shes lhag ger shar ba na/ de kha'i ngang du mnyam par bzhag /gnyis pa ni/ sems can thams cad drin can gyi pha ma yin par rang sems ngo ma shes pas nyon mongs dang las bsags te 'khor bar 'khyams pa 'di cis kyang snying re rje zhes yid la bsam zhing ngag tu yang brjod/ mthar snying rje bya yul snying rje byed mkhan thams cad ngos bzung dang bral ba'i ngang der cham mer bzhag /gsum pa la gsum las/ dang po ni/ tha mal shes pa rlung dang bsre/ /rnam rtog ma rig 'gag par 'gyur/ /zhes pa'i don ni/ sems ma bcos par phyag rgya chen po'i ngang la mnyam par 'jog cing /187—

rlung bum pa can drag tu bzung nas rlung sems 'jug pa gcig pa'i phyir/rtogs pa gong nas gong du 'phel bar 'gyur/ gnyis pa ni/ 'od gsal lha sku rlung dang bsre/ /nyams myong yar ngo bzhin du 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs te/ rang nyid bde mchog lhan skyes chu nang gi zla gzugs ltar snang la rang bzhin med par bsgom/ lha skur snang ba ma 'gag pa de ka ma bcos so ma/ 'od gsal phyag rgya chen pos zin par byas la rlung drag tu gcun pas phyag chen la lha skus bogs thon te/ nyams myong gong 'phel du 'gyur ro/ /gsum pa ni/ zung 'jug shes pa rlung dang bsre/ /'bras bus sku gsum mngon du 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs te/ rang lha sku gsal stong du bsgom/ gzhan lus shes rab ma'am/ rang lus thabs ldan ltar na gtum mo dang 'od gsal gyi nyams myong gis lha sku la rgyas btab ste/ de nyid phyag chen gyis zin par byas la gzhur te bsgom/ ngag rlung bum pa can drag tu bzung / lha sku gsal ba sprul sku/ phyag chen mi rtog pa chos sku/ bde ba longs sku/ de gsum ga'i grogs rlung gis byas te/ lam dus kyi sku gsum nyams su blangs pas gzhi dus kyi sems kyi rang bzhin 'bras bu'i tshul du mngon du 'gyur ro/ /ji srid du rtsa bral mngon du ma gyur ba de srid 'bad rtsol chen po'i 'du 'dzi spangs nas dben par bsgom pa gal che'o/ /gnyis pa gegs sel ni/ rtsa log rlung log sogs gegs sel te chos drug sogs thabs lam gyi yan lag yin pas thun mong bar song ste 'dir mi 'chad/ 'dir thun mong ma yin pa'i gegs bsal ba ni/ nyams kyi rtsis ma bcings pa dang / snang stong phyogs rer ma shor ba la 'bad pa ste/ de yang bde gsal mi rtog pa gsum —188—
