la zhen na gol bas/ lus sems dga' bde ci skyes dang / rig pa la dwangs cha dang gsal cha ci byung dang / stong sang sang po'i mi rtog pa'i nyams ci shar la dga' chen med par bskyur/ nyams mthug drags pa bshig mi thub pa 'dra ba byung na mi sgom par snang ba'i steng du gang dgar bskyur la 'jog /bde gsal stong par zhig pa na gnas lugs rjen gyis 'char/ sems kyis snang cha dang gsal cha dang 'char sgo la bden zhen skye/ chags sdang 'dzin zhen rags su song ba'i nyams byed na/ sgyu ma lta bur mos shing btsal ba'i mi rnyed pa la 'jog /des de stong par 'char/ rang sems kyi ngo bo la'ang khyad mi 'dug pas las 'bras spang blang mi dgos so snyam pa'i log lta skyes na/ las 'bras bden par med kyang kun rjesab rgyu 'bras bslu ba med/ me mi bden kyang shing tshig /chu mi bden kyang gsher ba mi 'gag pa ltar las 'bras la yid ches bskyed dgos so/ /de ltar nyams su blang / de la sems gsal stong 'dzin med du gnas na zhi gnas yin te/ bying rgod gnyis sel ba zhig dgos/ snang ba thams cad sems/gnas 'gyu thams cad ngos bzung med par myong thog tu phebs na lhag mthong skyes pa yin no/ /gang shar la rang ngo shes pas bzo bcos med par skyong thub na phyag chen dngos gzhi'i rtogs pa skyes pa yin no/ /sems la ci bsam snang ba la ci shar thams cad dran pa dang rtsol ba brten mi dgos pa thams cad rang ngo shes pa'i gsal stong rgya 'byams su song ba'i tshe/ rtsa bral zhes bya ba rjes kyi nyams myong mthar phyin pa yin no// //zhes pa 'di'ang tā ra nā thas shar kong po'i yul gyi bshes gnyen mkhyen rab ces bya ba'i don du nye bar gdams pa'o/ / maṅga le/ bkra shis/—189—

gcod pa'i lan zhes bya ba bzhugs/khrid 'jug tu/ phyag rgya chen po rang babs rnam gsum 'di la rjes kyi skabs/ sngags thun mong ma yin pa'i nyams myong dang 'dres nas nyams myong tshad du phyin pa phan chad nas/ sngags kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i phyag chen du 'gro ba yin gyi de phyin chad mdo dang thun mong ma yin pa yin no/ /'di lta bu'i phyag rgya chen po 'di la 'gro mgon zhang 'tshal pas kyang sa lam tshig chod yin par bzhed de/ phyag rgya chen po tshig chod la/ /sa lam brtsi pa'i rmongs pa 'khrul zhes sogs gsungs/ 'dir ni sngon rang babs rnam gsum tshad du phyin na tshogs lam cher por 'gyur/ dngos gzhi skyon bzhi rang grol tshad du phyin na/ sbyor lam drod kyi rtogs pa skye/ rjes sku gsum rang shar tshad du phyin na sbyor lam bzod par slebs/ 'bras bu tshad du phyin na mdo phyogs kyi sa dang po dang sngags phyogs kyi zung 'jug 'grub pa zhes bya ba yin no/ /phyag chen rang ngos kyi lta sgom gnyis kyi so so'i nyams myong shar yang spyod pa bsod nams kyi tshogs ma rdzogs na lam de rjes mthun pa yin gyi dngos ma yin/ dper na mgron po snga phyi 'bod du mi rung ba stabs gcig kho nar 'gro dgos pa yin pa la/ gcig gis grabs ma zin na gcig phresas rgya grab thams cad grub kyang / de sgug pa'i yun ring du sdod dgos pa bzhin du sngon 'gro'i tshang ma bcos tha mal gyi shes pa rang —190

dang mnyam pa'i bsod nams gyi tshogs ma rdzogs na tshogs lam chung 'bring gi yon tan tsam 'byung srid cing / chen po'i yon tan rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang bzhi thob pa sogs mi 'byung / de gnyis zung 'jug tu yod na yon tan de yang 'byung / de la sngon 'gro ni theg pa chen po'i zhi gnas gtso che ba yin la/ dngos gzhi'i skabs snang sem sa yid la mi byed pa rang ni gzung ba rang bzhin med pa la gsal snang chung ngu skyes pa yin pas de la brtan pa thob nas thun thun mtshams sgoms 'bor yug tu song ba ni chos kyi snang ba 'phel ba'i phyir sbyor lam rtse mo yin no/ /rjes nyams myong rang shar ni gzung ba rang bzhin med pa mthong zhing de ltar ma rtogs pa'i sems can la snying rje zhugs pa yin pas sbyor lam bzod pa yin la/ de la brtan pa thob cing mi g.yo ba ni 'dzin pa sems kyi rnam rtog mngon gyur pa yang 'gags pa'i rgyu mtshan gyi yin pas sbyor lam chos mchog go /'bras bu'i rtogs pa skyes pa'i blo 'das zung 'jug rang shar zhes bya ba ni sgra dang rnam rtog gi yul las 'das shing gnas lugs zung 'jug de nyid mngon sum du shar ba'i tshul gyis rtogs pa de mthong lam thob pa phan chad 'phags pa'i sa thams cad du yod la brtan pa'i tshad 'phrin las phyogs med rang shar ni sa brgyad pa yan chad dag pa'i sa gsum yin pa shes par bya'o/ /de ltar dogs pa gcod pa'i lan rje btsun tā ra nā thas gsungs pa yin no// //maṅga lo/ /—191—

sngon du 'gro ba'i chos bcu dang lngar dbye ba'i khyad par bsdokyigs/na 31 gu nag ye shes mkha' 'gro ni gu ma nas brgyud pa'i dbang bka' che chung rnams la nye bar mkho ba'i sngon 'gro rnam pa bcu dang / lnga'i dbye ba bshad par bya ste/ de la sngon 'gro bcu ni bsam pa 'chos pa dang / skyabs 'gro sems bskyed dang / spro ba bskyed nas/ de rjes gsol ba btab pa/ gnang pa sbyin pa dang / nyan par gdams pa dang / yan lag lnga pa bya zhid / sdom pa bzung ba/ gsang ba bsgragaba'ite ye shes dbab pa'o/ /'di la bsam pa 'chos pa yan lag tu btang nas/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed so sor bgrang bas bcur byed pa'i skabs kyang yod mod don gcig go/yig rnying 'ga' zhig na/ spro ba bskyed pa med par/ gzeng bstod dang / gsang ba bsgrags pa so sor byed pa'ang yod do/ /'dir 'gro mgon sangs rgyas ston pa'i yi ge ltar byas te/ de la dang po bsam pa 'chos pa ni/da res rang re rnams kyi rnyed par dka' ba'i dal 'byor kyi mi lus rin po che thob/ mjal bar dka' ba'i sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che spyi dang dgos su sngags kyi theg pa zab mo dang mjal ba'i skabs 'dir chos la 'bad na bla na med pa'i sangs rgyas kyang bsgrub par dka' ba min na/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i phun tshogs gzhan rnams lta smos kyang ci dgos/'on kyang da res chos la ma 'bad na/ phyis mi lus thob pa tsam yang rled dka'/mi lus ma thob na chos byed pa'i skal ba med/ chos ma byas na 'khor tshoba'i sdug —192

bsngal las grol ba mi srid/ mi lus lan gcig thob pas phan pa yang min gyis/ nges par 'chi/ myur du 'chi/ nam 'chi cha med 'chi ba la cis kyang mi phan/shi nas khungs med du song na ta kho rang shes te/ da lta'i dgra gnyen longs spyod tshe 'di'i snang ba kun dang bral yang sems khungs med du mi 'gro/ sngar byas kyi sdig pa rnams tshe 'di'i longs spyod bzhin shul tu spangs pa mi 'dod/ las kyi dbang gis rigs drug gang rung du skye ba las 'os med/ gang du skyes kyang sdug bsngal gyi rang bzhin kho na yin / sdug bsngal de yang zad mi shes shing thar bar dka' ba rgya mtsho dang mtshungs pa bzhin 'dug pa las/ nges par thar dgos par 'dug /rang gcig pu thar bas mi phan gyis sems can thams cad thar dgos pa 'dug snyam pa'i 'dun pa mdzod/ /ces brjod/gnyis pa skyabs 'gro dang sems bskyed gnyis kyi skyabs 'gro ni/ sbyongags bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ slob dpon bdag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas dus 'di nas bzung nas/ ji srid snying por byang chub la mchis kyi bar du/rkang gnyis rnams kyi mchog sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /'dod chags dang bral ba rnams kyi mchog zhi ba mya ngan las 'das pa'i chos la skyabs su mchi'o/ /tshogs rnams kyi mchog byang chub sems dpa' phyir mi ldog pa'i 'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /zhes lan gasdo/ma/gnyid pa sems bskyed la gnyis kyi/ smon pa sems bskyed ni/ sbyo1gas rnga5ཿ na bsdos/sa —193

pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ slob dpon bdag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba'i tshe rabs thog ma med pa nas da lta la thug gi bar du sbyin pa'i rang bzhin dang / tshul khrims kyi rang bzhin dang / sgom pa'i rang bzhin gyi dge ba'i rtsa ba des/ ji ltar sngon gyi de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgya bcom ldan 'das rnams dang / sa chen po la rab tu bzhugs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyis ji ltar thugs rin po che skyed par mdzad pa de bzhin du/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas kyang dus 'di nas bzung nas/ snying po byang chub la mchis kyi bar du byang chub kyi mchog tu sems bskyed par bgyid do/ /sems can ma sgral ba rnams bsgral bar bgyi'o/ /ma grol pa rnams dgrol bar bgyi'o/ /dbugs ma dbyungs ba rnams dbugs dbyung bar bgyi'o/ /yongs su mya ngan las ma 'das pa rnams yongs su mya ngan las 'da' bar bgyi'o/ /zhes lan gsum/gnyis pa 'jug pa sems bskyed ni/ dgongs gsol gong bzhin/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas dus 'di nas bzung nas ji srid snying po byang chub la mchis kyi bar du sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la mthar gyis bslabs pa dang / mthar gyis sbyangs pa dang / mthar gyis bsgrubs par bgyi'o/ /de bzhin du tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / bzod pa'i/pha rol tu phyin pa dang / brtson 'grus dang / bsam gtan dang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa rnams la mthar gyis bslabs pa dang / mthar gyi sbyangs pa dang / mthar gyis bsgrub par bgyi'o/ /gsum pa spro ba —194

bskyed pa ni/ sngags kyi dngos grub don gnyer gang / /dkyil 'khor 'dir ni gzhug par bya/ /bsod nams 'dod pas de las gzhan/ /gzhan ni 'jig rten pha rol gnyer/ /dad pa chen po ldan pa dag /'jig rten pha rol la dmigs na/ /dkyil 'khor dam pa gzhug bya ste/ /tshe 'di'i 'bras bu gnyer mi bya/ /bdag don tshe 'dir gnyer byed na/ /gzhan don sangs rgyas ga la byung / /'jig rten pha rol la dmigs na/ /'bad pa med par 'di 'bras 'grub/ /bzhi pa maṇ+ḍal 'bul zhing gsol ba gdab pa ni/ thog mar slob mas maṇ+ḍal phul te/ tshigs lhug pa rgyas bsdus gang yang rung ba zhig gis maṇ+ḍal phul ba'i rjes la/ bska/da pa shin tu legs pa'i maṇ+ḍal mchog /zhesasogasabarjod/ gsol ba gdab pa ni/ dga' chen khyod bdag ston pa ste/ /slob dpon khyod ni dgongs su gsol/ /byang chub chen po'i tshul bstan pa/ /mgon po chen po bdag 'tshal lo/ /dam tshig de nyid bdag la stsol/ /sdom pa rnams kyang bdag la stsol/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ /skyabs gsum dag kyang bdag la stsol/ /thar pa chen po'i grong mchog tu/ /mgon pos bdag ni 'jug par 'tshal zhes lan gsum/lnga pa gnang ba sbyin pa ni/ bu tshur theg pa chen po yi/ khyod ni tshul chen snod yin te/ / gsang sngags spyod tshul cho ga 'di/ khyod la yang dag bstan par bya/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gang 'das dang / /de bzhin gang dag ma byon dang / /da ltar byung ba'i rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /'gro la phan phyir bzhugs pa rnams/ /de dag kun gyis gsang sngags kyi/ /cho ga bzang po 'di mkhyen nas/ /dpa' bo byang chub shing drung du/ /thams cad mkhyen pa tshad med brnyes/ /gsang sngags —195

sbyor ba mnyam med des/ /ye shes mnyam med thob pas na/ /skyob pa sangs rgyas he ru gas/ /bdud ni shin tu mi bzad pa/ /dpung chen dag kyang de yis bcom/ /de bas kun mkhyen thob bya'i phyir/ /bu yis blo gros 'di gyis shig /ces brjod la don bzhad do/ /drug pa rtog pa bsdu ba ni/rtog pa thams cad legs par bsdus nas ni/ snyonan tu bsam pa bzang po'i sems kyis nyon/ /brjed nges blo la he ru ka sogs dang / /bde bar gshegs pa rnams kyis byin mi rlobs//zhes brjod la don zugad do/ /bdun pa yan lag lnga pa bya ba ni/ bdag gi sdig pa bgyis pa dang / /bgyid rtsal rjes su yi rang gang / /sangs rgyas spyan sngar mchis nas su/ /de dag bdag gis bshags par bgyi/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang / /rang rgyal dgra bcom 'gro rnams kyis/ /sgom dang bzlasabarjod bsod nams kyi/ /tshogs la bdag ni yi rang ngo/ /sems bskyed mngon par sangs rgyas nas/ /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba dang / /byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyi mchog /de la bdag ni skyabs su mchi/ /sangs rgyas 'byung ba ji ltar bar/ / skal ldan byang chub sems dpa' yis/ /byang chub tu ni sems bskyed ltar/ /de bzhin bdag ni sems bskyed do/ /bdag gi dge ba'i las rnams 'di dag gis/ /'jig rten 'dir ni myur du sangs rgyas shog /'gro la phan phyir chos ni ston bgyid cing / /sems can sdug bsngal mang po gzir las sgrol/ /zhes lan gsum/brgyad pa sdom pa 'bogs pa ni/ sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' rnams/ /ji tsam dus nas bzung nas su/ /ma lus bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /bdag —196—

ming 'di zhes bgyi ba yis/ /dus 'di nyid nas bzung nas su/ /ji srid byang chub snying po la/ /yongs su gnas pa'i bar dag tu/ /bdag gis byang chub mchog gi sems/ /ma lus par ni skyed par bgyi/ /sangs rgyas rnal 'byor sdom pa la/ /tshul khrims kyi ni bslab pa dang / /dge ba'i chos ni sdud pa dang / /sems can don byed tshul khrims gsum/ /bdag gis brtan por bzung bar bgyi/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ /bla na med pa'i dkon mchog gsum/ /deng nas brtsams te bzung bar bgyi/ nam du yang ni mi spang ngo/ /rdo rje rigs mchog chen po la/ /rdo rje dril bu phyag rgya yang / /yang dag nyid du bzung bar bgyi/ /slob dpon dag kyang bzung bar bgyi/ /rin chen rigs mchog chen po yis/ /dam tshig yid du 'ong ba la/ /nyin re bzhin yang dus drug tu/ /spyin pa rnam bzhi rtag tu spyin/ /byang chub chen po las byung ba'i/ /pad+ma'i rigs chen dag pa la/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i theg pa gsum/ /dam pa'i chos ni ma lus bzung / /las kyi rigs mchog chen po la/ /sdom pa thams cad ldan par ni/ /yang dag nyid du bzung bar bgyi/ /mchod pa'i las kyang ci nus bgyi/ /byang chub sems ni bla na med/ /dam pa bdag gis bskyed bgyis nas/ /sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir/ /bdag gis sdom pa ma lus bzung / /ma grol ba ni dgrol bar bgyi/ /ma bsgral ba ni bsgral bar bgyi/ /dbugs ma phyin pa dbugs dbyung zhid / /sems can mya ngan 'das la 'god/ /ces brjod/dgu pa gzengs /stod cing gsang ba bsgrags pasogs ni/ 'jig rten du ni kun mkhyen —197—

rnams/ /u dam wa ri'i me tog bzhin/ /brgya lam na ni re 'ga' zhig /'byung 'gyur yang ni mi 'byung srid/ /gsang sngags spyod tshul cho ga ni/ / de bas kyang ni dkon pa ste/ /gnyis med zab mo'i spyod yul 'dis/ /sems can thams cad sangs rgyas byed/ /gang gis bskal pa bye ba 〈sna /sdig pa'i las rnams byas pa yang / /zab mo'i dkyil 'khor 'di mthong bas/ /de dag thams cad byang gyur nas/ /grags pa mtha' yas sngags spyod pa'i/ /tshul la gnas na smos ci dgos / /gang gi bskal ba dpag med du/ /bsod nams ye shes tshogs bsags kyang / /'di ni rnyed pa shin tu dka'/ /de bas 'di la dga' bar gyis/ /zhes brjod/de nas gsang ba bsgrags pa ni/ slob ma'i gnas gsum du dri bzang gis thig le byas/dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ snying gar hūṃ/ de rnams kyi 'od kyis lus gang bas/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi dri ma dag par gyur/ snying gar kun rdzob byang chub sems kyi ngo bo/ zla ba'i dkyil 'bor gyi steng du/ don dam byang chub sems kyi ngo bo rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa/ oṃ sarba yo ga tsit+ta u pa ta ya mi/ snying gar rdo rje bzhag la/ oṃ su ra ta sa ma ya stam/ hoḥsirnyi badz+ra ya thā su khaṃ/ zhesabarjod/de nasadam la bzhag pa ni/rdo rje mgo bor gzhag la/ 'di ni dam tshig rdo rje ste/ khyod kyi spyi bor bzhag pa yis/ /sangs rgyas sku ru khyod 'grub cing / /mi byed ye shes thob par 'gyur/ /rdo rje snying gar bas la/rdo rje 'dzin pa deng khyod kyi/ /snying la yang dag zhugs par gyur/ /gal te tshul 'di smra na ni/ /de ma thag tu gral te gshegs/ /bdud rtsi lnga yis chu blud la/ /'di ni khyod kyi dmyal ba'i chu/ /dam tshig 'das —198—

na sreg par byed/ /dam tshig bsrung na dngos grub ni/ /ye shes bdud rtsi'i chu 'dis 'grub/ /oṃ badz+ra sarba pañca amṛ ta u ta ka hūṃ/ yang rdo rje spyi bor bzhag la/deng nas bzung ste bu khyod kyi/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa nga yin gyi/ /nga yi je ltar bka' stsal pa/ /gus pa'i tshul gyis nyan par gyis/ /gal te nga la brnyas na ni/ /sangs rgyas thams cad brnyas pa yin/ /mi bde ma spangs dus byas nas/ /dmyal ba chen por 'gyur ta re/ /bcu pa ye shes dbab par gsol ba gdab pa ni/ de bzhin potanags pa thams cad kyis/ /bdag la byin gyis rlobs mdzod la/ /rdo rje ye shes bla med ni/ /da lta nyid du dbab tu gsol/ /cesapa'am/ bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyi/ /byin gyis brlab pa'i ye shes mchog /sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir/ /gtso bos bdag la 455 du garbedul/ /zhes pa gang rung gis lan gsum gsol ba gdab/ sngon 'gro bcu ni de rnams yin la/ ye shes dbab pa ni/ so so la cung zad mi 'dra ste/ sposadang rol mo'i sgra bya ste/ sgyu lusadabang mo che'i ye shes dbab pa la/slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ mdun bskyed rgyud sde lnga'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams dang / rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma mkha' 'gro sde lnga'i lha tshogs dang bcas pa rnams dang / myur mdzad ye shes kyi mgon po'i lha tshogs rnams dang / bla ma rdo rje he ru ka mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams las de dang 'dra ba'i lha tshogs dpag tu med pa byung khyod rang rnams kyi spyi bo nas zhugs lus gang lus sems bde bas khyab par gyur/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs thams cad dang bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong gi lha tshogs sa gzhi —199

bar snang thams cad khyab pa tsam spyan drangs te khyed rang rnams kyi lus la sib sib thim par mos pa mdzod/ cesabarjod la/ sposaphul/ rol wo dbab/ rgyud sde lnga dang rnal 'byor ma dang / mgon po'i snying po dang / na mo bud+dha ya'i sngagasarnamasakyi mthar/ ā be sha ya a āḥ zhesabatagasal ye shes 'bebs/ tisgo badz+ra sogasani 'di rnamasal mi dgos/ 'di rnams kyisagazhan rnams la'ang rigs 'gre/ bde mchog lha lnga'i dbang bzhi lusabasgres su grags pa ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang dang 'pho ba'i dbang mo che dang / chos dug so so'i sgosabaka' dang / phyag chen bka' lnga/ mkha' spyod bka' lnga/ gzhan yang rgyud sde lnga'i ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang bka' sogs phal che ba zhig la/ sgyu lus dbang mo che 'di kha 'don pa spo bas chog ste/ mdun bskyed gang bskyed ba de dang 'dra ba'i lha tshogs spros nas slob ma'i spyi bor bstim pa dang / phyogs bcu'i sangasargyas byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyang bdun bskyed kyi lha rnams dang rnam pa mthun par spyan drangs te/ lus kyi cha thams cad nas bstim/ mdun bskyed la ji ltar bskyed pa'i lha de'i sngags la a be sha btagasapasa'abebs/ sgyu lus dbang mo che'i dbang chog las ye shes 'bebs pa'i skabs mig dar bcings par gsung na'ang / lag len la mi mdzad do/ /bsdus pa sngon 'gro lnga pa ni/ maṇ+ḍal phul nas/ dga' chen khyod bdag ston pa sogasakyis gsol ba gdab/ dkon mchoge gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ /sogs/rgyun bshags bya/ zla ba rdor sems bskyed pa dang / mna' chu blud pa'i dam bzhag dang / gsol ba btab nas ye shes 'bebs pa rnams yin te/ yig rnying rnamasal dbang bka' thamasacad la sngon 'gro bcu pa 'di byed par gsung pas/ de bzhin lcogs na bzang ba'o/ /dngosagazhi'i cho ga shin tu bsdusapa la sngon 'gro rgyas pa de mi mdzes pas phyag len la bde mchog lha lnga'i dbang rgyas pa dang / sgyu lus dbang mo che la sngon 'gro bcu pa 'di mdzad cing / gzhan rnams la sngon 'gro lnga pa 'di mdzad na/ dgos don 'grub pasashin tu legasaso/ kho bo cag gi bla ma dam pa don la sangasargyas dang gnyisasu med cing / tshul ston du yang —200

rdzogs rim gyi man ngag rtsoms pa la mkhyen pa rgyas pa dang / bye brag tu yang gdams pa 'di'i skor la thos bsam sgom pa'i nyams myong phyag len de rnam pa lnga'i sgo nas rang byan chud pa de nyid kyi phyag len bzhin du bdag gis 'khum pa lags/ gzhan deng sang chos 'di'i skor la mkhas par grags shing mkhas par rlom pa 'ga' la〈snang lag len oṃ so las mi gda'o// //sngon 'gro'i yig chung bsdus pa 'di yang tā ra nā thas smras pa'o/ /sarba maṅga lam/ dge legs 'phel/ 'di bris dge bas lasasgrib dag gyur cig /bkra shisabade legs/ /

zhes bya ba bsdokyigs/a yig chos kyi 'byung gnas pho brang du/ /a dkar zag med bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun gyis/ /a bhi ṣiñcas sems kyi dri ma 'brud/ /a haṃ mi phyed bde stong rdo rje 'chang / /gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs/ /dag byed stong ra'i rnal 'byor bsgoms pa'i mthus/ /'gal rkyen nad gdon sdig sgrub sbyangs pa dang / /mthun rkyen rtags gsum ci rigs shar nas kyang / /ting 'dzin myur du skye bar byin gyis rlobs/ /mi rtog gtum mos rnam rtog bud shing bsregs/ /bde chen gtum mos sdug bsngal tshang tshing 'jom/ /zung 'jug gtum mos ye shes me lce 'bar/ /gtum mo mthar byin mkha' 'gro ni gu ma/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs/ /zas dang gos dang stan gyi rnal 'byor gyi/ /spyod lam kun tu gtum mo 'bral med cing / /srid pa'i dbang thob gegs kun rang sar grol/ /rlung 'byong bde drod 'bar bar byin gyis rlobs/ /snang ba sgyu mar rtogs pa'i chags sdang grol/ /rang sems sgyu mar shar ba'i 'khrul pa dag /gnyis 'dzin sgyu ma shar pa'i 'od gsal shar/ /sgyu ma'i don rtogs khyung po rnal 'byor la/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs/ /yang rab bla ma'i mos gus 'bral med cing / /'bring gis brjod bral bar ma chad du sgoms/ /tha ma'i kun kyang sgyu mar sbyangs nas ni/ /zhen med rang sar grol bar —— —202

byin gyis rlobs/ /rmi lam lta bur chos rnams thugs su chud/ /smi lam nyid kyang bden med sgyu mar gzigs/ /rmi lam sgyu ma'ang 'od gsal gnas gyur te/ /rmi lam mthar phyin mnyam med rmog cog pa/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs/ /'dun pa'i gnad kyis rmi lam bzung nas ni/ /sbyang dang spel dang sprul sgyur sna tshogs kyis/ /yul snang rnam bzhi gtan la phab nas kyang / /gsal stong 'dzin med 'char bar byin gyis rlobs/ /gsal stong zhen med 'od gsal rang gsal gyis/ /zab zhi spros bral 'od gsal mthar sbyang nas/ /bde chen mthar thug 'od gsal mngon gyur te/ /'od gsal dag pa gnyis ldan skyer sgang ba/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs/ /'od gsal zung bzhi lam du khyer ba dang / /bsre 'pho'i gnad dang gegs sel bogs 'don gyis/ /dam tshig ma nyams 'char sgo ngo zin nas/ /'od gsal nyams myong 'byong par byin gyis rlobs/ /chos sku 'pho ba'i sgyu ma lam du khyer/ /zung 'jug 'pho ba'i yi dam lam du khyer/ /byin rlabs 'pho ba'i bla ma lam du khyer/ /'pho ba'i lam la mnga' brnyes gnyan ston pa/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs/ /lam khyer gsum gyis 'pho ba mthar phyin nas/ /'chug med mkha' spyod gnas su 'khrid pa dang / /mthar thug rgyal ba longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku/ /'bad med lhun gyi 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /rmi lam bar dor sprul bsgyur mthar phyin nas/ /skye shi bar dor 'od gsal rgyun chad med/ /srid pa bar do'i rang zhal lhun gyis grub/ /bar dor rang dag sangs rgyas ston pa la/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs/ /'jigs —203

pa'i sgra bzhi ya nga'i g.yang sa sogs/ /bar do'i 'phrang du mchug med thabs kyi gnad/ /lam khyer gsum gyis 'jigs pa rang sar dag /sku gsum mngon du gyur par byin gyis rlobs/ /phyi rol yul rnams snang stong rgyas btab cing / /nang gi sems nyid gsal stong rgya yis btab/ /rang lus lha sku bde stong rgyas btab nas/ /phyag rgya chen po'i don rtogs shangs ston pa/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs/ /sngon 'gro rang babs rnam gsum gnad la dbab/ /dngos gzhi skyon bzhi las grol nyams len gyis/ /mthar thug sku bzhi rang shar lhun gyis grub/ /phyag chen gnas lugs rtogs par byin gyis rlobs/ /snang ba'i rol pa bla ma yin dam lha/ /grag stong brjod bral yan lag drug cu'i gsungs/ /gsal la 'dzin med bde gsal mi rtog thugs/ /lam khyer mthar phyin khyung po tshul khrims mgon /gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs/ /spyod lam kun tu snang ba sna tshogs kun/ /bla ma yi dam sgyu mar lam khyer nas/ /sems nyid 'od gsal 'dzin med gnad kyi ni/ /mtshan rtogs rang sar grol bar byin gyis rlobs/ /mkha' 'gro'i dbang mo bye ba'i zhal gyi gsung / /mkha' 'gro'i dbang phyug mched las legs brgyud nas/ /mkha' 'gro'i gsang tshig ni gu su kha'i chos/ /mkha' 'gros rjes bzung tshad ldan ri khrod pa/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs/ /mkha' spyod dkar dmar bskyed rdzogs zung 'jug ma/ /mkha' spyod ril bu'i sgrub pa mthar phyin nas/ /mkha' spyod 'pho ba'i rig 'dzin nye lam gyis/ /mkha' sbyod zhing du bsgrod par byin gyis rlobs/ /rang lus lha sku snang stong mtha' dang —2slo

bral/ /sems nyid 'dzin med 'od gsal lhun gyis grub/ /'ching bar byed pa rang sang dag pa ste/ /'chi med don rtogs mkhyen ldan shangs dkar ba/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs/ /blos byas rtsol ba'i dri ma kun spangs shing / /tha mal zhen pa'i 'dzin pa rang dag nas/ /snang la rang bzhin med par lha yi sku/ /rang sems 'chi med rtogs par byin gyis rlobs/ /bar do'i srid pa lag mthil spu ji bzhin/ /ma 'dres ye shes spyan gyis legs gzigs nas/ /snying rjes 'gro drug sems can thams cad kyang / /thar pa'i lam du 'khrid mdzad sangs rgyas dpal/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs/ /rnam mang 'gro ba'i skye sgo mtha' yas pa/ /rnam dag ye shes 'khor lo'i legs sbyangs nas/ /rnam par myong ba'i lam sgrib kun bsal te/ /'chug med longs sku thob par byin gyis rlobs/ /ro rkyang nyi zla'i bsgrod pa dhu ti r+yā /yongs su 'jug pa'i btsan thabs sbyor ba yis/ /las rlung rgyu ba'i grong khyer kun bcom nas/ /grub pa'i dbang phyug nam mkha' rgyal mtshan la/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs/ /phyag rgya bcing grol bum pa shing rta can/ /lus sems 'chi med grub pa'i 'khrul 'khor gyis/ /chags can rnal 'byor pho nya'i myur lam las/ /'ja' lus dngos su 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /zhi ba'i dbyings las thugs rje'i khros pa'i gar/ /myur mdzad ye shes mgon po'i skur bzhengs nas/ /bar chad bdud dpung g.yul las legs rgyal ba'i/ /rgya sgom bla ma mgon po dbyer med la/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs/ /las bzhi'i 'phrin las bsgrub pa'i srung ma'i tshogs/ /—205

dus las mi 'da' bran du 'khol nus shing / /srid zhi'i phan bde'i dpal gyi skal bzang rnams/ /re ba ji bzhin 'grub par byin gyis rlobs /dus gsum rgyal ba'i thugs bskyed rmad byung dang / /rgyal sras sems dpa'i rlabs chen mdzad pa dang / /bstan 'dzin skyes bu kun gyi lta spyod la/ /rjes su yi rang mthar phyin grol mchog la/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs/ /thar pa'i lam ston dge ba'i bshes gnyen dang / /thar pa'i lam mchog yang dag dam pa'i chos/ /thar pa'i lam du ches pa'i mched grogs la/ /dag snang phyogs med 'byung par byin gyis rlobs/ /thabs lam gtum mo las rgya zung 'brel zhing / /grol lam gtum mo sgyu lus zung 'jug gi /'phrin las don gnyis phun tshogs lha dbang grags/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs/ /dgyes mdzad gtum mo bde mchog gzhan lus dang / /gsang 'dus sgyu lus mā ya 'od gsal sogs/ /'jigs mdzad 'phrin las rnam bzhi'i don 'grub par/ /rnam lnga'i brgyud don rtogs par byin gyis rlobs/ /dri mdzad gzhan don bsngo ba'i rgyas 'debs shing / /smon lam dbang gis sngags lam bkra shis chos/ /bka' rgya grol bar ston mdzad sgrol ba'i mgon/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs/ /rin chen sgrom bu lta bur dmigs pa'i gnad/ /zab don 'phrul gyis gnad don kun shes sheng / /rig sngags 'bros pa'i dbang mo dpag yas kyi/ khams gyi dbang bsgyur stsol bar byin gyis rlobs/ /gzhi'i gnas lugs sku gsum rang shar gyis/ /lam gyi 'khrul pa glo bur sgrib sbyangs nas/ /'bras bu dag pa gnyis —206

ldan kun dga'i mtshan/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs/ /thabs mkhas gzhan gyi don la ma rmongs zhing / /gang du sprul pa phyogs bcur 'gyed nus pa'i/ /bsam pa'i don rnams yid bzhin kun 'grub pa/ /smon lam yid bzhin 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /'brul med lam gyi yon tan kun rdzogs shing / /'khrul pa'i snang brnyan dge legs dpal gyur pa'i/ /dge legs kun 'byung rnal 'byor byams pa la/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs/ /'khor 'das kun gyi bkra shis dge legs rnams/ /bkra shis dpal yon bzang po'i phun tshogs kyis/ /dpal ldan shangs pa bka' brgyud phyogs kun tu/ /dar zhing rgyas la yun gnas byin gyi rlobs/ /mdo sngags rgyud sde kun gyi gsang ba'i mdzod/ /ma lus thugs su chud cing dpal shangs pa'i/ /bstan pa'i srog shing byams pa yon tan mgon/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs/ /tshe gcig sangs rgyas sgrod pa'i thegs pa'i mchog /lam du sgoms pas bar chad kun zhi zhing / /mthar thug sku bzhi'i ye shes mngon du gyur/ /'bad med myur du rtogs par byin gyis rlobs/ /skyes kun smon lam bzang po'i rgyud sde'i bcud/ /nges gsang mkha' 'gro'i bka' babs man ngag 95/ /blo gros yangs pa kun dga' lhun grub la/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs/ /chos bdag mkha' 'gro'i bka' rgya nyams med chos/ /byin rlabs chu bo'i bka' rgyun mi nyams shing / /grub thob brgyud pa'i zam pa ma chad par/ /nyams dang rtogs pa 'char bar byin gyis rlobs// //zhes pa 'di ni tā ra nā thas smras pa'o/ / —207

/ 'di'i kha skong rje tshul khrimasakyis mdzad pa ni/ sngon gom smon lam bzang po'i legs byas kyis/ /nyer grangs mkha' 'gro'i snyan rgyud bdud rtsi'i bcud/khyod thugs rin chen bum bzang chud sor ldems/ /chos drug mthar phyin ngag dbang blo gros la/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs /sgrib gnyis bag chags 'thug po'i non pa'i dri/ /chos drug chab kyis lhag med 'khrud pa dang / /'gro ba'i nad gso sbas pa'i rnal 'byor gyis/ /rang gzhan smin zhing grol bar byin gyis rlobs/ khyod gsung thugs kyi nying khu 'dzin pa la/ /mkhyen rab thugs rjes nam yang mi dor zhing / /sangs rgyas kun las lhag pa'i brtse ba can/ /rdo rje 'chang chen ngag dbang 'jam dbyangs la/ /gsolab 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs/ /rnam kun rtsa rgyud bla ma'i rnam thar la/ /mi phyed dad pa'i rjes 'jug snying khong nas/ /rtse gcig gus pa'i gsol ba btab pa'i mthus/ /zab lam mthar phyin mkha' spyod bsgrod par shog /bka' drin 'khor med rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang / /bcu gsum snying po'i don rtsol sgrol ba'i mgon/ /snyigs ma'i dus 'dir 'dren mchog chos kyi rje/ /kirti dharma warti'i mtshan can la/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs/ khyed kyi zab gsung chos drug bdud rtsi'i ro/ /bdag blo ma dag 'dzin rtog kun bkrus te/ /'khor ba gnas 'gyur ye shes mngon mthong ba'i/ /he ru ka nyid thob par byin gyis rlobs// //zhes so/ /bkra shis/ /ci 208

zhes dra/ ba bsdokyib/rba /na motho gu jag sgyu lus dbang mo che bskur ba 'dod pa'i go skabasayangasapar stegs bu'i steng du rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum gang rung zhig 'bri'o/ /de la rgyas pa ni/ phyi nas rim pas mu khyud dkar po dang dmar po dang sngon po gsum gyis bskor ba'i zlum po 'khor yug chen po ste/de yang phyi dpal ldan 'bras spungs kyi mchod rten dang / de'i nang du me ri/ de'i nang rdo rje'i ra ba rnams yod pa mtshon pa yin la/ sku gsung thugs gsum mtshon pa'ang yin no/ /de'i nang du gzhal med khang gru bzhi spyi dang mthun pa/ rtsigs pa'i nang dbusal thugs kyi bar dang / phyi'i khyamasaganyisakar shar dkar/lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang / phyogs mdog yin la/ gzhal yas khang gi nang du tshangs thig gis bcad pa'i re mig bzhi po la/ zlum skor re bya ste/ de yang shar lho'i zlumasar la chos 'byung nyisabartsegs dkar po/ bcad mthing nag /rtsibs mchan dmar po/ dbus su nyi gdan lnga tshoms la/ tshoms bu mthing kha re re bkod/ lho nub kyi grar pad+ma 'dab bzhi'i phyogs mdog /lte bar nyi gdan la tshom bu sngon po/ byang shar gyi grwar chos 'byung dmar po bcad ljang khu gru chad dkar po nub byang gi grwar chos 'byung nag po/ me ri dmar po/ gru chad ljang khu/ zlum bskor bzhi/ bcad kyi mu khyud nag po/ chosa'abyung dmar po'i dbusasu/ nyi gdan lnga tshoms la/ dbus dkar shar nag /lto ser nub dmar byang ljang ba'i tshoms bu dang / chos 'byung nag po'i dbus su nyi gdan la tshoms bu nag po/ gzhal yas khang gi dbus rang du nyi gdan la rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa gcig bri/ 'di bshad tshod la med na'ang bla ma'i phyag len la mdzad do/ /'bring po ni/ 'dod snam pha gu drwa phyed shar bu mda' yab rnams dor te/ rtsigs pa ljang khu/ sgo khyud/ sgo 'gram/ sgo logs/ sgo —209

steng spru/ gdung dang bcasapa zhig bya/ gzhan snga ma dang 'dra/ bsdusapa ni/ rtsigs pa phan chad mi 'bri bar/maṇ+ḍal gru bzhi phyogs kyi mdog can la zlum skor bzhi po gong bzhin 'bri/ phyi'i mu khyud gru bzhir re kha dkar po 'bri'o/ /stegs bu de'i mdun du zlum gtor me sasabargyan pa gnyis/ go skabasaci bder/ chu gnyisasngon du 'gro ba'i mchod pa rnams dang / 'og tu dgosapa'i dbang rdzas dang tshogs kyi yo byad sogs bzhag go/bum pa ni lho nub kyi grwa'i pad+ma 'dab bzhi'i dkyil 'khor der 'jog pa dbang chog las gsungs pa ltar dkyil 'khor rgya khyon chen po yod na/ der mañja'i steng du bzhag rgyu yin na'ang / phyag len la ni/ dkyil 'khor che na zlum skor bzhi tshom gyi dbusasu mañju la 'jog kyin 'dug /dkyil 'khor chung ngu la bum pa logs su bshams pa legs/ bum pa ni mgul chings kha rgyan dang bcas pa sogs bshams lugs spyi dang 'dra ba las/ dung chos gzungs thag sogs mi dgos so/ /'di nyid kyi dbang chog las pad+ma 'dab bzhi'i dkyil 'khor la tshom bu lnga 'god pa ltar gsungs shing / der lha mi bskyed kyang bum pa'i gdan yin pas bum nang gi lha rnams nyid mtshon pa 'dra ba dang / chos 'byung dmar po'i steng du bde mchog lha lnga bskyed pa ltar gsungs shing deng sang yang phal cher yi ge nag 'ded ltar byed la/ lhan thabs kyi yi ge 'ga' re na yang / de dang 'dra min tsam bshad kyang / bla ma'i zhal nas de rnams man ngag gab pa yin zhing / khyad par lhan thabs kyi yi ge na/ pad+ma 'dab bzhi'i dbusasu rtsa ba'i bla ma/ mdun du yi dam/g.yas su 'das pa'i bla ma zhes sogs 'chad pa ni/ shin tu ma dag gsungs/ desan rang lugasazhal bzhesaphyag len ni/ chosa'abyung nyisabartsegs dang bum pa'i nang du rgyud sde lnga'i gtso bsdus/ pad+ma 'dab bzhi la/ bla ma rdo rje 'chang la mkha' 'gro sde lnga'i bskor ba'am/ bla ma'i ngo bo bde mchog lha lnga/ chosa'abyung dmar po'i nang du rdo rje phag mo lha lnga bsgom pa yin no/ /de ltar na sngon 'gro gtor ma mkha' 'gro spyi gtor bzhin tu btang / gnas dang mchod pa byin rlabs kyang bde mchog lha lnga dang 'dra ste/ spyi dang mthun skyabs 'gro nas brtsams te/ slar yang rang nyid he ru ka yab yum kyi nga rgyal la gnas gsum byin —210

brlabs kyi bar rgyud sde lnga'i sgrub thabs bsdus pa nag bshad pa bzhin/ bdag bskyes bzlaba'ipa dang bcas pa bya/ de nas mdun bskyed/ a mṛ tas bsangs/ swā bha was sbyangs/ —1nga pa'i ngang las dur khrod chen po'i dbus su phyi dpal ldan 'bras sbungs kyi mchod rten/ nang bsrung 'khor rdo rje'i sa gzhi rwa gur me dpung dang bcas pa'i gzhal med khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs bzhis brgyan pa 'dod snam dang pha gu dang drwa phyed dang mda' yab la sogs pa mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa/ nang phyogs kyi mdog can du gyur ba'i dkyil 'khor dang po'i nang du chos 'byung gru gsum nyis brtsegs kyi dbus dang / mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i bum pa'i nang du sna tshogs pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan lnga tshoms su gnas pa'i dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du bcom ldan 'das dpal he ru ka 'khor lo bde mchog sku mdog mthing kha in+d+ra ni la ltar rab tu 'bar ba'i 'od zer 'phro ba zhal gcig phyag gnyis dmar la zlum pa'i spyan g.yo ba 'phro zhing sgeg pa la chags pa'i nyams can mche ba'i myu gu cung zad gtsigs pa bzhin shin tu 'gyur pas khro gnyer can bung ba ltar gnag pa'i dbu skra ral pa'i thor tshugs spyi bor bcings pa'i rtse mor rus pa'i 'bor lo la gnas pa'i nor bu dang ral pa'i ngos la sna tshogs rdo rje dang / g.yon ngos su zla ba phyed pa'i brgyan pa mi rus kyi rna cha dang /mgul rgyan dang gdub bu'i tshogs dang / ska rags dang mchod phyir thog gis brgyan pa thal ba chen po'i nye bar byugs shing mi mgo sgom po lnga'i dbu rgyan/dpa' bo'i dar dpyang dang bcas pa mi'i rgyu ma la rgyus pa'i khrag 'dzag mgo bo lnga bcu'i do shal can/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs bkrol ba/ phyag g.yas —211—

rdo rje dang g.yon dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa zhabs g.yon bskum pas 'jigs byed nag po dang / g.yas brkyang bas dus mtshan dmar mo mnan pa/gar gyi nyams dgu dang ldan zhing mtshan dang dpe byad yongs su rdzogs pa'o/ /de la 'byud pa'i yum rdo rje phag mo sku mdog dmar mo bskal ba'i me ltar gzi brjid 'bar ba phyag g.yas rdo rje gri gug dang bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub kyis phyogs thams cad gnon zhing / g.yon thod pa khrag gis bkang ba 'dzin pas yab la 'byud pa gcer bu skra grol zhing phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ thod skam gyi dbu rgyan dang do shal can zhabs g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang pa'i yab la 'khyud cing yab yum gnyis ka yang lang tsho gsar du brdo ba me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ shar du gsang ba 'dus pa sku mdog sngon po yid tsam khro ba rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas rang mtshungs kyis yum la 'byud pa rdo rje skyil krung gis pad nyi la bzhugs shing dar dang rin po che'i brgyan pa'o/ /lhor dgyes mdzad rdo rje mthing kha phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas/ yum bdag med ma sngon mo gri thod 'dzin pa la 'byud pa skra ser po gyen du brdze ba g.yas brkyang gis pad nyi la tshangs pa dang drag po mnan pa'o/ /nub tu mahā mā ya mthing kha phyag gnyis kyis mda' gzhu 'dzin pas yum sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro ma dmar mo rang dang mtshungs pa la 'khyud pa skra ser brdzes pa g.yas brkyang gi pad nyi la mi ro mnan pa'o/ /byang du rdo rje 'jigs byed mthing nag ma he'i zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis gri gug thod khrag 'dzin pas yum phag mo dmar mo gri thod 'dzin pa la 'byud pa skra ser gyen du brdzes shing dur khrod kyi chas rdzogs pa —212

g.yon brkyang gis pad nyi la ma he mnan pa'o/ /yang dbang chogagi dpe mang po las/shar du dgyesamadzad/ stor gsang 'dusabashad pa ltar byasakyang rung ste 'dam kha'o/ /dkyil 'khor gnyis pa'i dbus su pad+ma'i lte ba la rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje 'chang gsang ba 'dus pa dang mtshungs pa las yum rdo rje phag mo dmar mo 'byud pa/ 'dab ma bzhi la/shar du mkha' 'gro ma nag mo/ byang du lā ma ljang khu/ nub tu dum skyes ma dmar mo/ lhor gzugs can ma ser mo rnams gri gug dang thod pa kha ṭaṃ ga 'dzin pa g.yas brkyang gi stabs kyi bzhugs pa'o/ /dkyil 'khor gsum pa chos 'byung dmar po'i dbus su rdo rje phag mo'i ngo bo sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro ma dmar mo/shar du rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma sngon mo/ lhor rin chen mkha' 'gro ma ser mo/ nub tu pad+ma mkha' 'gro ma dkar mo/ byang du las kyi mkha' 'gro ma ljang mo rnams ḍā ma ru dang thod pa kha ṭ+wāṃ ga 'dzin pa/ gcer bu phyag rgya lnga dang mi mgo'i 'phreng bas brgyan pa/ rang mtshungs kyi 'khor dpag tu med pa dang bcas pa'o/ /dkyil 'khor bzhi pa'i dbus su myur mdzad ye shes mgon po zhal gcig phyag drug pa sku mdog nag po phyag g.yas rnams na thod skam gyi 'phreng ba dang / gri gug dang ḍā ma ru dang / g.yon rnams na thod khrag dang rtse gsum dang zhags pa bsnams pa/ dgra bgegs dang yi dwags kyi gdan la bzhugs pa/ gtsang rigs kyis mgon po bdun cu rtsa lnga sogs dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs kyis bskor ba'o/ /rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ ye shes sems dpa'i tshogs thams cad badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhesaspyan drangasardoladrilagayab mo dang /sposadang rol mo sgra r+pā po dang casate/ oṃ hri hā hā hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ badz+ra samā dzaḥ zhesalanagasum/de bzhi du sbyar —213

tsho te mabadz+ra'iro tsa na ye hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ a a badz+ra sgriska hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ skyetshe badz+ra bshamā dzaḥ skyed a hri hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ skye( badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ tso( de wa pi tsu badz+ra hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ o hrīḥdhīḥwi kṛ tā na na hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ i oṃ oṃ sarba bud+dha ḍa ki nī ye/ badz+ra war+ṇa ni ye badz+ra be+e ro tsa ni ye haṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa swāhā/ badz+ra sa 'amā dzaḥ skyetshe badz+ra mahā' ka la k+ṣiṃ k+ṣe dra bisnan bi rno ya ka hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ khyad par mgon po la/k+ṣiḥ mang du brjod pasaspyan drangasaso/ /de nas dzaḥ& baṃ hoḥ lan mang du brjod/ gnyis su med par thim/ lha thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs gar hūṃ sngon po/ yang snying kha'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros/ dbang gi lha sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' khro bo'i dbang po btsun mor bcas pa thams cad spyan drangs/ phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa thams cad kyis mchod par gyur/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣiñca tu paṃ/ gtso bo'i thugs ka nas yum lnga bdud rtsi'i bum pa thogs pa spros/ oṃ badz+ra bha wa a bhi ṣiñca hūṃ/ zhes gsungs shing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang dri ma dag /chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las/ rgyud sde lnga'i gtso bo rnams dang / bla ma dang nag po chen po la mi bskyod pas dbu rgyan/mkha' 'gro lnga po rnams la rigs lnga so so'i dbu brgyan par gyur/ de nasaphyi mchod nang mchod gsang mchod rnams bde mchog lha lnga'i dkyil chog ltar phul/ bstod pa ni/chor+sha5 dbyings rnam dag dbyings las ma g.yos kyang / /thabs kyi khro bo'i skur bstan gdug pa 'dul/ /che ba'i che mchog lha yi lhar gyur pa/ /kun bzang he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo/ /he ru ka dpal dpa' bo che/ /rnam dag rdo rje dbang phyug dang / /rjes —214

chags chags pa che rnams kyis/ /rdo rje phag mo la 'dud do/ /thams cad dngos po rang bzhin mchog /gdod nas thams cad bdag nyid gnas/ /thabs dang shes rab gnyis med pa'i/ /dgyes mdzad rdo rje la phyag 'tshal/ /mi bskyod rdo rje ye shes che/ /rdo rje dbyings ni mkhas pa che/ /rdo rje gsum mchog dkyil 'khor gsum/ /gsang ba'i dbyings la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro dang / /mkha' 'gro ma yi 'khor lo bsgyur/ /ye shes lnga dang sku gsum nyid/ /'gro ba skyobs la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /dur khrod rgyan gyi legs brgyan pa'i/ /zhe sdang gshin rje gshed po ni/ /dngos med nam mkha' lta bu la/ /thugs rjes sprul pa'i skur ston pa/ /ye shes khro rgyal rab 'jigs pa/ /dud kha mun chen khyod la 'dud/ /chos dbyings ngang las ma g.yos kyang / /gdug pa 'dul phyir khros pa'i sku/ /bstan pa'i ru ṭa 'joms mdzad pa/ /nag po che la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /ces sogs kyi bstod/gtor ma ni/ bdag skyed bzhin bsang sbyangs byin gyis rlabs/rgyud sde lnga dang /rdo rje phag mo dang /mgon po'i snying po rnams kyi mthar/ a kā 1du/ btagasapa lan gsum gsum dang / mgon po la/shā sa na lan gsum gyis kyang phul la/ slar yang arnya nas shap+ta'i bar gyis mchod/ sangs rgyas kun gyi sku gsung thugs/ /yon tan 'phrin las rab rdzogs pa/ /dkyil 'bor lnga po thams cad la/ /kun nas dang bas phyag 'tshal lo/ /hūṃ myur mdzad spyan ras gzigs la phyag 'tshal mtho/ /zhabs gdub dang bcas bi nā ya ka mnan/ /nag po chen po stag gi sham thabs can/ /phyag drug sprul gyi rgyan gyis rnam par brgyan/ /g.yas pa gri gug bar pa phreng ba 'dzin/ /tha mas ḍa ma ru ni drag tu —215

'brol/ /g.yon pas thod khrag dang ni mdung rtse gsum/ /de bzhin zhags pa bzung nas 'ching bar byed/ /drag po'i zhal gdangs mche ba rnam par gtsigs/spyan gsum drag po dbu skra gyen du 'bar/ /dpral bar sirgyu ra yis thig le byugs/ /spyi bor mi bskyod rgyal pos rgyas btab brtan/ khrag 'dzag mi mgo lnga bcu'i do shal can/ /rin chen thod skam lnga yis dbu la brgyan/ mang las byon nas gtor ma len mdzad pa'i/ /dpal ldan phyag drug pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mchod spyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /nas/cayid la 'dod pa kun 'grub 31ga /gi bar 'phrin lasabacol/ mdun bskyed dang bum pa la dmigasanas bzlasapa ci 'grub bya/'og nas 'byung ba'i dbang gi dngos gzhi rnamasadamigasapas bdag 'jug gi tshul du blangs/ tshogs 'khor byin gyis rlabs pa yang / skabs 'dir byas na legs te slob dpon gyi bya ba'o/ /de nas slob ma rnams nang du 'dusapa la/ thog mar bgegasagator spyi dang 'dra bar btang la bgegs bskrad/ lag len bsdus pa'i skabs/ sngar gyi sngon 'gro'i gtor ma la 'di'i don tshang pas/bgegs gtor ma btang kyang rung ngo / /de nasasems bskyed gsol ba 'debasapa sogasachos dang lo rgyus cung zad bshad/ 'gro mgon sangasargyas ston pas mdzad pa'i sngon 'gro rgyasapa'o/ /mdo tsam logasasu 'bri ba ltar sngon 'gro ༄ po rnamasabya/ de rjes/ da lan gyi skabs 'dir dngos gzhi la btags pa brda' yi dbang bzhi/ thob pa don gyi dbang bzhi/ mthar thug gsang ba'i dbang bzhi ste/ ting nge 'dzin gyi mchod dbang bzhi gsum bcu gnyis yod pa las/ thog mar btags pa brda'i dbang bzhi'i don du maṇ+ḍal 'bul bar zhu/zhesapasabaskul/ slob masamaṇ+ḍal phul/ de ltar maṇ+ḍal phul nas gsol ba gdabs pa 'di'i rjes bzlos mdzod/ byang chub rdo rje sangs rgyas la/ /mchod wo ji ltar —216

stsal ba ltar/ /bdag kyang skyabs pa'i don gyi phyir/ /nam mkha'i rdo rje deng bdag stsol/ /lan gsum gyi gsol ba btabs/mdun bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor la slob ma'i ngor gong bzhin gsal btab/mdun du bzhugs pa'i/ sku gsang ba 'dus pa/ gsung mahā mā ya/ thugs dgyes mdzad rdo rje/ yon to 'bor lo sdom pa/ 'phrin las rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi lha tshogs rnams dang / rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma mkha' 'gro sde lnga/myur mdzad dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang bcas pas dbang bskur ba'i dgongs pa mdzad/ phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba thams cad kyis shis pa brjod/ rdo rje phag mo dang / mkha' 'gro ma la sogs pas phyag na bum pa thog nas dbang bskur bas lus kyi sdig sgrib dag pa'i mos pa mdzod/ hūṃ/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni/ /lha rnams gyis ni khrus gsol ltar / /lha yi chu ni dag pa yis/ /de bzhin bdag gis sku khrus gsol/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā la sha a bhi ṣiñci me/ bum pa'i chu rgyun gyis spyi bo'i 'khor lor sleb/ des bum pa'i dbang bskur ba thob pas/ lus kyis dri ma dag /'bras bu sprul sku thob pa'i skal pa can du byas/phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas sras dang bcas pa yab yum thams cad bde ba'i ngo bor zhu/ dkyil 'khor gyis gtso bo rnams kyi zhal du zhugs/ sku'i cha thams cad rgyud/ rdo rje'i lam nas shes rab kyi gsang ba'i mtsho skyes su byon pa'i byang chub kyi sems lce thog tu bzhag par gyur/ nang mchod la bum chu cung zad bsres te/ hūṃ phyogs dus sangs rgyas thams cad kyis/ /gsang gsum gnas las byung ba yis/ khams gsum kun gyis phyag byas pas/ /rdo rje'i dbang bskur sbyin par bya/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta gu h+ye a sbyi ṣañci me/ zhesabadud rtsi sbyin/bum chu dang bdud —217—

rtsi'i rgyun gyis mgrin par slebs/ des gsang dbang thob/ ngag gi dri ma dag /longs sku thob pa'i skal ba dang ldan par byas/ yang bum chu spyi boragator la/khyed rang rnams lha sku yab yum zhal sbyor gyis rnam par gnas pa la thugs rgyud bde ba chen po'i yongs su gang bar gyur/ bum chu'i rgyun dang bdud rtsi snying gar slebs pas/ dbang gsum pa'i ye shes skyes par mos pa mdzod/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pra dz+nya dz+nyā na a bhi ṣiñca mi/ des shes rab ye shes kyi dbang bskur ba thob pas yid kyi dri ma dag /'bras bu chos sku thob pa'i skal ba can du byas/ yang bum chu gtor/bum chu dang bdud rtsi'i rgyun lte bar slebs/ lus thams cad gang / gzung 'dzin gyi rtog pa dbyings su dag par mos la/ cu'i zad mnyapa par bzhug par mdzod/oṃ sarba ta thā ga tā tsa /the a bhi ṣiñca me/ de'i dbang bzhi pa thob pas lus ngag yid gsum gyi dri ma bag chags dang bcas pa thams cad dag /ngo bo nyid sku thob pa'i skal ba can du byas/ des btags pa brda' yi dbang bzhi song /gnyis pa thob pa don gyis dbang bzhi'i don du maṇ+ḍal phul/ cesabaskul/slob masamaṇ+ḍal phul/ 'di la dbang gdams ngag dang 'brel ba dang / gdams ngag dbang dang ma 'brel ba gnyis las/ dang po ni/ khyed rang rnams kyis lus dang longs spyod phyi nang gsang gsum gyi mchod pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa sprul te/ bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong rnams la phul bar mos te/ 'di'i rjes bzlos mdzod/ rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyis bdag la yang dag par sgyu lus kyi dbang bskur du gsol/ yi dam dkyil 'khor gyis lha tshogs rnams kyi bdag la yang dag par sgyu lus kyi dbang bskur —218—

du gsol/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro chos skyongs ba'i srung ma rnams kyis bdag 'ju/ yang dag par/ sgyu lus kyi dbang bskur du gsol zhu ba dang / nyams su len /la bar chad thams cad bsrung bar mdzad du gsol/ zhesapa lan gsum/ de nas /khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bor oṃ dkar po de las 'od zer dkar po 'phros/ sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi sku'i byin rlabs thams cad skye( dkar po'i rnam par bsdus/ spyi bo'i oṃ la thim/ oṃ de nyid 'od zer dkar por ldem ldem zhu ste/ spyi bo nas zhugs/ lte bar byon pas de nyid thig le dkar po gcig tu gyur/ de'i 'od kyis lus gang bas khyed rang rnams kyi lus kyang 'od dkar po'i ngo bor ldem ldem 'dug /nyon mongs pa gti mug sangs kyis dag par mos/ de'i rigs 'gresate/ khyed rang rnams kyi mgrin par āḥdamar po de las 'od zer dmar po 'phros/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis gsung gi byin rlabs thams cad āḥdamar po'i rnam par bsdus/ mgrin pa'i āḥl thim/ āḥde nyid 'od zer dmar por ldem ldem zhu ste/ mgrin pa nas zhugs/ lte bar byon pas de nyid thig le dmar po gcig tu gyur/ de'i 'od kyis lus gang bas khyed rang rnams kyi lus kyang 'od dmar po'i ngo bor ldem ldem 'dug /nyon mongs pa 'dod chags sangs kyis dag par mos/ khyed rang rnams kyi snying gar hūṃ sngon po de las 'od zer sngon po 'phros/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi thugs kyi byin rlabs thams cad hūṃ sngon po'i rnam par bsdus/ thugs ga'i hūṃ la thim/ hūṃ de nyid 'od zer sngon por ldem ldem zhu ste/ thugs ka nas zhugs/ lte bar byon pas de nyid thig le sngon po gcig tu —219

song / de'i 'od kyis lus gang bas/ khyed rang rnams kyi lus kyang 'od sngon po'i ngo bor ldem ldem 'dug /nyon mongs pa zhe sdang sangs rgyas dag par mos/ khyed rang rnams kyi lte bar traṃ ser po de las 'od zer ser po 'phros/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi yon tan gyi byin rlabs thams cad traṃ ser po'i rnam par bsdus/ lte ba'i traṃ la thim/ traṃ de nyid 'od zer ser por ldem ldem zhu ste/ spyi bo nas zhugs/ lte bar byon pas de nyid thig le ser po gcig tu song / de'i 'od kyis lus gang bas/ khyed rang rnams kyi lus kyang 'od ser po'i ngo bor ldem ldem 'dug /nyon mongs pa nga rgyal dang ser sna sangs kyis dag par mos/ zhes sogasa'adon pa spos/ khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bor a ljang khu de las 'od zer ljang khu 'phros/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi 'phrin las thams cad a ljang khu'i rnam par bsdus/ spyi bo'i a la thim sa de nyid 'od zer ljang khur ldem ldem zhu ste/ spyi bo nas zhugs/ lte bar byon pas de nyid thig le ljang khu gcig tu song / de'i 'od kyis lus gang bas/ khyed rang rnams kyi lus kyang 'od ljang khu'i ngo bor ldem ldem 'dug nyon mongs pa phrag dog sangs kyis dag pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de ltar na khyed rang rnams kyi sems nyid dwangs ma ye shes lnga ldan/ bde mchog lhan cig skyes pa'i skur gsal seng nger gyur pa la mnyam par bzhag mdzod/gnyis pa ni/ dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su rin po che'i khri yangs shing rgya che ba'i gdan la bla ma rdo rje 'chang chen la yum rdo rje phag mos 'khyud pa/ 'khor mkha' 'gro ma bzhis bsgor ba la/ mos gus kyi gdung shugs drag po dang bcas te/—220—

khyed rang rnams kyi lus dang longs spyod dus gsum gyi dge ba'i dngos po dang bcas pa thams cad blos ling gis phul nas 'di'i rjes bzlos mdzod/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bo bla ma rin po ches sems can thams cad kyi don du/ bdag la bum pa'i dbang bskur du gsol/ lan gsum/bla ma'i sku'i smin mtshams nas 'od zer dkar po byung / khyed rang rnams kyi smin phrag tu thim/ lus kyi sdig sgrib dag khyed rang rnams kyi lus lha sku gsal stong 'ja' tshon lta bur gyur pa la mnyam par zhog mdzod/ yang gsang ba'i dbang gi don du 'di'i rjes bzlos mdzod/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bo bla ma rin po ches/ sems can thams cad kyi don du bdag la gsang ba'i dbang bskur du gsol/ lan gsum/ bla ma yab yum gyi gsang ba'i sbyor mtshams nas/ byang chub sems kyi ngo bo 'od zer dkar dmar 'dres pa byung /khyed rang rnams kyi lce la thim pas/ ngag gis dri ma dag /lha sku snga ma las kyang ches gsal bar gyur pa la mnyam par zhog mdzod/ yang shes rab kyi dbang gi don du 'di'i rjes bzlos mdzod/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bo bla ma rin po ches sems can thams cad kyi don du/ bdag la shes rab ye shes kyi dbang bskur du gsol/ lan gsum/ bla ma'i thugs ka nas 'od zer kha dog sna lnga byung / khyed rang rnams kyi snying gar thim pas/ yid kyi sdig sgrib dag nas/ lha sku gsal ba rab kyi mthar thug par gyur pa la mnyam par zhog mdzod/ ces brjod/ dbang de gsum re re'i mthar lha sku la cung zad semasa'adzin du 'jug /yang dbang bzhi pa'i don du 'di'i rjes bzlos mdzod/ dus gsum sangs rgyas —221—

thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bo bla ma rin po ches sems can thams cad kyi don du/bdag la bzhi pa'i dbang bskur du gsol/ lan gsum/ khyed rang rnams kyi lus sems khong klod la gshis cir yang ma grub cing gdangs gang du yang 'gag pa med pa/ thol skyes rang byung gi shes pa so ma 'di la bzo bcos med par lhan ne mnyam par zhog cig /cesabarjod la cung zad bsgom du gzhug go/de ni sems spros med lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes bya ba/ dbang bzhi pa'i ye shes lags so/ /des thob pa don gyi dbang bzhi song / gsum pa mthar thug gsang ba'i dbang bzhi zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal phul/ zhes bskul la slob mas maṇ+ḍal phul/de nas mthar thug gsang ba'i dbang bzhi 'di gsum ste/ stong pa'i gzhi 'cha' ba dang / rtsa lam sbyang ba dang / dag pa'i lha skur bsgom pa'o/ /dang po ni/ khyed rang lha skur gsal ba'i lus kyi dbus su rtsa dbu ma kha dog dkar ba/ yar rtse tshangs bug dang / mar rtse gsang gnas su zug pa zhig gsal btab/ dbu ma de'i nang snying ga'i thad du a dkar po dwangs gsal 'od kyi rang bzhin can gsal btab/ ngag tu/ a zhes lan mang du brjod cig byas la/ brjod du gzhug /a las 'od zer 'phros/ thog mar dbu ma dang / de nas rang lus gang / mthar rang gzhan snod bcud thams cad a yig gi 'od kyis khyab pas/ thams cad 'od du ldem ldem 'dug pa la/ cung zad sems gtad pas/ de rnams kyang nam mkha' la 'ja' yal ba bzhin du gyur pa'i ngang du cung zad mnyam par zhog mdzod/ gnyisapa rtsa lam sbyangs ba ni/ yang khyed rang rnams lha skur gsal ba'i lus kyi dbus su/ rtsa dbu ma kha dog dkar po yar rtse tshangs bug dang / mar rtse gsang gnas su zug pa zhig gsal btab/—222

dbuma'iwangaspyibo'ithad du haṃ dkar po mgo bo thur du blta ba/ mgrin pa'i thad du ā 0dmar po mgo bo gyen du blta ba/ snying ga'i thad du hūṃ mthing nag mgo bo thur du blta ba/ lte ba'i thad du e dmar ser mgo bo gyen du blta ba/ spyi bo'i haṃ las 'od zer gsal seng gis byung / mgrin pa'i āḥl phog de las 'od zer gsal seng gis byung / snying ga'i hūṃ la phog /de las 'od zer gsal seng gis byung / lte ba'i e la phog /lus sems thams cad bde cham cham song /yang 'od zer yar log ste sngar gyi rim pas lugs bzlog tu song ste/ spyi bo'i haṃ gi bar du gsos/ de ltar yas rim dang mas rim du 'phros pa'i 'od zer de rnams kyi rtsa gnas thams cad gang / 'khor lo bzhi la sogs pa'i rtsa mdud thams cad grol/ rtsa nang thams cad 'od zer gyis gang ba'i rkyen gyis rtsa rnams kyang 'ja' 'od du ldem ldem 'dug par bsam mo/ /gsum pa lha skur bsgom pa ni/ yang khyed rang rnams bde mchog lhan cig skyes pa'i sku 'ja' tshon lta bur gsal ba'i rdo rje nor bu'i nang du hūṃ sngon po mgo bo gyen du bstan pa/ hūṃ gi rtse mo la thig le dmar po sran ma tsam gyis mtshan pa/spyi bor haṃ dkar po mgo bo thur du bstan pa haṃ gi rtse mo la thig le dkar po sran ma tsam gyis mtshan pa/ de nas 'og rlung cung zad 'then pa'i rkyen gyis hūṃ de yar yong bas gsang ba'i dbang po phyi nang bzlog pa bzhin tu/ hūṃ gis 'khrid nas yar byung ste/ hūṃ snying gar slebs nyon mongs pa 'dod chags dag /steng rlung cung zad mnan pas spyi bo'i haṃ snying gar slebs/ nyon mongs pa gti mug dag gnyis po snying gar 'dzoms pas/ zhe sdang rang dag la song bar bsgoms shig /mthar —223—

thug gsang ba'i dbang gi skabasader/ de man chad ni sngon 'gro gdams ngag dbang dang 'brel ba zhes bya ba yin la/ da ni dngos gzhi dbang gdams ngag dang ma 'brel pa ni/ khyed rang rnams kyi snying ga'i haṃ yig de thig le dkar po la thim/snying ga'i hūṃ yig de thig le dmar po la thim/ thig le dkar dmar de gnyis snying gar 'bros 'ded kyi tshul du 'khor ba la sems gtod la 'di thams cad sgyu ma lta bu yin snyam du 'dun pa sbyongs shig /de bum dbang yin/ thig le gnyis po snying gar 'khor bas gcig rjes gcig gis zin pa'i tshul gyis rig rig 'dug pa la sems gtad la sgyu ma'i 'dun pa sbyongs shig /de gsang dbang yin/ de ltar thig le gnyis reg pas sdo/sa sems bde bas khyab pa la sems gtod la sgyu ma'i 'dun pa sbyongs shig /de sher dbang yin/ thig le gnyis po gcig la gcig thim nas nam mkha' la 'ja' yal ba ltar gyur pa'i ngang der gang yang sgom du med bsam du med pa'i tshul/ rig pa gcer bu brten med kyi ngang du rang gar zhog cig /de dbang bzhi pa yin/ spros bral de'i ngang las bdag dang snang ba thams cad lha sku 'ja' tshon lta bu'i zung 'jug tu gsal thob la mnyam par bzhag go /de dag gis gnas skabs su thob pa'i dam tshig dang sdom pa bsrung sdom tshul bzhin du bgyid snyam pas 'di'i rjes bzlos mdzod cig /gtso bo'i ji ltar bka' stsal pa/ /de dag thams cad bdag gis bgyi/ /lan gsum/ dbang zab mo legs par thob pa'i bka' drin gtang rag tu maṇ+ḍal 'bul/ oṃ badz+ra bhu me a hūṃ/ maṇ+ḍal rgyasabasdusaskabasadang sbyar/lus longs spyod dus gsum dge ba'i dngos po thams cad bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs la —224

'bul/ cha shas nas longs spyad du gsol snyam pas 'di'i rjes bzlos mdzod/deng nas brtsams te bdag bran du/ khyed la bdag ni 'bul lags na/ khyod kyis slob mar bzung ba dang / /cha shas kyang ni spyad du gsol/ /lan gsum mo/ /sgyu lus dbang mo che'i dbang legs par thob nas rang gzhan gyi don rgya chen po mdzad par zhu/ bsod nams 'di yis thams cad sogs/ sgrol bar sgo/ga /tshogasaphud 'bul ba nas/ tshogs lhag gi bar tshogs 'khor gyis bya ba rnams kyang skabs 'dir byed/rjes chog mchod pa kha gsos/ de nasabyin rlabs bya/ arnya nas shap+ta'i bar gyisamachod/ snying po so so'i mthar 'bru gsum btags nang mchod 'bul/ sangs rgyas kun gyis sku gsung thugs sogs kyis bstod/ yig brgya lan bdun bzlas/ gang yang bdag blo gti mug pas/ /sogasakyisabazod par gsol/ oṃ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzod/ /sogs/ gshegasasu gsol/ sems can thams cad bde sdi/ra cig /sogasakyi smon lam btab/ yon tan rab rdzogs sogs kyi bkra shis brjod/ dge ba'i tshogs rnams bsags pa kun/ /bdag gir yongs su bzung med par/ /sems can ma lus kun don du/ /chos dbyings bla na med par bsngo/ /sogs kyi bsngo ba bya'o// //zhes sgyu lus dbang mo che'i lag len 'di yang / rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas smras pa'o/ /maṅga lo/ bkra shis/—225

na mo mahā mu dra ya/ phyag chen ga'u mar grags pa'i snying po ni/ thun mgor skyabs sems/ rang lha sku bla ma'i rnal 'byor rnams chos drug dang mtshungs/ mjug tu bsngo ba spyi dang 'dra'o/ /nyams len dang po la sngon 'gro rang babs rnam gsum ni/ lus gnad bcas rlung ro lan gsum bsal/ de nas lus lhod bde ba/ ngag rlung rang gar bzhag /sems ma bcos pa had de/ dran pa tur re bya/ yang na thol skyes rbad gcod dam/ yengs pa'i ngo bo de ka la ce re lta/ rtog pa rgya 'byams byung na zhe bcad dang 'dun pa shugs can dang / dran pa rtag tu brtan pa sgrims/ thun mtshams kun du sems snang dbyer med la rang gar had de 'jog pa'i sgom dang / ma bral bya byed spyod lam chos spyod kun dang 'dres te dran 'dun gal che'o/ /de nas rags phra rgyang ring thung / gyen thur bar gsum/ mdo 'don sngags bzla/ gtam sna tshogs spyod lam kun dang / khyad par rtog pa tshoms/ dka' tshad la rtsal phyogs med du sbyangs gsung / gtso bor dmigs/ rten gang yang med par che re 'jog /nang du gzhug la sems rang la lhan ne+e lta/ rnam rtog ched du dgag sgrub med ngo mi shes su ye ma song ba gal che'o/ /de na sems tshol bya ste/ ji ltar skye 'gag gnas/ ngo bo gcig bzhir gcig lus sam ming ngam/ spyi bo'i dngos po gang la 'dug /gcig gam/ tha dad du 'dug /gzugs su 'dug gam/ shes pa'am cing med du 'dus ches kha —226—

nang du phyogs la rang gis rang la brda sbyor ro/ /dngos po ni skyon bzhi rang grol ni/ lar phyag chen bya ba bzang bzang skad pa/ bde bde mo/ stong stong po/gsal gsal mo zhig gi ched 'dzin gyis phud du btang / don med du rang bzhag pas bcings pa yin/ de tha mal shes pa yengs med rjed che re ba ngos bzung med pa la gsal rig ge pa/ snang ba ci yang 'char ba la/ gnas rung 'gyu rung rang stong rtsa bral du thag le ba/ so khad de ba/ lhug ge ba/ ye re ba/ ci snang yang cha le ba/ 'di ka bzang ngan gang gis yang ma bcos pa/ bcos rung de ka la ma 'da' ba'i rang grol 'di ka la/ 'khor 'das snang ba thams cad 'di'i cho 'phrul tsam/ 'di rang ngo bo yin min yong med las ye nas 'das 'di nye grags ngo ma shes / zab grags ngo ma zin/ sla grags yid ma ches bzang grags blor ma chud pas 'khor bar 'khyams pa yin/ rgyun du ngo shes kyi dran pa dang ma bral bar nyon mongs gang skyer rang stong tshul mi thub wal le ba 'khyer ba gnang /yang skabs su nyon mongs pa'i yul yid la byas nas ched du bcug la/ de kha'i ngo la cher re 'jog dge mi dge lung ma bstan gyi sems ci byung la de ltar bskyang ngo / /rjes sku gsum rang shar ni/ 'di la sgom bogs thon nas/ snang ba ci shar la sems kyi rtsal gang yang ci yang 'char kyang / rnam rtog rang kha gdod ma nas ye skye rgyu rang med pa/ sems rang ngo shes pa'i thag chos rtsal phral du 'ong rtogs 'ongs/ mnyam rjes dbyer med du 'dres/ rgya ma chad/ phyogs su ma lhung ba'i rtsal 'gag med dgu yangs rgya 'byams nyams len gyi snying po phyogs med du 'char ba dang / spyod lam tho cho dang / sgom tshogs tshol du mi 'gro ba yin/ de la —227—

dang po nas snang stong dbyer med/ sku gsum rang grol te/ de'i dus rang shar pa yin/ yengs med dang thag chod kyis skyangs pa gal che/ dmigs pa med pa'i rang mdangs ma 'gags pa'i ngang nas thabs lam rnams dang / mos gus dang snying rje bogs 'don/ spros bcas kyi dge ba thams cad spros med rtsa bral ngang nas bogs phyungs pa'i rdo rje 'chang mngon du byed pa gdon mi za'o/ /phyag rgya chen po'i snying po bstan pa 'di yang dad ldan slob ma 'gas bskul te dge slong spong pa par rdzu ba kun dga' snying po tā ra nā thas grub pa'i gnas mchog bsam sdings n+da/ sbyar ba dge legs 'phel// //༄tsho/ /oṃ swā sti pra dza bh+yaḥ mthu stobs dbang phyug 'jig rten kun la dbang bsgyur ba/ /gang gi sku la lha rdzas mchog 'di 'bul lags na/ /sngon gyi khas blangs dran par gyis shig rgyal ba yis/ /bstan la gnod byed 'di dag myur du brlag par mdzod/ /'gro ba kun gyi mgon gyur pa/ /rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che/ /bshes gnyen dam par bcas pa dag /khyod kyi yongs su skyongs par rigs/ /mahāsamayanan// maṅga la bstir ku sto brtse chen gyi chos bsrungs la'o/ // o swā sti dza phebhabastumahākāsum̐/ mig sman rjes 'gro dus mtha'i rlung shugs can/ /stong gsum skad cig gis 'khor bdud kyi sde/ /ma lus 'thag la mngon rtsol rta mchog 'di/ /rdo rje nag po chen po rten du 'thul/ /dge la bar ba/ cod ma lus bdud dpung dang / /chos spyod la 'tshe bstan dgra gdug can —228

nyid la sgrol/ /srid mtsho brgal phyir thar 'dod don mthun gang / /dam chos gru chen gzings rnams dam du yang / /thugs rje'i phyag gis rjes bzung phyi nang gi /'jigs pa kun las g.yel ba med du srungs/ /ting skyes brag dkar mgon gyi dra'ad la rta nag gi gzungs btsugs pa'i tshig go/maṅga lo/ oṃ samadza/ /

oṃ swā sti/ de la lam rnams kyi rim pa mdor bsdus pa'i dbang du byas te/ yan lag bdun pa'i rim pa'o/ /de yang phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /sras bcas 'gro la phan mdzad pa/ /nam mkha' lta bu'i thugs mnga' ba/ /kun la dang bas phyag 'tshal lo/ /deng nas brtsams te dus rtag tu/ /bdag dang ma lus sems can rnams/ /'dren pa mchog dang mya ngan 'das/ /'phags pa'i tshogs la skyabs su mchi/ 1 /me tog rnams dang bdug pa mar me dri/ /rnam mang zhal zas rol mo gos rnams dang / /byas dang byed gyur dge ba dpag med pas/ /rnam 'dren sras dang bcas pa mchod par bgyi/ 2 /rab med 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho cher lhungs pa'i/ /rmongs pa bdag dang mtha' yas bdag gis mas/ /mi dge bcu dang mtshams med lnga la sogs/ /nyes pa spyad pa thams cad so sor bshags/ 3 /so so skye bo lam ma zhugs pa dang / /rgyun zhugs phyir 'ong phyir mi 'ong dgra bcom/ /rang rgyal rgyal ba sras dang bcas rnams kyis/ /byas dang byed 'gyur dge la rjes yi rang / 4 /zhi bar bzhed pa'i 'bum phrag brgya pa rnams/ /srid pa ji srid gnas pa de srid bzhugs/ /nyon mongs dug gis rnam nyams sdug bsngal gyi/ /ngan skyugs khang bu dag la rab chags pa/ /'di dag zhi ba'i dga' tshal mthong ba'i slad/ /bdud rtsi dam chos stsol zhig bcom ldan gyi/ 5 /ma lus phyogs bcu'i 'dren pa —230

bdag la dgongs/ /bdag gis deng nas brtsams te bdag gi ma/ /mi rtag mtha' yas 'di rnams yongs bzungs shing / /de la gnod pa ci yang mi bgyi'o/ /bdag ni 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho 'dir mi gnas/ /zhi ba'i 'brog dgon der yang bdag mi 'gro/ /lus pa med pa'i 'gro rnams byang chub phyir/ /bdag ni bla med byang chub der thob bya/ 6 /'di ltar bgyis dang ma lus dge ba yis/ /bla med byang chub gsal bar mthong bar shog 7 /dngos po med pa'i rang bzhin ni/ /thams cad sgyu ma lta bu ste/ /rnal 'byor pa gang de rig 'dod/ /(des ni 'di ltar bsgom par bya/ /grong ngam dgon par 'dug na yang / /byang chub sems ni ma nyams pas/ /byang chub sbyod pa bla med pa/ /yid kyis kyang ni rtag tu sbyod/ /'di ltar khyim ni nyes mang can/ /nam yang sdig pa'i las kyi gnas/ /'jo sgeg 'thab dang glag cor can/ /rtag tu zil gyi gnod byed mang / /kye ma nam zhig 'di las thar 'gyur zhes/ /blo ldan de ni dben pa 'tshol bar byed/ /nyes mang khyim te gdon mi za bar spang / /gnod pa med pa'i nags su de 'gro ste/ /mang ngam nyung ngur thos kyang rgyal sras rnams/ /rtag tu bsgom pa lhur len byas pa rnams/ /thos pa tsam gyis 'di la khengs par byed/ /de ni 'tsho ba pa bzhin rnam par nyams/ /de nas blo dang ldan pa ste/ /dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsten pa yin/ /dam pa'i chos ni 'tshol bar byed/ /man ngag mchog gi nor blangs nas/ /nags 'dab bab col skye bo yis/ /nam yang bgrod pa med pa'i gnas/ /mi mchog de ni der song nas/ /drang po'i lus kyis gnas par bya/ /sems kyis sems ni bzung byas nas/ /'dir ni dpa' bo —231—

rnam par bsdud/ /rnam rtog mang po rnam nyams che/ /rgya mtsho'i rlabs bzhin zhi bar bya/ /yid ni rnam par g.yengasagyur na/ /de tshe dran pa'i 'dul bar bya/ /'dod yon spyod ba dran la sogs/ /de tshe dpal dang lus 'dod pa/ /'dus byas yid tsam gar mkhan dang / /dus kyi sprin pa glog 'gyu mtshungs/ /'khor ba sprul gyi ro 'dzin na/ /kye ma bdag ni g.yengs pa'i gnas / /gzhan yang zhe sdang 'dod chags rmongs/ /chom rkun 'jigs chen 'di dag rnams/ /byams dang rten cing 'brel 'byung dang / /mi sdug ting 'dzin dpung gis bcom/ /sems ni sgo gtan bcug pa ltar/ /rnam rtog rlung gis g.yo ba med/ /'dod pa rnams la dgar mi 'gyur/ zhan tu sbyang ba'i bde ba thob/ /de nas thos pa chen po las/ khres rab pha rol phyin gang gsung / /de las 'byung bzhin blo ldan ni/ /gdam ngag ldan pas bsgom par byed/ /swa lu'i myu gu 'ja' tshon ltar/ /rten cing 'byung ba ngo mtshar med/ /chos rnams bden pa'i stong pa'o zhes/ /yang yang rang bzhin de sgom bya/ /dran dang shes bzhin ldan pa yis/ /spyod lam kun tu bag yod brten/ /bya ba kun la ji zhig ltar/ /sems mi g.yo zhing chos rnams 'byed/ /de nas gzhan yang / blo ldan khyim na 'dug gam/ yang na bas mthar 'dug kyang rung / mnyam par 'jog kyang rung / 'dod pa la spyod kyang rung / yun ring por bslab pa'am/ las dang po pa yin yang rung ste/ re zhig sems can thams cad la snying rje bsgom par bya'o/ /gang ci yang rung ba dag la bsad par sems pa rnams la dge ba'i bshes gnyen nam pha dang mar 'du shes par bya'o/ /gal te de khong du chud par gyur na/ gzugs brje zhing —232

bsgom par bya ste/ yang na re zhig byams pa bsgom zhing phyi nas nges par snying rje la nan tan du bya ste/ gzhan du na byang chub kyi sems rgyas par mi 'gyur ro/ /de ltar 'gro ba kun byang chub la 'god par 'dod pas snying rje la goms par bya zhing / gnod pa dang sdug bsngal bzod pa nan tan du 'bad nas/ rim gyis na pha rol du phyin pa drug la yang dag par bslab par bya'o/ /gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' snying rje la bslab par byed pa rnams 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la mchod par bya'o/ /brjod par bya'o/ /bsnyen par bya zhing bsgom par bya'o/ /lam mdor bsdus pa rdzogs so/ /bdag gis 'di bris dge ba yis/ /sems can tshogs rnams ma lus pa/ /myur du bla na med byang chub/ /rtag cing bde ba myur thob rbesgog/ //dge slong kun dga' snying pos bris/ /dge'o/ /der brten mdzad bzang 'od stong gis/ /bstan 'gro'i legs tshogs pad+mo'i tshal/ /phyogs dang dus su yongs bzhad de/ /phan bde'i gzi 'od 'bar gyur cig /—233

ṭī ka bi dzā ha ri pā ru bzhugs/na mo bud+dha ya/ gang gis yang dag rdzogs sangs mngon du bgyis rnams dang / /'di na bde dge phra mo gang de'ang sangs rgyas drin/ /bdag gis nus min cung zad spobs pa'ang rgyal nyid kyi'o/ /de phyir de la phyag 'tshal nam yang gzigs pa'i rigs/ /de yang ji skad du/ shān ta de ba'i zhal snga nas/ ji ltar mas mo mun nag sprin rum na/ /glog 'gyu skad cig rab snang ston pa ltar/ /de bzhin sangs rgyas mthu yis brgya lam na/ /'jig rten bsod nams blo gros thang 'ga' 'byung / /zhes pa ltar/ sangs rgyas kyi mthus lus can rnams la phan pa'i blo gros sam dge ba'i sems 'ga' 'byung ste/ de'i phyir 'di yang sangs rgyas kyi mthur blta'o/ /de la 'di'i dgongs pa dang / brjod bya dang / dgos pa'i dgos pa rnams ci zhe na/ snying rje che dang stong pa nyid 〈bde blag tu rtogasapas 〉bsgom pa/ de 'dir dgos pa nyid yin 〈brjod bya stong nyid snying rje 〉ston par byed/gas 〈snying rje dgos 〉dag sgrol ba'i 〈phyir thos pa'i 〉byang chub ched du'o/ /〈stong pa nyid dang snying rje'i rnam gzhag bstan pa'i de go bar 'gyur la go ba de rnams dgos shing / sgom pas bla med thob par gyur te/de'i phyir sgom pa nyid tshol bar bya'o/ /〉sgom pa lhur byed thos tsam 'di la min/ ///bye/ lag tsha 1nge/ snye/// /ni//4 mi pha mi 4 mi /ni//sgyu mis bya'/ / yang skad du/ na yun thung shas bya' gnas kyang mang / / ya tshad kyang ji tsam mi rtogs pas/ /ngang bas chu la 'o ma len par ltar/ /rang gi —234

'angosad 〈'di'i mtshams nas ma yig gi ldeb gnyis pa ma rnyed pa'i skabs 'dir sko rgyu lhag yod pa'i rjes sor ma yig rnyed skabasasko dgosalags/〉 khyim na sogs kyis gang du bsgom pa'i gnas dang /bsgom pa po'i gang zag dang / re zhig sems can thams cad la sogs pas/ji ltar bsgom pa la 'jug pa ste/ snying rje rkyen gzhan gyis mi 'phrog par bya ba'i thabs dang / ma skyes pa bskyed pa'i thabs dang / byang chub kyi sems kyi mthun phyogs rnams la nan tan tu bslab dgos par bstan pa dang / spyod pa pha rol phyin pa drug la sbyor ba dang / ji ltar gsang sngags las 'byung ba ltar/ snying rje dang byang chub kyi sems rin po che bskyed pa'i thabs gzhan bstan pa rnams te/bsgom par bya zhes pa'i bar du sbyar ro/ /mjug gi don ni lam mdor bsdus rdzogs so zhes bya'o/ /bdag gi 'di bris sogs ni dge ba bsngo ba'o/ /da ni tshig gi don cung zad brjod par bya ste/ de la lam rnams kyi rim pa mang du yod pa/ rnal 'byor rnam pa gnyis mdor bsdu ba'i dbang du byas te/ nan tan du byed par 'dod pas re zhig /sems kyi dri ma 'go gnon zhing / ting nge 'dzin skye sla ba'i phyir/ blo chos la 'jug pa'i sgo/ yan lag bdun pa'i rnal 'byor 'di lam gyi rim pa rnams kyi dang po'o/ /zhes gleng ba'i rtsa ba dang 'brel bar yan lag bdun pa mdor smos so/ /de nas yan lag bdun pa dngos ni/ phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i la sogs pa spros te/ phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su 'gro ba/ nya mchod pa/ 2 sdig pa bshags pa/ 3 bsod nams la yi rang ba/ ya mya ngan las mi 'da' bar chos 'khor bskor bar bskul pa/ 5 byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa/ 6 rdzogs —235 tsho

pa'i byang chub tu bsngo ba 7ste bdun gyi/ dang po la phyag 'tshal ba ni/ phyogs bcur bzhugs pa ste/ rab 'byams mtha' yas pa'i rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sras dang bcas pa 'gro ba ma lus pa la phan par mdzad pa ste/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhis 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa la yang / byang sems so so'i skye bo dang / ma dag sa bdun dang / dag pa sa gsum la gnas pa rnams rim pa bzhin/ rje btsun gyis/ phal cher don med don yod dang / /rnam kun don yod shes par bya/ /zhes gsungs te 'gro ba'i don de dag kyang pha rol du phyin pa drug gi sgo nas gcig tu phan par mdzad kyang / nam mkha' lta bu ste don dam bden pa chos nyid stong pa rtogs pa'i mkhyen can rnams dang /rdzogs sangs rgyas rnams gzugs kyi skus sems can rnams grol bar mdzad pas 'gro la phan par mdzad pa dang / de ltar gzhan don mdzad pa yang / nam mkha' lta bu'i thugs mnga' ba ste/ chos sku kho na'i rnam rol nyid las nam du yang ma 'das mod/ 'on kyang / sngon gyi smon lam gyis dbang las dang / bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i tshul gyis so/ /zhes pa dang / rgyal sras rnams kyang gnas 'di la mngon du phyogs pa'i phyir phan pa dang / don dam pa'i thugs mnga' ba bsdus par rig ste/ mdor na phan par mdzad pa dang / don dam pa'i thugs ni rang gzhan don gyi sku gnyis dang / byang chub kyi sems gnyis so/ /de yang ji skad du/sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' las 'khrungs shing / /snying rje'i sems dang gnyis su med blo dang / /byang chub sems ni rgyal sras rnams kyi rgyu/ /zhes pa ltar/ sangasargyas/ rgyal sras/ byang chub kyi sems rnamasalas/ sangaba'irgyasani —236

byang sems kyi rgyu can dang / de ni byang chub kyi sems rnam gnyis kyi rgyu can gyi phyir rim pa 'di ltar smos pa yin no/ /phyag 'tshal nas skyabs su 'gro ba ni/dus kyi khyad par deng nas brtsams te dus rtag tu ste/ ji srid mngon par byang chub pa'i bar du'o/ /zhes/ dmigs pa'i khyad par dmigs pa ni/ /bdag dang ma lus sems can rnams/ zhes pa ste/ sems can thams cad do/ /de yang ji skad du/ gang zhig sems can thams cad sgral bar zhugs pa dang / /zhes rje btsun gyis gsungs so/ /dmigs pa'i yul gang la skyabs su 'gro ba ni/'dren pa mchog dang mya ngan 'das/ /'phags pa'i tshogs la zhes so/ /ngo bo ni skyabs su mchi'o zhes pa khas len pa ste/ rje btsun gyis/ 'di ni de dngos 'dod pa'i khas len de yang snying brtse las rig bya/ /zhes gsungs pa yin te/ de bas na/ sems can thams cad kyi don du skyabs yul thog mar 'dod pas khas len pa nyid yin no/ /gnas 'di rgyas par rje btsun gyis rgyan dang / rgyud bla mar gsungs pa/ de nges par blta bar bya la/ de ltar skyabs su song nas las ci zhig bgyi zhe na/ bsod nams kyi tshogs bsags pa'i sgo byin pa las gyur pa dang / ye shes kyi tshogs bsags pa'i sgor gyur pa/ tshul khrims las gyur pa dang / tshogs gnyis rdzogs pa'i sgor zhugs pa'i dge ba sangs rgyas su byed pa'i yan lag dang / de las gzhan don bsgrub pa'i yan lag dang / phyi ma gnyis ni/ dge ba thams cad 'bras bu byang chub snying po can du byed pa'i yan lag ste 'di dag byed do/ /de rnams las/ dang po gsum ni rang don gtso bo dang / bzhi pa gzhan don gtso bo dang / lnga pa dang drug pa ni thun mong yin te/ de —237—

yang gnyis pa ye shes tshogs las ting nge 'dzin gyi sgo dang / gsum pa phyi ma gnyis ni shes rab gtso bor gyur pa dang / lhag ma bsod nams kyi sgo ste/ kun kyang bsod nams kyi tshogs yin par rig go /de yang skyabs su song nas/longs spyod la ltos pa med par sbyin pa byas nas/ mi mthun phyogs sdig pa bshags shing bsal te/ mthun phyogs dge ba rgyas pas/ gzhan la phan pa bla med bsgrub nas/ thams cad kyang bla med byang chub kyi snying po can du bgyis te/phyis dge ba chud mi za zhing sangs rgyas su byed pa ni/ mi gnas pa'i myang 'das la 'jug pa'i sgo yin no/ /zhes shes par bya ste/ 'di ni yan lag bdun pa'i go rim yin no/ /de ltar yan lag phyi ma drug las/ dang po mchod pa ni/ me tog rnams dang bdug pa mar me dri/ rnam mang zhal zas rol mo gos rnams dang ste/zang zing dang / byas dang byed 'gyur dge ba dpag med kyi mthu las byung ba/rnam byang gi zhing dang / yo byad dbul ba mchog gi sbyin pa las gyur pa 'dis rnam 'dren sras dang bcas la mchod par bgyi/ zhes so/ /gnyis pa ni/ rab med de brgal dka' ba'i 'khor ba'i rgya mtshor lhung ba'i bdag dang mtha' yas pa'i bdag gi ma sems can rnams/ chos kyi de kho na nyid dang / las dang 'bras bu'i gnas la shin tu rmongs pa yin te/ de'i phyir/ mi shes pa'i dbang gis/ mi dge ba bcu dang mtshams med pa lnga la sogs pa'i nyes pa spyad pa thams cad so sor bshags shing / slan chad srog la babs kyang mi bgyi'o/ /zhes bya ste/ ci ni tshul khrims las gyur pa yin tsa na/ 'di ni nyes pa dang mi 'grogs shing / phyin chad sdom pa yin la tshul khrims kyang de'i las can te/—238

de'i phyir de ltar smras so/ /gsum pa ni/ so so'i skye bo lam la zhugs pa dang / /rgyun zhugs phyir 'ong phyi mi 'ong dgra bcom/ rang rgyal rgyal ba sras dang bcas rnams kyi/ byas dang byed 'gyur dge la rjes yi rang / zhes pa'o/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi dam pa'i chos kyis gzhan grol bar mdzad nga/ ni/ gzhan don gyi gtso bo yin la de lta bu'o/ /bzhi pa gzhan don gyi yan lag ni/ zhi bar bzhed pa'i 'bum phrag rgyal ba rnams/ /srid pa ji srid gnas pa de srid bzhugs/ /zhes pas mya ngan las mi 'da' bar gsol nas nyon mongs te ma rig pa la sogs pa rtsa ba dang nye ba'i nyon mongs pa'i dug gis rnam par nyams shing nyes pa'i ma rig pa dang 'dod chags la sogs pa'i dbang gis sdug bsngal te 'khor ba'i phung po dang nyer spyod ngan skyugs kyi khung bu lta bu dag la rab tu tshang ba'i sems can 'di dag rnams zhi ba ni sdug bsngal kun gyis mya ngan med pa dang / de skad du yang / rdzogs sangs rgyas dang nyan thos rnams/ /srid pa zad pas dgyes par 'gyur/ zhes gsungs pa'i tshul gyis so/ /zag med kyi dga' ba'i gzhir gyur pas dga' tshal dang chos mtshungs la/ de mthong ba ste mngon du bgyi ba'i slad du/bdud rtsi lta bu'i dam chos stsol zhig ste/ chos 'bor bskor du gsol/ kyai phyogs bcu ma lus pa'i bcom ldan 'das rnams zhes chos gsung bar bskul pa'o/ /lnga pa ni/ ma lus phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i 'dren pa rnams bdag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag gis dus deng nas brtsam ste bdag gi ma ste/ sems can 'khor bar rtag tu 'khor bas dang / zhi ba rtag cing brtan pa ma thob pas mi brtan pa mtha' yas shing bgrang ba las 'das pa ma lus pa 'di rnams bu —230

gcig pa ltar/ brtse bas yongs su bzungs shing / bslab bya de las gnon pa ci yang mi bgyi'o/ /zhes pas/ sems bskyed kyi bslab bya la slob par khabashablangs nas/ sems bskyed pa dngos ni/ bdag ni 'khor ba'i rgya mtshor 'dir mi gnas te las nyon gyi skye ba mi len pa dang / zhi ba chad pa'i myang 'das kyi 'brog dgon der yang bdag mi 'gro ste/ lhag med du zhi bar mi byed par/ smon lam dang / sprul pa dang / bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i lus kyis 'gro ba'i don byed do/ /zhes so/ /tshul de dang ldan pas bdag gis bla na med pa'i byang chub mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa nges par 'thob par bya ste/ lus pa med pa'i 'gro ba rnams byang chub la 'god pa'i phyir kho nar yin gyi bdag nyid srid pa'i 'jig pa tsam gyis ni ma yin no/ /zhes so/ /drug pa ni/ yan lag drug po 'di ltar bgyis pa dang / srid zhi ma lus pa'i dge ba'i mthu yis bla med byang chub gsal bar mthong par shog ces pa ste/ myur du thob par gyur cig ces yi rang dang / sems bskyed dang / bsngo ba rnams shes rab kyi sgo ci zhe na/ lhag mthong lam ni de don dang / /rnam par spyod par shes par bya/ / zhes gsungs pa dang tshul mtshungs pa nyid du yi rang ni/ dge ba'i bsam pa dang / byed pa dang /'bras bu la sogs pa ji snyed pa'i gnas la dmigs nas yi rang ba'i phyir dang / tha ma gnyis ni/ byang chub phra zhing zab pa ji lta ba'i gnas la dmigs pa'i phyir/ de skad ces smras so/ /de ltar yan lag bdun pa bshad nas/ gang la 'jug pa'i rnal 'byor nyid brjod na/ de la thog mar mdor bstan pa la/don dam sems bskyed ni/ dngos po kun gyi ste chos thams cad kyi rang bzhin —240

nam/ gshis ni thog ma nyid nas thams cad ste gzung ba dang / 'dzin pa'am yul dang yul can rnam shes dang ye shes la sogs pa thams cad kyis thams cad du sgyu ma lta bur stong bzhin du snang ba ste/ rnal 'byor pa gang ste/ 'dis ni/rnal 'byor ting nge 'dzin la mngon du phyogs pa rnams kyang bsdus par bsgom par bya/ zhes pa dang 'brel te/ de la rnal 'byor pa des ni 'di ltar te/ 'og nas ji ltar 'byung ba bzhin du bsgom par bya ste/ dngos po kun gyi rang bzhin de ni rig cing mngon par bgyi bar 'dod pa kho nas so/ /de nas kun rdzob byang sems spyod pa dang bcas pa mdor bstan pa ni/ grong la sogs pa 'du 'dzi dang bcas pa'i yul lam/ 'brog dgon par 'dug na'ang / gnas 'di ma rung ste/rgyal po byams pa'i stobs dang / shrī si ra dza dang / tshong dpon sbyin pa la dpa' ba dang / zil gyis mi gnon pa la sogs pa byang chub sems dpa'i skyes pa'i rabs dag bskang bar 'os la/ gang yang / don dam byang chub kyi sems la ni/rgyal sras shin tu las dang po pas de ltar ma yin te/ 'dod yon rnam par ma spangs pas ni/ sems rtse gcig tsam yang sgrub mi nus so/ /de ltar byang chub sems dpa' des byang chub sems dpa'i grogs snying rje dang stobs ma nyams pas/ byang chub spyod pa ste/ byang chub kyi phyir spyad par 'os pa gang yin pa de'o/ /de la byang chub ni bla na med pa nyid yin la/ de bas na spyad pa yang bla na med pa ste/ sbyin pa la sogs pa rgya chen po dngos su spyad par bya zhing ci ste mi nus na/ yid kyis kyang ni rtag tu ste nam yang nyon mongs pas lhag par zil gyis ma mnan par spyad par bya zhing / de'i tshul yang / zla ba'i zhal snga nas/—241—

sbyin sogs chos gsum 'di dag phal mo cher/ /bde bar gshegs pas khyim pa rnams la bsngags/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ khyim pa'i snga ma gsum dang / rab tu byung pa'i phyi ma gsum la gtso cher bslab par gsung ste/ de yang khyim pas sbyin pa phal che ba la slob cing / tshul khrims dang / bzod pa phal cher la phyis slob cing 'jug par bya ba yin la/ rab tu byung nas ni/ rab tu byung phyin 'tsho ba rnam par dag pa la brten dgos pa'i phyir/ longs spyod spang dgos pas sbyin pa dang / bsrung bya tshul khrims kyi gtso bo so sor thar pa'i sdom pa la gnas dgos pas tshul khrims dang / dge sbyong du byed pa'i chos bzhi la gnas pas gnod pa la bzod pa yang 'grub pas na/ dang po gsum la gnas nas/ bsgrub par bya ba thos bsam sgom gsum la rtsol ba ches chen pos 'bad dgos pa'i phyir/ phyi ma gsum la sleb par 'grub ste/ rgyal sras rnams kyi dbang du byas pa yin no/ /da ni don dam byang chub kyi sems bsgom pa'i rim pa cung zad rgyas par bshad na/ zhi gnas dang lhag mthong gi lam gyi rim pas 'grub ste/ de skad du yang /rgyal sras shan+ta de ba'i zhabs kyis/ zhi gnas rab tu ldan pa'i lhag mthong gis/ /nyon mongs rnam par 'joms pa shes byas nas/ /zhes kyang gsungs shing / dgong pa nges par 'grel pa las kyang bka' stsal te/ rnal 'byor pa yi zhi gnas dang / /lhag mthong bsgom par byas pas ni/ /mtshan ma'i mching dang de bzhin du/ /gnas ngan len gyi 'chi bas grol/ /zhes pa'o/ /de ltar zhi gnas kyis nyon mongs pa dang / lhag mthong gis shes bya'i sgrib pa sbyangs pas ni/ mang du smra ba ngal te/ mdor bsdu na/ zhi gnasabasgom pa'i tshul yang / zhi —242
