ba'i lha chen pos/ thog mar zhi gnas btsal bya de yang ni/ 'jig rten chags pa med la mngon dgas 'grub/ /ces gsungs pa ltar/ 'dod yon la ma chags pa sngon du 'gro ba yin la/ de'i phyir du/ ji skad du/ 'dod ldan la la lus kyang bcad/ kha cig gsal shing rtse la btsug /zhes pa dang / byis dang skal pa mnyam spyod na/ /nges par ngan 'gror 'gro 'gyur te/ /skal mi mnyam par 'khrid byed na/ /byis pa brten pas ci zhig bya/ /skad cig gcig gi mdza' 'gyur la/ /yud tsam gyis ni dgrar yang 'gyur/ /dga' ba'i gnas la khro byed pa/ /so so'i skye bo mgu bar dka'/ /phan par smras na khro bar byed/ /bdag kyang phan las bzlog par byed/ /de dag ngag ni ma nyan na/ khro bas ngan 'gror 'gro bar 'gyur/ /zhes dang / byis dang 'grogs na byis pa la/ /bdag bstod g.yin la smod pa dang / /'khor bar dga' ba'i gtam la sogs/ /mi dge zhes kyang nges par 'byung / /de ltar bdag dang gzhan brten pa/ /des ni phung bar 'gyur bar zad/ /ces gsungs te/ /de'i phyir 'di ltar khyim ni nyes mang can/ /nam yang sdig pa'i las kyi gnas/ /'jo sgeg 'thab dang klag cor can/ /zhes smras pa yin no/ /gzhan yang mahā tsar+ya shan+ta de bas/ mtho la phrag dog mnyam la 'gran/ /dma' la nga rgyal bstod na dregs/ /mi snyan brjod na khong khro skye/ /nam zhig byas la phan pa 'thob/ /ces dang / nags na ri dwags bya rnams dang / /shing rnams mi snyan brjod mi byed/ /'grogs na bde ba de dag dang / /nam zhig lhan cig bdag gnas 'gyur/ gzhan yang nam zhig rgyab tu mi lta zhing / /chags pa med par 'gyur zhig gu/ /sa phyogs bdag gir gzung med pa/ /rang —243

bzhin gyis ni yangs rnams su/ /rang dbang spyod cing chags med par/ /nam zhig bdag ni gnas par gyur/ /lhung bzed la sogs nye tshe dang / /kun la mi mkho'i gos 'chang zhing / /lus 'di sba ba ma byas kyang / /'jigs med gnas par nam zhig 'gyur / /zhes gsungs te/ de nyid mdor bsdu na/ rtag tu zil gyis gnod byed mang / /kye ma nam zhig 'di las thar 'gyur zhes/ /blo ldan de ni dben pa 'tshol bar byed/ /nyes mang khyim du gdon mi za bar spangs/ /zhes smras pa'o/ gnod pa med pa'i gnas su de 'gro ste/ / zhes pa ni/ de nyid las/ji skad du/ khang stong shing drung phug dag tu/ /gang du ji srid 'dod gnas te/ /yongs 'dzin bsrung pa'i sdug bsngal spangs/ /ltos pa med par bag yangs spyod/ /rang dbang spyod cing chags med la/ /gang dag yang ni 'brel med pa/ /chog shes bde spyod gang yin pa/ /dbang pos kyang ni de snyed dka'/ /zhes so/ /de ltar bsam nas rnal 'byor du bya ba ni mang ngam nyung ngu thos kyang / zhes sogs 'brel te/ de la nang rnal 'byor la gzhol pa'i sems dpa' de dben pa 'tshol zhing / mang ngam nyung ngur thos kyang rgyal sras rnams/ rtag tu bsgom pa lhur len/ zhes pa ni rgyal ba'i gsung rab ni sgom pa lhur len gyis/ thos pa dang rtsod pa lhur len pa'i rgyud ni/ rgyal sras chen po a ti shas/ mngon sum rjes dpag dgos pa med/ /mu stegs rtsod pa bzlog phyir yin/ /zhes kyang gsung ste/ rtog ge dang rig byed dang / bha ra ta dang / klu'i 'bum pa dang / lha'i in+d+ra bya ka ra ṇa la sogs pa'i 'da' bar byed pa la/ mang ngam nyung ngur thos kyang byis pa rnams/ /thos pa tsam gyis 'di na khengs par byed/ /zhes so/ /—244—

mdor na/ rgyal sras khyim spangs pa ste ji ltar thos pa de ltar bsgom pa'i snying po can du byed do/ /ci rgyal sras rnams bsgom pa lhur len na/ nyung ngur thos pas/chog gam zhe na/ thams cad mkhyen pa bsgrub par 'dod pas shin tu mang du thos dgos pa yang / thos pas mi ngom nyid dang ni/ /zhes gsungs pa bzhin sa thob nas kyang thos pa tshol ba'i phyir/ 'di na/ phyug bdag gi brtul bzhugs can thos pa dri med la lhag par brnyas pa dag ni bdud kyi 'jug pa las gzhan du ci/ de bas 'dir byang sems dang byis pa thos pa'i dgos pa min mtshungs te/dang po ni/ tshigs bcad gcig kho na thos pa yang sgom pa'i snying po can du byed pa dang / byis pa zhes pa spyir so so skye bo thams cad la 'jug kyang / 'dir ni yang dag pa'i lam la zhugs pa rnams 'phags pa la mngon du phyogs pas 'phags pa'i rigs yin pas/ byis pa ni yang dag pa'i khams la mi nga 'a ba rnams te/ de rnams thos pa tsam gyis chog shes nas/ mi bsgrub po zhes bstan pa yin no/ /thos pa tsam gyis khengs pa de ni 'tsho ba pa bzhin rnam par nyams zhes pa la/ 'tsho ba pa ni mi dbul po'i khyad par zhig ste/ 'tsho ba pa rigs kyi gtso bo la mi smon pa nyid kyis bya ba bzang po la mi 'jug pas rtag tu sdug bsngal ba bzhin no/ /zhes pa'o/ /de nas blo dang ldan pa de/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsten pa yin/ dam pa'i chos ni 'tshol bar byed/ /man ngag gi snying po can gyis thos pa de dag gang las thos par 'gyur ba/ dam pa'i chos la spyod pa'i rkyen gyi gtso bo dge ba'i bshes gnyen las te/ bsten tshul rje btsun gyi/skyo ba spang la brten/ bkur sti rnyed pa dag dang rim gro dang / /sgrub pa'i sgo nas —245

bshes gnyen bsten par bya/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /bsten nas kyang dam pa'i chos 'tshol bar byed do/ /de'i phyir bsten pas so/ /dper na dpal 'byung pa'i rnam thar las/ bla ma bsten pa'i tshul ltar bslab/ /zhes gsungs pa dang /nor bzang gi bla ma brgya rtsa bsten pa bzhin/ bdag cag rnams kyis kyang bslab par bya'o/ /man ngag mchog gis nor blang nas zhes pa ni/ de ltar dam chos 'tshol zhing mang du thos nas kyang / thos pa thams cad kyang man ngag dang ldan par byas nas sgom pa la phyogs pa'o/ /zhes pa'o/ /de nas/ gang du bsgom pa'i gnas brtan de/ nags 'dab bab 'chol skye bo yis/ /nam yang bskyod pa med pa'i gnas/ /de skad du/ rgyal sras tsan+d+ra go mis/ nags klung chu gtsang ngos bde dben pa skyid pa gang / /ci ste lha yi bu mo dri zhim byug pa yi/ /lan bu'i rgyan du thogs pa'i rgyun ldan me tog bcas/ /mdzes pa zil gnon lha yi tshula'ang yod 'gyur ram/ /zhes dang / rtsa ba 'bras bu shun pa lo ma phun sum tshogs pa'i ljon shing ldan/ /nags tshal ltos med ri bo'i chu rgyun gsal babs chags pa med pa'i gnas/ chu klung yangs pa'i mtha' ru 'bras bu rgya chen lhung bas brgyan pa yi/ /nyams dga' bas mtha' ci zhig med de dmyal dong khyim du bslus te sdod/ /ri sul yangs pa skye bo lhug pa med pas rab bde ba/ /nyer spyod rgya chen khor yug nags tshal sngo 'byungs 'phreng ba sgrengs/ /chu ngogs snyan pa phu chu'i rgyun sgra rnga ltar snyan pa yi/ /bdag cag nyon mongs yul ma yin zhes mgron la sgrogs pa bzhin/ /zhes gsungs te/ tshigs bcad dang pos/ lha yi chu bo nags klung mchog ste/ dang pos nyon mongs 'phel zhing / phyi ma chags bral yid 'byung —246

ba'i gnas yin pa'i phyir/ zhes bstan la/ ljon shing ldan yan chad ri dang ri bo'i chu rgyun nas dga' zhes pa'i bar dang / nyer spyod rgya chen man chad kyis der bza' btung sogs kyis ngal te/ las kyi mtha' la ma zhugs kyang / bdag pos ma bzung ba dag bde blag tu rnyed pas so/ /gzhan yang / 'brog dgon par bsam gtan bsgom pa la mi skyo ba'i nyer spyod dang ldan la/ khyim gyi nyer spyod ni/ rnam par g.yeng bar byed pa yin pas na/ bas mtha' ci zhig med de sogs gsungs so/ /nags tshal ltos med ni dgra dang gnyen gyi bya ba la mi ltos pas/ g.yeng ba'i rgyu med pas dang / ri sul yangs pa ni bdag la gnod pa dang chags pa'i skye bo med cing / gzhan gyis ma bzung pas spyod pa spang pa'o/ /de'i phyir nags 'dab zhes spros la/ skye bo lhug pa ni/ nyon mongs pa'i spyod pa ma bsdams par lhug par spyod pa ste/ de bas ni bab col skye bo yis/ /nam yang bgrod pa med pa'i gnas/ /zhes smras pa'o/ /de ltar ma bsdom pa khyim pa la sogs pa dang lhan cig tu 'dug na/ rang nyid kyang nyon mongs pa ma bsdams par spyod la/ shin tu nyon mongs par spyod pa dag snang ba ni/ rang nyid yang nyon mongs stobs su 'gyur pa las/ de dag med pa'i phyir/ ting nge 'dzin cher skyes sla bas rab bde ba'o/ /de'i phyir rnga ltar snyan pa yin sogs kyi don/ nags tshal sogs dben pa ni/ bdag cag nyon mongs zhes sogs brjod par bya'o/ /mi mchod de ni der song nas/ /drang po'i lus kyi gnas par bya/ /zhes pa ni/ dben pa der rje btsun rnam par snang mdzad kyi chos bdun gyi lus gnad dang ldan par bya'o/ /zhes pa ste/ 'di yan chad rnal 'byor la 'jug —247

pa'i rim pa sngon du 'gro ba yin no/ /de'i tshul yang mahā a tsar+ya pad+ma'i ngang tshul gyis/ de ltar tshul khrims la sogs pa zhi gnas kyi tshogs rnams la gan te/yid du 'ong ba'i phyogs su sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal la sogs pa byas shing / sdig pa bshags pa dang / bsod nams la rjes su yi rang bar byas la/ snying rje chen po kho na sngon du byas pas/ 'gro ba mtha' dag 'don pa'i bsam pa nan du gyur nas/ lus drangs por bsrang la stan bde ba'i steng du 'dug ste skyil mo krung bcas la ting nge 'dzin mngon par bsgrub po/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar bya ba ste/ de ltar tshul khrims la sogs pa zhi gnas kyi tshogs rnams la gnas te/ zhes pa zhi gnas kyi rgyu tshul khrims sngon du 'gro ba ste/ 'di ltar khyim ni zhes sogs bshad pa yin no/ /yid 'ong pa'i phyogs ni/ nags 'dab zhes sogs smras pa ste/ sangs rgyas dang zhes bya ba la sogs pa ni/ dben pa der sngar bshad pa ltar yan lag bdun pa bya ba yin la/snying rje chen po kho na sngon du byed pa ni bsgom pa dang / 'gro ba mtha' dag 'don pa'i bsam pa ni/ byang chub tu sems bskyed pa ste/ de nas lus drang por bsrang ba la sogs pas/ lus gnad bstan te/ de'i phyir drang po'i lus kyi sogs smras pa yin no/ /da ni ting nge 'dzin mngon par sgrub bo zhes pa 'dir bshad par bya ba ste/ sems kyi sems ni bzung bya ste/ /zhesapa/ rnal 'byor pa gang nang sems nyid kyi gnas la/ sems kho nar dmigs te/ rtog med du 'jog pa dang / de nyid yun bsrang ba ste/ 'jog pa dang / rgyun du 'jog pa'o/ /'dir ni dbang po rnam par bsdu ba ni/ snga ma nas bying rgod spangs te/ rnam rtog gi rgyu —248 ri

spangs nas dbang po nang du bsdus te mnyam par 'jog pa nyer 'jog go /rnam rtog mang pos rnams nyams tshe/ rgya mtsho'i rlabs bzhin zhi bar bya ba ni blan te 'jog pa ste/ rnam rtog mang du skyes pa na de shes par byas nas slar yang mnyam par 'jog pa'o/ /yid ni rnam par g.yeng gyur na/ de tshe dran pas gdul bar bya zhes pa ni/ zhi bar byed pa dang rab tu zhi bar byed pa ste/ rnam rtog 'phros kyang dang du mi len pa dang / brjed nas rnam par g.yengs na dran pas zin par byas nas de la nyes par lta zhing mnyam par 'jog pa la mi dga' ba spangs te 'jog pa yin te/ ji skad du/ ka ma la shī la mahā pu ru dzis sgom rim las/ gang gi tshe de la mi dga' bar mthong ba de'i tshe/ ting nge 'dzin gyi yon tan la bltas nas de la dga' bar bsgom zhing / rnam par g.yeng ba la nyes par lta bas mi dga' ba rab tu zhi bar bya'o/ /zhes gsungs shing / 'dod yon spyad pa dran pa sogs/ /de tshe dpal dang lus 'dod pa/ /'dus byas yud tsam gar mkhan dang / /dus kyi sprin dang glog 'gyu mtshungs/ /'khor ba sprul gyi ro 'dzin na/ /kye ma bdag ni g.yeng ba'i gnas/ /zhes pas 'dod pa'i nyes pa dang / de spang nas dben pa dang bsam gtan gyi phan yon yid la byed pa ni/'dul bar byed pa ste/ de nyid las/ ci ste gang gi tshe sngon rgod pa dang rtses pa la sogs pa dran zhing bar bar du sems rgod par mthong ba de'i tshe mi rtag pa la sogs pa yid 'byung bar 'gyur ba'i dngos po yid la byed pas rgod pa zhi bar bya'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /gzhan yang 'dod chags zhe sdang rmongs/ /chom rkun dgra chen 'di dag rnams/ /byams dang rten cing 'brel 'byung dang / /mi sdug —249—

ting 'dzin dpung gis bcom/ /zhes pa la gti mug shas che bar bying ba dang /'dod chags shas che bar rgod pa dang / zhe snang yang de dang phyogs mthun par rig ste/ de rnams la rim pa bzhin rten 'brel dang / byams pa dang / mi sdug pa bsgom pas bsal zhing / der mdor bsdu na/ bying rgod spang ste sems kyi rgyun rtse gcig tu byed pa bsgrub pa la/ bying ba la spro ba bskyed pa dang / rgod pa la sems mi sdug pa la sogs pas bsal bar bya ste/ ji skad du/ gang gi tshe bar skabs 'dod chags la sogs pa sems phyir rol du rnam par g.yeng ba de'i tshe/sems rnam par g.yeng ba shes par byas la/ mi sdug pa la sogs pa bsgom pas rnam par g.yeng ba zhi bar byas shing / myur du de nyid la byang sems phyi phyir rol gzhugs par bya'o/ /zhes dang / ci ste gang gi tshe gnyid dang rmugs pas non te dmigs pa 'dzin pa la mi gsal zhing sems bying bar gyur pa de'i tshe/snang ba'i 'du shes bsgom pa'i mchog tu dga' ba'i dngos po sangs rgyas la sogs pa'i yon tan yid la byed pas bying ba bsal la/ dmigs pa de nyid la dam du bzung ngo / /zhes gsungs so/ /sems ni sgo gtan bcug pa ltar/ rnam rtog rlung gis g.yo ba med/ /ces pa ni de nyid las/ gang gi tshe bying ba dang rgod pa gnyis ka dang bral ba'i tshe/ mnyam par 'jug cing sems rang gi ngang gis 'byung bar mthong ba de'i tshe rtsol ba klod de bltar snyoms su bya'o/ /zhes gsungs te/ bying rgod dang bral nas/ sgo gtan bcug pa ltar sems mi g.yo bar gnas pa la ring du 'jog pa ni/ mnyam par 'jog pa zhes bya ste/ zhi gnas grub bo/ /phan yon ni/ 'dod pa rnams la dgar mi 'gyur/ shin tu —250

sbyangs pas bde ba thob/ ces te dang po zhi gnas grub pa'i sems kyis dang /phyi ma lus kyi gtso che ste/ de ltar na tshig gi don to/ de la sems gnas pa'i thabs dgu po nyid dang / spong pa'i 'du byed brgyad po ci zhe na/ dang po rje btsun gyis rgyan las/ dmigs pa la ni sems gtan nas/ /de rgyun rnam par g.yeng mi bya/ /rnam g.yeng myur du rtog byas nas/ /de la slar yang slan par bya/ /blo ldan gang nas gong du yang / /sems ni gang du bsdu bar bya/ /de nas yon tan mthong ba'i phyir/ /ting nge 'dzin la sems 'dul lo/ /rnam g.yeng nyes pa mthong ba'i phyir/ /de la mi dga' zhi bar bya/ /rlom sems yid mi bde la sogs/ /lags pa de bzhin zhi bar bya/ /de nas sdom brtson can gyi ni/ /sems ni mngon par 'du byed byas/ /rang gi ngang gis 'byung ba thob/ /de gom pa las 'du mi bya/ /zhes pa rnams te dam pa'i chos mngon pa kun btus las kyang / zhi gnas gang zhe na 'di lta ste/ nang nyid la sems 'jog pa dang / rgyun du 'jog pa dang /blan te 'jog pa dang / nye bar 'jog pa dang / 'dul bar byed pa dang / zhi bar byed pa dang / rnam par zhi bar byed pa dang / rtse gcig tu byed pa dang / mnyam par 'jog pa'o/ /zhes so/ /'di'i don ni/ mahā bho dhi sa twa pad+ma'i ngang tshul gyi sgom rim las/ de la 'jog ces bya ba ni/ dmigs pa la sems 'dogs pa'o/ /rgyun du 'jog ces bya ba ni/ dmigs pa de nyid la rgyun du 'jog pa'o/ /bslan te 'jog ces bya ba ni/ rnam par g.yeng ba shes nas de spang pa'o/ /nye bar 'jog ces bya ba ni/ rnam par g.yeng ba spang nas phyi phyir bstun te dmigs pa de nyid la 'jog pa'o/ /'dul lo zhes bya ba ni dga' ba bskyed —251—

pa'o/ /zhi bar byed do zhes bya ba ni/ rnam par g.yeng pa'i nyes pa mthong nas mi dga' bar rab tu zhi bar byed pa'o/ /rnam par zhi bar byed pa ni/ rmugs pa dang gnyid la sogs pa lang ba rnam par sel pa'o/ /rtse gcig tu byed pa ni mngon par 'du byed pa med pas 'jug par 'bad byed pa'o/ /mnyam par 'jog ces bya ba ni/ sems par gyur pa na btang snyoms su byed pa ste/ mnyam par 'dzin zhes bya ba'i tha tshig go /tshig 'di rnams kyi don 'di rnams ni 'phags pa byams pa dang / sngon gyi mkhan po rnams bshad do/ /zhes gsungs te/ thog mar dmigs pa la sems rtse gcig tu gtod de 'jog pa/ re zhig dang por sems bzhag pa de nyid la/ rang du mnyam par 'jog cing / dmigs pa kho na la yengs su 'jug pa rgyun du 'jog la/ sems rnam par g.yeng na/ de ngo shes par byas nas slar mnyam par 'jog pa bslan te 'jog pa/ sems phyi rol du mi 'phro ba'i ched du/ dang po nyid du dran pa dang ldan pas rnam g.yengs spangs shing 'jog pa nye bar 'jog pa/ ting nge 'dzin la sogs pa'i phan yon dang /g.yengs pa'i rgyu 'dod yon la nyes dmigs su bltas nas sems 'phror mi 'jug pa 'dul bar byed pa dang / sems 'khrugs pas mi gnas pa'i rgyu rnam g.yeng la nyes par lta bas/ sems mnyam par 'jog pa la mi dga' ba spangs nas mnyam par 'jog pa zhi bar byed pa dang / dmigs pa brjed nas de las gzhan du yengs nas bying rgod rnam rtog sogs mngon du gyur kyang / skabs mi 'byed par rab tu zhi bar byed pa dang / de nas sems brtson pas rtse gcig tu mngon par 'du byed pa dang bcas pas bying rgod ci tsam spangs pa de tsam du —252

mnyam par 'jog pa sems kyi rgyun gcig tu byed pa dang / de las shin tu goms pas 'bad rtsol mngon par 'du byed med par rang gis gnas pa ni mnyam par 'jog pa'o/ /sngar bshad pa'i lung gi tshig don ni dpe bshad pa'i phyir re zhig bzhag go /gnyis pa la/ ting nge 'dzin gyi nyes pa lnga ni/ le lo dang ni gdam ngag dang / /brjed dang bying dang rgod pa dang / /'du mi byed dang 'du byed de/ /'di dag nyes pa lngar 'dod do/ /zhes dang / de spangs pa'i 'du byed brgyad ni/ gnas dang de la gnas pa dang / rgyu dang 'bras bu nyid du'o/ /zhes dang po bzhi dang / dmigs pa brjed par ma gyur dang / /bying dang rgod pa rtog pa dang / /de spangs mngon par 'du byed dang / /zhi tshe rnal du 'jog pa'o/ /zhes phyi ma bzhi po rnams te/ /'di'i don ni/ mahā ra ba ka ma la shi las/ mdor na ting nge 'dzin gyi nyes pa drug yod de/ le lo dang / dmigs pa brjed pa dang /bying ba dang / rgod pa dang / mi rtsol ba dang / rtsol ba'o/ /'di rnamasakyi gnyen po yang / spong ba'i 'du byed brgyad kyis spong ngo / /'di lta ste/ dad pa dang /'dun pa dang / rtsol ba dang / shin tu sbyang pa dang / dran pa dang / shes bzhin dang / sems pa dang / btang snyoms so/ /de la gong ma bzhi ni le lo'i gnyen po ste/ 'di ltar ting nge 'dzin gyi yon tan dag la mngon par yid ches pa/ mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i dad pa'i rnal 'byor pa rnams la 'dod pa skye'o/ /de nas 'dod pa'i brtson 'grus rtsom mo/ /de brtson 'grus kyi stobs kyi lus dang sems las su rung ba nyid byed do/ /de nas lus dang sems shin tu sbyangs par gyur pas le lo ldog ste/ de bas na dad pa la sogs pa ni le lo spang pa'i phyir —253

sgom mo/ /dran pa ni dmigs pa brjed pa'i gnyen po'o/ /shes bzhin ni bying ba dang rgod pa'i gnyen po ste/ des bying ba dang rgod pa yang dag par rtogs pa'i phyir ro/ /bying ba dang rgod pa rab tu ma zhi ba'i dus na mi rtsol ba nyes pa ste/de'i gnyen por sems pa bsgom mo/ /bying ba dang rgod pa rab tu zhi ste/ gang gi sems rnal du 'jug pa de'i tshe rtsol ba nyes pa yin te/ de'i gnyen por btang snyoms so/ /spang ba'i 'du byed brgyad po de dag dang ldan pa ting nge 'dzin shin tu zhugs pa yin te/ zhes sgom rim las gsungs te/ de la rtsol ba'i rgyu dad pa/gzhi'am gnas 'dun pa/ de la gnas pa rtsol pa/ rtsol ba'i 'bras bu shin tu sbyangs pa ste/ sems gnas pa'i thabs dang po bzhi yi gnas skabs dang rim par sbyar bar bya'o/ /dmigs pa brjod pa ste/ rnam rtog las 'byams pa'i gnyen por dran pa ste/ 'dul bar byed pa dang / zhi bar byed pa'i skabs su rig la/ shes bzhin gyis ni gang gi tshe ji ltar bying ba dang rgod pa shes te/ de'i phyir bying rgod kyis sems las su mi rung ba'i gnyen por shes bzhin te/ rab tu zhi bar byed pa dang / sems pa ni sems rtse gcig tu byed pa'i skabs su rig la/mi rtsol pa'i gnyen po'i ci'i phyir sems pa mi rtsol ba'i gnyen po zhe na/ de yang mi rtsol ba ni/ rtse gcig pa la mi rtsol ba ste/ bying rgod gyi skabs rnyed du rung ba yin la/ sems pa ni/ de skad du yang / sems pa gang zhe na/ mngon par 'du byed pa yid kyi las de dge ba dang mi dge ba dang lung ma bstan pa rnams la sems 'jug pa'i las can no/ /zhes/ gsungs te/ skabs 'dir yang khab len gyi rjes su lcags 'gro ba ltar/ ting nge 'dzin la sems rtse gcig tu 'gro ba'o/ /—254

btang snyoms ni mnyam par 'jog pa'i tshe rang bzhin gyi sems gnas pa/ rtsol ba nyes pa yin te/ de'i phyir zhing rnam rtog gis 'byugs te de'i gnyen por bsgom par bya ste/ 'di dag bsgom pa'i rim pa mdor bsdus su bshad zin to/ /da ni lhag mthong bsgom tshul shin tu cung zad cig brjod na/ de ltar zhi gnas grub pa de nas zhes pa/ chos mngon pa las/ yang zhi gnas dang lhag mthong de dag la brten nas lam bzhir gyur te/ la la ni zhi gnas thob pa yin gyi/ lhag mthong ni ma thob ste/ de zhi gnas la brten nas lhag mthong la brtson par byed do/ /la la ni lhag mthong thob pa yin gyi/ zhi gnas ni ma thob ste/ de lhag mthong la brten nas zhi gnas la brtson par byed do/ /la la ni/ zhi gnas yang thob pa ma yin la/ lhag mthong yang thob pa ma yin te/ de la chos la rgol ba mngon par tshar bcad pa'i sems kyis gnyis ka la brtson par byed do/ /la la ni zhi gnas dang lhag mthong yang thob pa yin te/ de'i gnas dang lhag mthong yang 'dres par gyur nas mnyam par zung du 'jug go /zhes gsungs pas dang po'i dbang du byas pa'o/ /de ltar de nas theg pa chen po'i mdo rnams las/shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bsgom pa'i rim pa gang gsung pa de las byung ba bzhin man ngag dang ldan pas blo ldan te/ byang chub sems dpas bsgom par byed do zhes pa mtshams sbyar ba'o/ /de nas bsgom pa dngos ni/ de skad du lhag mthong gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ chos rnams la rnam par 'byed pa dang / rab tu rnam par 'byed pa dang / yongs su rnam par rtog pan byed pa dang / yongs su —255 ci

rnam par dpyod par byed pa'o/ /zhes gsungs te/ rnam par 'byed pa ni ji snyed pa'i chos la 'di dag go /zhes lta ba dang / rab tu rnam 'byed ni chos nyid ji lta ba'i don la rnam par 'byed pa dang / yongs su rtog pa ni/ rtog pa dang bcas pa'i shes rab kyis mtshan mar byed cing ngo bo la rang sar 'tshol ba dang /yongs su dpyod pa ni khyad par la zhib tu 'tshol ba yin no/ khyad par de dag dang ldan pa'i zab mo stong pa nyid sgom tshul yang / mahā sa twa ka ma shi la'i sgom rim du/ gang gi tshe yid la byed pa de dag zhugs par gyur pa de'i tshe/ phung po dang khams la sogs pa'i bye brag gis rgyas par dmigs pa byed pa kho na ste/'di skad du/ dgongs pa nges par 'grel pa la sogs pa las kyang / rnal 'byor pa rnams kyis stong pa nyid rnam pa bco brgyad dmigs pa la sogs pa'i bye brag gis dmigs pa'i rnam pa mang du bka' stsal to/ /zhes gsungs te/ bye brag gis rgyas par dmigs pa zhes pa/ ji snyed pa rnam 'byed dang / dmigs pa la sogs pa'i bye brag gis zhes pa/ ji lta ba rab tu rnam 'byed dang phyi ma gnyis yin la/ da ni 'di'i rjes su 'brang bar bya ste/ sa las myu gu dang 'ja' tshon ltar chos 'di dag thams cad rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba tsam ste/ sems kyi snang ba tsam las legs par dpyad na ngos bzung dang bral ba'i phyir ngo mtshar med du 'byung ba'o/ /de'i phyir snang ba'i chos 'di kun sgyu ma lta bur bden pa'i stong pa'o zhes sngar bshad pa'i zhi gnas kyi ngang nas yang nas yang du chos rnams kyi rang bzhin stong pa nyid de bsgom par bya'o/ /de la 'dir ni lang rkar gshegs pa las bka' stsal te/ sems tsam la ni rab brten nas/ /phyi rol —256—

don la mi chog go /de bzhin nyid la dmigs nas ni/ /sems tsam las kyang 'da' bar skyed/ /sems tsam las ni 'das nas su/ /snang ba las ni 'da' bar bya/ /snang med gnas pa'i rnal 'byor pa/ /ye shes theg pa chen po mthong / /zhes so/ /de yang sems tsam la ni rab brten nas zhes pa nas brtsam ste/ sems tsam las kyang 'oda' bar bya/ /zhes pa'i bar ni/ swā lu'i myu gu zhes pa nas/ de bsgom bya/ zhes pas bshad de/ snang med la gnas pa dang / ye shes theg pa chen po mthong ba ni snga ma goms pa las 'byung zhing / sems mi g.yo zhing chos rnam 'byed ces pas bshad do/ /de la swa lu'i myu gu rten 'byung tsam gyi dpe dang 'ja' tshon ni bar snang las logs su med pa ltar/ chos kun sems las gzhan du med pa'i dpe'o/ /skabs 'dir nges shes skyes dka' na/rgyal ba'i sras kyi dbang phyug klu sgrub dang / gnas brten chen po rgyal sras dbyig gnyen sogs kyis ji skad bshad pa'i rim pa dang lung gis kyang ci rigs su gtan la dbab bo/ /bsdus pa ni 'di yin te/ chos kun gyi rang bzhin gcig pa ni/ mtha' kun bral ba'i stong nyid rtogs pa de bsgom pa'i phyir/yang yang stong pa'o zhes kyang bsgom par bya'o/ /zhes pa'o/ /'di tshig don ltag 'og mi mthun pa'o snyam na ma yin te/ de yang ji ltar bha ra ta las/ mes smin pa'i 'khur ba gsod pa 'on cig ces pa'i don la/ grub pa me yis bsreg pa yi/ /'khur ba gsod pa 'on cig bu/ /zhes pa lta bu ste/ de'i phyir tshig la skyon med do/ /de ltar mnyam bzhag tu bsam gtan gyi skyon dang / yid la byed pa dang bsam gtan nyid dran pa dang / skyon dang yon tan dang / yang dag pa'i —257

gnas la sems son ma son sogs shes bzhin dang / spyod yul 'jug pa nas kyang smras pa/ bdag gi las dang / dkon mchog gi yon tan 'khor ba'i nyes pa dang / rang gi sems la dran pa dang / shes bzhin du yang brtag par bya/ spyod lam kun tu srog la babs kyang nyon mongs pa dang las ngan pa bsdom pa'i bag yod brten par bya'o/ /zhi gnas dang lhag mthong cha mnyam pa de ci tsam na rab tu zhugs zhe na/ bya ba kun la ci zhig ltar/ /sems mi g.yo zhid chos rnams 'byed/ /zhes pa'o/ /de ltar rab tu smras pa gang / /'di la legs rnams rgyal ba dang / /mkhan po slob dpon rnams kyi'o/ /nyes pa gang yin bdag gi bzung / /nyes smras lhag par sdig che bas/ /nongs pa gang yin mchog la bshags/ /mabo/na po klu dbang 'phags pa lha/ /zla grags 'phags pa thogs med dang / /slob dpon dbyig gnyen blo brtan dang / /tsan+d+ra go mi bdag nyid che/ /zhi ba lha la sogs pa yi/ /dngos po rnams la skyabs su mchi/ /deng 'dir gcig tu phan pa'i blos/ /bshad mod nyes pa gang mchis te/ /bdag ni shes bya kun la rmongs/ /de lta na yang bsgom pa'i tshul / /'di la zhabrul pa yod ma yin/ /ting 'dzin 'di la gang gnas pa/ /des ni rin chen bzang po lta'i/ /ting nge 'dzin sogs kun 'jug nus/ /ko da ni kun rdzob byang chub kyi sems bsgom tshul cung zad gcig tu brjod par bya ste/ de nas zhes pa sngar de bshad pa'i rjes thog de nas bshad par bya'o zhes pa yin gyi/ bsgom pa'i rim pa bzhin du bstan pa ni ma yin no/ /de la de nas gzhan yang blo ldan byang chub gnyer ba dag gis gcig tu —258—

'bad par bya ba 'di la ni/ dang por gang du bsgom pa'i gnas sngar bshad pa nyid ches mchog yin mod/ gcig tu de ltar dgos pa yang ma yin te/ khyim na 'dug gam yang na bas mthar 'dug kyang rung ste/ dper na thams cad sgrol dang / bram ze spun du gyur pa lta bu'o/ /bsgom pa'i gang zag ni gtso bor nang gi nang la rab tu 'jog nyid yin mod/ gzhan yang mnyam par 'jog kyang rung /'dod pa la spyod kyang rung / zhes kun rdzob byang chub kyi sems la thog mar 'jug pa ni/ dka' thub pa dang 'dod ldan kun rung bar mtshungs te/ mdor na sems can dmyal ba pa la yang skye bar rung ngo / /de'i phyir bdag sngon dge ba ma bsags zhes/ /zhus pa nyid du mi bya ste/ /mi gang lam 'di thos gyur pa/ /de dag kun yang mthu dang ldan/ /'di ni lam gyi gnas skabs phyogs gcig pa yang ma yin te yun ring mor bslab pa mdor na dag pa'i sa la gnas pa dang /las dang po pa sems bskyed ma thag yan chod kyang 'di nyid bsgom par bya ste/'on kyang dbang po dang lam gyi bye brag gis dmigs pa dang rnam pa tha dad pa'o/ /da ni de nyid sgom tshul yang bsdus te brjod na/ re zhig dang por sems can thams cad la snying rje bsgom par bya ste/ de yang thog mar sems can rnams kyi nang nas dgra la sogs pa rnams la bzod pa bsgom pa dang / de lta bu'i snying rje de yang rkyen gyis mi 'phrog pa'i phyir sems can gang ci yang rung ba bdag rang la gnod pa'i sems kyis bsad par bya'o snyam du sems pa'i dgra la sogs pa'i drin dran pa dang byams pa'i sems skye/ de la snying rje skye ste/ gal te de yang rgyud la mi skye bar khong du chud par ma gyur na/ pha ma dang dgra sogs —259

gzugs brje zhing bsgom par bya la yang na re zhig sdug bsngal gtso bor mi bsam par 'gro rnams bde bar gyur na ci ma rung zhes byams pa bsgom par bya zhing / phyis nas nges par snying rje la nan tan du bya ste/ gzhan du ni byang chub kyi sems rgyas par mi 'gyur ro/ /de ltar 'gro ba kun byang chub la 'god par 'dod pas snying rje la bsgom par bya dgos te/ de med na rang gi don nyid sems pas na gzhan don la btang snyoms par 'gyur bas gnon pa dang / sdug bsngal la bzod pa yang nan tan du bya dgos te/ gzhan yang bla na med pa'i byang chub las phyir ldog par 'gyur te/ gzhan gyis gnod pa byas pas khro ba'am skyo bar 'gyur ba dang / byang chub kyi phyir bskal ba grangs med par dka' ba med par du ma 'bad dgos pa'i phyir/ de la yid skyo bas byang chub chen po bsgrub par mi byed la/ snying rje mtshungs pa med pa dang ldan pa'i gang zag rnams de dag bzod par 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/ /'di rnams ni byang chub kyi sems mi nyams shing 'phel rgyas su byed pa'i thabs yin no/ /de ltar na thabs de rnams la nan tan du 'bad na rim gyis te/ gang zag dbang po dman pas dang por so so'i skye bos bya sla ba'i sbyin pa sogs la 'bad na/ phyi nas pha rol du phyin pa thams cad la yang dag par bslab par bya'o/ /de yang ji skad du/ tshod ma la sogs sbyin pa la/ /'dren pa'i thog mar sbyor ba mdzad/ /de la gom nas phyi nas ni/ /rim gyis rang gi sha yang gtang / /de'i rgyu mtshan yang / gang tshe rang gi lus la ni/ /tshod sogs lta bu'i blo skyes nas/ /de tshe sha la sogs gtang ba/ /de la dka' ba ci zhig yod/ /ces so/ /de la pha rol du phyin pa'i rnam par bzhag pa'i rgyan —260

las/ grangs dang de yi mtshan nyid go rim dang / /nges pa'i tshig dang goms pa'i yon tan dang / /de dag rab dbye bsdu dang mi mthun phyogs/ /yon tan phan tshun rnam nges yin ches bya/ /zhes rber+shags rgyas par gsungs pa las/ /'dir mdor bsdus te bshad na/ mtshan nyid dang / dbye ba dang /ngo bo dang /grangasanges dang / go rim dang / nges tshig dang / 'bras bu'o/ /sdom ni/ mtshan nyid dbye ba ngo bo dang / /grangs dang go rim nges tshig 'bras/ /de la dang po ni/rje btsun gyis/ sbyin pa mi mthun phyogs nyams dang / /rnam par mi rtog ye shes ldan/ /'dod pa thams cad yongs rdzogs byed/ /sems can rnam smin de rnam gsum/ /de bzhin du shes rab kyi bar du gsungs te/ sbyin pa nas shes rab kyi bar du phar phyin du 'gyur ba la khyad par bzhi dang ldan pa dgos la/ de dag ni sbyin pa'i mi mthun phyogs ser sna nyams pa/ sbyin pa sbyin bya len po gtong pos stong / /zhes pa ltar/ sbyin pa'i 'khor gsum rnam par mi rtog pa'i shes rab kyis zin pas/ zang zing dang chos la sogs pa'i sbyin pas 'dod pa thams cad yongs su rdzogs par byed/ zang zing sogs kyis 'gro ba bsdus nas rgyud smin par byed pas mtshams sbyar ba'o/ /de ltar chos bzhi dang ldan pa'i gtong pa'i sems pa ni sbyin pa'i pha rol du phyin pa'o/ /de bzhin du tshul khrims kyi mi mthun phyogs tshul 'chal la sogs pa dang / bzod pa'i mi mthun phyogs khong khro la sogs pa dang / le lo sogs brtson 'grus kyi mi mthun phyogs dang / rnam g.yengs sogasabasam gtan gyi mi mthun phyogs dang / shes 'chal sogs shes rab kyi mi mthun phyogs rnams nyams pa dang / rang rang gi 'khor gsum —261—

rnam par rtog pa'i shes rab kyis zin pa dang / tshul khrims phun sum tshogs pas yid dang ba sogs dpag tu med pas dang / bzod pas gzhan gyis gnon pa byas pas bzod pa la sogs pas dang / brtson pas gzhan gyi grogs byed pa dang / bsam gtan gyis mngon shes lnga sogs kyis dang / shes rab kyis blang dor gyi gnas dang gnas ma yin pa rnam par 'byed pa la sogs pas gzhan gyi 'dod pa yongs su rdzogs par byed pa dang / de kun gyis kyang 'dod pa rdzogs par byas nas chos bstan pas snga ma lngas rgyud smin par byed pa la mtshams sbyor la drug pas smin par byed pa ste/ de ltar chos bzhi bzhi dang ldan pas spong ba'i sems pa tshul khrims dang / mi zhabrugs pa ni bzod pa dang / spro ba'i ni brtson 'grus dang / rtse gcig pa'i bsam gtan dang / rab tu rnam par 'byed pa'i sems pa ni shes rab bo/ /gnyis pa dbye ba ni/ sbyin pa la/ zang zing mi 'jigs/ chos kyi sbyin pa'o/ /zang zing la gtong ba dang / shin tu gtong ba/gtong ba chen po'o/ /tshul khrims la nyes spyod sdom pa dang / dge ba chos sdud dang / sems can don byed kyi tshul khrims gsum gyi dang po la/ so sor thar pa rigs bdun no/ /bzod pa la sdug bsngal dang len gyi dang / gnod pa la ji mi snyam pa dang / chos la nges pa'i bzod pa dang gsum mo/ /brtson 'grus la go cha'i brtson 'grus/ sbyor pa'i brtson 'grus/ mi ldog pa'i brtson 'grus so/ /bsam gtan la mthong chos la bde bar gnas pa'i bsam gtan/ yon tan mngon par bsgrub pa'i bsam gtan/ sems can gyi don bgyid pa'i bsam gtan no/ khres rab la/ kun rdzob la darmegs pa don dam la dmigs pa/—262

sems can la dmigs pa'i shes rab bo/ /gsum pa ngo bo ni/ lan dang rnam par smin pa la mi re ba'i sbyin pa yang srid la 'dun pa dang bral ba'i tshul khrims/ sems can la khong nas zhes 'gras pa med pa'i bzod pa/ rang bzhin gyi dge ba'i chos mtha' cideg la ngang gis spro ba'i brtson 'grus/ bsam gtan gzugs med kyi snyoms 'jug bsal ba'i ting nge 'dzin/ thabs snying rje chen po dang ya ma bral ba'i shes rab rnams so/ /de kun yang rten dam pa byang chub kyi sems dang ldan pa/ dngos po dam pa sbyin sogs kyi dngos po rnams phyogs re ba min pas ris med/ ched du bya ba dam pa gzhan don du sbyor ba/ thabs dam pa 'khor gsum rnam par mi rtog pa'i shes rab kyis zin pa/ bsngo ba dam pa byang chub chen por bsngo ba dug med/ dag pa dam pa sgrib gnyis dngos kyi gnyen por spyod pa ste dam pa drug dang ldan pas nyams su blang ngo / /bzhi pa ni ci'i phyir phyin drug tu grangs nges zhe na/ byang chub sems dpa' chos thams cad ni mdor na bslab pa gsum mo/ /de'ang sbyin pas longs sbyod thams cad la chags pa dang bral bar byas pa las tshul khrims phun sum tshogs par 'gyur la/ tshul khrims la khros kyang slar mi khro ba sogs kyis dge sbyong du byed pa'i chos bzhi dang ldan par 'gyur bas bzod pa ste/ de ltar gsum ni lhag pa tshul khrims bslab pa'i ngo bo yin la/ bsam gtan ni lhag pa ting nge 'dzin dang / shes rab ni lhag pa shes rab kyi bslab pa dang / brtson 'grus ni thams cad kyi grogs su 'gyur bas na/ de'i phyir grangs nges pa'o/ /lnga pa go rim ni/ snga ma snga ma las phyi ma phyi ma skye bas na/ snga ma las phyi ma mchog tu gyur pas snga ma rnams rags pa —263 ci

la phyi ma rnams phra ba'i phyir bstan ste/ ji skad du/ snga ma ma bstan phyi mi skye/ /dman dang mchog tu gnas phyir dang / /rags pa dang ni phra ba'i phyir/ /de dag rim par bstan pa yin zhes so/ /drug pa sgra don nam nges tshig ni/ rje btsun gyis/ dbul ba 'dor bar byed pa dang / /bsil ba thob dang khro bzod dang / /mchog sbyor ba dang yid 'dzin la/ /don dam shes pa'i phyir bshad do/ /'di ni/ saṃ kṛ ta'i skad las shes dgos te/ de yang dā na zhes pa/ da ri tra ngan par 'gro ba la'o/ /zhes pa'i dbyings las dwa ni dbul ba yin la/ na ni bshan te de yis bka' bas/ de ltar dbul ba 'dor bas sbyin pa'o/ shwe la las shī ta bsil ba dang shul bha ṣa thob pa la'o/ /zhes pa'i byings las la thob pa ste/ de ltar na bsil ba thob pas tshul khrims so/ /de yang yul gyi tsha ba'i gdung bas mi brdzi bar bsil ba thob pa'o/ /k+ṣan+tiḥlas k+tamu dka' thub dang bzod pa la yang ngo / /zhes pa'i dbyings las sdug bsngal gyi tshogs la sran tshugs par bzod pas bzod pa'o/ /bir+ya las bī ni bir rnam par gnon pa la'o/ /zhes pa'i byings las/ dpa' ba dang rtul phod pa la 'jug pas mchog gi snying stobs ma zhum par sbyor ba'i don kyis brtson 'grus so/ /d+me na zhes pa dhe sems pa la'o/ /zhes pa'i byings las sems pa'i rgyun gzhan du yeng ba med par sgo gtan bcug pa ltar mi g.yo ba'i don gyis na bsam gtan no/ /pradz+nyā ni dz+nyā khong du chud pa'am rtogs pa la'o/ /zhes pa'i byings las nyer bsgyur pra sngon du bzhag pas/ rab tu khong du chud pa'am rab tu rtogs pa zhes pa yin te/ de ltar rab tu rtogs bya'i yul ni don dam pa yin la/ don dam pa ni 'phags —264—

rgyud kyi mnyam bzhag ye shes yin pas/ don ni de'i spyod yul du gyur pa ste/de'i phyir dam pa'i don shes pas shes rab bo/ /bdun pa 'bras bu ni/ gnas skabs su/ sbyin pas longs spyod khrims kyis bde/ /bzod pas gzugs bzang brtson pas brjid/ /bsam gtan gyis bde blo yis grol/ /zhes rin chen 'phreng bar gsungs pa ltar ro/ /mthar thug gi 'bras bu sbyin sogs dang po gsum bsod nams kyi tshogs te/ gzungs sku'i dngos rgyu dang / shes rab ni ye shes kyi tshogs dang / bsam gtan phal cher yang ye shes kyi tshogs te/ de'i phyir de gnyis chos kyi sku'i dngos rgyu dang / brtson 'grus kyis thams cad kyi grogs byed do/ /'dir bsam gtan dang shes rab ni gtso bor bshad par bya ba yin mod/ de lta mod kyi skabs su bab pa'i mdor bsdus bsgom tshul cung zad bshad zin la/ 'di skabs kyi ting nge 'dzin ni ting nge 'dzin rnam pa lnga'i mdor/ rin chen bzang po lta bu dang / rab 'byams rgya mtsho'i ting nge 'dzin dang / yang dag pa'i mtha' dang / spyod pa mchog tu spyod pa dang / 'dod dgur bsgyur ba rnams kyi phyi ma yin la/ shes rab ni de'i mtha'i ting nge 'dzin yin la/'di dag gi rnam par bzhag pa ni yi ge mang ba'i 'jigs pas re zhig btang snyoms su bya'o/ /pha rol phyin pa 'di dag la/ /gang rnams slob par 'dod de dag /bla med byang chub 'dod dgur bsgyur/ /gzhan du mkhas pa rnams kyang 'o965sa/ /zhes kyang smras rbes/ /gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' snying rje la bslab par byed pa rnams 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la mchod par bya'o/ /brjod par bya'o/ /bston par bya zhing bsgom par bya'o/ /zhes te/—265

'di'i bsgom tshul 'og nas cung zad bshad par bya'o/ /de la 'phags pa spyan gzigs ni sngon gyi smon lam gyis dbang las rgyal ba kun gyi thugs rje'i bdag nyid du bzhugs pa ste/ de yang ji skad du/ zag med dbyings nas sangs rgyas rnams/ /sngon gyi lus rjes 'brang phyir dang / /mkha' ltar lus ni med pa'i phyir/ /gcig min du ma nyid kyang min/ /zhes gsungasapa dran par bya'o/ /da ni de ltar cung zad bshad pas grub pa'i don/ nyams su blang pa rim pa mdor bsdus na 'di yin te/ rnam par dben pa'i ri bo dang / nags 'dab chu ngogs la sogs pa skye bo'i rgyu 'grul dang / bklag cor dang / bya gh+ra dang / chom rkun la sogs pas bgrod par mi 'gyur zhing 'jigs pa med pa'i gnas su/ dkon mchog gi rten dag bzhugs su gsol ba'am/ gcig tu dgos pa pa yang ma yin pas med yang rung ste/ de lta na phyogs bcu'i rab 'byams ma lus pa'i rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa kun la dang pa'i sems dang / 'gro ba kun la mthar thug tu nges par phan gdags pa'i blos/ sangs rgyas sras bcas ma lus pa'i spyan sngar 'dug par bsam nas sngar bshad pa ltar don dran bzhin pas yan lag bdun pa lan mang du bya'o/ /de la phyag 'tshal ba'i skabs su bdag dang 'gro ba kun gyi lus kyang zhing khams rgya mtsho'i rdul snyed du sprul nas phyag 'tshal bar sgoms pa dang / mchod pa'i skabs/ bdag sogs sems can rnams kyis dus gsum du bsags pa'i dge ba rnams dang / sems can rnams kyi don du bdag gi lus kyang dbul bar bya ste/ rgyal dang de sras rnams la bdag gis ni/ /bdag gi lus kun gtan du dbul bar bgyi/ /sems dpa' mchog —266

rnams bdag ni yongs bzhes shig /gus pas khyed kyi 'bangs su mchi bar bgyi/ /bdag ni khyed kyi yongs su bzung bas na/ /srid na mi 'jigasasems can phan par bgyid/ /zhes bka' stsal pa yang brjod la don bsam/ /de ltar gnas skabs 'di dag tu yang / /spyir sems can thams cad dang / khyad par gnod byed thams cad la ches cher bsgom par bya'o/ /de nas 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs dang / 'dod pa rnams ni snog chung zhing nyes pa mang pa dang / dben pa'i phan yon dang / dal 'byor rnyed dka' dang / 'dus byas mi rtag pa dang /las dang 'bras bu mi bslu ba rnams yin la yang yang bsam par bya zhing /thabs du mas zhib mo nas sgom par bya ste/ thun gyi skabs su re zhig de dag la nan tan du sgom/ thun mtshams su mchod pa dang / skyabs su 'gro ba byang chub kyi sems bsam pa dang / gsung rab klog pa dang / phyag dang bskor ba sogs spros bcas ci rigs pa la nan du bya'o/ /ji zhig ltar na/ yid la byed pa de dag cung zad gom pa na/ de nas dngos gzhi la 'jug ste/ de yang mdun du/bcom ldan 'das mi 'brugs pa'am/ 'o skol gyi ston pa bcom ldan 'das lta bu'i rgyal ba'i sku gzugs ri mor bris la/ gser sogs ha cang 'chor bag che ba ma yin pa zhig mdun du bzhag la/ de la mig gtad de/ sems ma yengs pa tsam du bzung / de la goms nas mig sna rtse'i thad gar bltas nas mdun du rgyal ba'i sku brnyan bsam la/ de la ma yengs ba tsam du sems bzung / de la goms nas sems la sems bzhag nas rtse gcig tu bsgom/ de skabs sems g.yengs ba ma tshor bar cung zad 'gyu na/ yang nas yang du/ blan te bsgom nam —267

gnas pa na/ skad cig re re nas 'phro mthud/ de nas yang cung zad g.yengs pa de'i tshe bsgom pa la spro ba'am/ ma yin brtag la spro na/ bying rgod rnam rtog gang gi'ang dbang du ma song bar sems 'jog go snyams pa'i 'dun pa ches dran pa btang la shugs 'phyung nas rtse gcig tu bzhag /gal te mi spro ba'am/ 'jog cing snga ma las phyi ma yun thung zhing mi gsal ba dang / sems dub cing skyo na/'khor 'das dang / khyim dang / dben pa dang / nyon mongs dang / mnyam par 'jog pa rnams kyi phan yon dang / nyes dmigs rnams dran bzhin pas/ cung zad 'dug nas bsgom pa dang thun chung la grangs mang bar byed ces grags pa bzhin du bya'o/ /yang sems yan te mi 'gro yang rnam rtog chu bur lta bu mang pos ri risems dbyen spyos nas/ rnam rtog skye ba'i tshe de nyid la sems gtan nas yang mi dmigs par bzhag /de lta bu byung tshad skyes tshad la sbyor/ de ltar 'bad pas ci tsam na/ sems dum zhig ni gnas la skabs 'gar ni 'khrug go /de ni sems gnas pa la phyogs pa zhes bya'o/ /de nas sngon 'dod yon spyod paji dran pa dang / 'dod yon sems pa dang / tshe 'di'i bya bas sems brel na 'dod yon gyi nyeme dmigs/ 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal tshe mi rtag pas nam 'chi cha med/ tshe 'di me rnams kyi gdengs des ci 'dra zhes dran pas bzlog /yang rnam rtog skyes pa na/ kun rtog las ni 'dod skye zhing / /'dod pa las ni sdig par 'gyur/ /'gro rnams rnam par 'khyams byed pa'i/ /'dod pa'ang kun tu rtog las 'byung / /zhes sems zhabrugs pa'i rgyu rnam rtog gi nyes dmigs dran par bya'o/ /yang mnyam par 'jog pa la mi dga' ba skyes na/ 'bras bu zhi ba dang / lam mnyam par —268

'jog pa'i yon tan dran pas 'dul zhing / gong du bshad pa'i thabs sna tshogs kyis kyang 'dul bar bya ste/ bying na spro ba dang / rgod na mi rtag pa'i 'du shes sogs zhum pas 'dul/ gzhan yang 'dod chags la mi sdug pa/ zhe sdang la byams snying rje/ gti mug la bdag med bsgom pas bzlog nas mnyam par 'jog go /de la goms pas ji zhig nas sgrim ste bzhag na gnas pas bying rgod kyi go skabs mi 'byung zhing / ma bsgrim na 'byung ba de lta bu la ting 'dzin gyi sgo zhes bya'o de la sgoms nas sems rtsol med gnas pa 'byung bas de tshe de sems sgrim par lhod de shig ge ba la mnyam par bzhag 'jog ste zhi gnas so/ /de la ring du goms nas lhag mthong bsgom ste/ de yang thog mar rang lus la dmigs rten byas nas/ lhod de glod nas bzhag pa'i ngang nas lus dang sems de bdag gi phung po 'di dag sems tsam nyid do snyams pa yang yang sgom/ de gom nas 'di dag ni brag cha ltar rten 'byung tsam ma gtogs stong pa'o snyam du yang yang bsgom/ de yang gom nas snang ba thams cad dang khyad par bden 'dzin shas che ba rnams la ched cher bsgom/ de yang 'di zhi gnas grub rjes lhag mthong bsgom pa yin pas thog mar skabs 'ga' zhig tsam du lhag mthong phal cher zhi gnas/ de yang zhi gnas je nyung dang lhag mthong je mang yang lhag mthong stobs ches rtsub na/ zhi gnas je mang bsgom pas ji zhig ltar la cha mnyam par 'gyur/ de ltar 'jug ldog yang yang bsgom pas dbang po rab gyis mtha' bral rjes mthun gyi shes rab dang sems gnas pa ro mnyam du 'gyur/dbang po dman pas ni/ de nas stong pa'i gdeng de la/ mi dmigs par zhen pa —269

med pas mnyam par 'jog pa sogs sngar bzhin bsgom pas 'grub bo/ de la sgom nas rjes thob tu yang de 'dra'i ting nge 'dzin te yang yang dran zhing las la 'jug ste/ tshul 'di dang ldan bzhin pas sbyin sogs spyad pas ni/ rnam par mi rtog ye shes ldan/ zhes pa la phyogs par 'gyur gyi/ mi rtog pa tsam pos ni ma yin no/ /de nas rin chen bzang po lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin dang / rab 'byams rgya mtsho dang / yang dag pa'i mtha'i ting nge 'dzin rnams kyi nang gi dbye ba so so nas rim bzhin bsgom pa'i chos mchog gi bar du bgrod par 'gyur la/ 'di dag yi ge mang bas 'jigs nas ma bris so/ /skyes bu che zhes rab tu grags smra bas/ /phyogs 'di mkhas mang go mtshams bral ba bzhin/ /brtags tshe ji ltar mchod sbyin 'os/ /de ltar snying po med pas nyon mongs so/ /de'i phyir re zhig chog go /da ni kun rdzob byang sems bsgom tshul bshad de/ de la 'di ni thams cad kyis bsgom par bya'o/ /de yang bdag dang 'gro ba thams cad sangs rgyas thob par bya snyams pa'i blo'i shugs dang bcas/ thog mar sems can rnams kyi sdug bsngal dang / de las thar bar mi nus pa'i 'gro ba rmongs pa rnams dran bzhin pas 'di rnams snying re rje/ sdug bsngal bskyabs/ bde ba la 'god par bya zhes yang yang bsgom/ de'i snying rje mi skye na sems can thams cad pha mar shes par drin dran pa'i sgo nas dang / 'di rnams chos kun bden med khong du ma chud pas/ las ngan bsags pa'i dbang las sdug bsngal la spyod pa 'di lta bu kye ma snyam du yang yang bsam/ de la gom nas skye dka' ba gnod byed rnams la sngar bzhin du sgom de'i kyang mi skye na/ yang 'di dag bdag chos la bskul ba'o —270

snyam du drin dran bzhin pas bsgom/ gzhan yang 'di dag la pha ma kho na yin pa la ma rig pas 'khyams nas/ bdag la gnod pa byas pas ngan song du lhung ba 'dug pas snying rje snyam pa yang yang du bsgom pas zhe sdang gis brdzi bar mi nus so/ /des kyang ma skyes na gzugs brje zhing bsgoms pas skye bar 'gyur te/ de dag la goms nas/ yang snying rjes bskul nas sangs rgyas kun la gsol ba btab nas dngos su byon nas chos gsung ba dang / 'od zer spro ba la sogs pas skad cig de la sems can gcig kyang ma lus par sangs rgyas thob par bsgom/ khyad par gnod byed gdon dang dgra sogs la gtso cher bsgom par bya ste/ de ltar na 'di dag bdag gzhan mnyam pa bsgom tshul lo/ /gal te ches mchog tu gyur pa brje ba bsgom par 'dod na/ dbugs rngub pa dang lhan cig sems can gyi sdig sdug len/ dbyung ba dang lhan cig rang gi bde dge sems can la sbyin par bya ste tshul 'di sngon gyi dam pa ches mang ba rnams kyis rgya cher gsungs so/ /de'i skabs su mgon po spyan ras gzigs phyag bzhi pa la mchod pa la sogs pa bya ste/ slob dpon du bud+dhā gu h+ya sogs kyis mdzad pa'i maṇ+ḍal gyi cho gar blta'o/ /bsgom tshul sngags las 'byung ba ltar mdor bsdus su bshad na/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed/ stong par sbyangs/ pad zla la/ hrīḥlas mgon po spyan ras gzigs phyag bzhi pa/ phyag dang po gnyis thal mo sbyar ba/ 'og ma gnyis shel 'phreng dang pad+ma dkar po 'dzin pa/ rdo rje skyil krung can/rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa ye shes kyi sku can zhig mdun du lam gyis grub par bsgom/ gnas gsum du yi ge 'bru gsum/ thugs gar hrīḥrnams bkod/—271—

ye shes pa dgug gzhug bya/ dbang bskur rigs bdag gi rgyas btab nas/ sgorme ma ṇi pad+me hūṃ/ zhes bzlasate/ mdun bskyed kyi thugs rgyud bskul/ thugs ga'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros sems can thams cad la phog pas sangs rgyas thob par bsgom/ yang na jo bo kha sar pa ni dkar po mchog sbyin dang pad+ma can rol stabs su bzhugs pa bsgom nas bzlas pa'i tshe/ oṃ uhrīḥswāhā/ zhes bzla ba ni/ khyad par tsam yin la gzhan 'dra'o/ /de la sems cung zad brtan nas rang yang de ltar sgom/ de yang brtan nas dngos po thams cad rje btsun lo ki shwa rar bsgom/ de dag gis skabs thams cad snying rje kho na bsgom par bya ste/ snying rjes bogs dbyung pa'o/ /mdor na de ltar byang chub kyi sems rnam pa gnyis re zhig res 'jog res 'jog tu bsgom/ phyi nas gcig gis gcig la rgyas btab kyin bsgom pas ji zhigoge ltare la ro mnyam du 'gyur ro/ /de kun la thun mgor yan lag bdun pa la nan tan dang / mjug tu rgyal ba dang sar bzhugs kyi sems dpa' rnams kyi zhal snga nas mdzad pa'i smon lam yang dag pa gdab par bya'o/ /'ga' zhig lam 'di rgyas 'debs kyis bcings pa yid la byed pa'i dus 'da' ba rnam rtog gi dri ma la zhen pa'o zhes smra ba dag 'byung srid na'ang / dam pa'i chos la rgyal ba nyid tshad ma yin la phan pa'i blo kho nas bris pa'i phyir dang / log par gces pa med pas mi 'jigs so/ /'di skad kyang bsam skad/ bdag 'dzin 'dul ba nyid kyi phyir/ /rtog pas bcing pa nyid na'ang bla/ /gzhan du rmongs pa'i rang bzhin las/ /grogs dag thar pa yod dam ci/ /nyon mongs skyes tshe gnyen pos ma phyin na/ /chos kyi dgos pa stong zhes dam —272

ru pas gsungs/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi gsungs las phyir phyogs na/ /ji ltar bsgom chen yin zhes bsam pa'i rigs/ /'gro 'di 'bor bar spyod la rab dga' bas/ /log par spyod la nye bar brgyug pa mthong / /lus med pho nya'i rnam 'phrul dpag med pas/ /dam chos rjes 'brang 'di na smon byed pa/ /yid 'ong tshul khrims dri bsrung thos mang po'i/ /'dab rgyas la 'od sgrub pa'i snying po can/ /nag po'i rtsa lag ma ṣi dir mi mos/ /ngan skyug khong bur brgyug pa de yi lugs/ /legs ldan legs byas phrag can gyis/ /gang gi zhabs zung nyer bsten nas/ /'bum phrag bstod dbyangs 'dab brgya'i 'phreng bcas phyogs grol bkang nas mchod byas pa/ /bcom ldan de yi bka' drin dran pas rtag tu phyag 'tshal nam yang skyongs / /snyirnga nas khyod las skyabs gzhan spangs nas khyod kyi gsung bzhin bsgrub par shog /lam mdor bsdus pa rdzogs so// //bdag gi 'di dang ma lus dge ba yi/ /ma gyur sems can tshogs rnams ma lus pa/ /myur du bla med byang chub sku gsum dngos/ /rtag cing bde ba'i go 'phang myur thob shog khwakya'i dge slong kun dga' snying pos rtsa ba sngags dang sbyar ba las/ mkhyen yang ma'i dbang po'i bkas bskul te rgyas 'grel sbyar ba'o/ /rang lo bcu dgu pa la li khaṃ ti/ oṃ a thamaṅga lo ya peṣ+ṭi kai ku sa o su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swāhā/ /maṅga lo// //

oṃ swā sti/ bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa la/ /nyon mongs lam du byed pa yod/ /bde bas bde ba 'grub 'gyur cizhing / /'dod chags kyis ni 'dod chags dag /su ka sidha'i zhal na re/ /gzhan lus lam du len pa la/ /rig ma brtag cing dgug pa dang / /bde ba sgom pa gsum du bzhed/ /dang po rig ma brtag pa ni/ /dpral bar sme ba dkar po yod/ /de ni kyā bzang mor balko/ /nag po yod na rdo rje'i rigs/ /ser po rat+na sngon po las/ /dmar po yod pa pad+ma'i rigs/ /kun kyang rnam snang rigs la byed/ /lte bar sme ba yod pa dang / /dpral bar rtse gsum yod pa ni/ /rin chen 'byung ldan rigs su 'dod/ /de la'ang nang tshan rigs lnga yod/ /mgrin pa'i dbus su sme ba can/ /thabs kyi reg na mi bzod pa/ /'od dpag med pa'i rigs su 'dod/ /rna ba g.yon par sme ba can/ /don yod grub pa'i rigs yin gsungs/ /nu 'phrag dbus su smre bas mtshan/ /mi 'khrugs pa yi rigs yin te/kha dog bya ba mi 'dra lnga/ /kun la yod de nyer lnga yin/ /gzhan yang dkar po bud+dha'i rigs/ /dkar la dmar ba pad+ma'i rigs/ /las kyi rigs dang rdo rje'i rigs/ /gnyis ka sngo bsangs yin zhes gsungs/ sha mdog dmar ba rin chen rigs/ /bud+dha'i rigs ni bde ba bul/ /'khul ba bzang ste zlos pa sla/ /rat+na de dang 'dra ba las/ /'dzin pa sla ba'i yon tan yod/ pad+ma'i rigs ni bde ba myur/ /chags par byed la'ang bsngags pa yin/ /las rigs bde ba brtan —274

pa dang / /rdo rje'i rigs ni gsal la dwangs/ /'di gnyis rjes ni bzang bar 'dod/ // gnyis pa dgug par bya ba ni/ /mi bskyod pa la gzugs brnyan bya/ /rak+ta dang ni ghi hang gi /ming rus bris la snying khar gzhug /zangs kyi khab bam rtags kyis ni/ /bha gar bskul zhing zhag bdun bsgrub/ /lte ba'i 'khor lo bcug nas ni/ /gnas pa med pa rnam gsum sgom/ /chags pas dwangs ma 'dzag par bsam/ /de yang yi ge lnga la stim/ /a ha ri ni sa che ge mo khug / rnam shes breng breng dung dung / /bdag gis dbang du bsdus/ /a ha ri ni sa/ zhag bdun bar du sgrub nas ni/ /sngags kyis btab pa'i bza' btung byin/ /des ni dbang du 'du bar nges/ /gsum pa bde ba sgom pa ni/ /dbab dang bzung dang zlog pa dang / /dgram dang rlung dang bsre ba dang / /ye shes chen por bskyel ba'o/ kha cig 'dod yon lnga po la/ /rim bzhin slob par 'dod mod kyang / /dus gcig dag tu 'byung ba'i phyir/ /cig car slob pa bzang bar bzhed/ khung zad grub cing rtsol ba na/ /nor bu hūṃ gyis bkag par bsam/ /'gyur ba bzhi yis 'dzin pa yin/ /zin pas dka' na thig le ni/ /hūṃ gis phul nas hūṃ gis 'dren/ /spyi bor han han bstim par bsam/ /sprug cing gling bzhi 'phangs ba dang / /gnyis ga'i bo dhi zhu bar bya/ /de nas bdun srub rgya mtsho sbyar/ rtu gis drag tu drangs par bya/ shes rab 'od du zhu nas ni/ /rdo rje'i lam nas rang lus khyab/ /'ol ma se'i mdog 'dra ba/ /rang nyid bkrag mdangs rgyas par mos/ /de'i chos 'byung dbus su ni/ khyur khyur nyams su myong nas kyang / /zug ngur bcas pa 'byung bar 'gyur/ /rdo rje thal mo pus btsug —275

gnyis/ /bzlog pa'i las la bsngags pa yin/ /lcags 'bar dang ni re mos phra/ /dgram pa'i man ngag yin par bzhed/ /thig le rlung la bsre ba'i phyir/ /bum can tshar 'ga' sgom par bya/ /dbyings su bskyel bar byed pa ni/ /sems ni mi rtog nam mkha' 'dra/ /snang ba bden med sgyu ma bzhin/ /rlung gi ciyon tan sems la thim/ gsang sngags gnad kyi gdams pa ni/ /skal med rnams la sba bar bya/ 9ni/ 1na mo gu sa rdza'i sbal ba'i nang du ming rus bris la gzhug yungs dkar bdun nang du gzhug bdun sbal pa'i 'og tu bcug /rang phag mo'i thugs ka nas pho nya mang po sprul/ khams gsum dbang du bsdus par bsam la ngag bcad de/ swahā sbal sha khol/ tsag tsag dung dung / 'dur 'dur med yed/m+me mo'i tsit+ta dkrug /bdag gis dbang du gyur cig /ces sems ma g.yengs bar rab zhag gcig /'bring gnyis/ tha ma gsum/ rmi lam du bud med 'du ba/khrom 'tshogs pa/ gter rnyed pa sogs 'byung ngo / /las spyor ni nyi ma dmar thag chod pa ni/ rdzas la sngags stong tsam bzlas/ rab phyi'i nyungs dkar gtor ba/ 'bring sha la brlan pa tsam dang / tha ma'ang sbal pa lus la thebs na the tshom med/ lus 'byor ba dang/ sems mi gnas pa yong nyin yod/ de la 'dod pa spyod pas sel/ grol bar 'dod na gangs chu grang mo lus la rgyag /sngags mgo mjug bzlog /sbal tshob bcag /ming rus spos chus khrus byas pas grol bar 'gyur ro/ ñcā/2na mo gu sa klod dang 'gyur bzhi gzhom pa ste/ /'dzin pa rnam pa gsum du 'dod/ /rdo rje khu tshur thal mo pus btsug dang / /rtsal sprug khong 'dren —276

rta zhon tshul/ /'dren pa'i zhabrul 'khor rnam lnga'o/ /dgram pa'i zhabrul 'khor rnam dgu ni/ /dang por mgo lcogs 'phar sprug bya/ /gnyis ka rkang lag re mos 'khrab/ /gsum pa dpung 'dzin zhi sprug rdebs/ /bzhi pa mkhal mnan pho ba bskor/ /lnga drug lag sprug gan rkyal 'khrab/ /bdun pa sug bzhi g.yas g.yon 'then/ /brgyad dgu brkyang bskum gyen rkyal rgyangs/ / lus kyi 'dug stangs 'khrul 'khor gyis/ /yang dag ting 'dzin bskyed pa 'di/ / mkha' 'gro bde ba'i dngos grub dang / /dpal ldan gang ga dha ri dang / /ḍa ki kun du bzang mo yi/ /dgongs pa gcig tu gung spros pa/ /rtogs ldan zhang sgom gsung bzhin du/ /lhag chad med par bkod pa'o/ ñcā/3'gyur ba bzhi ni/ rgya mtsho ri rab la gcer pa/ gling bzhi dbang du bsdu ba/ dar po che rang gnas su 'char ba/ nyi zla nam mkhar bzung ba ste bzung pa'o/ /bzlog pa ni/ rdo rje thal mo spyi bor 'then la/ rlung sems nam mkhar 'phang pa'o/ /yang pus mo dang rdo rje khu tshur btsugs la hag hig hog ces snying kha/ mgrin pa spyi bo rnams su drangs so/ khyab par byed pa la langs te mgo la thal lcag re mos su rdeg pa dang / 'phags shing lag pa'ang sprug go/gnyis pa ni rgur nas rkang lag re mos su 'khrab bo/ /mkha' 'gro su ka sidhi'i gdams pa'o/ ñcā/ 4'dzin pa'i klod pa'i man ngag ni/ lus sems khong klod cing srin zhal yan pa'o/ /bzlog pa ni lus sprug ste/ rlung phyir 'phang srin pos 'then/ khu tshur brla la btsugs te 'dren no/ /yang gnyis pa ni/ lag pa gnyis kyi phan tshun du dpung pa bzung nas/ smad kyi rlung khong nas drangs so / /'gram pa la dang —277

po/ lag pa gnyis kyis dpung ba bzung la pho khar bsnol bzhi sprug byas nas mchan khung dang 'phongs tshos rdeb pa'o/ /yang khu tshur mkhal ma'i thad du btsugs la 'pho ba bskor/ gsang bar gcog cing g.yas g.yon 'then no/ /yang langs nas lag pa gnyis sprug go /yang cung zad gan rkyal du byas nas sug bzhi 'khrab bo/ /gang ga dha ra'i lugs/ lkog/ 5na mo gu sa bo dhi tsit+ta bzung 'dod na/ /chags pa'i dang po dbyings su gzhom/ /rlung yang rang yan lus kyang klod/ /dga' ba'i rang zhal lta bar byed/ /des ni grol bar the tshom med/ /lag pa gcig brkyang gcig shos ni/ khu tshur dpung pa'i thad du bcangs/ /rkang pa gcig shos btsugs nas ni/ /gcig ni rta la 'god tshul byed/ kha spyor stong du 'then par bya/ /gnas su bskyel ba'i man ngag yin/ /yan lag sug bzhi btsugs nas ni/ /g.yas g.yon dbus su rdeg cing 'then/ /gdungs sna la 'jug dpyangs nasani/ /lusakyang brkyang bskum drag tu bya/ /rtsa mig gnas su 'debs pa yin/ /mkha' 'gro kun tu bzang mo'i lugs/ khri/ 6na mo gu sa gsang sngags mgyogs byed pho nya'i lam/ /blo ngan rnams la mi bstan te/ /dug chen ha la ha la 'gyur/ /dper na bcud chen 'o mi nga / /gdug pa'i sprul la blud pa 'dra/ /'ga' zhig chos la skur ba 'debs/ yang na chos kyi gang zag brlag /de bas snod ldan 'tshol ba gces/ /rig ma mtshan ldan rnyed sla ste/ /rten gyi gang zag shin tu dkon/ /rab ni mngon shes stobs kyi brtag /'bring ni mkha' 'gro'i lung bstan tshol/ /tha ma rten gyi gang zag ste/ /bla mas gcig gsung sgrub nus shing / /chos kyi phyir du dka' ba spyod/ /ngo tsha che —278

zhing sdig pa 'dzem/ /brtson 'grus che zhing gsang thub pa/ /chos phyir 'bad med gtong nus na/ /skal ldan de rang yin zhes gsung / /'di la rig ma brtag pa dang / /rtsa 'tshol ba dang rtsa bskyed dang / /sbyangs dang las la sbyar ba dang / /mthar thug sgom pa drug tu bzhed/ /de la dang po brtag pa ni/ /dung can ma ni bde ba myur/ /de yi dpral ba mgrin pa dang / /snying kha lte ba skye gnas te/ /gnas lnga de dag gang rung du/ /dung dang 'dra ba'i ri mo yod/ /glang chen ma ni sme ba smug /stong nyid bsgom na bogs su che/ /pad+ma can ni bde ba rgyas/ /lus la thig le'i ri mo 'byung / /ri mo dgur por rgyab sprod du/ /yod na ri dwags can ma yin/ /bde ba mi che shin tu brtan/ /ri mo can la ṭi mi ni/ /drang po phal cher gsum sgrigs yod/ /gnas su dkyil ba shin tu sla/ /lcug phran ma la lnga yod de/ /gsal nyams mthar dbus med par 'char/ /chos 'byung ma ni chos 'byung gzugs/ /zag bcas bde ba shugs dang ldan/ /gnyis pa na mi 'tshol ba ni/ /spyi bor gla rtsi tsan+dan dmar/ /til mar gsum po bsres pas mnye/ /rgyab bstan steng du khal bsnol dang / stonang leb dang ni ska rags bsdams/ /k+ṣu yig gnas su 'phying bu bzhag /des ni rtsa de rnyed par 'gyur/ /sbom na pun da ri ka yi/ /rtsa ba dgos te mi rnyed de/ khug chos ba dkar 'o ma dang / /ka ra mar gsar rgya tsang tshil/ /chang dang sbyar ba byug na ni/ /phra zhing shin du rno bar 'gyur/ /gsum pa rtsa ni skyed pa la/ /na chen chu bor phyung nas ni/ /dga' ba'i dmar por bcud dug gtso/ kha ru tsha dag shin shin btabs/ /yang na mkha' lding rgya gtsang btags/ /ra mo sha dang dkar gsum dang / /thabs shes dam rdzas brten pa yis/ /gnyis ka lus bzung skyed par bya/ /bzhi pa sngon 'gro sbyangs pa ni/ /gzugs snang sgyu —279

mar shes bya zhing / /ngag ni las rlung khegs par bya/ /sems ni 'dzin med nam mkha' 'dra/ /ma rtogs 'gro drug sems can la/ /snying rje mkha' khyab sgom pa gces/ /lnga pa las la sbyar ba ni/ /dang po gzugasal lta ba dang / /gnyis pa sgra la bslabs pa dang / /gsum pa dri zhim bde ba rgyas/ /bzhi pa lus kyi reg bya dang / /ro mchog khyad par myong ba ni/ /'byud dang tsim pa bha gar reg /lnga pa snyoms par 'jug pa yin/ /rtsa sna rig na rkang pa brkyang / /thung na phrag par skal ba yin/ /phyogs bzhir rdo rjes btsal bya zhing / /cig shos kyis kyang 'og rlung bskum/ /srog rtsol mnan pas gter bar bya/ /'pho 'pho 'dra na klod par gces/ /mig ni gyen du lta bar bya/ /cig shos sked pa nyag gis btang / /rlung ni gsang bar phul ba na/ /bde ba zin par the tshomi med/ /nyams te yal du mi 'jug par/ /yang yang dbab par bya ba las/ /bde ba klod par mi nus na/ /lag pa sogs kyi klod rnga ra bzhed/ /rtsa sprug byed cing khong nas 'dren/ /mkhal mnan pho ba bskor ba dang / /lag pa sprug cing gan rgyal 'khrub/ /gnas su bzlog cing gnas su khrems/ /drug pa mthar thug sgom pa ni/ /rig pa dwangs snyigs phye ba na/ /bde ba rang gi rig pa tsam / /rig pa gsal stong brjod du med/ /nam mkha'i dbyings dang mnyam par bsre/ /mkha' 'gro gang ga dha ra dang / /rje btsun rin chen lha mo gnyis/ / yi dam zhal gzigs dngos grub brnyes/ /gdams pa mkha' 'gro'i bstan pa yin/ lkog/ 7na mo gu sa man ngag zab mo smin mdzad pa'i/ /bla ma sangs rgyas zhabs la 'dud / /mgyogs byed las kyi phyag rgya'i lam/ /mkha' 'gro'i snying khrag lta bu la/ /kun du bzang mo'i zhal na re/ /seṅge'i 'o ma 'dra zhesagasungs//—280

dper na seṅge'i 'o ma ste/ /phal ba'i snod du blug pa na/ /snod kyang 'chag la bcud kyang 'bo/ /rin chen snod du byug na ni/ /dri zhim ro mchog lhag par 'phel/ /brten dang rtsa stobs rgyas par 'gyur/ /'dod chags tha mal nyon mongs 'di/ /skye bo kun la dug yin zhing / /lam du longs na 'chi med ster/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas byang sems kyi/ /yon tan ma lus thams cad kyang / /lhan skyes bde ba che las byung / /bde ba kun+da yin pas na/ /las rgya lam du byed pa bsngags/ /'di la mtshan nyid brtag pa dang / /skem dang bde gnas 'tshol ba dang / /sad dang las la sbyar ba ste/ /rtses mgo rnam pa lnga ru bzhed/ /dang po rigs ni ma gsungs kyang / /brten rgyu rung ste de ltar yang / /rab 'bring tha ma'i khyad par yod/ /mchu la bha ga brtag par bya/ /srab dang rgyas dang bar mas yin/kha yis dkyus la cig 3(sa brtag /dgu la sor lnga lhag pa spangs/ /bcu drug la yang 'gyud gang dang / /rtsal rdzogs na yang nyi shu'o/ /de bas ring ba ma brten no/ /man chad bsten du rung ba yin/ /bde bas mtshan nyid mig la brtag /mig dkyus ring zhing mig 'bras snum/ /sri la 'dzum pa yod na bzang / /nu ma dang ni skra dag las/ /gus dang mi gus brtag tu rung / /li na bzang ste ser na 'bring / /nag cing rtsub pa tha ma yin/ /zlum po bzang ste rno ba 'bring / khren tu 'phyang na mi bzang ngo / /ol mdud sbom zhing snying gi spu/ /'dug na gsang sgrogs thub pa 'ong / /chos 'byung ba spu spangs pa rab/ /ser kham 'bring dang nag po ngan/ /rus sbal dkar zhing nang dmar ma/ /de ni mchog tu 'dod pa yin/ /smug pa 'bring yin gzhan ni spangs/ /lce dang snying la kha dog dang / /mchan khung las ni ba spu brtag /skem ni rgya skyegs khu ba ste/ /chu rtse'i me la skol —281—

nas ni/ /spang rgyan me tog btab pa 'thung / /gnyer po che ni gser gyis bsres/ /bha gar chu bcag btab pa dang / /ber ga sor ni brgyad pa yi/ tshang ra bcos so dal bus brdung / /gsum pa bde gnas 'tshol ba ni/ /bcos ma'i 'ob las phyi dang ni/ /nang du yang yang reg par bya/ /gang la ngo gcig byung ba der/ /rdo rje dbyings phyug yod pa yin/ /bzhi pa sad par bya ba ni/ /mig ni gyen bstan lag pa gnyis/ /pus mo dag la bkab par bya/ /hūṃ yig ring po ring po'i mthar/ /hig ni mang du brgyud pa yin/ /de 'dra yang yang sbyangs nas ni/ /'og sgo 'byed 'grum sbyor ba las/ /gsang ba'i gnas su btsud par bya/ /de nas lan gcig lcam pa yi/ /rkang gi rtsal te yang yang drangs/ /'byed 'dzum sbyor bas yang yang dbyung / /'di la rtagasasu thon na ni/ /dngos gzhi'i las la 'jug par byed/ /lnga pa las la sbyar ba ni/ /dang por glu dang dga' tshig nyan/ /de rjesalus kyi cha la brtag /de rjesaku re 'khrig tshig dang / /de nas rtse 'jo sna tshogasadang / /de 'og phyi yi reg bya ste/ /lag bcings mo dang 'byud pa dang / /so dang sen mo 'debs pa dang / /bde reg byed cing pha rol 'drud/ /de nas snyoms par 'jug pa ste/ /chags spyod bdun du bzhed pa yin/ /rus sbal 'gros kyi 'bebs par bya/ /skad cig de la phrad gzhom dang / /steng pa gser gling gnas su bzhag /des ni brten par 'gyur ba yin/ /rta zhen tshul gyis gnas su bskyal/ /sug bzhi g.yas g.yon 'then nas ni/ /brkyang bskum bya zhing gan rkyal rgyangs/ /de 'dras rtsa mig dag tu 'debs/ /lus gnad rnam snang chos bdun las/ /sems ni mi rtog mtha' dbus med/ /ngag ni rang babs 'gro 'ongs bral/ /chags med mnyam par bzhag pa las/ /bde ba chen med ngo —282

mtshar che/ /dbyings su skyil ba'i gdams ngag yin/ ñcā/ 8 na mo gu māgasang sngags bde ba lam byed ni/ /rnam rtog nyid kyi rnam rtog dang / /srid pa nyid kyi srid pa dag /ji ltar me yi tshig pa la/ /me yi yang ni gdung bar bya/ /de bzhin 'dod chags mes tshig pa/ /'dod chags mes ni gdung bar bya/ /zhes gsung gnad du che na yang / /las rgya brten pa mi nus na/ /yid kyi sgom nas sbyor bar bzhed/ /snang stong sgyu ma lta bu la/ /'bad rtsol med par byang bar gces/ /gzhan du thar med gnas su lhung / /rang shar lha sku'i lam khyer bya/ /tshogs zlum byin gyis rlobs pa yin/ /rtsa yig sngags kyis byin gyis rlobs/ /bar chad mi 'jug lam du 'gro/ /gzung du med cing thob pa med/ /byar med nam mkha'i dbyings dang mnyam/ /chos nyid 'od gsal rtogs par 'gyur/ /bla ma shangs pa chen po des/ /ma rgyud spyi yi rdzogs rim gnad/ /mkha' 'gro rnam pa gsum gyis ni/ /zhal gdams thugs la chud par mdzod/ /rtogs ldan zhad sgom chos seng gis/ /bla ma chen po de la ni/ /lus kyi zhabs rtog phul ba dang / /sgrub pa nyams myong shar ba yin/ /sgrub pa'i me tog skrungs pa'i dus/ /pad+ma steng du thugs bcud gnang / /de la bla ma rin chen gyis/ /rkang thag spangs te gsan pa yin/ /byin rlabs brgyud ldan man ngag 'di/ / slob bu'i don du gsal bar bkod/ /mkha' 'gro rnam gsum gyi man ngag rdzogs so// //maṅga lo/ /—283

༄tsho/ /mkha' 'gro rnam gsum gyi zhal gdams gung bsgrigs te nyams su len bde ba bzhugs/ — ri.oṃ swā sti/ mkha' 'gro rnam gsum gyi ri bong dbab bzung la ni/ don gsum ste/ rig ma brtag cing dgug pa dang / sta gon sbyangs pa las la sbyar ba 'phros dang bcas pa'o/ /dang po ni/ dkar mo dpral bar sme —ba yod pa —budhe'i rigs/ dmar mo lte bar sme ba yod pa dpral bar rtse gsum yod pa rin chen rigs/ dkar la dmar ba mgrin par sme ba can/ skyes pas reg na mi bzod pa pad+ma'i rigs/ sngo bsangs nu phrag dog pa rna ba g.yon pa la sme ba can las kyi rigs/ sngo bsangs snying ga la sme ba can thugs kyi rigs yin no/ /zhes su ka sirnyi'i gsung ngo / /dung can ma la gnas lnga po gang rung du dung dang 'dra ba'i ri mo yod pa/ glang chen ma der sme ba smug po yod pa/ pad+ma can ma thig le'i ri mo yod pa/ ri dwags can ma ri mo sgur po rgyab sprod du yod pa/ ri mo can ma la ri mo drang po gsum/ lcug phran ma la lnga/ chos 'byung ma la gru gsum 'byung ba'o/ /de dag la bde ba myur ba dang / stong nyams che ba dang / bde ba rgyas pa dang / bde ba 'bring ba dang / thig le 'dzin sla ba dang / gsal nyams che ba dang / bde ba shug che ba rnams kyi dgos pa yod/ ces gang ga dha ras gsung ngo / /yang kha'i mchu la bha ga brtag /mchu 'thug ma bha ga sha rgyas/ kha che chung la bha ga che chung yod/ bha ga ni lo dgu la sor lnga/ bcu drug la mkhyud gang / nyi shu —284

la sor bcu gnyis che tshad yin/ /de las dkyus ring ba mi brten no/ /bde ba che chung mig la brtag ste/ mig dkyus ring zhing mig 'bras nag pa/ sri kha dang mig 'dzum yod na bzang / skra dang nu ma legs na bdag po la gus te/ skra li na rab/ ser na 'bring / nag po rkyang pa tha ma'o/ /nu ma 'bur zhing zlum na rab/ rno ba 'bring / 'phyang ba tha ma'o/ /ol mdud dang snying spu 'dug na gsang thub par 'ongs/ bha ga yang spu med pa dang / nag po 'thug po dang / ser kham gsum rab mtha' 'bring / bha ga phyi dkar la nang dmar ba dang / smug pa dang / sngo ba rnams spyir sha mdog dkar ba gzhir bzhag pa la rab 'bring tha ma ste/ lce dang snying las bha ga'i kha dog dang / mchan khung gi spu las de'i spu brtag dgos te/de dang de dag mtshungs par 'ong ngo / /zhes kun tu bzang mos gsungs so/ /drug pa ni/ bu mo de'i chu shul gyi sa la gzugs brnyan byas/ snying khar gi haṃ dang pad+ma rak+tas ming rus bris pa'i sgo/ga dril gzhug /dgugs gzhug bya/zangs kyi ling ga'am/ khab kyis bha ga 'tshag cing / ha ri ni sa m+me mo khugarnam shes breng breng dung dung bdag gi dbang du bsdus/ zhes zhag bdun bzlas pa'i bza' btung byin na dbang du 'dus so/ /yang ye shes mkha' 'gro ma su ka sirnyi'i gnyan ston la dngos su gnang ba'i dgug pa zab mo ni/ rdzas sbal pa'i ming rus bris la gzhug /yungs dkar bdun nang du gzhug /bdun sbal pa'i 'og tu bcug /rang phag mo'i thugs ka nas pho nya dmar mo mang po spros/ khams gsum dbang du bsdus par bsam la/ ngag bcad de/ swāhā sbal sha khol/ tsag tsag /dung dung / 'dur 'dur yed yed m+me mo'i tsit+ta dkrugs/ bdag gi dbang —285

du gyur cig /ces sems ma g.yeng bar rab zhag gcig /'bring gnyis/ tha ma gsum/ rmi lam du bud med 'du ba/ khrom 'tshogs pa/ gter rnyed pa sogs 'byung ngo / /las sbyor ni nyi ma dmar thag chod pa na/ rdzas la sngags stong tsam bzlas/ rab phyi'i nyungasadakar gtor ba/ 'bring sha la brlan pa tsam dang / tha ma'i sbal ba lus la thebs na the tshom med/ lus 'khyor ba dang sems mi gnas pa yongs nyen yod/ de la 'dod pa spyad pas sel/ grol bar 'dod na gangs chu grang mo lus la rgyab/ sngags mgo 'jug bzlog /sbal ba bcag /ming rus spos chus khrus byas pas phrol bar 'gyur ro/ /rtsa 'tshol ba ni/ spyi bor gla rtsi/tsan+dan dkar po/ til mar gsum bsres pas mnyes/ rga shing steng du mkhal ma gnon pa dang / shing leb dang ske rag bsdoms/ bshang lam du 'be ldogs 'phying bu bcug pas bha ga'i mkhur sha nu ma 'dra bar 'gro/ rtsa'i rtse mor rib rib 'ong / yang na bcos ma'i rdo rjes phyi nas btsags/ nang du bskor bas rtsa yod par phrad pa la 'khun zhing sdang yed pa 'ong / rtsa sbom na pad+ma dkar po'i rtsa ba dgos te bod du mi rnyed pas/ yug chos me tog rtsa ba bcas pa/ ba dkar po'i 'o ma/ ka ra/ mar sar/ gangs sbal/ da byid smug po'i tshil sbyar ba byug pa'am/ chang dang sbyar pad+mar dag pas phra bar 'gyur ro/ /rgya tshos kyi khu ba chu rtsa'i me la skol/ spangs rgyan me tog btab pa gas pa dang / gnyer po cher gser gyi me rtsa byed pa/ bha gar chu dugs dang / 'phongs tshos la ber gas dal bus brdung ba sogs ni srid rgyun skem pa'o/ /gnyis pa bum pa can brtan po sgom pa yin na/ zhabrul 'khor rnams las la sbyar ba'i skabs su dgos na'ang /—286

da lta nas sbyang dgos pas thams cad la rlung 'khrab sngon du gtong bar shes par bya'o/ /'dzin pa la gsum gyi dang po klod pa ni/ lus sems khong klod/srin po la yan pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ rgya mtsho bcer ba sogs 'gyur ba bzhi'o/ /gsum pa sems kyi 'khrul 'khor te/ bde ba'i ngo bo la bltas nas klod pa'o/ /bzlog pa la lnga'i dang po ni/ spyi bor rdo rje thal mo 'then la/ stong 'dren byas la sems nam mkhar 'phang ngo / /langs te lan gsum skyed cing stong 'dren byed/ gnyis pa ni/ pus btsugs rdo rje khu tshur mdun du btsugs la hag hig tog ces/ snying kha mgrin pa/ spyi bo rnams su drang ngo / /gsum pa ni rtsal sprugs kyi mthar/ steng rlung phyir 'phangs / thur sel 'then/ skyil krung rdo rje khur tshur brla sgang la btsugs te rgang 'dren bya'o/ /bzhi pa ni sems skyil stod skyil bcas nas/ smad kyi rlung khong 'dren dang / sto 'dren bya'o/ /lnga pa ni lag pa g.yon brkyang/ g.yas dpung par khu tshur bcangs/ rkang pa rta la g.yon zhen byed tshul gyis/ g.yon nas rkang 'then bya/ de nyid mgo bzlog re'ang bya'o/ /dgram pa la dgu las/ dang po ni/ langs te slar bsdad thal mo rtsegs lag pa brkyang / mgo bo la thal cag re mos su rdeg pa dang / 'phag cing lag pa'ang sprug go /gnyis pa ni/ sgur la lang rkang lag re mos su 'khrab po/ /gsum pa ni/ skyil krung lag gnyis dpung 'dzin pho khar bsnol/ bzhi sprug byas nas mchan khung rdeb cing 'phags pa'o/ /bzhi pa ni/rdo rje skyil krung dang /rdo rje khu tshur mkhal ma'i thad du btsug la/ g.yas g.yon dbus gsum du brteg cing 'then no/ /brgyad pa ni/ gdung sna sogs la 'jus te brkyang bskum bya'o/ /dgu —287—

pa ni/ gan rkyal dang kha phub rung sug bzhi phyogs bzhir rgyangs nas bcud la bor ro/ /de dag la 'dren kun la smad sgrim stod glod rgya mtsho gcer ba sogs rdzo gang 'grub dgos/ 'grems kun la kha sbyor lus lhod cing 'chun dang ldan pa dgos so/ / kun khyab tu seṅge rnam grol yang bya'o/ /de dag la sdom 'di skad ces bya ste/ glod dang 'gyur bzhi gshom pa ste/ /'dzin pa rnam pa gsum du 'dod/ /rdo rje khu tshur pus btsugs dang / /rtsal sprug khong 'dren rta thon tshul/ /'dren pa'i 'brul 'khor rnam lnga'o/ /dgram pa'i 'brul 'khor rnam dgu ni/ /dang po mgo lcog 'phang sprug bya/ /gnyis pa rkang lag re mos 'khrab/ /gsum pa dpung 'dzin bzhi sprug rdeb/ /bzhi pa mkhal mnan pho ba bskor/ /lnga drug lag sprug gan rkyal phra/ /bdun pa sug bzhi g.yas g.yon 'then/ /brgyad dgu brkyang bskum gan rkyal rgyangs/ /'di dag mkha' 'gro gsum gyi man ngag gung spros pa yin no/ /gsum pa ni/ dbab bzung bzlog dgram rlung dang bsre ba/ ye shes chen por bsre ba'o/ /su kha sirnyi 'dod yon lnga la rims slob mi bzhed/ rga ga dha ra ro la bslab pa nas/ reg bya spyi dang / rdo rje pad+mar reg pa yan chad sdoms pa la thun gcig tu mdzad pa yin/ kun tu bzang mo ni/ glu la nyan pa dang / gzugs la blta' ba dang / ku re byed pa dang / lus kyi rtsed mo dang / lag bcangs dang /'o dang 'byud pa dang / so dang sen mos 'debs pa dang / bde reg byed pa dang /phyi rol du drud pa ste drug /phyi'i reg bya la bslab pa dang / snyoms par 'jug pa —288

de chags spyo da bdun du bzhed do/ /de la rdo rje pad+mar cung zad gsor zhing / nor bur nyu nas po mgo gyen bstan gyis bkag par bsam/ 'dzin pa'i 'khrul 'khor gnyis pas 'dzin pa yin/ zin dka' na hūṃ gi phul nas thig le ba thag lta bu spyi bor lhan lhan bstim par bsam la hūṃ 'dren drag tu bya'o/ /de nas lus kun sprug cing gling bzhi 'phang ba dang / bskyang bskum bya'o/ /yang dang por dal bu dang mthar drag tu srub pas rang dang rig ma gnyis ga'i thig le zhu bar byas/de nas mi srubs par rgya mtsho sbyar te rnyu 'dren drag po byas la/ rig ma 'od du zhu nas rdo rjer drangs te rang lus khyab pas mdangs rgyas par mos/ des shes rab ma'i pad+mar grang sing ba dang / khyur khyur drangs pa'i nyams dang / bde ba zug ngur dang bcas pa mi bzod pa byung na 'dren thub pa'i rtags so/ /su kha'i lugs so/ /yang sha chen dug phyung ba ba dmar po'i 'o mar bcos/ shing kun dang kha ru tshwa btab pa brten/ mchil pa'i sha dang / da byid kyang btang / lug sha dang chang 'jam po dum re brten/ ra mo sha'i kha da dang / zho ma dkrogs pa gza' bas bdag dang rig ma gnyis ka lus zung bskyed/ rtsa ring na rkang pa brkyangs/ thung na rig ma'i rkang pa phrag la bkal nas spyod/ pad+ma'i nang gi g.yas g.yon steng 'og tu rdo rjes drud brud pas rtsa rtsal/ rig mas kyang 'og rlung bskum steng rlung mnon pas rtsa gter bar bya/ thig le 'byung ba snyams byed na 'phongs bsgrad mig gyen du blta'i/ shes rab mas sked pa nyag btang la/ rlung gsang gnas su phul nas zin yongs la de nas drangs/ yang bde ba yal du mi 'jug par bskyod cing 'bebs/ /bde bas sprid nas 'phongs 'byed mi thub na lag pas —289

dbye'o/ /gang ga dha'i lugs so/ /phal cher de dang 'dra ba la mig gyen du gtad/pus mo la lag pa bkab/ hūṃ rang gis mthar hig gi 'dren yun ring sbyangs nas/ lcam pa'i rkang 'jam po rdo rje bu gar cung zad 'jug cing / mthar rtsa bar lhan gyis gtong / de nas de 'dren pa la bslab/ de nas mdun mnan te 'phongs 'byed 'dzum gyis dbyung ba la bslab/ de nas dngos gzhi la 'jug /'dzin pa la sems kyi them bu ste/ 'khrul 'khor gsum pa dang / rting pas gnon pa kho na yin no/ /kun tu bzang mo'i lugs so/ /de nas thams cad la yang rus sbal 'gros kyi phab/ so so'i man ngag gis phyag rgya la sbyor bzhin pa'i ngang nas/ bzung bzlog gang 'grub bya/ de nas 'dren lnga dang 'grems dgu po de rnams ci rigs par bya/ thams cad la seṅge'i rnam rol gang mang byas te/bzlog pa dang khyab par bya'o/ /de nas bum pa can gang mang bsgom ste rlung dang bsre'o/ /ye shes chen por skyel ba ni sgyu lus sbas don dang 'dra'o/ /ma rgyud spyi'i rdzogs rim mkha' 'gro rnam gsum gyi gsang lam bshad zin to// //'di la gzhung shing yig rnying kho na las phyis yi ge gsar pa'i bsre slad med cing / phyis kyi yi ge 'khrul 'khor nyi shu pa dang / nyer gcig zer ba gnyis gda' na'ang /g.yin nas rkus shing khung med la/ phyi ma rnams 'di yang ni gu'i gsang khridayin zer ba ni ches 'khrul lo/ /'di la yig rnying yig chung drug yod do/ smyu/ zhes pa 'di'ang lcags zom chos rje/ rig 'dzin mkha' spyod dbang po'i nyams len du mkho bar bsam nas/ tā ra nā thas smras pa'o/ /—290

bla ma dang yi dam gyis dge bar mdzod cig /lam khyer rnam gsum gcig tu dril nas nyams su len pa'i tshul ni/ sngon 'gro dang rjes chos drug gi sgyu lus ltar bya/ dngos gzhi rang yi dam bde mchog spyi bor bla ma yid dam dbyer med kyi bskur mos shing rnam pa bla ma gsal btab nas/ mos gus drag pos yang gsol 'debs bya/ yang na rnam pa bla mas dbu brgyan pa'i yi dam du sgom yang rung ngo / /de nas dngos dang dran yul du byung ba'i rang gzhan gyi sgra zin ma zin thams cad la bla ma yid dam dbyer med kyi gsung sngags su mos/sems kyi 'char sgo ci byung yang bla ma yid dam dbyer med kyi thugs su mos shing / snang ba thams cad sems dang / sems skye 'gag gnas gsum gdod ma nas stong pa'i rang ngo la cher blta zhing thag chod bya/ de ga'i ngang la dug lnga dang tha mal rnam rtog ci byung rung / de rang gi ngo bo la ngo shes ngang bskyangs pas/ ma spangs rang dag ces bya/ thun mtshams kun la bzla/ snang ba sku/ grags pa gsung rten rtogs thugs su thag chod pa dang / mos gus lha sku/ snang ba rang sems/ sems sgyu ma ltar rang bzhin med pa'am/ dran 'dun rtsa bral lam/min na'ang ngo shes dang ma bral ba'i ngang nas bya/ bla mas rang gnas lugs zab mo la dkri bar mdzad pa'i bka' drin dran pas bla ma yi dam ro gcig pa la mchod bstod yan lag bdun pa bya zhing tshogs bsogs/ 'di la myong ba ci —291—

rigs byung nas/ 'gro drug sgyu mar 'char byed kyi sgyu lus/ rmi lam bzungs sbyangs spel bsgyur ba rnams dang sbrel nas nyams su len pa 'di ni snying pho/ /bla ma lam h+phur la snang ba la brten nas bla ma lam du wor ba dang / de /byeskyin thog tsha 1do ༷༷/ 1de re/nyag lagate :dob du bla ma la mas gus/ la bka' na/ la sa bsags/ la rang shar lam du h+phur/ yi dam lam h+phur la/ snang ba yid dam/ dag snang tshogs bsogs/ rang shar zung khrug gi lha sku dang / sgyu ma lam h+phur la/snang ba rang sems sgyu ma rmi lam/ 'od gsal rang shar rnams lam du h+phur ba ste de ltar shes par bya'o/ /de ltar na snang ba bla ma yi dam du shes/ de rang sems su shes/ de sgyu ma lta bu gsal shing bde ba rang shar ro// //zhes pa 'di yang kun dga' snying po tā ra nā thas sbyar ba'o/ /maṅga lo// //— —292

snying lngasto zhes bya ba bzhugs/na mo gu sto dngos grub 'byung gnas bla ma rin po che/ /skyabs gnas kun 'dus 'gro mgon rin po che/ /gnas lugs don ston chos rje rin po che/ /bdud bzhi 'joms mdzad dpa' bos byin gyis rlobs/ /'dir gcod zab mo nyams su len pa'i gang zag gis/ /nam 'chi cha med dran pas tshe 'di blo yis thong / /chos min bsam rgyu med cidza snying rus zhe bcad che/ /bla mas ci gsung sgrub cing gnyan khrod ri la tshugs/ /rkyen ngan klod la bsre zhing gang byung ro snyoms pa/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar dgos pa lags/ de nas nyams su blang pa'i chos ni 'di yin te/ brgyud pa la mos gus tshugs/ byin rlabs 'pho ba'i dbang bskur thob nas/ 'khrid kyi ngo bo la sngon 'gro/ dngos gzhi rjes gsum mo/ /dang po la skyabs 'gro sems bskyed maṇ+ḍal bla ma'i rnal 'byor dang bzhi las/ dang po rang gi mdun gyi nam mkhar seng khri pad+ma nyi zla'i gdan la/ dbus su rtsa ba'i bla ma/ mdun du yi dam dang sangs rgyas/ g.yas su dam chos kyi ngo bo glegs bam/ g.yon du theg pa che chung gi dge 'dun/ rgyab tu mkha' 'gro chos skyong rnams gsal btab la/ bdag dang mkha' mnyam sems can thams cad kyi skyid sdug tsholegs nyes khyed rang shes bsam pas/ bdag sogs 'gro ba nam —293—

mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems thams cad sangs rgyas gtso la skyabs su mchi/dam pa'i chos la skyabs su mchi/ dge 'dun rnams la skyabs su mchi/ kun 'dus bla ma la skyabs su mchi/ zhes pa dang / sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun gsum la skyabs su mchi/ bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro gsum la skyabs su mchi/rang sems stong pa chos sku gsum la skyabs su mchi/ zhes skyabs 'gro ci nus su bya'o/ /mthar skyabs yul rnams rang la thim/gnyis pa ni/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad la byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems dung ba'i ngang nas/ ma rgan sems can 'di rnams bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu mtha' dag dang ldan par bya'o/ /sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu mtha' dag dang bral bar bya'o/ /myur du bla na med pa'i byang chub re thob par bya'o/ /zhes ngag nas brjod cing yid la bsam mo/ /gsum pa ni/ rang gi mdun du bla ma dang ma cig lab sgron dbyer med pa/mdun du yi dam sogs skyabs yul bzhin gsal btab/ 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad mchod rdzas 'dod yon longs spyod thams cad kyis phyur bur bkang ste/ rang gi lus ngag yid gsum dus gsum dge tshogs dang bcas pa bla ma dkon mchog la phul bar mos la/ maṇ+ḍal tshom bu bdun ma'am gang yang rung ba 'bul zhing / mgo zhabs su maṇ+ḍal rgyas pa re yang 'bul zhing / maṇ+ḍal re re'i mthar bdag gi lus dang longs spyod dang / /dus gsum bsags pa'i dge ba kun/ /bla ma dkon mchog khyed la 'bul/ /thugs rjes dgongs la bzhes su gsol/ /zhes pa lan re re brjod/ —294

bzhi pa ni/ rang gi spyi bor bla ma dang ma cig dbyer med pa bsgom la/snying thag pa nas mos gus drag po bskyed cing / 'di nyid kyi brgyud 'debs kyang spro na bya/ khyad par bdag sogs sems can thams cad bla ma la mos 'dun drag po'i gsol ba 'debs par bsam nas/ mtshan ldan gyi bla ma rin po che/ /bdag la byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ /re sa gzhan na med pas da lta byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ /bdag 'dzin blo yis thongs bar byin gyis rlobs/ /skye med gcig chod du rtogs pa byin gyi rlobs/ /bar chad dngos grub tu longs par byin gyi rlobs/ /bdud tshogs rang sar chod par byin gyi rlobs/ /tshe gcig sangs rgyas 'grub par gyis rlobs/ /zhes gsol ba rtse gcig tu btab/ thun gyi mjug tu/ bla ma 'od du zhu nas rang la thim/ bla mas rjes su 'dzin par smon lam btab ste cung zad ngal bso/ /re zhig de dag re re la dmigs pa 'byongs 'byongs su bsgom nas/ slar yang snga dro skyabs 'gro/ nyin gung sems bskyed/dgong mo maṇ+ḍal/ srod la bla ma'i rnal 'byor rnams drag tu bsgom pa zhag bdun nam/ zla ba byed la sogs pa bskyangs pas/ de dag la myong ba ci rigs pa thon yong zhing / dngos gzhi dang mthun pa'i nyams rtogs kyang than thun skye ba srid/gang ltar na'ang sngar so sor bsgom pa rnams la yang zhag bdun re tsam bya zhing kun dril bas sngon 'gro la ma mtha' yang / zla ba phyed gnyis tsam re byed pa ba/95 che/gnyis pa dngos gzhi la/ yum don ngo sprod pa dang / bdud bzhi dbyings su gcod pa'o/ /dang po la sems 'dzin gyi gdams ngag dang / ngo sprod gnyis —295
