so/ /dang po ni/ lus rnam snang gi chos bdun bcas/ ngag rlung rang sor bzhag/sems dus gsum gyi rtog pa'i spros pa bcad nas/ sngar gyi rnam rtog 'gags/phyi ma skyes pa/ da ltar ba'i shes pa skad cig ma 'di la so ma khad de bzhag rnam rtog thol thol skyen rbad rbad 'phro bcad la sngar lugs bzhin bskyangs/ 'og 'gyu rgya 'byams su 'gro na skyon che bas phyin chad 'di lta bu ma byung ba byed dgos snyam pa dang / zhe bcad chen po byas la/ yang dran pas bzung ste sngar bzhin bsgoms pas de je nyung du 'gro /re zhig de kha ma gtogs thabs gzhan mi bya/yun ring du bsgoms kyang rnam rtog drag tu zhabrug pa kho na byung na/ rang gi mdun du gser gyi rdo rje nas 'bru tsam zhig gsal btab la zan kham gsum za yun tsam zhig de la rig pa drag tu gtad cing gzir/ de 'phral la sngar bzhin ma bcos so ma bskyang/ yang rdo rje la sems gtad/ yang so ma'i ngang bskyangs/yang rdo rje la sems gtad/ tshul de lta bu bzhur la lan nyi shu rtsa gcig tsam bsgom/ nyin re re bzhin de ltar byas pas rnam rtog shugs chad de sal ting gis 'gro/ gal te des ma phan na rdo rje'i tshabs su bcom ldan 'das thub pa'i dbang po'i sku che chung tshon gang tsam zhig bsgom/ gzhan sngar dang 'dra/ des kyang ma phan na bla ma dang ma cig dbyer med pa zhal nas phaṭa kyi sgra drag po lhang lhang sgrogs pa/ sku lus gnam lcags 'bar ba bzhin gang la'ang thog med du 'gro ba tshon gang ba tsam zhig gang nas byung cha med pa byon te/ rang gi lus 'di la yar thal mar thal phar thal tshur thal du phug pa la sems drag tu gtad/ de 'phral mi rtog pa'i ngang bskyangs pa sogs gong bzhin bsgom pas rnam rtog gya —296

ma gyu dang gzhan yang ting 'dzin skye ba la bar chad thams cad nges par sel ba yin/ de ltar thabs de rnams dang bcas pas sngar bzhin mnyam par bzhag pa na sems gsal hrig ge ba dang bcas song ba ci 'dod byas par 'byung zhing /bsam mno sogs dgos pa rnams kyang dran thub cing / mi 'dod bzhin du rnam rtog 'dre ba ma yin pas/ zhi gnas kyang klung du phebs par 'gyur ro/ /skabs 'di dag tu shes pa mi gsal zhing mun mun pa dang / thun mtshams su rmongs shing dran pa mi gsal na/ bying ba bsang pa'i nus pa yin pas khang stengs sam/ ri rtse'i gzhan yang bsil zhing thongs dkar sar phyin/ mig gyen la gtad/ rig pa hur phyungs te bsgom na nges par sel ba yin/ gnyis pa ngo sprod pa ni/ sngar gyi de kha'i ngang las kha nang log gi shes pas sems kho rang gi ngo bo la cher re bltas/ phyi snang ba sna tshogs dang bcas pa la ma yengs tsam sdu bzhag pas/ ci yang ma yin zhing / ngos bzung rgyu med pa de kha yang yang bsgom/ de la rang gi nyams myong skye tshul dang bstun nas bla mas ngo sprod dgos pa yin/ 'on kyang ngo sprod pa'i don nyams su len tshul ni/ sems 'di nyid gnas pa'i dus na ngos bzung gcig kyang med cing rang snang gsal gsal ba zhes kyang 'char 'char du btub pa/ 'gyu ba'i dus na 'gyu ba nyid ngo bo yul yul ba'i 'gyu stongs 'gyu ba'i snang ba ma 'gags kyang ngos bzung gcig kyang med/ yul gyi snang ba sna tshogs su shar ba'ang / snang ba 'gags med lam lam 'char bzhin pa'i dus nas ngos bzung du med pa de lta yul snang dang / rnam rtog dang sems gnas pa'i ngo bo gsum tha dad du ma grub ste dbye ba med/—297—

gcig tu yang ma grub ste/ thams cad yul stong / de kha yum chen mo shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa'i don yin/ dus gsum rgyal ba'i dgongs pa yin/ stong pa nyid dang / spros bral dang / brjod bral dang / don dam la sogs pa'i tha snyad ji snyed pa zhig btag mod/ don rang sems skad cig ma gcig bu de yin pas de ka la rang ngo shes tsam gyis sgo nas/ gnas sam 'gyu ba gang byung de la bzo bcos med par mnyam par 'jog /gnyis pa bdud bzhi dbyings su bcad pa la bzhi las/ dang po thog bcas kyi bdud dbyings su bcad pa ni/ dgra gnyen sogs chags sdang gi yul gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya rnams la brten nas/ rnam rtog 'dzin pa dang bcas pa skyes ched thog bcad bcas kyi bdud ces bya ba yin/ thog bcas kyi go don gzugs sogs phyi'i dngos po la brten pa'i don yin/ de gcod par byed pa ni/dper na dgra lta bu zhig dran te zhe sdang gi rnam rtog tshig pa za ba rim gyis byung ba na/ de'i dbang du ma shor ba skad cig de nyid la phaṭa ces drag tu brjod/ rnam rtog de la skyon yon gang du yang mi blta bar 'phro rbad kyis bcad nas sngar gyi yum don gyi dbyings der cha mer bzhag /de bzhin du gnyen dang nor rdzas sogs la chags sems dang / gzugs sogs yid du 'ong ba la chags/ mi 'ong ba la sdang zhing skyug 31ga /'ga' zhig la 'jigs/ 'ga' zhig la skyo/ bar ma rnams la yang chags sdang sogs kyi mtho dman med kyang / der 'dzin gyi rnam rtog skye tshad thams cad la sngar bzhin sbyangs/ de yang rnam rtog lam gyis byung ba lhongs/ci de'i dbang du shor na bdud kyi khyer/ de nyid du phaṭa brjod nas 'phro —298

gcod pa ni gcod/ de rjes su sngar gyi bsgom la bogs thon pa ni tshar tshad chod tshad yin/ 'di 'og ma rnams la yang rigs 'gre'o/ /gnyis pa thog med kyi bdud gcod pa ni/ thog med kyi bdud kyi go don/ phyi rol gyi rkyen la ma rag par rkyen med kyang dga' ba'am/ mi dga' ba'am/ spro snang ngam/ skyo ba'am/'jigs pa la sogs pa'i mtho dman gyi rnam rtog skye ba rnams yin te/ de yang lam gyis shar ba na phaṭa kyis 'phro ba cad la dbyings su bzhag go /gsum pa dga' brod kyi bdud gcod pa ni/ bla ma dang chos brgyud bzang ba dang / rang la dge sbyor 'phel ba'am/ mthun rkyen 'dzoms pa sogs kyi bzang 'dzin dang / nga rgyal la brten nas dga' brod skyid snang skyes na dga' brod kyi bdud yin te/ gong bzhin dbyings su gcod do/ /bzhi pa snyems byed kyi bdud gcod pa ni/ rnam rtog dang 'dzin pa ci byung thams cad snyems byed kyi bdud yin/ gang shar thams cad gong bzhin phaṭa kyis dbyings su bskyal bas chod par 'gyur ro/ /'di la gong ma gsum char 'dus/ 'di yan chad la rang stobs kyi nyams len rkang tshugs pa'i myong pa med par gnyan khrod 'grims pa stong zob yin/ sgom gyi rkang 'di yan chad la tshugs dgos/ gnyan khrod byed pa bogs 'don dag 'gro ba'i don yin pas de bzhin go dgos so/ /gsum pa rjes nyams skyong ba la don gsum ste/ zhi gcod/ drag gcod/zhi drag phyed ma'i gcod do/ /de la dang po ni/ rang gi gnas khang du sems can thams cad la byams snying rje thun bzhir drag tu bsgom zhid / thun bzhi gar —299

dkar 'byed tshar re byed pa gal che/ de yang rang gi mdun du mi mgo'i skyed bu gsum byung / rang sems rdo rje'i phag mo'i rnam pas smin mtshams nas phyir thon/thod pa breg ste skyed pu'i steng du bkal/ rang lus lhag ma rnams dum bur gtubs te der blug rgya khyon nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam par gyur/ oṃ āḥ& zhes brjod pa'i bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor song / rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' mo mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs thams cad spyan drangs/ de thams cad la mchod pas de rnams tshims shing dgyes/ 'gro drug gi sems can thams cad la sbyin pas gnas skabs su tshim zhing mthar thug sdig sgrib thams cad sbyangs/ bdud rtsi'i lhag ma gtor bas mchod pa'i lha mo dpag tu med par byung nas/ mchod pa bsam gyis mi khyab pas mchod par bsam de thams cad rang sems su shes/ de'i ngo bo la cher gyis bltas la phaṭa ces brjod la dbyings rig bsre/ yang de rnams lam te dran par byas la/ slar yang phaṭa ces dbyings rig bsre/ de lta bu lan mang du bya'o/ /de ltar bsgom la dmigs pa cung zad 'byongs pa na/ rang nyid gnyan khrod gang du 'gro ba der 'dun pa btang la/ spyir sems can thams cad dang bye brag tu gnyan khrod de'i gzhi bdag dang 'byung po 'dre gdon sogs thams cad la byams snying rje drag tu bsgom zhing / sngar gyi dkar 'gyed kyi dmigs pa de kha yang yang bsgom pa gnyis zhag gnyis gsum byas la/ lam du 'gro tshe yang byams snying rje dang dbyings rig bsre ba spel ma de ka bsgom/ gnas der sleb nas sa gnad che ba zhig btsal la bsdad/ der thog mar gzhi bdag dang 'byung po sogs la sil —300—

gtor dang / mkha' 'gro spyi gtor/ gzhi bdag gtor/ bgegs gtor sogs shes tshad gtang / de dag tu yang byams snying rje drag tu bsgom pa gal che/ de nas skyabs 'gro sogs sngon 'gro rnam bzhi drag la 'jur ba yun ring ba bya/de'i rjes su sngar bzhin dkar 'gyed kyi dmigs pa de lan mang du bsgom/ slar yang spyir 'gro drug gi sems can/ dgos gnyan khrod 'di'i 'dre gdon la gtso bor dmigs nas byams snying rje drag tu bsgom/ yul phyogs de dang 'dre gdon sogs sems can du snang ba lam lam pa de'i steng du shes pa cher gyis gtad la phaṭa ces dbyings rig bsres la 'dzin med du bzhag /yang snying rje bsgom/yang dbyings rig bsre ba sogs de kho na bsgom/ ltas dang cho 'phrul ci byung na yang dbyings rig bsre ba dang snying rje bsgom pa gnyis po rang la bsgrim/ cho 'phrul drag po byung yang rung / ma byung yang rung / mthar gnas bag chags shing dge sbyor 'phel ba'i tshe/ tshar tshad chod tshad 'grigs pa yin pas/ dge sbyor bogs thon pa'i btang rag tu dmigs pa'i sgo nas dkar 'gyed lan mang du btang zhing / yi dam mkha' 'gro la gtor bsngo dang gzhi bdag rnams la gtor ma rgya cher byin/ smon lam ci shes 'don/ lam du yang sngar bzhin bsgom la/rang gnas su sleb pa na dkon mchog la gtang rag gi mchod gtor ci shes 'bul lo/ /gnyis pa ni/ thog mar rang gi gnas khang du thun gyi nyams len zhi gcod dang 'dra ba las/ thun gyi mthar dmar 'gyed gyi dmigs pa re bya/ de la dmar 'gyed ni/ rang sems sngar bzhin phyir bton la/ rang lus de stong —301—

gsum khyab pa'i mi ro tsho bcud snum bag dang ldan pa zhig tu gyur/ 'jig rten khams kyi lha srin sde brgyad thams cad la 'bod pa'i skad btang bas/ thams cad skad cig la 'dus te sa dang nam mkha' thams cad khyab par bsam de nas rang lus dum bu dum bur gtub/ khyed cag ci 'dod zo/ gang 'dod longs/ zhes brjod pas so so'i bsam pa dang mthun par/ sha khrag rus pa nang khrol yan lag sogs zos 'thung khyer bas/ gnas skabs tshim zhing / mthar thug nyon mongs zhi bar bsam/ slar de dag thams cad rang gnas su song bar bsgom/ de nas de yang rang sems su shes bzhin pas phaṭa ces dbyings rig bsre la bzhag /de lta bu yang yang bsgom/ de la cung zad goms nas gnyan khrod zhig la dmigs te slar yang zhag gnyis gsum bsgom/ lam du bsgom tshul zhi gcod dang 'dra/ gnas der sleb nas sa gnad gnyan sa zhig btsal nas bsdad/sngon 'gro'i chos bzhi po spyir sngar dang 'dra ba las rtsa ba'i bla ma dang ma cig dbyer med pa mkha' 'gro sde lnga'i tshogs dang bcas pa sgom pa dang / bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi skabs bla ma dang ma cig dbyer med pa rang la thim pas/rang nyid ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro mar gyur/ de nyid ye shes kyi me drag tu 'bar ba dang bcas te/ drag po'i steng stabs sna tshogs kyi gar mdzad/ gsung skad drag sngags sna tshogs 'brug ltar sgrogs par bsam la/ 'di'i skabs ma cig gi nga rgyal dang bcas pa ni dgos shing / 'dre gdon rnams la gnod sems gtan nas med par sgyu ma rmi lam ltar shes bzhin du gang snang gi ngo bo la rang sems —302

ched cher bsre bzhin du phaṭa ces dbyings rig bsre ba kho na bya/ 'tshub dang cho 'phrul ldang na phaṭa dang bcas par mchong rgyug dang / drag sngags shes tshad 'don/ de nas yang sngar gyi shul du 'dug ste/ stong pa nyid kho na la mnyam par bzhag /sems kyi mtho dman dang / 'char sgo rnam rtog cis byung kyang phaṭa ces dbyings rigs bsre ba kho na bya/ 'tshub dang cho 'phrul lhongs kyi phyi mthong snang dang / nang na tsha/ gsang ba nyon mongs log lta sogs ci skyes kyang 'khrul par shes pas dbyings rigs bsre ba kho na las gzhan gang yang mi byed cing yum don kho na la mnyam par bzhag /ngag gi smra brjod dang / lus kyis 'gul bskyod sogs gtan nas mi byed pa'i dam 'cha' dang zhe mna' lag tu longs pa bya/ rnam pa thams cad du lus sems la gces 'dzin rdul tsam med par bya/ lha 'dre drag pos dngos su sdod pa spo dgos byung na sngar gyi shul der sdod pa bya/dngos su gang du bzhag byung ba der sdod/ dngos gzhi rang gi skabs 'dir gzhan la skyabs zhu bar ma song ba/ bsrung 'khor du ma song ba/ 'dre 'dul du ma song ba/ re dogs su ma song ba gal che chung ci byung rung khyad par med pa'i blo btad dang / dbyings rigs bsre ba'i mi rtog pa dang ma bral ba gal che/ gong du bshad pa ltar gyi tshad lhongs 'grigs pa na/ dmar 'gyed kyi dmigs pa yang 'ga' re bya zhing / rjes kyi bya ba zhi gcod dang 'dra ba las/ chab gtor klu gtor sogs gtor ma ci mang gtong ba dang / smon lam mang du 'debs pa/chos bshad mdo 'don pa sogs la brtson pa gal che/ de ltar byas pas khos gnas lus longs spyod nyams pa gsos/ sngar las kyang lhag par song bsam —303—

pa dang / chos dang ldan par song snyam pa yang yang bsam/ rjes kyi bya ba yang sngar dang 'dra/gsum pa ni/ sngon 'gro snga ma dang 'dra ba las dkar 'gyed dmar 'gyed gnyis ka bsgom/ gnyan khrod du sleb ma thag tu zhi gcod ltar gtor ma rgya cher btang / sngon 'gro chos bzhi snga thun gnyis la zhi gcod lta bu dang / phyi thun gnyis la drag gcod ltar bsgoms/ dngos gzhi nyams len yang zhi gcod kyi dmigs pa lan mang du 'gro ba'i mthar drag gcod ltar stong nyid kho na bsgom pa thun re bzhin bya/ yun ring por stongs ma byung na drag gcod kyi skabs ltar lhongs klongs pa'i spros bcas kyi gcod tshul de lan re byas pas nges par stongs yong bar gdon mi za/ re zhig de ma zhi bar la drag gcod bzhin du stong nyid kho na bsgoms/ lha 'dre dngos su rgol du byung na/ snying dmar tsar gyis btan nas ster ba'am/ mgo dang rkang lag rbad kyis bcad nas ster ba sogs lus sems ma bral bzhin du lus la gces 'dzin rdul tsam med par phung po gzan du bskyur ba 'di gal che/ tshar lhongs 'grigs pa na rjes kyi bya ba gong dang 'dra'o/ /'di dag la nye bar mkho ba'i skabs don cung zad cig brjod na/thog mar gnyan khrod bkra shis pa'i dge mtshan can/ gzhi bdag 'jam zhing chos la dkar ba zhig tu zhi gcod nyams su len du 'gro/ thog ma nas drag gcod byed pa dang / gnas rtsub pa dang / nag phyogs kyi 'dre gdon gnas pa'i sar 'gro ba lam du long dka' zhing / de nyid lam du song yang chos brgyud dang mched grogs sogs gang cir rten 'brel mi legs pa yin/ de nas thog mar —304—

zhi gcod la brten nas gnyan khrod bkra shis pa lan gnyis gsum tsam 'grim pa'i rjes su gnyan khrod 'bring po 'ga' rer zhi drag bsgoms/ de nas gnyan khrod rtsub pa 'ga' rer zhi gcod bsgom/ de ltar gnyan khrod mang du bsgom zhing 'byongs ba na/ gnyan khrod rtsub pa 'ga' rer zhi drag phyed ma ci rigs pa bya/'dre gdon gdug pa can gnas sar drag gcod 'ba' zhig kyang skabs rer byed pa yin/ spyir rgyun gyi nyams len zhi drag phyed ma yin/ lha 'dre 'jam zhing chos la dkar ba'i sar gtso bor zhi gcod rang bya zhing / zhi drag phyed ma'ang skabs dang bstun nas byar rung / drag gcod 'ba' zhig bya mi nyan/ zhi drag phyed ma'i skabs 'dir gong du bstan pa de la/ spros bcas zer zhing / de'i mjug tu zhi gcod ltar byams snying rje dang dbyings rig bsre ba spel ma bsgom pa la spros med zer/ de'i rjes su yum don kho na la mnyam par 'jog pa la shin tu spros med kyi gcod zer ba yin pas/ de dag kyang 'brel chags su bsgoms par bya'o/ /gcod las la 'gro khar nyon mongs chags sdang gi sems drag po skyes pa dang / bla ma'i mos gus la ldem 'gyangs shor ba rdeng / mched grogs dang gcod pa dam sel zhugs pa dang / thig le nyams pa sogs byung na rten 'brel 'chug nas gnyan khrod 'grim pa gnad du mi 'gro/ des na gsol 'debs/ snying rje/ bshags pa/ smon lam/ tshogs mchod/ gtor ma/ rtsa rlung sgom pa sogs rten 'brel khyad par can bsgrigs nas 'gro ba gal che/ lhongs la gsum las/ phyi'i lhongs ni sa g.yo ba dang / ri nyung ba dang / 'jigs pa'i mthong snang dang / thos snang 'di mi 'byung ba med pa 'ongs/ nang gi stongs/ snying —305—

rlung / klad gzer/ rgyu ma gzer ba sogs na tsha drag po glo bur du 'byung / gsang lhongs sems la byung ste/ dga' snang dang / sdug snang mi tshugs pa lta bu dang /'jigs skrag dang / skyo ngas dang / 'dod yon gyi rnam rtog dang / chos brgyad kyi 'char sgo la sogs pa dang / dug gsum gyi rnam rtog cher 'phel ba sogs 'byung zhing / chos dang bla ma la log lta ldang / de 'dra'i rigs thams cad stongs su shes par bya'o/ /lus mi bskyod/ kha don gyi rim pa dang / phaṭa sngags brjod pa ma gtogs tha mal gyi ngag mi smra ba la zung thub pa dang / sems 'char sgo ci byung thams cad de'i dbang du mi gtong ba dbyings rigs bsre ba rang gal che ba'o/ /yang skye bo mang po 'du sar sdod dgos sam 'grims dgos byung ba'i tshe/mi sngon du dge sbyor byed pa de spyir yang dgag bya che zhing / khyad par phaṭa sngags drag po brjod pa sogs mi mdzes pas/ phaṭa ces shub shub po brjod cing /nyams len gyi gdengs gtan nas ma phresar ba gnad du shes che/ yang sa cha yul mi 'dre gdon sogs mothong ba'i yul dang sems snang du lam de 'char bar byas/ mi dang mi ma yin pa rnams la snying rje dung ba zhig bsgom la/ 'di thams cad dbang du bsdu snyam pa'i 'dun pa zhig btang / de nas phaṭa ces brjod pas thams cad dbyings su bskyal/ 'di lta bu'i dmigs pa tho rangs la sogs par lan ci mang bstud nas bsgom/ de'i mthar smon lam rgya cher btab/ gang la yang ma zhen par sgyu ma lta bur sgom nas sa phyogs de dag gi mi dang mi ma yin thams cad dbang du 'du nges so/ /des mtshon de 'phrin las rnam bzhi gang bsgrub kyang dmigs pa'i gnad 'di rigs 'gre bar bya'o/ /—306—

g.yin yang mos gus gsol 'debs dbyings su bskyal bas/ bla mas thugs rjes 'dzin zhing byin rlabs 'jug /snying rje dbyings su bskyal bas 'gro don 'byung zhing sems can dbang du 'du/ skyo shas nges 'byung dbyings su bskyal bas rang gi dge sbyor gnad du 'gro zhing gzhan rgyud chos la 'khrul ched/ bskyed rim dbyings su bskyal bas nus pa che zhing 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i chos skyong dbang du 'du/ rtsa rlung thig le'i rnal 'byor dbyings su bskyal bas rtogs pa gong nas gong du 'phel zhing phyi nang gi mkha' 'gro 'du ba rgyun mi 'chad/ gnyan khrod 'grims shing gnad du song na sde brgyad dregs pa can thams cad bran 'khol thub/ gzhan yang 'dod chags dbyings su bskyal bas 'dod chags can gyi 'gro ba 'dul nus 'khor 'du/ 'on kyang de snying rjes ma zin na rang dang nye 'khor sogs la de la brten nas bar chad 'byung bas/'dod chags dbyings su bskyal ba'i stong nyid dang snying rjer skyes ba gal che/des mtshon te nyon mongs kyi rnam rtog gzhan rnams la'ang rigs 'gre/ de thams cad kyang rtsa ba re dogs med pa gal che bas/ spyir gcod kyis bar chad thams cad sel zhing dngos grub thams cad thob pa yin na'ang / dngos grub thob la re ba dang phan yon 'byung la re ba zhe 'dod pa gtan med pa rigacig dgos/ blo yi gting skyon ma thon na dge sbyor gnad du mi 'gro ste/ bla ma log lta can dang / chos la tshod yod po dang / rang bzang 'dod ngan mi 'dode pa dang /nor rdzas longs spyod la shi bar 'thams pa dang / re dogs kyis khyer nas blo thag gcad mi nus pa rnams la/ gnyan khrod lam du longs ba'i sgom skye ba ga la 307

srid/ lha 'dre gdug pa can gyi lhongs zhi ba skad/ longs spyod snyan grags than thun grub pa skad/ mgo bskor gakho ba mang bas/ gnyan khrod la dge sbyor gyi blo skyed chen po ma byung bar tshar tshad brdzus ma sad sud de la yid brtan ma byed cig /dge sbyor gyi bogs thon byung na gas de tsho byung ma byung 'dra/ bon ma legs pa'i yang rtse yin no/ /gcod yul kun gyi snying i don/ /dgongs 'du'i sgrub thabs 'di yin pas/ /nyams len gyis shig skal ldan bu/ /tsab /rdordo dzegate /ce/ la te 'tshom/ste//༷/ tshor dzogate //snye dzogateb bla sna ma mang ga/ //gcad yul zab ma da yag gnad dan nga pa zhes bya ba 'di ni bya bral ba rin chen bkra shis zhes bya bas bskul nas/ tā ra nā thas smras pa ste/ stag lung thang gi chos grwar sbyar ba'o/ /dge'o/ /—308

'don gsol 'debs zhes bya ba bzhugs/na mo gu sa dngos grub 'byung gnas bla ma rin po che/ /skyabs gnas kun 'dus 'gro mgon rin po che/ /gnas lugs don rtogs chos rje rin po che/ /bdud bzhi 'joms mdzad dpa' bos byin gyis rlobs/ /de nasakhosasu blang rgyu'i chos ni 'di yin te/brgyud pa la mos gus chug pa/byin rlangs 'pho ba'i dbang skur thob nas/'khrid las kyi ngo bo la/sngon 'gro/ dngosagazhi/ rjes gsum mo/ /rtsa ba'i sabacad dang po la skyabasa'agro semasabaskyed/maṇ+ḍal bla ma'i rnal 'byor/ bzhi lasadang po/ skyabs 'gro ni/rang gang du gnas pa'i sa phyogs 'di nyid dag pa'i zhing khams chen po yangs shing rgya che bar gyur pa'i dbus su/ seng khri pad+ma nyi zla'i gdan la/ dbus su rtsa ba'i bla ma/ mdun du yi dam dang sangs rgyas/ g.yas su dam chos kyi ngo bo glegs bam/ g.yon du theg pa che chung gi dge 'dun/ rgyab tu mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma rnams gsal btab la/ bdag dang sems can thams cad byang chub ma thob kyi bar du/ rtsa ba'i bla ma bka' drin can la skyabs su mchi'o/ /brgyud pa'i bla ma byin rlabs can la skyabs su mchi'o/ /'dren pa'i bla ma thugs rje can la skyabs su mchi'o/ /bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro gsum la skyabs su mchi'o/ /chos sku longs sku sprul sku gsum la skyabs su mchi'o/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun gsum la skyabs su mchi'o/ /gzhi dang lam dang 'bras bu gsum la skyabs su —309

mchi'o/ /lta ba spyod pa sgom pa gsum la skyabs su mchi'o/ /rang sems stong pa chos sku gsum la skyabs sumachi'o/ khyed rnams la ni skyabs su mchi/ khyed rnams la yang phyag 'tshal lo/ /'dod yon lnga yi mchod pa 'bul/ /sdig pa thams cad so sor bshags/ /'gro ba'i dge la rjes yi rang / /chos kyi 'bor lo bskor du gsol/ /mya ngan mi 'da' bzhugs gsol 'debs/ /dge des sems can bde gyur cig /phaṭaḥ ces skyabs 'gro ci nus su bya'o/ /mthar skyabs yul rnams 'od du nasarang la thi34/gnyis pa sems bskyed ni/ nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du zab lam gcod kyi gdams pa nyams su blang bar bgyi'o/ /snyam pa gyis la byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems dung ba'i ngang nas/ ma rgan sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig /sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral bar gyur cig /sdug bsngal med pa'i bde ba dang mi bral bar gyur cig /nye ring chags sdang dang bral ba'i btang snyoms tshad med pa la gnas par gyur rig /phaṭaḥ ces ngag nas brjod cing yid la bsam mo/ / gsum pa maṇ+ḍal ni/ rang gi mdun du bla ma dang ma cig lab sgron dbyer med pa/mdun du yi dam sogs skyabs yul bzhin gsal btab/ 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad mchod rdzas 'dod yon longs spyod thams cad kyi phyur bur bkang ste/rang gi lus ngag yid gsum kyi dus gsum gyi dge tshogs dang bcas pa thams cad/ bla ma dang dkon mchog la phul bar mos la phaṭaḥ pags pa gser gyi sa —310

gzhi'i dbus/ /sgal tshigs ri rab lhun por gyur/ /yan lag nying lag gling bzhi gling phran brgyad/ /longs spyod rnam par rgyal ba'i khang bzang dbus/ /mig ni nyi ma zla bas rab mdzes pa/ /nang khrol me tog snying ni yid bzhin nor/ /dgos 'dod ma lus char bzhin 'byung bas brgyan/ /phyi nang gsang gsum yon tan ci mchis pa/ /rtsa ba'i bla ma yum chen 'khor bcas dang / /yi dam lha tshogs dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dang / /chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs la dbul bar bgyi'o/ /thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don phyir bzhes su gsol/ /bzhes nas bdag la byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ /phaṭaḥ bdag gis lus dang longs spyod dang / /dus gsum bsags pa'i dge ba kun/ /bla ma dkon mchog khyed la 'bul/ /thugs rjes dgongs la bzhes su gsol/ /zhes pa lan mang du brjod do/ /bzhi pa bla ma'i rnal 'byor ni/ phaṭaḥ swa bhā was sbyangs/bdag dang sems can thams cad mnyam nyid du 'tshogs pa'i spyi bor rin po che'i khri'i steng du/ pad+ma 'dab ma stong ldan gyi dbus su zla ba nyi ma brtsegs pa'i steng du/ rtsa ba'i bla ma dang dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bo ma cig lab kyi sgron ma/sku mdog gangs ri'i phung po ltar dkar ba zhal gcig phyag gnyis zhi ba'i spyan gsum dang ldan pa/ phyag g.yas kyis ḍa ma ru nam mkha' la 'khrol ba/ stong gsum khyab pa'i sgras srid pa gsum gyi mkha' 'gro ma thams cad dbang du bsdud par byed pa/ g.yon pas dngul dkar gyi dril bu dku la brten zhing /srid gsum zil gyis gnon pa'i tshul gyis bzhugs pa/ dbu skra dmar ser gyi tshogs grol zhing sku rgyab gnon pa/ rin po che'i rtse phran lnga yis dbu la brgyan pa/—311—

rin po che dang rus pa'i rgyan drug dang ldan pa/ sku smad la dar dmar po'i sham thabs gsol ba/ lang tsho dar la bab pa/ bcu drug lon pa'i na tshod dang ldan pa/ zhabs gnyis gar stabs kyis bzhugs pa dam tshig sems dpa'/ de'i thugs gar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ ye shes sems dpa'i ngo bo bla ma rdo rje 'chang sku mdog sngon po/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'byud pa/ yum shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa'i rang bzhin sku mdog dmar la ser ba'i mdangs chags pa/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis gri gug dang thod khrag 'dzin pa/ gnyis ga'ang rus pa'i rgyan drug dang ldan pa/ zhabs gnyis gar stabs kyi bzhugs pa/ zag med bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin ye shes sems dpa'/ de'i thugs gar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ ting nge 'dzin sems dpa'i ngo bo hūṃ mthing nag 'od zer 'phro ba dang bcas pa/ de ltar bla ma yab yum la brgyud pa'i bla ma yi dam gyis bskor nas bzhugs pa/ thams cad kyang gcer bu rus pa'i rgyan drug dang bcas ldan pa/ shes rab ma dang mnyam par sbyar bas/ zag med chos sku'i rang bzhin gyis bzhugs pa/ ma cig gi mdun gyi 'dab ma la/ sangs rgyas rigs kyi mkha' 'gro ma dkar mo 'bum/lho'i 'dab ma la rin chen rigs kyi mkha' 'gro ma ser mo 'bum/ nub kyi 'dab ma la pad+ma'i rigs kyi mkha' 'gro ma dmar mo 'bum/ byang gi 'dab ma la las kyi rigs kyi mkha' 'gro ma ljang mo 'bum/ dbus phyogs su rdo rje'i rigs kyi mkha' 'gro ma sngon mo 'bum/ thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas cang te'u nam mkha' la 'brol la/ g.yon pas thod pa bdud rtsis —312

gang ba thugs gar 'dzin pa/ mchan khung na kha ṭ+wāṃ ga gyen du bsgreng zhing 'dzin pa/phyag rgya lnga dang ldan pa zhabs g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang pa'i gar stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ ma cig ma'i spyi bor pad+ma zla ba'i steng du pha gcig dam pa rgya gar sku mdog nag la dmar ba'i mdangs chags pa/ spyan gsum dmar la zlum pa shangs mtho la gug pa/ sma ra dang smin ma dmar ser du 'khyug pa/ tshems dkar la tshems rtse rno ba/ dbu skra zar bu gyen du brdzes shing / me tog gi phreng bas thod bcings pa/ phyag g.yas pas mi rkang gi gling bu kyu ru ru 'bud pa/ g.yon pas rten 'brel gyi gal ta thugs gar 'dzin pas/ sgrub pa po la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ster bar mdzad pa/ rus pa'i rgyan drug dang ldan pa/ zhabs gnyis rgyal po rol pa'i 'dus stangs kyis bzhugs pa/ de la bka' bzhi brgyud pa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba/ de'i steng gi nam mkhar seṅge sngon po rol pa'i khri'i steng du pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la 'jam dpal smra ba'i seṅge mtshan dang dpe byad kyis brgyan pa/ de la grub thob dpa' bo rgya mtsho'i tshogs kyis bskor ba/de'i spyi bor pad+ma dngazla ba'i gdan gyi steng du sprul sku shākya thub pa la bskal bzang gi sangs rgyas stong rtsa gnyis kyis bskor nas bzhugs pa/ de'i spyi bor pad zla nyi ma sum brtsegs kyi steng du yum chen mo shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma sku mdog gser btso ma'i mdog lta bu zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma/ zhi ba'i spyan gsum dang ldan pa/ phyag g.yas kyi dang po na gser gyi rdo rje rtse lnga pa/ g.yon gyi dang po na dngul dkar gyi dril bu/ tha ma gnyis shes rab kyi po ti re re bsnams pa/ rin po che'i sna tshogs kyis dbu rgyan/ mgul rgyan/ snyan cha/ phyag gdub/—313 spe

zhabs gdub/ do shal se mo do la sogs pa rgyan thams cad kyi brgyan pa/ dar sna tshogs kyis sham thabs mdzes pa/ zhabs rdo rje skyil krung du bzhugs pa/ de la phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis bskor nas bzhugs pa/ de rnams kyi 'og gi cha la mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma thams cad kyis hūṃ dang phaṭa kyi sgra sgrogs pa stong gsum 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad gang ba tsam du bzhugs par gyur/ lha tshogs thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ/mgrin par āḥ thugs dar hūṃ/ thugs ga'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros pas/ dam tshig sems dpa' rang rang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa spyan drangs/ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ ma lus sems can kun gyi mgon gyur cing / /zhes sogs/bka' rgyud bla ma gshegs su gsol/ /yi dam lha tshogs /ma dang mkha' 'gro /chos skyong srung ma gshegs su gsol/ /mahā gu ru de ba ḍā ki nī sa pa ri wā ra dzaḥ ྅ baṃ hoḥphaṭaḥ dngos su 'byor dang yid kyis sprul pa dang / /phyogs dus kun gyi mchod rdzas bzang dgu rnams/ /bla ma rgyal ba sras dang bcas la 'bul/ /mkha' khyab 'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol/ /mahā gu ru de ba ḍā ki nī sa pa ri wā ra arnya nas/shabha'i bar gyisamachod/phaṭaḥ ma mi min ye shes mkha' 'gro ma/ /rnam thar gsum gyi sgo 'byed ma/ /bdud kyi dpung rnams 'joms mdzad ma/ /lab sgron khyed la gsol ba 'debs/ /thugasarjes dgongs la byin gyis rlobs/ /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol/ /'og min chos dbyings pho brang du/ /yum wo sher phyir byin rlabs can / /byin rlabs can la gsol ba 'debs/ /blo snyem thag chod par byin gyis rlobs/ /bya rgod spungs pa'i ri bo nas/ /bcom ldan —314

shāka thub sogs/ rgya nag ri bo rtse lnga mā /'jam dpal smra seng sogs/ g.yu lo bkod pa'i zhing khams su/ /rje btsun sgrol ma sogs/ dag pa bde stong mkha' spyod du/ /rdo rje phag mo sogs/ o rgyan mkha' 'gro'i pho brang du/ /su kha sirnyi sogs/ rgya gar 'jag ma'i spyil po sa /ārla de ba sogs/ la stod ding ri gling skor du/ /dam pa sangs rgyas sogs/ ra sa spang lung dgon pa sa /bsod nams bla ma sogs/ zangs ri mkhar dmar dgon pa mra /ma gcig lab sgron byin sogs/ rgyal thang chu bzang dgon pa mā /bsam gtan 'od zer sogs/ byang chub gling gi dben gnas su/ /nam mkha' 'od zer sogs/ gnyan khrod brgya rtsa'i gnas mchog tu/ shwakya 'od zer sogs/ phyogs med yangs pa'i ri khrod du/ /bde legs mtshan can sogs/ byin rlabs bla ma'i zhabs drung du/ /dbon sras chos legs sogs/ kha rag bsam gling dgon pa n+da/ /yig drug shes dpal sogs/ chos lung byang rtse'i dben gnas su/ /rje btsun grol mchog sogs/brag stod rdo rje'i pho brang du/ /chos sku lha dbang sogs/ chos lung bde mchog pho brang du/ /lung rig rgya mtsho sogs/ khams gsum 'gro ba'i spyi bo sa /kun dga' snying po sogs/ bdud rtsi phug gi dben gnas su/ /grags pa dpal bzang sogs/ 'bral med snying gi dkyil nang du/ /kun dga' rin chen sogs/ spyi gtsug nyi zla'i gdan steng du/ /rtsa ba'i bla ma sogs/ nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i gnas mchog tu/ /dpal po mkha' 'gro byin sogs/ bsil ba'i tshal gyi dur khrod du/ /chos skyong srung ma sogs/ dag snang phyogs med gzhal yas su/ /rdo rje spun grogs byin rlabs can/ /byin rlabs can la gsol ba 'debs/ /blo snyem thag chod —315

par byin gyis rlobs/ khyad par bdag sogs sems can thams cad bla ma la mosa'adun drag po'i gsol ba 'debasapar bsam nas/ rje mtshan ldan gyi bla ma rin po che/ /bdag la byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ /re sa gzhan na med pas byin gyis rlobs/ /bdag 'dzin blo yi thongs par byin gyis rlobs/ /skye med gcig chod du rtogs par byin gyis rlobs/ /bar chad dngos grub du longs par byin gyis rlobs/ /bdud tshogs rang sar chod par byin gyis rlobs/ /tshe gcig sangs rgyas 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /ma chos dbyings rnam dag shes rab pha rol phyin/ /yum chen thugs las sprul pa'i ma gcig ma/ /ma sku lus chung la gzi brjid che/ /sku mdog dkar la 'od zer 'phro/ /dbu skra mthon mthing thur du grol/ /phyag g.yas gser gyi cang te'u 'brol/ /g.yon pas dngul dkar dril bu bsil/ /rin chen rus rgyan khral la la/ /dar gyi cod pan pu ru mā /zhabs gnyis gar stabs ling ling 'khrab/ /phyag gdub zhabs gdub sil li li ma chos dbyings rnam dag skye med dbyings kyi yum/ /'gags med rtsa bral sems nyid don gyi yum/ /mtha' dbus med pa mtha' bral stong pa'i yum/ /ma yum chen chos kyi sku la gsol ba 'debs/ /ma 'gyur pa med pa rdo rje'i sku sprul ma/ /dgos 'dod kun 'byung rin chen sku sprul ma/ /gdod nas dag pa pad+ma'i sku sprul ma/ /'phrin las grub pa las kyi sku sprul ma/ /ma yum chen sku lnga lhun grub ma/ /thugs rjes dgongs la byin gyi rlobs/ /thugs rjes dgongs la lam sna drongs/ /mkha' spyod gnas su drangs du gsol/ /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol/ /ma chos dbyings ye shes rnal 'byor ma/ /dgongs pa shar du bskyod —316

tsa na/ /don skye med ma bcos gdengs dang ldan/ /sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro dkar mo 'bum/ /sku yi gar byed khyugs se khyugs/ /phyag gnyis ḍā dril khral la la/ /zhabs gnyis 11 brdung khrabs se khrabs/ /phyag gdub zhakhas gdub sil li li/ /dar gyi cod paṇa pur ru mā /rus pa'i rgyan cha khral la la/ /gsung gi nyams dbyangs 'ur ru r+yā /thugs kyi byin rlabs bungs se bungs/ /dngos grub char rgyun sil li li/ /phaṭa kyi brda skad sangs se sangs/ /pha ṭa ya la bar chad sol/ 'dir 'tshogs skal ldan thams cad la/ /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol/ /ma mnyam nyid ye shes rnal 'byor ma/ /dgongs pa lho ru bskyod tsa na/ / don yon tan rdzogs pa'i nyams dang ldan/ /rin chen mkha' 'gro ser mo 'bum/ /sogasarigasa'agre'o/ /ma sor rtogs ye shes rnal 'byor ma/ /dgongs pa nub du bskyod rtsa na/ /don yon tan zag med nyams dang ldan/ /pad+ma mkha' 'gro dmar mo 'bum/ /sogs/ma bya grub ye shes rnal 'byor ma/ /dgongs pa byang du bskyod tsa na/ /don lhun gyis grub pa'i nyams dang ldan/ /las kyi mkha' 'gro ljang gu 'bum/ /sogs/ ma me long ye shes rnal 'byor ma/ /dgongs pa dbus su bskyod tsa na/ /don 'gyur ba med pa'i nyams dang ldan/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro sngon mo 'bum/ /sogs/shar sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro'i thugs ka nas/ /dkar mo lcags kyu thogs pa 'bum/ shar gyi phyogs kyi las mdzad ma/ shar phyogs dri za pho mo sogs/ /snang srid lha 'dre thams cad kun/ /byams pa tshad med lcags kyu yis/ /myur du bzung la 'dir khug cig /phaṭa/ lho rin chen mkha' 'gro'i thugs ka nas/ /ser mo zhags pa thogs pa 'bum/ /lho yi — —317

phyogs kyi las mdzad ma/ /lho phyogs gshin rje pho mo sogs/ /snang srid lha/ 'dre thams cad kun/ /snying rje tshad med zhags pa yis/ /myur du chings la 'dir khug cig /phaṭa/ nub pad+ma mkha' 'gro'i /dmar mo lcags sgrog thogs pa 'bum/ /nub kyi phyogs kyi las mdzad ma/ /nub phyogs klu bdud pho mo sogs/ /snang srid lha 'dre /dga' ba tshad med lcags sgrog gis/ myur du bsdoms la 'dir khug cig /phaṭa/ byang las kyi mkha' 'gro'i ljang gu dril bu thogs pa 'bum/ /byang gi phyogs kyi las mdzad ma/ /byang phyogs gnod spyin pho mo sogs/ /snang srid lha 'dre /btang snyoms tshad med dril bu yis/ /dbang du bsdus la 'dir khug cig /phaṭa/ dbus rdo rje'i mkha' 'gro'i /sngon mo rdo rje thogs pa 'bum/ /steng gi phyogs kyi las mdzad ma/ /steng phyogs lha gdon pho mo sogs/ /snang srid lha 'dre /gnyis med ye shes rdo rje yis/ /dbang du bsdus la 'dir khug cig /phaṭa/ steng na lha tshogs bungs se bungs/ /g.yas na dpa' bo ngar dang bcas/ /g.yon na dpa' mo mdangs dang ldan/ /rgyab na ḍā ki'i tshogs dang bcas/ /mdun na dam can tshogs dang bcas/ /rol mo sna tshogs 'ur ru mā /glu len brda' skad kyu ru mā /gar stabs mang po khyugs se zhugs/ /rgyan cha mang po khral la la/ /byin rlabs sprin ltar bungs se bungs/ /dngos grub char rgyun sil li li/ /'og na snang srid nyil li li/ /gus pa'i brkyang phyag khral la la/ /gdung ba'i gsol 'debs 'ur ru mā /dad pa'i mchi ma phril li li/ /bla ma ḍā ki'i tshogs bcas la/ /byang chub bar du skyabs su mchi/ /byang chub bar du mchod pa 'bul/ /byang chub bar du sdig pa bshags/ /—318

tshogs gnyis dge la rjes yi rang / /bla med chos 'khor bskor par bskul/ /'khor ba ji srid bzhugs gsol 'debs/ / dge ba 'di dang dge ba gzhan/ /ma sdo/sa gcig tu bsdus nas ni/ /mkha' mnyam sems can thams cad kyang / /yum chen go 'phang thob phyi bsngo/ /gsol ba 'debs so mkha' 'gro 'bum/ /byin gyis rlobs gcig mkha' 'gro 'bum/ /lam sna drongs shig mkha' 'gro 'bum/ /dag pa mkha' spyod bde chen du/ /dbang bzhi bskur bar mdzad du gsol/ khri/da bzhi smin par /sku bzhi thob par /phaṭa/ bdag 'dzin blo yis thongs par byin gyis rlobs/ /dgos med rgyud la skye bar /'chi ba rjes su dran par /mi rtag rgyud la skye bar /tshe 'di blo yis thongs paraḥ /gnyan sa ri khrod 'grim par byin gyis rlobs/ /skyid sdug ro snyams nus par /rkyen ngan grogs su 'char bar /ltas ngan g.yangs su len par /na tsha bogs su thon par /'gyel lan lam du longs bar /lha 'dre'i 'dren ston nus par /byams dang snying rje 'byongs par /'gro don mtha' ru phyin par /tshe 'di nyid la byin /gnas mchog 'di stse /'dug sa 'di ru /da lta nyid duḥ /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol/ /phaṭa/de nasadabang bzhi len thabasani/ oṃ āḥ( hoḥ mtshan ldan bla ma mchog la gsol ba 'debs/ /bdag la mngon par dbang bzhi bskur du gsol/ /zhesapa lan gsum brjod/ lha tshogs rnams kyi dpral ba'i oṃ las 'od zer dkar po gtsor byas kha dog lnga byung / rang gi dpral bar zhugs/ lus kyi dri ma dag /bum pa'i dbang thob/ sku rdo rje'i byin rlabs zhugs/ sprul sku'i go 'phang thob/ mgrin —319

pa'i snyalas 'od zer dmar po gtsor byas kha dog lnga byung / rang gi mgrin par zhugs/ ngag gi dri ma dag /gsang ba'i dbang thob/ gsung rdo rje'i longs sku'i thugs ga'i hūṃ las 'od zer mthing ka gtsor byas kha dog lnga byung / rang gi snying gar zhugs/ yid gyi dri ma dag shinas rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/thugs rdo rje'i chos sku'i yang lha tshogs rnams kyi gnas gsum du oṃ āḥ& gsum las 'od zer kha dog lnga cig car du byung / rang gi gnas gsum du thim/lus ngag yid gsum tha dad du 'dzin pa'i sgrib pa dag /phyag rgya chen po'i dbang thob/ ye shes rdo rje'i byin rlabs zhugs/ ngo bo nyid sku'i go 'phang thob/ lha tshogs thams cad 'od du zhu nas rtsa ba'i bla ma la thim/ bla ma 'od du zhu nas rang la thim/ bla ma'i sku gsung thugs kyi ngo bo dpral bar pad+ma dkar po 'dab ma bzhi pa'i lte bar oṃ dkarapo/ mgrin par pad+ma dmar po/ 'dab ma bzhi pa'i lte bar āḥdamar po/ snying gar pad+ma sngon po 'dab ma bzhi pa'i lte bar hūṃ sngon po la shes pa gtad la bgrang nas thun mtshams su/ skye( bla ma'i sku gsol ba 'debs/ /sku yi nyams chags mthol lo bshags/ /lus la sku'i byin gyis rlobs/ /sprul sku thob par mdzad du gsol/ /āX bla ma'i gsung la gsol ba gsung gi nyams chags ngag la gsung gis longs sku thob par ྅ bla ma'i thugs la thugs kyi nyams chags sems la thugs kyis chos sku thob par mdzad du gsol/ /mtshan mo nyal ba'i tshe snying pad ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i ste bar 'od kha dog sna lnga'i dbus su bla ma'i sku tshon gang ba gcig tu bsam/snying dbus a wa dhā tī'i gzhal yas su/ /mtshan ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma rin po che/ /mos gus gdung shugs drag pos gsol ba 'debs/ /sku lnga —320

lhun gyis grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /de'i thugasakar hūṃ la shes pa gtad la gnyid log par bya'o/ /sngon 'gro bzhi po 'di zhag bdun nam zla phyed la sogs pa la bskyangs/rtsa ba'i sa bcad gnyis pa dngos gzhi la/ yum don ngo sprod pa dang bdud bzhi dbyingasasu gcod pa gnyis so/ /dang po la sems 'dzin gyi gdams ngag dang /ngo sprod gnyisaso/ /dang po gnyisaka 'khrid yig gzhung na gsal/ gnyis pa bdud bzhi dbyings su gcod pa'i gsol 'debasani/ phaṭaḥ shākya 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug gsum/ /dug gsum rang sar dag par byin gyis rlobs/ /rkyen pho gdon mo gdon klu gdon gsum/ /gdon gsum rang sar dag par byin gyi rlobs/ /rlung mkhris bad rkan 'dus pa bzhi/ /nad bzhi rang sar dag par /thogs bcas bdud dang thogs med bdud/ /dga' brod bdud dang snyems byed bdud/ /bdud bzhi rang sar dag par /lha 'dre yid kyi cho 'phrul la/ /rang snang 'chun par byin gyis rlobs/ /'dre rtog 'dre 'dzin 'dre 'byung gsum/ /byung yang rang gi sems las byung / /thim yang rang gi sems la thim/ /yal yang chos nyid ngang nas yal/ /phaṭa/ phyag rgya chen po'i dbyings nas byin gyis rlobs/ /rdzogs ba chen po'i dbyings nas /dbu ma chen po'idabyings nas /gsal stong chen po'i — /rig stong chen po'i /snang stong chen po'i /gsal rig stong gsum dbyings nas /thabs shes zung 'jug dbyings nas /sems can thams cad don du /bdag na ba legs na na bar byin gyis rlobs/ /phan pa legs na phan par ston ba legs na shi bar /gson pa legs na gson paraḥ /sdug pa legs na sdug par /skyid pa legs na skyid par /bdag bde gzhan la btad bar /gzhan sdug rang la len pa /dbang —321—

bzhi rgyud la skye bar khuspyod bzhi sems la smin par byin gyis rlobs/ /phaṭaḥdabyings rig bsre ba khrid gzhung las shes par bya'o/ /'di yan chad la rang stobs kyi nyams len rkang tshugs pa'i myong ba med par gnyan khrod 'grims pa stong sob yin/ sgom gyi rkang 'di yan chad la tshugs dgos/ gnyan khrod 'grims pa bogs 'don dang 'gro ba'i don yin pas/ de bzhin go dgos so/ /rtsa ba'i sa bcad gsum pa la/ zhi gcod dang /drag gcod dang / zhi drag phyed ma'i gcod dang gsum las/ dang po zhi gcod dkar 'gyed ni/ phaṭa/ rang gi rig pa'i ngo bo rje btsun ma sku mdog dmar mo tshon gang ba tsam snying gar gnas pas de spyi gtsug rgya skar kha phye ba lta bu'i nang nas yar thon mdun du 'bod par gyur/ phaṭa/ de'i mdun du thod skyed nag po ri rab tsam gsum du gyur/ phaṭa/ rje btsun ma'i gri gug gis rang gi ro de'i smin mtshams yan chad har gyis bkog nas/ snyed po gsum gyi khar phog pas/ thod pa phyi dkar la nang dmar ba/ stong gsum gyi rgya dang mnyam par gyur/ phaṭa/ rje btsun mas rang gi ro de ma ning nas brang mdo'i bar du shags kyis bkas nas/ snying rbad kyis bcad pas thod pa'i nang du bzhag pas gtor ma'i sdong po ri rab tsam du gyur/ phaṭa glo ba/ stol kha/ mchin pa/ mtsher pa/mkhal ma nang khrol lnga po dmar nyil gyis byung nas gtor sha ri phran tsam du gyur/ phaṭa/ glad pa dang sgal slad gangs ri tsam du gyur nas gtor rgyan/ phaṭa/khrag dang chu ser dmar hril gyis byang nas rak+ta'i rgya mtsho dang mchod yon gyi chur gyur / phaṭa/ rje btsun ma'i thugs ga'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros pas/ rlung g.yos me sbar/ thod pa'i nang bcud thams cad 'od du zhu nas ye shes kyi bdud rtsi rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥ( ha ho hrīḥ lan gsum/ rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma yi dam sangs—322 byu

rgyas byang sems dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chosaskyong srung ma'i tshogs thams cad spyan drangs/ de thams cad la mchod pas de rnams tshim zhing dgyes/ 'gro drug gi sems can thams cad la sbyin pas/ gnas skabasasu tshim zhing / mthar thug sdig sgrib thams cad byang / bdud rtsi'i lhag ma gtor bas/ mchod pa'i lha mo dpag tu med pa byung / mchod pa bsam gyis mi khyab pas mchod par bsam/ de thamasacad rang sems su shesapas/ phaṭa/ tso( khams gasdo/ma ma sdo/sa zhing khams nas/ /sku gan+da/ma 'khegar 'das thugs rje'i mgron/ /stong gsum bdud rtsi'i khengs pa'i rdzas/ /gtor ma 'dod yon lnga ru bsngo/ /zhes pa'i rjes su gtor gzhong la bya ba ni/ oṃ phyi snod 'jig rten gtor gzhong du/ /nang bcud sems can gtor mas bkang / /skye 'chi med par mchod pa bzhes/ /phyi nam mkha' yangs pa'i gtor gzhong du/ /nang 'byung ba bzhi'i gtor mas /rang gsal rang dag mchod /bka' pha rol phyin pa'i /sa bcu dag pa'i gtor mas/ /myang 'das chen por /bka' rdzogs pa chen po'i gtor mas /theg pa brgyad kyi /ma 'dres yongs rdzogs /kun gzhi yangs pa'i gtoraḥ /rnam shes tshogs brgyad gtor mas /'phel 'grib med par ཿ /rang sems gnyug ma'i gtor /lus ngag yid gsum gtor mas bkang / /brjod du med paraḥ /skye ba med pa'i /rig pa byung tshor gtor mas /'gyu ba rang grol /chos sku dag pa'i gtor gzhong du/ /gzugs sku rnam gnyis gtor mas /thugs rjes 'gro don mchod par bzhes/ /stong pa nyid kyi gtor gzheng du/ /snang ba dkar dmar /snang med chen por /rang rgyud dag pa'i /gnyis med dag pa'i gtor mas bkang / /ngos bzung med par /chos nyid dag pa'i gtor gzheng du/ /sems bde gsal chen po'i gtor mas —323

bkang / /ngos bzung bral bar: /rang lus rgyal ba'i /rang sems skye med gtor mas bkang / /re dogs med par /ka pā la yi sha khrag rus gsum gtor mas bkang / /mchod sbyin chen pos /rin chen snod kyi /dkar gsum mngar gsum gtor mas bkang / /ro brgya ldan pa'i mchod pa bzhes/ /rdo rje 'chang chen man chad nas/ /rtsa ba'i bla ma yan chad la/ /bsngos pa bzhin du tshim gyur cig /bsam pa bzhin du 'grub gyur cig /re ba bzhin du skangs gyur cig /yum chen phar phyin man chad nas/ /yi dam lha tshogs rigasa'agre/shākya thub pa man chad nas/ /dmyal khams bco brgyad yan chad la/ /sogs/ kun tu bzang po man chad nas/ /'jag ma'i srin bu yan chad la/ /sogs/ sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro man chad nas/ kha za mkha' 'gro yan chad la/ /sogs/ chosaskyong srung ma man chad nas/ /lha srin sde brgyad yan chad la/ /sogs/ dpal ldan lha mo man chad nas/ /grong rgyug 'dre mo yan chad la/ /sogs/ dam can mgar ba /the brang pho mo sogs/ tshangs pa brgya byi nam mkha'i lha bran yan chad la/ sogs/klu rgyal mtha' yas /gdol rigs klu bran sogs/ byi na ya ka /sa 'og 'byung boḥ sogs/ gdon wo bco brgyad man lus gdon pho mo sogs/ mtho srid pa'i rtse mo man chad nas/ /dma' na rag dmyal khams yan chad la/ sogs/bar snang zhing srid pa'i lha 'dre la/ /tshad med gtor ma 'di bsngos pas/ /bla ma'i thugs dgongs rdzogs gyur cig /rgyal ba mchod pas gnyes gyur cig /dam can thugs dam skongs gyur cig /rigs drug 'dod pas tshim gyur cig /bu lon lan chags byang gyur cig /mchog gi dngos grub thob gyur cig /phaṭa/—324

'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho la/ /skam sar thon par byin gyis rlobs/ /sgyu lus gzugs kyi phung po la/ /bdag 'dzin bral bar snang ba sems kyi rang bzhin la/ /bden med rtogs bar /na tsha dge sbyor gyi bogs 'don la/ /lam du khyer bar byin /lha 'dre sems kyi 'cho 'phrul la/ /re dogs bral bar /skyid sdug sngon gyi las 'bras la/ /ro snyoms nus paraḥ /'dod yon thar pa'i bar chod la/ /zhen pa log par /'gro kun pha ma'i rang bzhin la/ /gnod sems zhi bar /sku 'gyur ba med par /gsung 'gag pa med par /thugs 'khrul pa med par /lus shags ma shigs maraḥ /sems khral ma khrol maraḥ /nyams 'ar ma 'ur mar byin gyis rlobs/ /phaṭa/ bdud rtsi'i lhag ma phyi snod kyi 'jig rten la gtor bas gzhal yas khang du gyur/ de 'od du zhu nas nang bcud kyi lha tshogs rnams la thim/ lha tshogs rnams 'od du zhu nas rang la thim phaṭa/ces brjod cing dbyings rig bsre/gnyis pa drag gcod dmar 'gyed ni/ thog mar rang gi gnas snying du thun gyi nyams len zhi gcod dang 'dra ba lasathun gyi mthar dmar 'gyed kyi dmigs pa re bya/ de la dmar 'gyed ni/ rang sems sngar bzhin phyir brtan la/ rang lus de stong gsum khyab pa'i mi ro tsho bcud snum bag dang ldan ba gcig tu gyur/ 'jig rten khams kyi lha srin sde brgyad thams cad la 'bod pa'i skad btang bas/ thams cad skad cig la 'dus te/ sa dang nam mkha' thams cad khyab par bsam/ de nas rang lus dum bur dum bur gtubs/ khyad cag ci 'dod zos/ gang 'dod pa longs/ khobarjod/ phaṭa/ rang nyid skad cig gis mkha' 'gro ma sku mdog dmar mo 'brug gi mgo can 'brug gi ngar skad dang —325

ldan pas stong gsum gyi lha 'dre thams cad klad pa bkas pa bzhin zhabs su btsud/ zhal nas thog dang ser ba 'bab pa/ sku la 'ja' tshon gyi ri mo bkra ba/phyag g.yas pas mi lpags kyi g.yang gzhi'i skyog chen po brdab cing / g.yon pas mi rkang gi gling bu tshag dir ri ri 'bud pas/ srid pa gsum gyi lha 'dre thams cad ra phag ser bas ded pa bzhin 'dir 'dus par bsam/ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa/ na mo gnyan sa 'dir gnas kyi lha 'dre dang / /skal ldan bdag la cho 'phrul ston mdzad pa'i/ /snang zhing srid pa'i lha 'dre ma lus kun/ /nam mkha'i sprin tshogs bzhin du 'dus la shog /bar snang char pa bzhin du 'phob la shog /sa gzhi rlung dmar bzhin du 'tshubs la shog /phaṭa/ sems 'gyu ba dngos med stong pa 'di/ /'dre khyod bas ngas kyang mthong ba med/ /dmyal khams bco brgyad dgrar langs kyang / /'jigs so snyams na rang la sdig /nga stong nyid nam mkha'i rnal 'byor pa/ /'byul pa'i mtshan ma chod pa'i phyir/ /'dre khyod la nyams nga rdul tsam med/ /lar thams cad sems kyi cho 'phrul yin/ /e ma khams gsum 'khor ba'i chos/ /med bzhin du snang ba ngo mtshar che/ khyed cag 'jig rten lha ma srin/ /skye 'gro'i tshe srog nyul ma rnams/ /nga sgyu ma'i gzugs kyi phung po 'di/ /mi rtag 'jig pa'i chos can te/ /cis kyang mi sdod 'dor ba la/ /'dre khyod la dgos na gang dgos khyer/ /phaṭa/ khog stod ya bdud rgyal pos khyer/ /ya bdud rgyal po tshim gyur cig khog smad ma bdud rgyal mos khyer/ /ma bdud rgyal mo tshim gyur cig /rked pa klu bdud the brang khyer/ /klu bdud the brang tshim gyur cig /yan lag gnyan chen sde bzhis khyer/ /gnyan chen —326

sde bzhi tshim gyur cig /glo snying pe har rgyal pos khyer/ /pe har rgyal po tshim gyur cig /rgyu ma yul 'dre 'khyams pos khyer/ /yul 'dre 'khyams po /phyi sha phyi yi lha 'dres khyer/ /phyi yi lha 'dre /bar sha bar gyi lha 'dres khyer/ /bar gyi lha 'dre /nang sha nang gi lha 'dres khyer/ /nang gi lha 'dre sha la dgyes pa sha la rol/ sha za'i 'chag sgra dir ri ri/ khrag la dgyes pa khrag la rol/ khrag 'thung hub sgra di ri ri/ /rus la dgyes pa rus la rol/ /rkang brdung lhab pa chibs se chibs/ /seṅge sha la rol pa bzhin/ /phud lhag med pa bzhes su gsol/ /ya gi spyi gtsug man chad nas/ /ma gi rkang mthil yan chad la/ /lhu tshigs bcu gnyis mgo bo dang / /klad pa klad rgyas gzi mdangs bkrag /nang khrol rnam lnga khu khrag zhag /dbugs dang tshe srog ba spu skra/ /rkang dang tshil bu sen mo so/ /pags pa dri ma thams cad 'bul/ /spyir khams gsum sems can glud du 'bul/ /dgos rdo rje slob dpon glud du lathul/ /chos mdzad rdo rje spun gyi glud du 'bul/ khyad par drin can pha ma'i glud du 'bul/ /lus sha khrag gtor ma 'di bsngos pas/khyed dga' mgu rangs zhing tshim gyur cig /sngon chad 'khor ba thog med kyi/ /bu lon 'brel thag chod gyur cig /phaṭa/ cesabarjod pas/ so so'i bsam pa dang mthun par sha khrag rus pa/ nang khrol yan lag sogs zos 'thung khyer bas/gnas skabs su tshim zhing / mthar thug nyon mongs zhi bar bsam/ slar de thamasacad rang gnas su song bar bsgom/ de nas de yang rang semasasu shesabazhin pas/ phaṭa/ ces dbyings rig bsre la bzhag /de lta bu yang yang bsgom/gsum pa zhi drag phyed ma ni/sngon 'gro snga ma dang 'dra ba las/ dkar 'gyed dang dmar 'gyed —327—

gnyis ka bsgom/ de yang sngon 'gro chosabazhi/ snga thun gnyisal zhi gcod lta bu dang /phyi thun gnyis la drag gcod lta bu bsgom/ mthar drag gcod ltar stong nyid kho na bsgom pa thun re bzhin bya/ de ltar nyams su blangasapas/ phyi nang gsang gsum gyi stongs tshad dang mchog thun mong gi tshan tshad la sogs pa 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /rgyas par khrid yig dang man ngag las shes par bya'o/ /snying rje sgom pa/ bshags pa dang / slon lam dang /tshogasamachod dang / gtor ma rnamasagal che'o/ /bshagasapa ni/ oṃ bde legs mchoge gi rnyed thabs te/ /rtsa ba'i bla ma yin par ma shes nas/ /dngos grub gzhan du btsal ba de/ /ma sprul pa'i sku la mthol lo bshags/ /rang sems rtsa ba chad pa de/ /chos sku yin par ma shes nas/ /sangs rgyas g.yin du btsal ba de/ /ma sprul pa'i sku la mthol lo gshags/ /gsum ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma de/ /skyabs gnas yin par ma shes nas/ /mos gus 'bul stobs chung ba de/ /ma sprul ba'i /brtse gdung 'dres pa'i mched grogs de/ /dpa' bo mkha' 'gro yin par ma shes nas/ /nyams pa'i khong khro shor ba de/ /ma sprul pa'i /tshul khrims rnam dag dri med de/ /thar lam yin par ma shes nas/ /'chal ba'i mngon lkog shor ba de/ /ma sprul ba'i /'jig rten zhen pa che ba de/ /ltas ngan yin par ma shes nas/ /rtag tu re ba byed pa de/ /ma sprul pa'i khams gsum sems can thams cad kun/ /pha ma yin par ma shes nas/ /sems can gzhan gnod byed pa de/ /ma sprul pa'i /man ngag bdud kyi gcod yul de/ /snod ngan yin par ma shes nas/ /rgyal khams yongs la spel ba de/ /ma sprul pa'i /chags med sbyin pa btang ba de/ /tshogs gnyis yin par ma shes nas/ /rang lus gces 'dzin byed pa —328

de/ /ma sprul ba'i sku la mthol lo bshags/ /mthol lo gshags so ye shes mkha' 'gro ma/ /gnong ngo 'grod do dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs/ /phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa/ na mo bdag gzhan kun gyi dus gsum du/ /dge ba 'dus byas 'dus ma byas/ /de bzhin zag bcas zag pa med/ /de dag la ni yi rang ngo / /yi rang byang chub chen por bsngo/ /tshogs kyi lam dang sbyor ba'i lam mthong ba'i lam dang sgom pa'i lam/ /bla na med pa'i khyad par lam/ /bar chad med par 'jug par shog /bar chad med par 'jug nas kyang / /ji srid 'khor ba ma stong par/ /stong nyid dam pa'i don rtogs shog /phaṭa/ bcom ldan shākya thub pa yis/ /byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pas/ /lam bgrod byang chub mchog thob nas/ /bkra shis des kyang bde legs shog /skye ba med la gzugs sku 'char/ /'gro rnams bde la 'god mdzad pas/ /yum chen pha rol phyin ma yis/ /bkra shis des kyang tshangs pa brgya byin rgyal chen bzhis/ /mchod pa'i tshogs kyis rab mchod pas/ /nin mtshan kun du bsrung byed pa/ /bkra shis des kyang bde legs phresag /phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa/ gcod yul kun kyi snying po'i don/ /gang de sgrub thabs 'di yin pas/ /nyams len gyisashig skal ldan bu/ /tsob tsob blo sna ma mang zhig khrid yig gnad don snying po'i zhabs tog tu dmigs nas/ bla ma gong ma'i gsung rgyun ngag 'don 'thor ba rnams phyogs gcig tu grags pa dpal bzang gis bsdebasate brisapa'o// //skal med la gsang ba gal che/ rgya rgya rgya/ maṅga lo/ /dge'o/ /'di brisadage bsabadag dang semasacan thamasacad kyi bdag 'dzin dbyings su chod cing bdag med rtogs pa'i rgyur gyur cig /bkra shis/ /—329

/ gsol 'debs dgongs bskyod ma ni/ ma yum chen thugs las sprul pa'i sku/ /ma cig jo mo rnal 'byor ma/ /skal ldan rnams kyi rgyud khrol ma/ /pha rol phyin ma'i grub thob ma/ /bdag dang mos pa'i gang zag la/ /ma yi dbang bskur byin gyis rlobs/ /ma cig jo mo la gsol ba 'debs/ /byang chub lam sgron la gsol ba 'debs/ /ye shes mkha' 'gro la gsol ba 'debs/ /ma skye ba dman la dgongs pa mtho/ /sku lus chung la gzi mdangs che/ /sku sha dkar la 'od zer 'phros/ /kun dang mthun pa'i spyod pa can/ /bdag dang mos sogs/ma ser sna med pa'i don rtogs pa'i/ /kun khyab sbyin pa blo gtong ba'i / /rang byung ye shes don rtogs pa'i/ /nyams pa med pa'i khrims bsrung ma/ /ma bdag gzhan med pa'i don rtogs pa'i/ /ma skye med bzod pa bsgom tsa na/ /ma gzhi rtsa med pa'i don rtogs pas/ /'bad med brtson 'grus brtsom mdzad ma/ /bdag dang mos sogs/ma g.yeng ba med pa'i don rtogs pa'i/ /g.yengs med bsam gtan sgom mdzad ma/ /mnyam pa nyid kyi don rtogs pa'i/ /bdag med shes rab sgom mdzad ma/ /bdag dang mos sogs/ ma phyogs med lta bu'i zhen pa khrol/ /mnyam nyid sgom pa'i dmigs gtad grol/ /rtogs med spyod pa'i nyam nga grol/ /dmigs med 'bras bus re dogs grol/ /gti mug med pa'i don rtogs pa'i/ /rnam mkhyen thugs la mnga' mdzad ma/ /bdag dang mos sogs/ma mnyam nyid ngang la bzhugs tsa na/ /don mtha' dbus med pa'i nyams dang ldan/ /dug lnga spang pa'i ye shes kyi/ /sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro 'bum gyi bskor//nyams dbyangs mgur ma khrol lo lo/ /gdam ngag sbrang char si li li/ /byin —330

rlabs na bun thu lu lu/ /g.yas na dpa' bo sha ra ra/ /g.yon na dpa' mo thibs se thibs/ /mi rkang gling bu kyu ru n+dan /tshul chen dud pa chi li li/ /hūṃ gi gdam pa sha ra ra/ /phaṭa kyi 'brug sgra di ri ri/ /bdag dang mos pa'i gang zag la/ /ma yi dbang bskur byin gyis rlobs/ /ma cig jo mo la gsol ba 'debs//byang chub lam sgron lajo /ye shes mkha' 'gro la /ma mnyam nyid ngang la bzhugs tsa na/ /don rjes thob gsal ba'i nyams dang ldan/ /sna tshogs mkha' 'gro 'bum gyis bskor/ /nyams dbyangs sogs bgres so/ /ma dgongs pa shar du bskyod tsa na/ /don skye ba med pa'i don dang ldan/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro 'bum gyi bskor/ /nyams dbyangs sogs/ma dgongs pa lho ru skyod tsa na/ /don yon tan rdzogs pa'i nyams dang ldan/ /rin chen mkha' 'gro 'bum gyi bskor/ /nyams dbyangs sogs/ ma dgongs pa nub tu bskyod tsa na/ /don skyon rnams dag pa'i nyams dang ldan/ /pad+ma mkha' 'gro 'bum gyi bskor/ /nyams dbyangs sogs/ma dgongs pa byang du bskyod tsa na/ /don 'gags pa med pa'i nyams dang ldan/ /las kyi mkha' 'gro 'bum gyi bskor/ /nyams dbyangs sogs/ ma dgongs pa dbus su bskyod tsa na/ /don mtha' dbus med pa'i nyams dang ldan/ /rig pa dbyings su pu ru mā /rig med lta ba phya la la/ /mnyam nyid dgongs pa phri li li/ /mkha' 'gro'i ma tshogs thibs se thibs/ /bdag dang mos pa'i gang zag la/ /byin gyis rlabs par mdzad du gsol/ /phaṭaḥ phaṭaḥ de ltar gsol 'debs dgongs bskyod ma 'di ni slob ma dbang bskur ba'i skabs gtor dbang gi mgor 'don dgos lags/ dbang gi mgor mi dgos lags/ sgra bsgyur smra ba'i phyag tu phul/ bran pa blos tshul nas so/ /maṅga lo/ dge'o/ /—331—

phaṭa/ ma mi min ye shes mkha' 'gro ma/ /rnam thar gsum gyi sgo 'byed ma/ /bdud kyi dpung rnams 'joms mdzad ma/ /lab sgron khyed la gsol ba 'debs/ /thugs rje dgongs la byin gyis rlobs/ /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol/ /'og min chos sku'i pho brang du/ /yum chen sher phyin byin rlabs can/ /byin rlabs can la gsol ba 'debs/ /blo snyem thags chod par byin gyis rlobs/ /bya rgod phung po'i ri bo la/ /bcom ldan shāka thub byin rlabs can/ /sogs/ rgya nag ri bo rtse lnga sa /'jam dpal smra seng sogs/ g.yu lo bkod pa'i zhing khams su/ /rje btsun sgrol ma sogs/ dag pa'i bde stong mkha' sbyod du/ /rdo rje phag mo sogs/o rgyan mkha' 'gro'i pho brang du/ su kha sirnyi sogs/rgya gar 'jags ma'i spyil po sa /ār+ya de ba sogs/ la stod deng ri gling stod du/ /dam pa sangs rgyas sogs/ ra sa spang lung dgon pa mā /bsod nams bla ma sogs/ zangs ri mkhar dmar dgon pa mā /ma cig lab sgron sogs/ rgyal thang chu gtsang dgon pa sa /bsam bstan 'od zer sogs/ byang chub gling gi dben gnas su/ /nam mkha' 'od zer sogs/ gnyan khrod brgya rtsa'i gnas mchog tu/ shwakya 'od zer sogs/ phyogs med yangs pa'i ri khrod du/ /bde gshegs comatshan can sogs/ byin rlabs bla ma'i zhabs drung du/ /dbon sras chos legs sogs/ kha rag bsam gling dgon pa sa /g.yu phrug sher dpal sogs/ chos lung —332

byang rtse'i dben gnas su/ /rje btsun grol mchog sogs/ brag stod rdo rje'i pho brang du/ /chos sku lha dbang sogs/ chos 'byung bdag med pho brang du/ /lung rig rgya mtsho byin rlabs can/ /byin rlabs can la sogs ba 'debs/ /blo snyem thag chod par byin gyis rlobs/ khams gsum 'gro ba'i spyi bo mā /kun dga' snying po sogs/ bdud rtsi phug gi dben gnas su/ /grags pa dpal bzang sogs/gnod sbyin ming gi dgon pa r+yā /kun dga' rin chen sogs/ 'bral med snying gi dkyil nang du/ /'phrin las rnam rgyal sogs/ spyi gtsug nyi zla'i gdan steng du/ /rtsa ba'i bla ma sogs/ nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i gnas mchog tu/ /dpa' bo mkha' 'gro sogs/ bsil ba tshal gyi dur khrod du/ /chos skyong srung ma sogs/ dag snang phyogs med gzhal yas su/ /rdo rje spun grogs sogs/ mtshan ldan gyi bla ma rin po che/ /bdag la byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ /re sa gzhan na med pa'i byin gyis rlobs/ /bdag 'dzin blo'i thongs b.raḥ /skye med 'od gsal rtogs par /bar chod dngos grub long bar /bdud tshogs rang sar chod par /tshe gcig sangs rgyas 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /khyad par du bdag sogs semasacan thams cad kyi bla ma la mos gus drag po'i gsol ba 'debs par bsam/ brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs de nyid bdag 'jug gi mgor 'don par /'o/ / —333

mu tig phreng ba bzhugs/'o nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du theg pa chen po'i gcod kyi dbang zab mo gsan snyams pa'i bsam pa byang chub mchog tu thugs bskyed te gsan par zhu/ gang gsan par byed pa de nyid la yang / rgyud nyi zla kha sbyor las/lo rgyus don gyis ma bshad na/ /gsang chen nges pa'i bka' 'di la/ /yid mi ches pa'i skyon du gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa bzhin/ sngon gyi dus na/ ngam shod smad kyi grogs mtsho bya ba na/ yab sge khad chos la bya ba dang / yum phyug mo 'bum sde lcam bya ba'i lhums su zhugs nas/ ma'i lus la bzhugs pa'i skabs su yum gyi rmi lam du sgron me btegs pa dang / zla ba drug lon pa'i dus su khyim thams cad sgron mes gang ba dang / zla ba dgu pa'i dus su yul thams cad sgron mes gang ba rmis pa dang / zla ba bcu lon pa'i skabs su ga ta'i sngags dang ha ri ni sa'i sngags sgra grags pa sogs ngo mtshar ba mang du 'byung bas yum gyis yab la/nga'i lus la yod pa 'di lha mi gang gis sprul pa yin pa mi shes/ 'di 'dra'i rtags byung ba ci yin dris pa na/ yab kyis ga ti'i sngags ni bcom ldan 'das kyi snying po dang / ha ri ni sa mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyi snying po yin/ bdud kyis sprul pa ni min gzhan la ma smra gsungs/ de nas sku bltams te mas gzigs pa —334

na/ mdog dkar ba dpral ba na spyan gsum yod pa zhal nas a a zhes gsungs pa/ skye thog tu yi ge hrīḥdamar po gcig 'khor ba snang ba'i yab la smras pa na/ yab kyis 'di bzang ngan ci yin shan ma 'byed kyi bar du gsang dgos gsungs/ zla ba gsum lon pa na mi rnams kyis yid du 'ong ba dang ngo mtshar ba'i mtshan ma du ma byung ba dang / de nas yab yum dag gis sgron tshe ma zhes ming btags / yul du nad rims yod pa rnams kyi rgyun chad pa dang / de nas dge bshes in ston gyi mdun du phyin nas de'i zhal nas khyod kyi bu mo 'di la mkha' 'gro ma'i mtshan rtags tshang 'dug 'di la klog slob dang chos pa bzang po zhig 'ong bar 'dug gsungs/ de nas rab tu byung nas yi ge bslab pas lo bcu tsam nas klog la mkhas par gyur/ dus lan gcig na yul de'i rgyal pos ston mo chen po bshams pas thams cad ston mo la song ba'i der 'dus pa'i pho mo thams cad kyis bu mo 'di gang nas 'ong ba yin 'di ngo mtshar ba gcig 'dug ces kun gyis smras pa dang / yab kyis lab kyi yul nas 'ong ba yin pa sogs rgyu mtshan bshad pa dang / khrom rnams kyis bu mo la lab sgron mtshan du gsol ba yin/ de nas g.yu ru gra thang du byon nas/ grwa pa mngon shes can gyi drung du 'bum rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum 'don nas 'dug tsa na/ rgya pho ba grong 'jug gi 'bum cha gcig klog pa'i grwa pa mngon shes can gyis jo mo khyod zhwa chung 'di gyon na bzang bar 'dug gsungs pa'i ming jo mo zhwa chung can du btags/ rgya pho ba grong 'jug gi klog 'don pa las jo mo nyis 'gyur gyis bzang po thag chod pa byung / de skabs rgya gar gyi a tsa ra'i mngon shes kyi gzigs nas der byon pa'i —335

sngon rgya gar ser skya'i grong khyer du byon pa'i paṇ+ḍi ta a tsa ra gcig po ṭa la'i brag phug tu bsgoms nas yod pa'i dus su mkha' 'gros lung bstan nas sngon las mkhan byas pa 'dir tshe 'phos nas/ lab kyi lung pa na sku 'khrungs te/'dir bzhugs pa mjal du 'ong ba yin zer/ phyir nyin nyi ma shar dus mjal ba'i phyag byas nas dbu gtugs res byas/ jo mo'i zhal nas/ dam pa khyod bod yul du 'gro don la byon pa ngo mtshar che gsungs/ dam pa'i zhal nas khyod ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma bod yul du 'gro don du byon pa yin pas ngo mtshar che/a tsa ra de nyid dam pa rgya gar yin/ jo mo ni ma cig lab kyi sgron ma yum chen mo'i sprul pa bod yul du 'gro don la pheb pa dang / 'di'i chos rgyun ni mkha' la nyi ma shar ba ltar mtha' dbus med par sa steng kun tu khyab pa yin/ de nas dbu gtsang dang rgyal khams phyogs med du byon pa dang / la stod dwang ri la byon nas dam pa rgya gar dang mjal/ dam pa'i mngon shes kyis gzigs pa'i ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma lab kyi sgron ma byon gsungs pas thams cad kyis bsu ba byas/ dam pa dang nyams bskur byas/ de nasazangs ri mkhar dmar du byon te/ yon bdag mo chos mtsho bya ba gcig gi rtsar bzhugs nas yod skabs srod la gzhi bdag de byung nas des jo mo khyod kyi mtshan ni lab sgron du snang / steng ya ki na dur khrod yod pa de la dgon pa btabs nas bzhugs na ngas yon bdag byed zer/ yang mi dmar rta dmar can zhig 'byung ba 'di zangs ri'i gzhi bdag yin par snang / der dgon pa btabasanas bzhugs pa'i lo gsum tsam na bstan pa nam mkha' dang monyam pa/ sku'i snyan pa 'brug ltar sgrogaba'ipa byung / de —336

nas rgya chos dang bod chos gnam chos sa chos sogs dang / bka' gter gnyis dang pho gcod mo gcod sogs ngos bzung byas/ chos 'di'i brgyud pa bshad na spyir dam pa'i chos thams cad rgya gar nas bod la dar ba yin/ bod kyi chos rgya gar na'ang yod/ rgya gar rdo rje gdan du chos thams cad bsdus nas chos thams cad rgya gar na'ang yod pa yin gyi/ deng sang bod la phyag rgya chen po'i gcod pa gcig yod zer bas ci 'dra yin rkang mgyogs gcig byas nas rgya gar la 'gro zer nas gros byas nas rkang mgyogs btang / khra hor ba dgung sngon la 'grim pa bzhin byon pas zhag gnyis nas zangs ri mkhar dmar ma'i sgo drung du slebs/ de nas nye gnas rnams kyis 'u cag gi sgo drung na a tsa ra gsum 'dug zer/ ma'i zhal nas a tsa ra gsum gyi gzugs ci 'dra/ gos ci 'dra gyon 'dug ltos gsungs nas bltas tsa na/ gzhan gyis gos gyon lugs ma red/dar gyi la wos gsum de gyon 'dug zer/ de nas mas mdun du bos nas 'tsho ba drangs / bgro gleng byas tsa na/ mas rgya gar gyi skad thogs med du mkhyen/ a tsa ra rnams kyis nyid kyi rgya gar gyi skad 'di tsam mkhyen pa 'di ci yin dris pas/ma'i zhal nas nga tshe snga ma rgya gar du skyes pas yin gsungs/ a tsa ras skye ba dran pa yin nam zer bas/ ngas skye ba snga phyi da lta gsum dran gsungs/ de gsum ci ltar dran gsungs zhus pa'i/ ma'i rgya gar skad kyis bshad na grwa slob rnams kyi mi go /bshad kyang dgos pa chung gsungs/ de nas a tsa ra gsum brang khang du bzhag pa'i zhabs tog byas/ dbu gtsang ru bzhi'i mkhas btsun rnams dang / yul phyogs kyi grwa skor yon bdag dang / rgya gar ba dang bod kyi lo —337

tsā ba kun la/ pho nya btang nas thams cad bsdus pas 'bum tsho bdun dang brgya 'tshogs te/ de nas mchod pa chen po dang ston mo bshams/ der 'tshogs pa rnams kyi gong du bzhugs nas ma cig gi mdun du a tsa ra rnams bos nas chos kyi bgro gleng byas te log rtog ci rigs pa bsal/ dbu gtsang gi lo tsā ba bzhis 'tshogs pa rnams la lo tsās bsgyur nas ma'i chos rgyud thams cad kun gyis yid ches pa dang / a tsa ra rnams kyis chos thams cad rgya gar nas ma byung ba med gsungs/ ma'i zhal nas rgya gar bod la bka' drin che/ rgya gar nas chos dar tshul khyed gsum gyis shod gsungs/ nged gsum gyis mi shes pas mas gsungs zhus pas/ ma'i zhal nas nga ni yum chen mo'i sprul pa yin pas shes zer/ sngon rgya gar gyi rgyal po dza wa bya ba bzhugs pa'i dus su gdamags ngag gi rgyun thams cad char bzhin du babs pa yin/ de yang yum gyis byin gyis rlabs pa yin gsungs/ 'o skol 'dir 'tshogs pa'i khrom pa rnams gson dang / nga yi skye ba snga phyi da lta rnams ma bshad na nga yi brgyud pa 'dzin pa rnams kyis yid mi ches/ phyag rgya chen po'i gcod kyi rgyud ma bshad na gdams ngag la yid mi ches gsungs nas skye ba snga phyi dang gcod kyi rgyun zla ba gcig la gsungs pas/ der 'tshogs pa rnams kyis yid ches/ tshig gi sgro 'dog chod pa dang / yang yum gyi skye rabs ni/ sum cu rtsa gsum dga' ldan lha yul na/ gling chen po bde skyob nor bu phun tshogs kyi gling zhes bya ba na/ yab ni rgyal po bde skyong dang / yum dpal mtsho bya ba'i sras su zhabrungs te lha yul du 'gro don dpag med mdzad/ de nas rdo rje gdan gyi ser skya'i grong khyer du yab a'i dbang —338

phyug /yum lha za klu sgron bya ba gnyis kyi sras su zhabrungs/ mtshan sde smon 'grub tu btags/ rgya gar gyi mu stegs pa mang po btul nas nang pa'i sde la bkod/yab yum kyi gshegs rdzong byas/ chos tshan gyi sgro 'dogs bcad nas po ta la'i brag phug tu sgom zhing bzhugs pa'i skabs su mkha' 'gro las mkhan byas nas bem rig bral/ ngas bem po brag phug nang du yod pa'i mgo la rgyal ba rig lnga la ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma lngas bskor ba 'bur du dod pa dang / snying la shākya thub pa rang byung du dod pa yod pa dang / lhag ma'i ro de la gdung sha ri raṃ sran ma tsam 'bum dang / de ma yin pa'i ring bsrel kha dog sna lnga pa rdo rje gdan gyi bre gang gi tshad byon nas yod/ zhes gsungs pas der 'tshogs pa rnams kyis gros byas nas rgya gar du rkang mgyogs gsum btang nas/ rdo rje gdan du song nas rgya gar gyi rgyal po dang paṇ+ḍi ta rnams 'dus nas thams cad la sngar gyi ma'i lo rgyus dang / po ta la'i ri'i khung gi gdungs rus kyi lo rgyus rnams zhus pas/rgyal po dang paṇ+ḍi ta rnams kyi zhal nas 'di yum gyi sprul pa yin nam rgyal bsen gyi sprul ba yin cha med/ gdams ngag ma lus pa len dgos/ po ta la'i brag phug tu song nas i bden ltos gsungs te/ parnyi ta rnams der song bas/ lab sgron gyi ci skad gsungs pa bzhin yod pas gdung rus rnams rgya gar du gdan drangs/ rgyal po rnams kyis phyogs su rkang mgyog btang te mi skya pho mo rnams bsdus nas/ rten rnams bstan pas kun gyis ngo mtshar skyes nas/ ma cig gi chos rgyun gcod rgyud snoms gdan drangs pa'i gros byas / ring bsrel bre gang yod pa de rgyal po thams cad lu phul bas tshim par byas/ dbu la rigs lnga —339

bzhugs pa rdo rje gdan du bzhag te rten du byas/ thugs la shākya thub pa yod pa de bod yul du dam pa rgya gar dang rkang mgyogs gi mi rnams kyis bzung nas zangs ri mkhar dmar du ma'i drung du 'ongs nas/ khyed yum chen thugs sprul yin pas ngo mtshar che/ zhal nas gsungs pa thams cad zhakhrul med du 'dug pa sogs zhus pa dang / de nas thugs la byon pa'i shākya thub pa de dbus gtsang gi skye bo thams cad la mjal bcug nas kun kyi rgyud la lung rtogs kyi bstan pa ci rigs pa skyes pa'i sgo nas 'gro don rgya cher 'byung / thugs su gyur pa'i rten de dam pa rgya gar gyi gdan drangs/ de nas ma cig gis gcod kyi rgyud pha rgyud ma rgyud nye rgyud ring rgyud thams cad gsungs nas bsdus te ngo mtshar can gyi brjod pa bcu gsum gsungs pa dang / de thams cad rkang mgyogs gsum la rdo rje gdan du bskur nas rgya gar du dar bar mdzad/ de nas yum gyi sras 'grub pa/'grub chung / thod ston bsam 'grub bya ba de rnams yin pa'i 'grub chung ni/ lo bcu lon pa na gza' nad phog nas bsto (smyo brgyal du song ba ni/ ma'i drung du khyer ba'i mas snod ldan du gzigs pa dang / rmi lam du phyogs bzhir dung 'bud pas gling bzhi la sgras khyab par rmis/ de nas mas rjes su bzung nas dmigs pa brgya rtsa bstan dur khrod na zhag bdun nyal bas spyo nad kyang sos/dam pa rgya gar gyi mdun du rab tu byung / mtshan thod snyan bsam 'grub gsol/ma'i thugs la yod pa'i gdams pa rnams gnang / ma cig seng ge dkar mo la chibs te sham bu gangs la byon nas seṅge'i khri'i steng nas mkha' 'gro mas tshogs kyis bskor nas bzhugs pa'i skabs su sras kyang der byon nas rgyud —340

pa'i dbang dang / tshe dbang ma rgyud mkha' 'gro'i dbang / snyan rgyud kyi lung bstan thams cad bgrol nas gnang/ sham bu'i gzhi bdag yang dam la btags nas bka' sgo mdzad/ de nas ma'i zhal nas nga lo dgu bcu go dgu lon pas/ sras rgyal ba don 'grub la dbusu gtsang ru bzhi'i grwa slob rnams bsdus gsungs/thams cad bsdus nas tshogs brgya mang du byas/ dbang dang byin rlabs mdzad/dam rdzas rnams grwa pa rnams la gnang / 'brug gi lo'i tshes bco lnga'i mtshan mor zangs mkhar du byon nas tho rangs skya rings shar ba'i dus su sku gshegs tshul byas/ skabs su sras gnyis kyi phyag tu zhal mchil re re blugaba'ipas/ sras rgyal ba don 'grub kyi phyag tu dung g.yas su 'khyil ba gcig byon/ 'gro ba'i don yun ring du 'byung bar gyur cig gsungs/ thod ston bsam 'grub kyi phyag tu rje btsun ma'i sku gcig byon/ mo rgyud dbang dang ldan par gyur cig ces gsungs/ de nas ma cig seng ge la chibs nas 'khor mkha' 'gro ma grangs med kyis bskor nas sku lus lhag med du nub phyogs u rgyan mkha' 'gro'i yul du phebs/ de nas sras thod ston bsam 'grub sham bu'i gad la pheb nas/sras gnyis dang grwa slob rnams kyis ma'i na bza' rnams me mchod byas pas 'ga' zhig rten rnams bzhengs mchod pa rgya chen po byas so/ /de nas sras gnyis dang grwa slob rnams kyis gcod kyi rgyud sa steng kun tu khyab par byas/ma'i zhal nas gcod 'di g.yu'i dum bu dang gser gyi phye ma dang 'dra/ man ngag sna res kyang phan thogs chen po 'byung / de bzhin du gcod mkhan gyi chos gzhan mi shes kyang gcod 'dis nyagro don byed thub/ skye med kyi don khong du chud nas —341—

sems can thams cad smin grol gyi lam la myur du 'god pa yin no/ /de lta bu'i sangs rgyas nas da lta'i bar du brgyud pa'i zam pa ma chad/ gdams ngag kyi bcud ma nyams/ byin rlabs kyi drod ma yal/ bka' rgyud don gyi gdams pa dbang po rab 'bring mtha' gsum gyi gcod nang drod tshad gsum dang ldan pa/cho 'phrul rang zhi la gtong bar byed pa'i nad brgya sman gcig ltar byin brlabs rtags mtshan dang ldan pa ni/ grub thob gcod kyi rgyud 'di nyid yin la/ 'di'i dbang zab mo sgrub bar byed pa la slob dpon gyi bya ba dang / slob ma'i bya ba gnyis yod pa las slob dpon gyi bya ba rnams sngon du legs par grub zin/ da khyed rang rnams kyi ngos skal du gyur pa la bla ma dang ma cig lab sgron dbyer ma mchis pa'i drung du dbang zab mo zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal phul/ oṃ badz+ra bhu mi aḥ&/ zhes sogs maṇ+ḍal phul// //zhes gcod dbang gi lo rgyus mu tig phreng ba zhes bya ba 'di ni/gcod rgyud rnams kyi nang nas nye bar mkho ba rnams darmā bi dza ya('phrin las rnam rgyal/〉sa smras pa'o/ /ri tsho —342

dbu khye1gas legs par bsdo/gas pa lags/na mo gu n+dasga gcod yul gyi dbang nam mkha' sgo 'byed du grags pa bskur bar 'dod pas/maṇ+ḍal pad+ma 'dab bzhi tshom bu phyogs mdog can de'i steng du mañji la gtor ma dkar zlum lnga tshom/ mar dang sha dang bu ram gyis brgyan pa bzhag /mtha' mchod gtor gang 'dzoms kyis bskor/ bgegs gtor spyi dang mthun par btang la bgegs bskrad/ phyogs skyong dang gzhi bdag la sngon 'gro gtor ma'i cho ga gang yang rung ba zhig gis gtor ma btang / mchod pa byin brlabs kyang spyi dang mthun/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed sngon du 'gro ba'i mdo bsgrub gang nus byas ste/ sngon 'gro'o/ /de'i sdom ni/ yo byad cha rkyen legs 'dzoms nas/ /legs bsham bgegs bskrad gtor ma btang / /mchod pa byin brlabs skyabasa'agro dang / /sems bskyed mdo bsgrub spyi 'gro yin/ /de nas bdag dang mdun bskyed gnyis ka swa bhā was stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las skad cig gis chos 'byung gi nang dur khrod 'bar ba'i gzhal yas kyi dbus su/ sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma bzhi pa/ tshosna bzhi ḍā ki ni oṃ/ dbus su sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro ma dkar mo 'khor lo'i thor tshugs can/ oṃ badz+ra ḍā ki ni hūṃ/ zhar du rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma sngon po'am rdo rje'i thor tshugs can/ oṃ rat+na ḍā ki nī traṃ/ lhor rin chen mkha' 'gro ma ser po'am rin po che'i thor tshugs can/ oṃ pad+ma ḍā ki ni hrīḥ nub tu pad+ma mkha' 'gro ma dmar po'am pad+ma'i thor tshugs can/ oṃ garma ḍā ki ni āḥ byang du las kyi mkha' 'gro ma ljang khu rdo rje rgya gram gyi thor tshugs can/ thams cad kyang spyan gsumyo/ pa —343

ḍā ma ru dang thod pa kha ṭ+wāṃ ga bsnams pa/ zhabs gar stabs bsgyur ba/ rin po che dang rus pa la sogs pa'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ rang mtshungs kyi 'khor 'bum sde dang bcas pa'o/ /hrīḥmahā ḍā ki niḥ ma āḥsnyi/ gtso mo'i mdun du rang nyid ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma gtso mo dang 'dra ba las/ phyag g.yon dril bu 'brol ba'o/ /de nas bdug spos dang rol mo'i sgra dang bcas te/hrī mos gus dag pa'i pho brang nas/ /bla ma dkon mchog gshegs su gsol/ /rang bzhin rnam dag gzhal yas nas/ /yi dam lha tshogs gshegs su gsol/ /rdo rje can gyi zhing khams nas/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro spyan 'dren no/ /rin chen 'bar ba'i zhing khams nas/ /rin chen mkha' 'gro spyan 'dren no/ /pad+ma can gyi zhing khams nas/ /pad+ma mkha' 'gro spyan 'dren no/ /'brug sgra sgrogs pa'i zhing khams nas/ /las kyi mkha' 'gro 'khor lo can gyi zhing khams nas/ /sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro gar bzhugs gnas mchog dam pa nas/ /ma cig ye shes mkha' 'gro spyan 'dren no/ /nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i gnas mchog nas/ /dpa' bo mkha' 'gro gshegs su gsol/ /bstan pa rin chen gzhal yas nas/ /bstan srung chos skyong gshegs su gsol/ /oṃ gu ru de wa ḍā ki nī a gu sha dzaḥ pa sha hūṃ/ sbo ṭa baṃ/ ghaṇ+ḍi hoḥ snying ga'i sa bon las 'od 'phros/ /bde gshegs rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i tshogs/ /dbang gi don du 'dir byon la/ /sna tshogs mchod pas mnyes gyur cig /ji ltar bltams pa nas/shri ye hūṃ gis/sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro la rnam snang / rdo rje mkha' 'gro la mi bskyod pa/ rin chen mkha' 'gro la rin chen 'byung / pad+ma mkha' 'gro la snang mtha'/ las kyi mkha' 'gro la don grub/ rang —344—

nyid ma cig ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma la rigs lnga char gyis dbu brgyan/ dri med yid du 'ong ba yi/ /lha rdzas dam pa'i mchod yon 'di/ /bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro la/ /'bul lo ṅgezhes shig byin gyis rlobs/ /oṃ gu ru de wa ḍa ki nī arnya pra tīts+tsha ā kli swāhā/ de bzhi du rol mo nasashap+ta'i bar du 'don pa spo/ oṃ gu hūṃ de wa ḍā ki ni pañca a mṛ ta āḥ(/ zhesanang mchod 'thul/ spro na/ ban+ta snod bzang yangs pa sa /rang byung gdod nas rnam par dag /rtsa brgyad stong la sbyar ba'i sman/ /rigs lnga'i dam latshig lnga yi dngos/ /ye shes lnga rdzogs grub pa'i rdzas/ /dug lnga sel ba'i bdud rtsi 'di/ /rgyu drug sems can kun sgrol shing / /bla ma yi dam tshogs la 'bul/ /mchod pa dam pa 'bul gyis bzhes/ /mchod bzhes dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /sngags rnying ma'i lugasadang mthun pa'i gyer byed par gda'/ gtor ma rnams yi dam gyi mngon rtogs gang rung zhig dang mthun par byin gyis brlabs par bya/ gtor ma dngos de bla ma yi dam dbyer med dam pa la yi dam gang byed kyi gtor tshogs kyis 'bul/ gnyis pa mkha' 'gro sde lnga la gong gi sngags thung re re'i mthar/ dzi5 kā ze( btags pa lan gsum gsum gyis 'bul/ gsum pa ste chos skyong la rang gi gtor chog gisa'abul/ bzhi pa mkha' 'gro spyi gtor dang / lnga pa gzhi bdag gtor ma'i cho ga btang / drug pa a kā blos lan drug gis rigasadrug la bsngo/ slob ma'i rgyud la nyams rtogs khyad par can skye bar gsol ba btab/brgyud pa'i bla ma'i gsol 'debs sngon du 'gro ba'i sgo nas slob ma la ji ltar bskul ba'i cho ga'i bya ba rnams rang gis kyang dmigs pa'i sgo nas bdag 'jug du blangs/ tshogasardzas bshams pa rnams yi dam gang byed kyi gtor chog dang mthun par byin gyis rlabs te bzhag go/de dag gi sdom ni/ stong nyid — —345—

lhar bskyed spyan 'dren dang / /dgug gzhug rgyas btab mchod gtor 'bul/ /gsol 'debasabadag 'jug tshogs byin rlabs/ /dkyil 'khor bsgrub pa'i spyi sdom yin/ /de nasaslob ma rnamasanang du gzhug /chab btang gral la 'khod/ me rtag bkye bsdu bya/ sngon 'gro chosashad byasal/ mkha tsol du gtso ste/rdo rje slob dpon dgongs su garmel/ /thugs chos kyi dbyings las ma g.yos kyang / /'gro ba 'dren pa'i don slad du/ /rdo rje 'chang du sku sprul nas/ /dbang bskur zab mo stsol ba dang / /chos kyi 'bor lo bskor du gsol/ /tshogs kyi 'khor lo bla na med/ zhan tu rgya chen bskor du garbesal/ /zhesalan gsum dang / dpon slob thams cad kyis sher snying lan gsum mam lan bdun bzlog pa dang bcas pa bya/ 'di'i sngon du bgegs gtor gtong ba'i lugs kyang 'dug pas spro na de bzhin du bya/ de nas skyabs 'gro 'bogs te 'dis rjesasu zlosabyar gzhug go/sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ slob dpon bdag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba dus 'di nas bzung ste/ ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du/ rkang gnyis rnams kyi mchog sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /'dod chags dang bral ba rnams kyi mchog /zhi ba mya ngan las 'das pa'i chos rnams la skyabs su tshogs rnams kyi mchog /byang chub sems dpa' phyir mi ldog pa'i 'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /lan gsum/ semasabaskyed ni/ dgongasasu gsol gong bzhi/ ji ltar sngon gyi de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams dang / sa chen por bzhugs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems —346

bskyed pa de bzhin du/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas kyang / dus 'di nas bzung ste/ ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed par bgyis te/ sems can ma bsgral ba rnams bsgral bar bgyi'o/ /ma grol ba rnams dgrol bar bgyi'o/ /dbugs ma dbyung ba rnams dbugs dbyung bar bgyi'o/ /yongs su mya ngan las ma 'das pa rnams yongs su mya ngan las 'da' bar bgyi'o/ /lan gsum/ 'jug sems kyang len pa'i thol kyang yod mod/ logasasu ma byas kyang chog /bsdus pa la mngon par dga' bas gur nasabyung ba'i rgyun bshags sam/ sangs rgyas chos dang sogs kyi chog ste sngon 'gro'o/ /dngos gzhi la nam mkha' sgo 'byed dngos ni/ sprosabral dngos med la brten pa'i ngo sprod pa dang /spros bcas dngos po la brten nas ngo sprod pa'o/ /dang po ni/ khyed rang rnams kyis lus gnad bcas/ rlung rang sar bzhag /sems bzo bcos med par lhan ne+e ba'i ngang nas cher re ltos shig /de'i ngo bo ni rang gzhan du ma grub de bzhin du kha dog dang dbyibs dang phyi dang nang dang bem po dang / shes pa 'gro ba dang go ba gang yang ngos bzung med par skye 'gags gnas gsum dang bral ba'i ngang de nyid la 'khor 'das thams cad 'char du rung ba 'di ka don dam shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa de yin no/ /zhesaganas pa'i steng nasango sprad/ yang khyed rang rnams dran pa legs par bzung la rnam rtog gi skye 'gags gnas gsum gyi steng du 'char sgo ji ltar 'dug pa lta dgos pa'i rnam rtog zhig bskyed la gzhig 'grel thongs shig /ces lta ru gzhug /yang 'di skad du/ sems gnas pa'i rnam rtog skyes pa'i tshe yang skye bzhin pa'i dus de nyid nas ngos bzung med/ rnam rtog shar nas —347—

ma 'gags par lam me yod pa'i skabs de nyid na/ phyi nang bar gsum/ mthong thos rig gsum gang gi ngo bor yang 'di lta bu'o zhes ma grub par gnas pa'i dus na yang ngo bzung med/ yang rnam rtog yal ba'i tshe yul 'di lta bu zhig tu tshul 'di lta bur 'gags zhes kyang dmigs su med/ des na skye 'gags gnas gsum du snang ba 'di thams cad 'char sgo ma 'gags tsam ma gtogs ngos bzung med pa 'di gsar du byung ba ma yin gdod nas gnas lugs lags so/ /de nas rang ngo ma shes na rnam rtog bdud yin/ rang ngo shes na chos nyid kyi rol pa zhes gsungs zhes sogs ngo sprod/ rgyasabasdusaslob ma'i rgyud dang lamo par bshad/ de lta bu'i gnas lugs mi rtogs shing phung du 'jug mkhan bdag gces 'dzin 'di yin pas/ lus 'di la gces pa'i snyems khrig rdul tsam yang med par gnod byed 'byung po thams cad la blos rgyangs kyis thongs shig /yang lus sems gces par 'dzin pa'i phyir rnam rtog kho rang gi ngo bo la cher gyi ltos la/phaṭaḥ ces brjod la de dbyings blta zhing / phaṭaḥ 7gnyis pa ni/ khyed rang rnams kyis mig mi rig dgu rig 'di rkang mthil gnyis su 'od dkar po bya sgong tsam gnyis su song / 'gril nas gsang gnas su cung zad 'dug / de bzhin du lte ba/ snying ga /mgrin pa/ spyi gtsug gi sgo rnams su 'gril/ spyi gtsug tshangs pa'i bu ga nas 'don la khad khad 'dug pa la/ phaṭaḥ ces brjod pa'i rgyangs kyi thon rnam smin gyi lus skyed rnams la zan du bor/ rig pa gsal la ngos bzung med pa de nam mkha' la chams te khyab pa'i ngang der lhod kyis zhog cig /phaṭaḥ dmigasapa 'di lan gsum 'bogasapa las/ dang po la —348—
