slob ma rnamasaskyil krung mnyam bzhag byed/ gnyis pa la tsog pusa'aphongs sal ma reg tsam dang bcas/lag pa snying khar rdo rje bsdamasapa'i phyag rgya byed/ gsum pa langs te rkang pa'i brang sal btsug /thal mo spyi bor sbyar/ gsum ka la nywa bzhi sgrengs zhing gyen du blta'o/ /rol mo'i mthar rol mo byed pa'i lugasakyang yod/ 'di skabs ye shes phebs pa'ang 'byung ngo / /de nas phyag rgya'i rjesaganang ni/ 'di ni mkha' 'gro thams cad kyis/ /pha rol phyin drug mtshon pa'i rgyan/ /rgyan de thogs la bdud rnams mchod/ /rgyan drug rus pa'i dbu mar ro/ /oṃ mahā ḍā ki ni ka ya a bhi ṣiñca hūṃ/ zhes rgyan drug g.yogs/gsung sngagasakyi rjesaganang ni/ 'di ni mkha' 'gro thams cad kyi/ /gzung 'dzin dbyings su gcod pa'i sgra/ /sgra 'di sgrogs cing bdud rnams chod/ /gsung skad phaṭa kyi dbang bskur ro/ /oṃ mahā ḍā ki nī waka a bhi ṣiñca hūṃ/ dbyingasarig bsre ba'i/phaṭaḥ lan gsum brjod/ 'di ni mkha' 'gro thams cad kyi/ /don dam stong nyid snying po'i don/ /don 'di bsgom zhing bdud rnams chod/ /chos nyid don gyi dbang bskur ro/ /oṃ mahā ḍā ki ni tsit+ta a bhi ṣiñca hūṃ/ 'di ni mkha' 'gro thams cad kyi/ khams gsum dbang du bsdud pa'i sgra/ /sgra 'di sgrogs cing bdud rnams chod/ /cang te'u sgra yi dbang bskur ro/ /oṃ mahā ḍā zhi nī gu ṇa abhi ṣiñca hūṃ/ zhesacang te7 brol du ga'i /'di ni mkha' 'gro thams cad kyi/ /snang srid bden med rtogs pa'i skad/ /skad 'dis bsgyur zhing bdud rnams chod/ /mi rkang gling bu'o dbang bskur ro/ /oṃ mahā ḍā ki nī rkarma abhi ṣiñca hūṃ/ zhesarkang dung 'bud du gas/'dir mig dar me tog sbyin/ de nas byin rlabasalha yi ye shes 'bebasapa ni/ maṇ+ḍal phul/ 11ba dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad —349

mkha' 'gro sde lnga'i rnam par spyan drangs/ steng 'og phyogs mtshams thams cad nas byon te/ khyed rang rnams la thim pas/ mdun bskyed kyi thugs ka nas kyang mkha' 'gro sde lnga dpag tu med pa gar stabs ling ling byung ste/ rgya comatsho'i la char bab pa bzhin du khyed rang la sib sib thim/ de nasarolamo'i sgra dang ṣ+ṭhasate/ gong gi lha bskyed pa'i sngagasakyis/ a be sha ya a āḥ zhesabatagasapa mang du brjod/ skyed su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swāhā/ zhesaspyi bor rdo rje bzhag pa la me tog gtor zhing brtan par bya/ snying khar rdo rje bzhag la/ gnas gsum mkha' 'gro sde lnga'i tshogs/ khyed kyi snying la yang dag zhugs/ /rtag tu byin gyis brlabs par byed/ /tshul 'di gzhan la ma smra zhig /cesagasang bar gdams/ ye shes mkha' 'gro'i tshogs bcas la/ /rigs pa me tog 'di 'bul nas/ /rigs lnga mkha' 'gros rjes bzung nas/ /bdud tshogs dbyings su grol bar shog /cesame tog 'bul du gzhug /e ma skal ldan rigs kyi bu/ /ltos shig ltos shig 'di la ltos/ /dkyil 'khor bzang po 'di la ltos/ khyed ni ye shes mkha' 'gro'i rigs/ /he badz+ra pā she /zhesabalta bar bskul/ mdun bskyed ji ltar bskyed pa bzhin du slob ma la lha ngo bstan/ maṇ+ḍal steng gi gtor ma lnga tsam ma cig ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma dang mkha' 'gro sde lnga'i tshogs dang bcas pa gsol 'debs su bcug /lasakyi rdo rjes lag tu bzung la/ dpon slob thams cad kyis gsol 'debs dbyangs dang bcas pa bya/ lag len la rgyal ba don 'grub kyis mdzad pa'i gsol 'debs dgongs skyod ma mdzad kyin 'dug /de rjes gtor dbang du spyi dang mthun par bskur la rol mo'i sgra bya/ de nas gtor ma las dngos grub kyi rdzasacung zad re slob ma rnams la thob byar 'jug /zan zhi ba/ mar rgyasapa/ bu ram dbang /sha nasamangon spyod grub bo zhesabya/ rjesakhas len maṇ+ḍal yon 'bul ba spyi dang dang 'dra/ de dag la sdom ni/ chosabashad maṇ+ḍal gsol btab —350

dang / /bgegs gtor mdo sgrub skyabs sems 'bogs/ /ngo sprod gnyis dang rjesaganang lnga/ /lha yi byin dbab rten gnas la/ /dam bzhag me tog gtor ba dang / /blta bar bskul nas lha ngo bstan/ /gsol 'debs gtor dbang dngos grub rnams/ /rjes kyi bya ba spyi dang mthun/ /zhes so/ /de nas tshogs phud 'bul ba nas brtsams/ lha'i gtor ma gtong ba'i bar du bya zhing / de rjes yig brgya bzod gsol gshegs su gsol/ dam tshig pa rang la bsdu ba/ smon lam bkra shis rnams bya'o/ /tshogs gzhung sogs cho ga'i rgyan chog rnams la/ bla ma snga ma rnams kyis 'gros nag gi lugs bzhin mdzad pa ni/ de la yi dam mdzad pa'i bag chags btab pa tsam yin gyi/ gcig tu nges par dgos pa ma yin la/ phag mo bdag med ma la sogs pa rigs tshad ldan zhig gis cho ga gang la brten kyang chogade ltar gcod kyi chos dbang sems la bskur ba'i lag len 'di yang / lhag chad 'gal 'khrul nor ba'i skyon thams cad spangs te/ byin rlabs bla ma brgyud pa'i phyag len bzhin tā ra nā thas smras pa'o// //de ltar gcod tshogs po ti brgya brgyad kyi/ /yang snying man ngag legs bshad rin chen 'phreng / /mkha' mnyam 'gro ba'i chos 'byor gyis 'bul ba/ /sel phyir gragasapa dpal bzang ded dpon gyis/ /rdo rje 'chang dngos tā ra nā tha yis/ /gsung rab rgya mtsho'i nub gyur rab dgongs nas/ /kun la phan phyir lag len bca' bar bris/ /'dis mtshon dus gsum dge ba rgya mtsho las/ /'gro kun kun mkhyen sangs rgyas myur thob shog /gcod yul nam mkha' sgo 'byed 'di nyid kyis/ khams gsum 'gro kun bdag gis smin byas nas/ /phan dang bde ba'i mkha' dbyings gang ba dang / /ngesadon bstan pa dar ba'i bkra shis 3|ga /bkra shis/ /—351—

na mo gu sa 'pho ba'i man ngag ni/ 'pho ba 'debs yul des/ sngar chosakyi go ba yod pa 'debs dgos pa des kyang rig pa dwangs shing dmigs pa gsal theb pa 'dug na 'di ltar bya ste de bla ma la mos nas bla ma steng gi nam mkha' la bzhugs par mos la/ yi dam la mos nas yi dam steng gi nam mkha' la bzhugs par bsam/ mosagus gdung bas gsol 'debasasu bcug kho rang gi rnam shes mar me 'dra ba gcig spyi bo sogs gang bde zhig las sbyangs te thon la/ bla ma yi dam kyi thugs kur thim/ yang mosagus byed du bcug /thugasakar thim pa'i mos gus byed du bcug /de ka skyar gyin lan mang du gsal btab nas de kho na man ngag gi dmigs pa byed du bcug /rang re yi dam kyi bstod dbyangs gsol 'debs su gyer/ bstod pa gsol 'debs la so so'i rang lugs su byas pa'i chog /de dag gi bar du 'di skad ces bya ste/ rang gi spyi gtsug mda' gang tsam gyi steng gi nam ma/ba' la rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje 'chang chen po sku mdog sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis rdo rje dang dril bu thugs gar bsnol nas bzung ba/ zhabs rdo rje skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ mtshan dpe rdzogs shing pad zla'i gdan la bzhugs pa zhig legs par gsal thob la/ khyed rang gi lus 'di nyid khang stong ka ba gcig pa lta bu phyi gsal nang gsal dwangs gsal 'od kyi rang bzhin can lte ba nas spyi gtsug gi bar du rtsa dbu ma drang tha le'i yar zug nas spyi gtsug kha yangs su song ba rgya mthong kha ha re phyes yod pa lta bu/ snying kha'i thad tsam gyi rtsa dbu ma'i nang na rnam —352

shes kyi ngo bo mar me me lce lta bu 'od lam me yod pa gcig gsal btab nas gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/༈ rje mtshan ldan gyi bla ma rin po che/ /dus da ltar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ /'gro drug gi skye sgo bkag tu gsol/ /bar do'i 'khrul pa bsal du gsol/ /thar pa'i lam sna 'dren du gsol/ /byin rlabs kyi tshan ka dbab tu gsol/ /chos nyid kyi don dang sprad du gsol/ /dus la bab bo thugs rje can/khyed thugs chos nyid kyi dkyil 'khor du/ /bdag sogs kyi rig pa dri med thim/ /mnyam nyid kyi ngang las ma g.yos kyang / /mos gus kyi sa lam bsgrod par 3|ga /ces gsol ba btab pa la brten nas bla ma'i thugs ka nas 'od zer lcags kyu lta bu thur du rgyug nas snying kha'i rnam par shes pa'i ngo bo mar me me lce lta bu 'od lam me yod pa de yar drangs nas rtsa ba'i bla ma'i thugs gar thim/ bla ma'i thugs dang khyed rang gi sems dbyer med du 'dres nas nam mkha' la 'ja' yal ba bzhin du mos pa mdzod/ de'i ngang der cung zad cig mnyam par bzhag go/phaṭa/ ces lan gsum brjod la dbyings su cham me bzhag go/'o che ge mo de lta bu'i dmigs pa yang yang byang dgos pas slar yang dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ khyed rang gi spyi gtsug mda' gang tsam gyis steng gi nam mkha' la sogs gong gi rigs 'gre/ de lta bu'i tshul gyi lan gsum lan bdun bdun nyer gcig sogs skabs dang bstun pa'i rang gis kyang nang nub la ma 'chags par sbyang ba dang / gzhan tshe 'das pa la'ang las la sbyar ba de bzhin du bya'o/ /phyi'i snang ba cung zad bsdus pa'i skabs su sleb na snyan la skad gsang mthon pos bos te/khyod bsod nams bsags pa'i bla ma che ge mo 'di na grong gi byon gda'/ da —353

dung mos gus yang yang sgom shig /cesasogasaspro ba bskyed du bas /de'i bar du rang gi kyang 'pho ba'i dmigs pa kho na spo la rang gang mos pa'i yi dmamam bla ma'i thugs gar 'pho ba'i dmigs pa yang yang bsam la/ zas nor gyi 'dun pa dang khengasadregasasogs mi byed par nges 'byung dung nge ba dang snying rje'i sgo nasasbyangasapa'i phan yon ni shin tu che bar yod/ yi dam la mosana'ang bstod pa'i/ yi dam thugs rje dbang phyug rnams/ /dus da lta byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ /'gro drug gi skye sgo sogs/ mosagusasogasasngar bzhin sbyar ba'i chog /lugs so sor nas blang ba'i 'pho ba'i dmigasapa sgom myong ba'i mi yin na/ kho rang sngar bsgom myong ba de bsgom du bcug pasachog /gzhan sngar dang 'dra/ sngar chosakyi go ba med pas/ de dusadamigs pa gsal mi thebs pa dang / sngar go ba yod kyang de dus rig pa gsal dwangasanyamasa'adug na/ dad pa'am snying rje'am ngesa'abyung sogs gang rung zhig rna bar bshad nas mtshams spyor gyis sems dge ba zhig yod par bya/ rang res rtsa brgyud gyi bla ma yi dam dbyer med du mosal/ de'ang rang ngo la cher re bltasal/ phaṭa/ ces dbyings su cham te sgyur/ smon lam yang yang 'debasapa nyid gnad kyi snying po yin no/ /sngagasachu sogasabyin/ 'thung du bcug nas/ skra lhag lan gsum 'then par bya/ mgron bu pho chen bsregasathal/rdo khab len/ rgya tsha tshal/ cu gang rnamasakyi phyi ma sbrang ston la sbyor ba'ang spyi gtsug gi mthil du byugs/ spyi bo'i steng gi nam mkhar sgra snyan pa cung zad cig yod par bya/ skabasathamasacad du smon lam yang yang 'debs pa gnad du che/ sngagasachu'i sgom bzlas byed tshul ni/ rang nyid lha mo ye shes dbang phyug ma dkar mo kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dang thod pa 'dzin pa zhi ma khro dbu skra dmar ser dar dang rin po che dang / rusapas brgyan pa gcig tu bsgoms nas/ oṃ gisaswāhā/ sum̐ k+ṣu sum̐ hūṃ/ 11sgrornyazhes pal sngon du bsnyen pa 'bum tsam bzlas la/ dgos dus su brgya rtsa bzla ba'i bkluphumuXgasachus—354

'am bum chu khong du gtong ba dang / bu ga dgu'am/ lte ba dang snying ga smin mtshams la sogasapar thig le tsam byas pas kyang ngan song gi sgo khegs par bshad do// //'pho ba nyer mkho 'di yang rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas smras pa'o/ /'dir bzhad dge ba'i zla zer gyis/ /bstan 'gro'i legs dge'i ku mud tshal/ /yongs rgyas dga' ston gsar pa'i dpal/ /srid mtha'i bar tu nyams med therteg /dge'o/ bkra shis pa gyur cig /༄༅/ /'pho ba hika dgu ma bzhugs/skye( swā sti/ skyabasasems sngon du 'gro ba'i/ rang nyid sha khrag gi gdos bcas ma yin pa/ rang dus 'khor lhan skyes sku mdog sngon po rkyal pa sbub stong dag shel sngon po'i dbyibs su bsgom pa'i/ rtsa dbu ma mda' snyug 'bring po tsam lus kyi dbus su srog shing tshul gi du yod pa/ mar sne lte 'og sor bzhi tsam la zug pa/ yar sne spyi bor tshangs bug tu zug pa'o/ /spyi bor haṃ dkar po mgo bo thur du lta ba/ dpral bar oṃ dkar bo mgo bo thur du blta ba/ mgrin par āḥdamar po mgo bo thur du blta ba/ snying gar hūṃ sngon po mgo bo gyen du blta ba/lte bar swā ser bo mgo bo gyen du blta ba/ dbu ma'i mar sna'i a yig dmar po ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbyibs can rnams bsgoms pa'i mthar bshang sgo bsdams pa dang / hika ces brjod pa'i tshe me rlung drangs pa'i rkyen gyis āḥyig la me 'bar ba'i dbu ma'i nang nas yar song bas/ yang tig ces brjod pa'i yang rlung drangs pa'i rkyen gyi lte ba'i swā yig ser po la phog pas thig le ser —355

por gyur/ yang hika ces brjod pa'i rkyen gyi snying ga'i hūṃ yig la phog pas thig le nag por gyur/ sngar gyi thig le ser po dang ro gcig tu 'dres pas ser nag tu gyur/ yang hika ces brjod pa'i rkyen gyi steng rlung thur du mnan pa'i spyi bor haṃ dkar po la phog pas haṃ yig thig le dkar po'i rnam par zhu/ yang hika ces brjod pas rlung thur du mnan pa'i rkyen gyi/ dpral bar oṃ dang 'dres pas thig le dkar po gyur/ yang hika ces brjod pas rlung thur du mnan pa'i mgrin par āḥl phog sngar gyi thig le dkar po dang ro gcig tu 'dres/ thig le dkar dmar 'dres pa/ yang hig ces brjod pas rlung thur du mnan pa'i rkyen gyi thig le dmar po de nyid snying ga'i thig le ser nag la thim pa'i thig le khra bo sran ma tsam mam yungs 'bru tsam gang rung bsgom pa'i mthar hig gsum dang bcas dbu ma'i nang nas yar song bas sor bcu drug gzhal ba'i spyi gtsug steng gi nam mkha' la chos sku'i bla ma dus kyi 'khor lo'i thugs gar yid gnyis the tshom med par 'phos/ // spyi bor thar pa'i sgo chen yangs pa mā /skyabs gnas bslu ba med pa'i rdo rje 'chang / /nges 'byung gdung shug drag pos gsol ba 'debs/ /bla ma'i thugs gar 'pho bar byin gyis rlobs/ /dpal ldan bla ma'i rnam par thar ba — sogs/ skye ba kun tu yang dag sogs/ yi dam la mos na/ yi dam thugs rje'i dbang phyug rnams/ /dus da lta byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ /zhes man chad sngar bzhin sbyar bas chog go/'di'i mdzad byang mi snang yang tā ra nā tha'i gsung yin par grags so/ /mthile/ /—356

bcad ma zhugs/na mo mañju nā tha ya/ ris med rdo rje'i gsang gsum dpa' bo ni/ /gzung 'dzin g.yem ma'i co 'dri nyid kyis kyang / /zung 'jug rtse dga'i dga' ston rgyas nas slar/ /rang bzhin bde ba'i khyim du ngal bsos shig /'dir ni bla ma'i man ngag zhig /dran pa'i snod du ci gnas pa/ /de tsam yi ger 'bri ba la/ /grub pa rnams kyis dgyes pa'i rigs/ /de phyir dam tshig mkhyen pa rnams/ /mnyes shing bzod par gyur na ni/ /thos pa tsam gyis mkhas rlom sogs/ khams gsum gshe bar gyur kyang sla/ /de la phyir bzlog rnam pa brgyad/ /phyi yi bar chad bzlog pa yi/ /bsam gtan 'brul 'khor gzhan du bshad/ /'dir gang nges pa'i don bshad do/ /stag dang phag gi sgra dang ni/ /gtun shing dang ni mtshon cha'o/ /dgang dang dgug dang gzhol dang rengs/ /de ltar rlung gi rnal 'byor ro/ /stag gi sgra ni ha gsum dang / /hūṃ gsum ngag tu brjod par bya/ /pus mor lag bkab gru mo ni/ /rtsibs 31gas la brdeg phag skad 'byin/ /lag pas pus bkab lte 'og ni/ /g.yas g.yon mdun rgyab sdeb gtun shing / /mtshon cha rting g.yon bshang lam gtad/ /de mdun g.yas bzhags bol gnyis bzung / /g.yas g.yon dbus rngub rang phyogs bskor/ /bgang ba thub tshad rngub pa dang / /dgug pa mchil ma mid nas mnan/ /gzhil ba rngub chung byed pa —357

dang / /rengs pa rtsol klod thad gar blta/ /sbyor ba bzhi la dor ba zlas sbyor/ /rtsol med rdo rje'i bzlas pa'ang bya/ /lte snying lte la zla bar hūṃ/ /spyi bo nas ni rkang pa'i bar/ /gang ba bum can bsgom pa'o/ /rkang gnyis g.yas g.yon gsang bar srubs/ /kum+bha ka yi bogs 'don no/ /rlung gi phyir bzlog go /dga' dang skyid dang dgra dang gdon/ /mya ngan nad dang mi snyan sogs/ /thams cad rang bzhin ma grub pas/ /mnyam pa nyid du blta bar bya/ /mnyam pa nyid kyi phyir bzlog go /bde sdug ya nga ngo tsha dang / /nyon mongs gang skyes thams cad la/ /rang bzhin gsal stong me long blta/ /rang la gces 'dzin med par bya/ /lus ni sangs rgyas rnams la 'bul/ /gnod byed rnams la lus kyi sbyin/ /thams cad stong par shes par bya/ /de ni mnyam nyid ye shes so/ /'dod chags so sor rtog pa ste/ /phyag rgya bzhi la sbyor thabs yin/ /lta bar 'dod pa'i smra gtam dang / /dri ro reg dang gnyis sprod bzhi/ /reg dang bcug dang skyod dang mthar/ /lhan skyes phyi nang dga' bzhi por/ /rang rig gsal stong bsgom par bya/ /las rgya lan gakhrig myong byas nas/ /phyi nas myong pas bsgrub par bya/ /snying rje dang ni bya ba kun/ /rang bzhin stong pa gsal rig bsgom/ /bya ba sdo/ba pa de bzhin ste/ /mtha' bral sems la mtha' mi bsgom/ /ma bcos rang bzhin nyid las ni/ khro bo bde mchog gar mdzad pa/ /yid gyi rang bzhin stong par bsgom/ /rang bzhin med kyang nga rgyal ni/ /chos dbyings ye shes zhes bya'o/ /ye shes 'khor los phyir bzlos pa'o/ /dgra dang bgegs sogs gnod ribyed rnams/ /rang bzhin gyis ni ma grub kyang / /las nyon gyis ni 'khor bar —358

'khor/ /de la snying rje drag tu bsgom/ /sems can kun la byang sems dang / /snying rjes bde sdug brje bar bya/ /mi dang mi ma yin pa la/ /gnod pa mi bya brtse bar bya/ /mi 'dod pa yis non pa'i tshe/ /gzhan gyi sdug bsngal bsdu bar bya/ /snying rjes phyir bzlog pa'o/ /ci tsam gzung 'dzin snang ba kun/ /thams cad ye shes nyid du shes/ /gnyis 'dzin rgyun chags thams cad bya/ /'khrul pa thams cad skad cig tsam/ /rang rig skad cig 'gyur ba med/ /snang ba ci dang ci shar la/ /gsal tsam de la mnyam par bzhag /gsal stong tsam yang mi bsam dang / /bde sdug snang tsam la lta dang / /ngo bo med par dpyod pa gsum/ /'di yi gdams ngag yin zhes kyang / /rang rig skad cig gis phyir bzlog pa'o/ /rang sems gnod byed sems la thim/ /rang gzhan brje ba'i dmigs pa bya/ /lha sngags gnod byed la rber+shags pa/ /thams cad 'khrul pa shes par bya/ /'di nyid gnyis med ye shes la/ /kun rtog dra bas bcings nas ci/ /gnod bya gnon byed thams cad ni/ /sgyu ma'i dgra gnyen bzhin du blta/ /thob bya thob byed thams cad kyang / /rmi lam rgyal po'i rgyal srid bzhin/ /re dogs med par bsgom par bya/ /drod rtags gang la'ang dga' mi bya/ /gang la'ang ma zhen skyon mi lta/ /rang sems las gzhan sangs rgyas med/ /gnod bya gnod byed thob bya sogs/ /gang bsam rig stong ngang la bzhag /bdag bstod bsnyems 'khrig kun spangs so/ /legs pa thams cad bla ma'i drin/ /rkyen kun lha dang bla mar bsgom/ /yul dang spyod pa sna tshogs pas/ /nyams ni sna tshogs spros bral bsgom/ /srid zhi mnyam nyid kyis bzlog — —359 sna

pa'o/ /lha sngags bla ma las 'brasabarnyas mi bya/ /'jig rten mthun 'jug kun ra tsho tshog 〈〈 ra tsha /) shāni skusgo spron yigaspangs spyan pa' la/ /chas da ngas rang ba na sa gnyas bral bsgom// //r+ṣa pa 'di yang tā ra nā thas smrasapa grub pa'i gsung bzhi rang lo nyer gnyisapa la bris pa'o/ /maṅga yaṃ//ri —360

bla ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rlung gi phyir bzlog gi skabs/ ha gsum la yid kyis hūṃ gi sgrar mos ha hūṃ drug char la/ hūṃ ring po dang hoḥthung ngu 'byung rngubs dang sbyar ba'i rdor bzlas bya ba yin la/ phag skad la yang hūṃ dang 'dra/grangs nges pa med pa hūṃ gsum gyi skabs hūṃ ngag tu brjod pa ni/ gre ba'i sbubs nas snar 'don gyi kha nas mi byed phag skad gyi sna nas ngur sgra 'don pa yin/gtun shing brdeb pa bzhi po lan gnyis gnyis bya/ mtshon cha'i skabs bol gnyis lag pas 'dzin/ rang phyogs skor ba ni/ dpung pa g.yon pas sna bug g.yon bkab/ g.yas nas rngub/ kha sbyor grub ma thag lto ba g.yas su bskor/gzhan gnyis la'ang phal cher 'gre/ dbus gnyis ka la rngub g.yas g.yon spel mar bskor/ bzhi po gcig rting la gcig bsgom pa la 'bad pa zhag nyi shu tsam bya/ bar bar du rdor bzlas spyi dang mthun pa bya ste 'di rnams la dbu ma mi bsgom/ dngos gzhi bum can skabs dbu ma'i nang du k+ṇi dmar nag 'og dang dmar skya steng du bya/ yar 'gro mar 'gro mang po byas / la thim par bsgom/'di la'ang rdor bzlas sbyor na/ 'di dang phyi ma gnyis ka ste gsum la 'bru gsum sbyor/ sbyor ba phyi ma rtsa drwa ba ma gtogs gzhan mi bsgom/ bogs 'don skabs ro rkyang gsang gnas nas dbu mar thim par bsgom/ grub lugs de phyogs kyi 'phongs tshos dang rkang pa bteg gcig re/sa sa la btsugs/—361—

gnyis char skyil krung ma zhig pa'o/ /lus sangs rgyas la 'bul ba la mchod rdzas dang bdud rtsir byas par 'bul/ gnod byed la gang 'dod pa bcad nas ster ba'ang mdzad/ gces 'dzin ni rang la gces 'dzin te/ nga zhes bzung nas / na yis dogs/ shi yis dogs/ sdug gi dogs / gtam mi snyan pa byung gi dogs/ de'i logs phyogs rnams yongs su re ba'i rang 'dod nga mtho na dgra dma' na snyam pa sogs gang yang mi byed pa'o/ khro bo bde mchog gar mdzad pa ni/ spros bral gyi ngang nas thol gyis shar ba'i rig pa rang hūṃ mdzad lta bu'am he ru gar bskyed pa'o/ /gnyis 'dzin rgyun chags ni shar dus nyid nas rang grol ma song ba'i zhabrul ba'i rab rib bo/ rang gnod byed la thim pa'i man ngag ni/rang lus la ni gnod byed kho ci 'dod pa gcig bya/ sems hūṃ gi rnam pa de'i snying gar thim pas rang sems dang de dbyer med du song / de nas spros bral gyi ngang skyong / zab gsal gnyis su med pa bsgom/ rang gzhan brje ba ni/ rang dang gnod byed ces bya ba don la med kyang sems kyi snang ba tsam zhes nges pas rang de dang de ru bsgom pa'o/ rkyen lhar sgom pa ni/ dgra gdon bde sdug cing byung yang / rang dang de gnyis ka lha'i skur wal gyis mos/ de bla ma'i ngo bor bsgom/ mos gus dung dung gsol ba btab rang la thim/ spros bral gyi ngang skyong / bya ba spyod pa thams cad la snyem chod chod/ snang stong la cer cer mnyam par 'jog /'di'i gtso bo ye shes 'khor lo'i chos dbyings ye shes kyi nyams len yin/ de'i bogs 'don gyi gtso bo sor rtog ye shes phyag rgya'i rnal 'byor dang rlung gi phyir bzlog gnyis yin/ gzhan rnams de dag gi yan lag yin —362

no/ /'dir dang po gsum nang gi byad ma phyir bzlog ste/ las dang po pa la thun dang rnal 'dresar ba la yang mnyam bzhag gces che/ phyi ma gan+da/ma cha mnyam/ tha ma 'bras bu la rjeXr ba yang nyams len da lta byed/ 'bras bu la dmigs pa re dogs 'gog pa dang / 'bras bu 'grub pa la bar chad lam du da lta nas 'khyer tshul yin/ de thams cad la snang ba gang snang des rtsal ma 'gags/ ma bcos pa la gshis cing yang ma grub pa'i rig stong de gal che shos yin/ gzhan dkyus na gsal/ nges don zab mo/ bar chad thams cad nang gi rnal 'byor gyis bzlog pa'i tshul phyir bzlog drug gi man ngag tshigs bcad ma'i gab pa mngon du gsal ba'i yig chung 'di yang tā ra nā thas rang lo nyer gnyis pa la bla ma'i gsung bzhin bris/ man ngag gi yi ge 'di shin tu gsang ba chen po yin pas gces pa bzung / 'di'i go don rgyud las bstan tshod kyi man ngag gi bshad pa/mkhas pa'i rnar 'ong zhing yid ches nges pa rnams khro bor rnam rol du bris zin to/ /o rgyan las byung man ngag 'di/ /gu ru lho phyogs pa yi drin/ /gzhan dag mgu ba ma yin yang / /rang nyid yid ches rmad du byung / khro bo rnam rol dang man ngag gi yi ge 'di gnyis mi sus kyang ma bskul zhing bris pa la rjes su yi rangs pa tsam yang mi snang mod mtshan ma rnyed nas brjed thor bris/ /gal+yan tilgadage'o/ /—363

dpo sgrig 'gan 'khur pa/ tshangs po/mdun shog mdzes 'god pa/ 'gro 'dul rdo rje/spen dugashe (1la 'dan la5/deb gya gcig pa/༄7/ /jo nang tā ra na tha'i gsung 'bum/(39(45)dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jus lang gis bsgrigs//jikrung go'i bod rig pa dpe skrun khang gis bskrun te bkram/pe cin ma'o rin tshon khra par 'debs kung sis dpar btab/spyi lo 2008lo'i zla 4par par gzhi dang po bsgrigs/spyi lo 2008lo'i zla 4par par thengs dang po btab/dpar grangs/ 0001wa 15001525978—7—80253—013—372 51gsung 'bum cha tshang (deb 1—45yod )la rin sgor/ 910 00

nged dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang gi las sgrub mi snar lo bstud mar 'tsho ba'i yon sbyor gnang mkhan mchog sprul pad+ma dbang rgyal rin po che la snying thag pa nas thugs rje zhu ba dang /krung go'i bod rig pa dpe skrun khang nas rje btsun tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum dpe bsdur ma par skrun thad la rgyab skyor dang mnyam las gnang bar snying thag pa nas thugs rje che zhu ba yin/dpar yon zhal 'debs gnang mkhan/rang re'i spun zla rnams kyi mtshan tho/ ka mad kyi go rim ltar lags/gdung sras phrin las nor bu rin po che/ bla ma mthar phyin rin po che/ bla ma yon tan/sman pa rig 'dzin lags/ las rab gling pa rin po che/ bsod nams bde skyid/

zlo rna dī ṇa r+sha 6 4 6 ge —— 4zlo// / ba yi na go snye— — — da ge ༷ dzo li 'i tsā0man ba sde ba ra ne ༄ waXne rngu ༷ doXrdo sde 454༷ me khapa pho rdzi sa tswa ༄ 4 mo1 — — — — ri~X nga risgyukhu nga ( 1 — — / — 1 skuX— 45༷ 67jiXdzes༄༷ /1— —— 3 4 gi4 4 4 ci snying4— — — — —4 ske 4) mi 4 r+sha pha — — —— — — —— ste tshe r+sharnya sa stu nang 3 — 3————
